sections.heading: Dark Horizons
sections.text:
Megatronus reigned over the Alliance Missions from April 5, 2019 to April 3, 2020. All three maps have been reworked with new names.

It’s time for the highly anticipated update to Alliance Missions! The first thing you’re going to notice is that all of the names have changed. Every Encounter, Boss and Buff on all of these Maps have been updated. And that’s not all… The brand new Fractured Tomb map (Map 3) has been completely revamped with a new Layout, and now goes up to Difficulty 120! 

*We had a few goals with this update:
**We wanted to get more creative with our usage of buffs in order to introduce new Alliances to more challenging fights, and create more engaging encounters for experienced players.
**We wanted to give Fractured Tomb a more streamlined Map, so you can focus more on the Fights, and less on navigation.
**We wanted to give more opportunities for players to team up on especially difficult fights.
**And lastly, we wanted to change up linked nodes so that our more daring Commanders can still try and fight through a linked node without it being impossible.

Welcome to Dark Horizons!

All new encounters means all new Mini-Bosses and Bosses! 

*Map 01 - Fallen Empire
**Miniboss 01: Starscream
***25% Ranged Dmg and 192 Ranged Speed
***When player's Bot activates a Buff, the boss will activate a similar Buff.
***50% Health Boost
**Miniboss 02: Hot Rod
***25% Ranged Dmg and 192 Ranged Speed
***Debuff duration on opponents is increased by 25%
***50% Health Boost
**Boss: Galvatron
***Every 7.5 seconds, alternates between 39% Physical or Energy Res.
***Heavy Attacks randomly inflict the opponent with a Stun for 1.5 seconds, Power Lock for 4 seconds or a 25% Armor Break for 7 seconds.
***100% Health Boost
*Map 02 - Orbital Command
**Miniboss 01: Wheeljack
***Heavy Attacks Stun for 2.5 Seconds.
***If not struck by a melee attack within 6 seconds, Power Gain for 3% every second.
***100% Health Boost
**Miniboss 02: Scorponok
***Heavy Attacks randomly inflict the opponent with a Stun for 2 seconds, Power Lock for 5 seconds or a 35% Armor Break for 7 seconds.
***When hit by a Special Attack, this enemy gains 1 Bar of Power.
***100% Health Boost
**Miniboss 03: Jetfire
***Gains 15% of a powerbar while blocking
***When player's Bot activates a Buff, the boss will activate a similar Buff. 50% more effective than Rank 1
***100% Health Boost
**Boss: Cyclonus
***Every 7.5 seconds, alternates between 55% Physical or Energy Res.
***When Hit this bot generates a Power Charge. When this bot reaches 8 Power Charges, the next successful hit within 5 seconds consumes all charges, generating 300 Power.
***300% Health Boost
*Map 03 - Fractured Tomb
**Miniboss 01: Megatron GS
***150% Melee Dmg
***Every 7.5 seconds, alternates between 65% Physical or Energy Res.
***Heals 75% of opponents Attack when hit by a Basic Ranged Attack.
***300% Health Boost
**Miniboss 02: Shockwave
***Debuff duration on opponents is increased by 100%
***Projectile attacks do 100% of attack as shock dmg over 7.5 sec
***If not struck by a melee attack within 6 seconds, Power Gain for 3% every second.
***300% Health Boost
**Right Lieutenant: Cyclonus
***Buff duration is increased by 100%
***Every 7.5 seconds, alternates between 65% Physical or Energy Res.
***When Hit this bot generates a Power Charge. When this bot reaches 8 Power Charges, the next successful hit within 5 seconds consumes all charges, generating 300 Power.
***300% Health Boost
**Left Lieutenant: Galvatron
***Gains 7.5% of a powerbar while blocking
***150% Ranged Dmg and 208 Ranged Speed
***75% Physical Res
***300% Health Boost
**Boss: Megatronus
***When player's Bot activates a Buff, the boss will activate a similar Buff.
***Cycles through Melee, Ranged and Special Damage Resistances. All resistances are at 130%.
***Basic Attacks are Unblockable.
***Basic and Heavy Ranged Attacks drain a small amount of Power on Hit.
***Basic and Heavy Melee Attacks drain a small amount of Power on Hit.
***500% Health Boost
*Mod Combinations
**Map 01 - Fallen Empire
***Section 1 - Buffs, Debuffs, and Timed Attacks
****Path 1: Debuff Duration
****Path 2: Energon Shield
****Path 3: Buff Duration
***Section 2 - Alternate Power Gain
****Path 1: Strike Back
****Path 2: Power Charge
****Path 3: Power Flow Timed
***Section 3 - Introduction to Difficult Buff Nodes
****Path 1: Absorb Projectile
****Path 2: Shock Block
****Path 3: Reflect Ranged
**Map 02 - Orbital Command
***Section 1 - Power Gain and Buff Activation
****Path 1: Evade Melee and Evade Power Gain
****Path 2: Energon Shield and Power Charge
****Path 3: Trigger Rate and Buff Duration
****Path 4: Special Damage and Power Flow Timed
***Section 2 - Alternative Power Gain

***Section 1 - Melee Combat Focus

*Rewards:
**You’ll notice that the Crystal rewards have not changed. Don’t worry! We’re trying something new here, and we want to make sure that we have the balance right before we update the rewards. We want to make sure the rewards match the difficulty. So, while there isn’t a change to the Crystal contents just yet, we are working on that!
**We’ve also added T4C Spark Crystal Fragments to the Top 10 Rank Rewards, and a new Top Milestone of 30,000,000.
**Expect a more comprehensive Rewards update after you’ve had some time with the new Maps!

sections.heading: Recommendations
sections.text:
Alliance Leaders:

Push yourself to do higher difficulty Alliance Missions. The rewards are worth it, in order to help you progress further with the rank-up materials you need to advance further. This is especially important once you start having rank 3 4* bots. You'll keep getting Repair and Revive Kits via crystals and Raid Store rotating offers. They will go to waste if you remain comfortable at the current AM difficulty (be it Shattered Lands or Sanctum map). 

Once your 18 members are ready, push up for higher difficulty. There might still be a few that aren't strong enough hence that is when you replace them with stronger members. An alliance family helps a lot as you can swap weak/strong members down/up of the alliances so that replacing members isn't as much as a chore.

Alliance Quest.lead:
Alliance events are special events for you and your alliance. Work together with your alliance and complete the required tasks to accumulate points. Contributing to the end goals of the mission makes you eligible for rewards. Reach new milestones, earn rewards, and improve your chances to get special alliance rewards together.

Note: Keep in mind that although alliance mission milestones and rank rewards can often be claimed by anyone in the alliance regardless of participation, some alliance events require that you participate in order to unlock these rewards.

Alliance events are located in the bottom-right corner of your home screen:

sections.heading: Blackout Period
sections.text:
There is a prize blackout period associated with alliance events and the delivery of the rewards in order to prevent the exploitation of alliance hopping. During this blackout period, alliance members will not be able to earn rewards for participating in events. This blackout impacts every player joining a new alliance, regardless of any pre-existing membership.

Note: Players that are kicked from their alliances by an officer will be impacted by the blackout period in the same manner as a player who chooses to leave.

Important: The blackout period will not be waived prematurely. Kabam's support team will not be able to adjust this in any way. Once the appropriate time frame is over, players affected by the blackout will be able to participate in new alliance events.

Alliance.lead:
Commanders can create or join Alliances to work together to earn rewards and more by participating in Alliance Quests and Alliance Missions, and asking for Alliance Help. Access to Alliances are unlocked at level 5. 

Upon joining an Alliance for the first time, a Commander would receive a Premium Bot Crystal, 25 Energon, and 100 Loyalty. This was replaced with an Objective, which would give 20 Energon, 3 Alliance Crystals, and 1000 Gold.

sections.heading: Creation
sections.text:
You can choose to spend  25 Energon or 2,000 Arena Chips  to create a new Alliance. Start your own Alliance in the Alliance Tab, by selecting ”Create Alliance”.

This will allow you to select:
* Your Alliance Name (not unique)
* Your Alliance Tag (unique)
* Description of the Alliance
* Privacy Type: Open, Closed or By Request

Notes
* An open Alliance allows every Player to join without sending a request.
* Selecting “By Request” forces users to send a request to the Alliance leader.
* Players cannot apply to join a closed Alliance.
* Description and privacy type can be changed by Alliance Leaders.

sections.heading: Ranks
sections.text:
Every Alliance has up to 18 Members, divided in 3 Ranks:
*Leader [only 1 per Alliance] - can update Alliance information, help, invite and accept new members, kick members from the Alliance, promote, and demote users.
*Officers [no limit] - can update Alliance information, help, invite and accept new members, and kick members from the Alliance.
*Members - can only help others.

If a Leader wishes to leave the Alliance, they will be able to promote an Officer to Leader. If the Leader leaves without promoting another member to that role, the player who has been in the Alliance the longest will be appointed Leader.

If all members leave an Alliance, it will be disbanded forever.

sections.heading: Leadership Change
sections.text:
Sometimes, for various reasons, alliance leaders can be inactive in the game. To make sure everyone continues to have a great experience, alliance leadership can be transferred to the next highest-ranking active member of the alliance.

Kabam's support team will assist players who contact us directly about leadership succession, as long as one of the following criteria is met:

* The alliance's current leader has been inactive for at least 28 days.
* The alliance's current leader has been temporarily suspended for 30 days.
* The alliance's current leader’s game account has been permanently closed from the game.
* The former alliance leader accidentally transferred leadership in the last 48 hours and contacts our support team directly.

The new leader will need to meet the following requirements:

* The member has been active in the game in the past 30 days.
* The member is the highest-ranking active member of the alliance (e.g. an officer).
* The member has been in the alliance the longest.

Important: Please note that Kabam is unable to make exceptions to this policy, and we will not consider leadership requests without an investigation. Requests that do not meet these requirements will not be granted the leadership position.

sections.heading: Alliance Help
sections.text:
* Remember that:
** You cannot ask for help if you are in an alliance by yourself.
** You can only ask for mission help when you run out of Energy.
** Each time an alliance member helps you, you gain one Energy.
** Each time you ask for help, up to 10 alliance members can provide help for missions, and five members can help you with arenas and player versus player (PvP) battles.
** You can only ask for mission help once every 12 hours.

Help your alliance to get Gold. You will earn 35 100 Gold each time you help alliance members, with a daily limit of 3,500 Gold. You can continue helping your alliance once you reach the cap of 3,500 Gold, but you will not receive extra Loyalty Points.

All active requests will be displayed in your alliance tab.

* Remember for Arena help:
** You cannot ask for help if you are in an alliance by yourself.
** You can ask for help after you fight with a bot in PvP mode if you are out of stamina.
** Each time an alliance member helps you in PvP mode, that character's cooldown is reduced by one minute.
** When you request PvP mode help, up to five alliance members can assist you.
** You can ask for PvP mode help once per character, per cooldown, and with no daily limit.

sections.heading: Alliance Chat
sections.text:
The alliance chat is a private chat channel for you and your alliance's members. You will need to join an alliance before you can access this chat window.

Once active, you can swipe left and right between global and alliance chat with your main chat bar.

You will need to have your alliance chat enabled via the in-game settings menu in order to see your alliance chat. If chat is enabled on your account, the blue square that you can tap to enable the feature should appear to be filled in completely.

sections.heading: Alliance Player Invites
sections.text:
In order to send alliance invites, you will need to be the leader of the alliance.

If you are the current leader:

# Tap on a player name in your chat window.
# Tap on the INVITE option to send the invitation to the alliance.

Note: This will only work for players in your chat channel.

Once the invite has been sent, the player will receive a message in their inbox.

sections.heading: Alliance Search Tool
sections.text:
If you are not part of an alliance, you will see recommended alliances first in the search results. These are all open alliances based on your strength, your country, and your language.

* SEARCHING FOR AN ALLIANCE WHEN YOU HAVE ALREADY JOINED ONE
* Tap the bulleted list icon on the top of the alliance menu next to the name of your current alliance.
* Access the search tool.
* (Screenshot of the alliance search window with the bulleted list icon highlighted)
* Enter an alliance name or tag to start the search.
* Note: You will have the option to filter the results by privacy type.

Arena Chip.lead:
Arena Chips are a currency used to purchase Arena Crystals. They can be earned from Away Missions, and they were awarded in Arenas, but have been replaced with whole Arena Crystals.

Arena Chips originally had more uses; they were described as being able to unlock new arenas, but this mechanic was either dropped or never came to be. They could be donated to an Alliance Treasury for Alliance Missions, but it was later disabled before the Treasury was eventually removed altogether.

As of v6.0, Arena Chips have been completely removed. They were replaced with Arena Crystals in Away Missions.

Category:Items

Arena.lead: The Arena is a versus game mode in which players can fight other player teams to earn Arena Crystals, milestone prizes and rank rewards.

sections.heading: How to play
sections.text:
For each match, you choose three of your Bots and pay 350 Gold, then select one of the three opponents Commander's teams given. They are random selections from other Commanders bots which are AI controlled, and can sometimes be CPU-generated "Optimus Team" or "Megatron Team" (You can change the selection for 5 Energon) Win 2 out of 3 fights to win a series and small amount of Gold and increase your win streak and score multiplier, up to 3x. As you win more matches, you will face higher-ranked Bots. If you lose a series, the win streak, score multiplier, and difficulty will be eset.

All of your bots can be used in the arena, regardless of their status on base defense, away missions, or missions. Each Bot has a cooldown period, counting down from when a bot is entered into a match . Bots with higher star ratings yield more points, but have longer cooldowns. You can ask for help from other Alliance members to shorten a Bot's cooldown and gain a small Arena Attack boost (max 20 stacks).

* 1-Star: ~452~ points, 1.5 hours, instant recharge for 5 Energon
* 2-Star: ~825~ points, 2 hours, instant recharge for 5 Energon
* 3-Star: ~1,760~ points, 3 hours, instant recharge for 10 Energon
* 4-Star: ~5,443~ points, 4 hours, instant recharge for 15 Energon
* 5-Star: ~6,921 ~points, 7 hours, instant recharge for 30 Energon

sections.heading: Class Clash
sections.text: Occasional weekly events have arenas for winning crystal shards of Class crystals from Tech Clash to Free-for-Alls.

sections.heading: OLD Bot Arenas
sections.text: Originally, twice for three days each, there were Bot Arenas for a featured Bot, split into 3-Star and 4-Star Arenas. (There were 2-Star Arenas for the first few Bots) Crystals and shards could be won from milestone and rank rewards, but only a few players could win the featured Bot. 3-Star Arenas only allow 1 and 2-Star Bots to enter, while 4-Star arenas only allow 3-Star Bots.

sections.heading: Arena Updates
sections.text:
From October 6, the arena system was completely rebuilt. [http://forums.transformersforgedtofight.com/discussion/2161/announcement-big-october-update/] There are now only 1-day arenas, each day focusing on one kind of item. All arenas now focus on ranked rewards distributed to more brackets, so the only milestone was a Rank Reward Unlock Ticket at 2,200 points. Arena Crystals are rewarded instead of Arena Chips. Featured Bot Arenas have been replaced with Featured Bot Chip Arenas, which run seven times for two weeks month.

In v6.0, Arenas were updated with milestones, and rank rewards were changed; Arena Crystals are now only awarded in milestones.

sections.heading: T4 Basic Bounty
sections.text:

sections.heading: Background
sections.text: Fleeing after the destruction of Cybertron, the Autobots sought refugee and stumbled upon Earth. Being tracked down by the Decepticons, both factions took the disguise of technology (specifically vehicles). The Autobots, aligned themselves with the Humans sharing common ideas, peace, liberty and freedom to defeat and end the Decepticons once and for all.

sections.heading: In game
sections.text: The Autobots are one of the four factions including Autobots, Decepticons, Maximals and Predacons. They are a group of Transformers who broke away from the Decepticons in order to seek peace.

sections.heading: Mission 1: Wrong Place, Wrong Time
sections.text:
Part 1:

Wheeljack: ...and you turn it back down, and we're back in our correct timeline.

Jetfire: Are you sure the vectors on your device were calibrated? First scans indicate something has gone wrong. Terribly wrong.

Wheeljack: A little faith in my abilities as an inventor would be appreciated, I'm a leader in my field.

Jetfire: According to this, we have jumped several years backwards in a parallel timeline of New Quintessa.

Wheeljack: ...something may have broken.

Jetfire: Since this is technically a parallel dimension it also won't allow me to return to our origin point. 

Wheeljack: ...to be fair, that's a new feature and is still relatively impressive. But, I can see how that presents a unique problem.

Part 2:

Grindor: Looks like some fresh metal has arrived, ready for the Autobot scrapheap.

Wheeljack: Oh great, I get to introduce the alternate timeline Decepticons to my knuckles all over again.

Jetfire: Alterations to timelines could have grave consequences, remember that.

Mixmaster: OH we'll make some grave alterations, like your face getting altered to a flaming wreck.

Wheeljack: Does the timeline have laws regarding excessive force being used in self defense?

Jetfire: The timeline doesn't have laws, just a series of warnings. I'm starting to doubt these two held high priority in world events.

Part 3:

Jetfire: I'm reading intense bursts of Dark Energon, packets of a strange virus, and pulses of energy which are increasing at a geometric rate.

Wheeljack: Yeah the little bars om my Chrono-Vector device are going up too. All red. Probably bad.

Jetfire: This has the signature of Megatronus all over it.

Bonecrusher: Who in the scrap is Megatronus? You mean Megatron? 

Wheeljack: Eavesdropping isn't very polite big fella.

Bonecrusher: Where are my manners...PLEASE, stand there as I tear you apart Auto-Scum.

sections.heading: Mission 2: Fight Fire With Fire
sections.text:
Part 1:

Jetfire: Wheeljack, this is wrong. Everything is wrong. We have failed.

Wheeljack: We're just out of the loop is all, we'll get in touch with Optimus or Marissa and then--

Jetfire: YOU HAVE DOOMED US!

Wheeljack: Control yourself! Think rationally!

Jetfire: I...I am sorry. Something came over me.

Part 2:

Starscream: Are my optics faulty? Have the fates brought me closure and delivered Skyfire to me?

Jetfire: This again...you are nothing if not predictable, Starscream. It's almost comforting.

Wheeljack: And he's goin' by Jetfire these days.

Starscream: Any name you choose, your function is the same: Destroy those who oppose the Decepticons.

Jetfire: MY FUNCTION IS TO FURTHER SCIENCE! 

Starscream: There's the fire I've been waiting for.

Part 3:

Wheeljack: Sorry to cut the reunion short, but if Megatronus isn't here yet there may be time to warn the others!

Jetfire: I DON'T TAKE ORDERS FROM YOU!

Wheeljack: Seems like an over-reaction. You feeling okay, bud?

Jetfire: YOU CLAIM TO BE A BOT OF SCIENCE! YOU ARE AND OBSCENE MOCKERY!

Wheeljack: Starting to get hurt feelings, I'd think real hard about what you're saying.

Jetfire: THE TIME FOR THINKING IS PAST! STARSCREAM WAS RIGHT! I CRAVE ONLY...DESTRUCTION!

sections.heading: Mission 3: Blast From The Past
sections.text:
Part 1:

Wheeljack: Sorry for forcing an unexpected restart on you there...how are your circuits?

Jetfire: All my circuits are...alert. The virus affecting my logic and aggression seems to be cleared.

Blaster: Wheeljack! Jetfire! I thought that was you squakin' on my speakers. You're a sight for sore signals

Wheeljack: So, this is hard to explain but we're actually--

Blaster: From a timeline that runs alongside but slightly ahead of this timeline, and Megatronus might be coming.

Jetfire: You've been listening to us this whole time?

Blaster: Most of the time, I flip stations.

Part 2:

Blaster: Dark Energon pulses and viruses have been affecting Autobots. Making them extra unpleasent.

Jetfire: Are we the only recent arrivals? Any other new Sparks detected? Megatronus perhaps?

Blaster: Oh if you're looking for trouble, head for the Forge. From what I hear Shockwave is sparking up a storm!

Wheeljack: Sounds like ultimate doom and evil waits ahead of us...let's get a move on then.

Blaster: We'll need reinforcements, luckily I think some is on the way.

Grimlock: GRAAAAAH! ME GRIMLOCK HEAD HURT! CRUSH ALL!

Jetfire: ...that is consistent to the type of luck we've been attracting.

Part 3:

Wheeljack: We need to get a signal out to Prime, or the Commander, or Marissa.

Blaster: I've tried all signals, somethinfg is blockin' my talkin'. I can receive signal but no transmissions getting out.

Bumblebee (DOTM): NO ONE IS GETTING OUT! NOT IN ONE PIECE AT LEAST!

Jetfire: Bumblebee...where is Prime?

Bumblebee(DOTM): WHO KNOWS! WHO CARES! A VOICE IN MY HEAD DEMANDS I END YOU!

Wheeljack: Let's try some percussive maintenance with Bee.

Jetfire: Yes, I'm certain that after a reboot Bumblebee will be infinitely better.

sections.heading: Mission 4: Mixed Messages
sections.text:
Part 1: 

Wheeljack: We've got to do something...we need reinforcements. I'm open to all options.

Blaster: There's something I wanted to try, hold on. All signal open do you copy?

Wheeljack: Are you pulling in more Autobots? Care to share with the class Blaster?

Blaster: Come on now, don't play dumb. I know you're picking up the meanin' of my readin'.

Jetfire: He's not playing dumb, he's just like this.

Wheeljack: HEY! It's part of my charm.

Blaster: So then I must mean business or I wouldn't be talking would I?

Part 2:

Blaster: Listen, there's some Dark Energon goin' on and we have to work together.

Jetfire: That's what we've been saying. Wheeljack is he stuck on a chrono-loop?

Blaster: Clear your static you glitch-headed loyalist! You wanna' get scrapped?

Wheeljack: You're kind of worrying us Blaster. Are you even hearing us?

Blaster: We can talk about rulers when there's a planet left to plan on!

Wheeljack: That sounds like a no.

Part 3:

Wheeljack: Jetfire, I say we drag Blaster along and keep moving to the source of this radiation. 

Blaster: The Forge! There's dark doings being done and we mean to stop it.

Wheeljack: That was dangerously close to a response that makes sense.

Blaster: That's what our time-hoppin' helpers have told us! That's why I'm talking to you!

Jetfire: Blaster! I demand to know who you're communicating with!

Blaster: Ruler Megatron! We'll see about that.

Jetfire: I've heard enough, he must be reacting to the virus in a unique fashion. Let's shut him down.

Blaster: Wait! NO! What are you doing?!

sections.heading: Mission 5: Herald Of Destruction
sections.text:
Part 1:

Jetfire: We must press on to the Forge, it is obvious that the disturbances are increasing.

Wheeljack: You have it on a map? Because all my signals are scrambled.

Jetfire: From what I have gathered thus far, as we get closer we will encounter more corrupted Autobots.

Optimus Prime (MV1): STAND DOWN OR BE DESTROYED!

Wheeljack: I'm simultaneously deeply disappointed you're right, and glad we're on the correct path.

Jetfire: Yes, I too feel complex emotions.

Part 2:

Wheeljack: Tough fight, but I think Optimus went easy on us.

Jetfire: It is possible he still had enough of his true self functioning to avoid removing our heads from our torsos.

Wheeljack: Is that...a thing he's prone to do?

Jetfire: It's not unprecedented. I think we're at the edge of the disturbance.

Jazz: THE VOICES! THEY SCREAM! THEY SAY TO END ALL WHO ENTER!

Wheeljack: ...yeah probably pretty close.

Part 3:

Jetfire: We have arrived. Prepare for anything.

Shockwave: Be gone! He is nearly here! I have heard him in my head, I have prepared all! We shall return to Cybertron as gods!

Jetfire: If you're referring to Megatronus he's not big on sharing power.

Shockwave: I do not need his power shared, I merely need to ride in the wake of his destruction and rule over what is still standing. 

Wheeljack: King Scrap of Junk-Mountain, it's a title that suits you.

Shockwave: The Forge has been tuned to your Chrono-Errors. It brings him! IT IS GLORIOUS!

Jetfire: Chrono-Errors? Shut it down, Wheeljack! Shut it down now!

sections.heading: Mission 6: Dark Arrival
sections.text:
Part 1:

Shockwave: You may have won a battle...but I shall still win this war. HE HAS ARRIVED!

Megatronus: Through time, space, and reality...I have to come to claim what is mine!

Jetfire: We are prepared for you this time.

Megatronus: No! You cannot fathom the lengths I have gone to reach this moment.

Wheeljack: Well if you want to tell us, we're willing to listen...as I power-up this very large laser.

Part 2: 

Megatronus: Your rips in time allowed me to absorb power and knowledge of the Titan, then I traveled back to when it still slumbered...

Wheeljack: Oh, he's actually monologuing. I didn't think he'd take that option.

Jetfire: Wheeljack he's toying with us, he's charging up for an attack.

Wheeljack: He hijacks our time-travel, he's using my dirty fighting idea...Think for yourself Mega-copy-and-paster!

Megatronus: Allow me to demonstrate a mere sample of what I have planned for your kind.

Part 3:

Wheeljack: He's not going down, I'm open to new plans...

Jetfire: We hold. We delay. We fight until our sparks extinguish. We don't let him leave this Forge.

Wheeljack: ...they better build some big statues of us for this. Chrome plated, Light up features.

Megatronus: There won't be anyone left to mourn you. 

Jetfire: Enough talk, let's get down to business.

sections.heading: Mission 1: Fuel
sections.text:
Part 1:

Soundwave: Decepticon Bonecrusher. You must follow me to assist with mission and signal tracking. Minesweeping form has tactical advantage.

Bonecrusher: Is this about those new Autobots I just fought?

Soundwave: Negative. New mission. Track and report. You are best utilized as front-line fodder in case of surprise attack.

Bonecrusher: Front of the line pass ey? Sounds like a promotion.

Soundwave: ...Subspace interference from Maximal forces is detected. Shockwave is utilizing the Forge. Communication a priority. We must eliminate their signals.

Bonecrusher: Crush 'em all?

Soundwave: Affirmative.

Bonecrusher: We're singing the same tune.

Part 2:

Bonecrusher: Hey, since you're a sound expert I have a question for you...what's that noise we make?

Soundwave: Question is flawed. Many noises created at all times by all Bots. Signals always overwhelming. 

Bonecrusher: The changin' noise. When we go from one thing to another. The "CHOKE-CHALK-CHEEK-CHOOSE" noise.

Soundwave: ...The emission "TSCHE-CHU-CHRR-CHU-TSCHE" is an Energon tracking signal sent during the quantum-shift of our atoms' position and purpose.

Bonecrusher: Oh. Swell. I just like it is all...Can't make it without converting. CHUNK-CHEESE-TICK-TOCK. See? Not the same.

Soundwave: This conversation has been unpleasant. Continue to next post to shut down Maximal presence.

 Part 3:

Cheetor: Hey! What's the big idea just sneaking up on folks and attacking? Buncha' Decepti-cowards?

Soundwave: Strange signal detected. Lives in balance. Maximal signal interfering. Solution: No Maximals.

Cheetor: You ever think about asking nicely?

Bonecrusher: Decepticons don't ASK for results, we just GET results. Ain't that right Soundblaster? 

Soundwave: WAVE! SOUNDWAVE! SOUNDWAVE SUPERIOR!

Cheetor: Yeah, great teamwork. Lets see how you hold together after I get my claws into you!

sections.heading: Mission 2: Fire
sections.text:
Part 1:

Soundwave: Incoming urgent transmission...

Bonecrusher: Ah, no Maximals and MAXIMUM signal. We're good at this.

Soundwave: Interference, signal unclear. Source unknown.

Bonecrusher: Sounds spooky, what are they saying? 

Soundwave: What is the purpose of this? Subspace communication opens chance for espionage.

Bonecrusher: Are you...talking to me? 

Soundwave: Make your intent clear or the signal and your Spark will be terminated.

Bonecrusher: HEY! You best watch yourself bud.

Part 2:

Scorponok: I saw you're kicking Maximal tail, what's a guy gotta' do to join up? 

Soundwave: Negative, additional assistance from inferior forces would only guarantee Decepticon demise.

Scorponok: No vote of confidence from the blank-faced tape-flipper, huh?

Bonecrusher: He has been weird. Some signal he's talking to. Think he may have switched his stations.

Soundwave: Decepticons shall rule what is left.

Bonecrusher: Alright so he's still talking SOME sense.

Part 3:

Soundwave: Forces should be focused upon the Forge.

Bonecruhser: The Forge? Nothing good comes in or out of there.

Soundwave: Shockwave is bringing a Spark back from the beyond.

Scorponok: That sounds like a thing we should stop.

Soundwave: We shall combine forces, but ruler Megatron is the only rightful leader. 

Autobot respond! Respond!

Bonecrusher: YOU'VE BEEN TALKING TO AN AUTOBOT? THIS WHOLE TIME?

Soundwave: Lower weapons now or be destroyed.

sections.heading: Mission 3: Desire
sections.text:
Part 1:

Soundwave: INQUIRY: Why did you attack?

Bonecrusher: It's the Dark Energon thing. Bot goes funny and you hit 'em till you turn 'em off or knock some sense into 'em.

Soundwave: Miscalculation. No Dark Energon malfunction has occurred. Autobots sent to Forge in order to provide needed bodies for battle.

Scorponok: You're just teaming up so you can use them as living shields? 

Soundwave: Autobot destruction will assist Decepticons. As they charge into battle we shall observe.

Bonecrusher: I gotta say, you're heartless buddy. And that's coming from ME.

Soundwave: Affirmative. I posses no heart, nor needless emotional programming. Only function is logic and loyalty to Decepticon causes.

We continue. Signal for Megatron is ahead. You two walk in front.

 Part 2:

Megatron: GRAAAAAHHRRRHHGGH 

Bonecrusher: Your Megatron usually like that?

Soundwave: Negative. Infection of Dark Energon has corrupted his circuitry.

Scorponok: Yeah that's a shame, always hate to see it happen. Give me a call if a Dinosaur version of him shows up.

Soundwave: Negative. All plans require Megatron leadership. He must be assisted.

Bonecrusher: Well, we can TRY to knock him down I guess. But he's taking off at quite a clip.

Soundwave: Follow Megatron. Destroy all in path. Top priority is Megatron's safety.

Part 3:

Megatron: STAY BACK! I WILL GRIND YOU ALL TO DUST!

Soundwave: Megatron. Regain senses. Urgent tasks necessitate your leadership.

Megatron: MEGATRON OBEYS NO ONE!

Bonecrusher: I don't know if we got the firepower for this one.

Soundwave: We do not seek to destroy. Only to survive the resetting of Megatron's senses.

Scorponok: So best case scenario is that we survive long enough for Megatron to be aware we just tried to beat him up.

Soundwave: Affirmative.

Scorponok: What's the reverse of a sneak attack? Obvious attack? If I had the ability to make a better plan I'd advise against this. But...let's do the dumb one I guess.

sections.heading: Mission 4: Burn
sections.text:
Part 1:

Soundwave: Megatron systems rebooting. Preparing apologies for forced resetting.

Megatron: I am owed too many apologies for yours to suffice, Soundwave. Whoever is behind these indignities shall pay dearly.

Scorponok: Soundwave was organizing a team-up. The Autobots and us are all rushin' to the fjord. Where are the narrow inlets created by glaciers around here?

Soundwave: THE FORGE. Our destination is THE FORGE.

Megatron: At every turn, at every impasse...I am cursed by the pathetic processing power of my minions.

Soundwave: With respect Leader Megatron. We must hurry before all is lost.

Megatron: So long as vengeance lays before us. Lead on, Soundwave.

Part 2:

Soundwave: Shockwave is utilizing the Forge to awaken dark powers. Solution. Eliminate Shockwave. Destroy Forge.

Megatron: An admirable plan, but we shall require more troops.

Soundwave: Autobots have been sent ahead.

Megatron: Fuel for the fire, they'll serve only to distract or delay the inevitable. We must gather forces while we can.

Thundercracker: Well if you're looking for someone who can lay down some heavy fire, Maybe I can be bribed into assisting.

Scorponok: Hey! Blue Starscream is here!

Thundercracker: EXCUSE ME?!

Part 3:

Megatron: Thundercracker, you shall obey my commands and assist our mission.

Thundercracker: Nope! No way, I ain't joining in until we punish the guy with a bee for a fist!

Scorponok: It's not really a fist so much as a clamp. Bees just kind of fire out of it. Never stopped to ask why to be honest.

Thundercracker: He's too dumb to even know I hate him! You call this a team?

Soundwave: Decepticons superior together. Cease bickering. Fall in line.

Thundercracker: I rule the skies! I never fall! Time to show you that!

sections.heading: Mission 5: Face
sections.text:
Part 1:

Scorponok: There ya' go. The Dark Energon making you be a jerk is probably gone now.

Thundercracker: Dark Energon? What? Sure why not. Ugh, my achin' fuselage.

Megatron: Where are your compatriots? As much as saying these words twist my Spark...Starscream and Skywarp could be of assistance.

Thundercracker: I ain't seen Skywarp in ages. But I think I saw Starscream going nutty somewhere around here. Shame it ain't all of us. It's like a tricycle missing a wheel.

Bonecrusher: So...a bicycle?

Thundercracker: I don't know you. But I don't like you.

Part 2:

Soundwave: Dark Energon emissions increasing rapidly. Forge may be active.

Starscream: PITIFUL PEASANTS. HAVE YOU COME TO SUFFER AT THE HANDS OF LORD STARSCREAM?

Thundercracker: So this team you're trying to build up on your way to the Forge, Boss? Feel like it's going pretty well so far?

Megatron: As always, I work with what the universe provides. A feral Starscream could at least prove to function as a distraction.

Starscream: MEGAAAATROOOOONNN! I SHALL RULE THE DECEPTICONS!

Bonecrusher: That voice. I think some of my glass parts just cracked.

Part 3: 

Megatron: Starscream, enough of this nonsense. Kisten to your leader!

Starscream: I AM LISTENING! TO GALVATRON AND CYCLONUS! THEY PROMISE POWER! THEY COMMAND!

Bonecrusher: Those the Unicron guys? I don't trust anything that came out of that weird planet hole of his.

Megatron: Yes. With the Forge activating it is possible they look to impress their old master. They must be using Dark Energon to gather their forces.

Starscream: THEY SUMMON YOU! YOU HAVE HEARD THE CALL!

Megatron: NOBODY SUMMONS MEGATRON!

sections.heading: Mission 6: Upon The Chrome
sections.text:
Start Point:

Starscream: My head. What happened? All I remember is shouting.

Scorponok: Cyclonus and Galvatron got up in your hardware and used you like a puppet. Then we punched you till you stopped.

Megatron: You're disloyal, dishonest, and a disappointment. However, I think this latest failure may spur you on to action, Starscream.

Starscream: No one can motivate their troops like you can, dearest Megatron. I do however crave revenge so it seems our goals are aligned.

Thundercracker: Nothing like getting the and back together, now we can all march into the mouth of certain death like a family.

Soundwave: Two paths lay ahead. Both lead to possible destruction. A choice must be made.

Left path: 

Cyclonus: This pathetic gathering looks to stop the arrival of Lord Megatronus?

Megatron: Megatronus? He's coming here?

Cyclonus: Not coming, he has arrived! The Autobots are already in the Forge being torn to shreds.

Bonecrusher: So this guy shows up then gets to have all the fun AND locks us out of the show?! What kinda Decepticon is he?

Cyclonus: He is the beginning of the end for this planet. Galvatron and I welcome him with open arms.

Megatron: Yes. GOOD. Open your arms. It gives me a chance to rip out that traitorous heart of yours!

Right path:

Galvatron: You fight fate like a child trying to hold back a tide. It is coming. It is here. Embrace it.

Megatron: Megatron alone controls his fate. You have become accustomed to serving under the heel of another, Galvatron. Perhaps my boot should have its turn.

Scorponok: YEAH! MESS UP THAT PURPLE PRETENDER!

Galvatron: Fools and mindless beasts. I look forward to seeing the pained expressions on your functionless bodies once Megatronus has defeated you.

Soundwave: Signals from Autobots indicate they are already battling Megatronus.

Galvatron: Yes, soon I shall witness the fall of the Autobots AND of the pathetic remnants of the Decepticons.

Megatron: You shall see nothing more than your own circuits scattered across the abyss of space. DECEPTICONS ATTACK!

End point:

Wheeljack: He's just not shutting down Jetfire. What sweet science you want me to teach him next?

Jetfire: Megatronus is near defeated...we must just rally for another attack.

Thundercracker: SKYFIRE! Well it is a big day for reunions.

Jetfire: Jetfire, thank you...you are actually a welcome sight old friend.

Megatronus: YOU HAVE ONLY COME TOGETHER TO DIE NEXT TO EACH OTHER.

Wheeljack: Right, sorry...almost forgot. You guys want to beat up a wanna-be god? Figure you can have a turn.

Megatron: I shall prove that only I am fit to rule this world!

Megatronus: I may be damaged, but this form shall soon mean nothing to me. Dare to strike me down and I shall become more powerful than you could possibly imagine!

sections.heading: Mission 1: Haste
sections.text:
Part 1: 

Wheeljack: Megatronus' is shut down, Galvatron and Cyclonus sent packing...Time to go home?

Jetfire: This is not a fantasy tale, we weren't just waiting for an excuse to click our heels and head back. We are trapped between realities, Wheeljack.

Wheeljack: I was hoping this was one of those "happily ever after" stories that wrapped up cleanly.

Nemesis Prime: Nothing is clean about you. You spread filth across timelines and spoil reality itself.

Wheeljack: Just popping over to the universe next-door to say hi, Nemesis?

Nemesis Prime: I have split time, ruptured reality, and traversed dimensions to come and punish you.

Wheeljack: ...that is a LOT of effort. Sounds like SOMEONE has a crush.

Part 2: 

Nemesis Prime: You have tangled realities and formed a knot that must be eliminated. Destruction is the only logical path. 

Jetfire: You speak of logic? Knots can be undone, they need not be cut off. We can help to set things right!

Nemesis Prime: No, I shall remove your chrono-travel abilities and once you are stranded in time and space you shall be destroyed.

Wheeljack: You and what army, big dark and ugly? You know I've seen some slime in my time but YOU take the cake.

Jetfire: Don't...mock...the reality bending destroyer.

Nemesis Prime: I have forces working alongside me. Though they may not yet know it. I withdraw to the shadows now to watch you suffer.

Wheeljack: Not if I have anything to say about...and he's gone. Guess I didn't have a say.

Part 3:

Hound: H-hey there fellas. N-n-not feeling too good. Something's burning me up. 

Wheeljack: I don't suppose a negatively shaded Prime has been whispering in your ear?

Hound: Matter of fact o-one did stop b-b-by. Stop. By. stop. STOP.

Jetfire: Your vocal systems appear faulty, Hound. Run diagnostics before corruption takes hold.

Hound: HAND OVER THE CHRONO-DEVICE AND SUBMIT TO YOUR DOOM.

Wheeljack: Oh good, the stutter is gone. One problem down and SO MANY MORE brought up!

Away Mission.lead:
The Mobile Command in your Base is where you can send Bots on Away Missions to earn additional resources.

You can select a Mission and choose which bots to deploy. Base rewards are guaranteed; succeeding in a mission give you bonus rewards. The higher leveled and ranked your Bots, the greater the probability of success. (Impossible, Low, Medium, High, Very High, Guaranteed) Missions sometimes have a recommended Class or two which further increases success rate if Bots of those classes are selected. The higher the Rarity of a Mission, the more Bots you can send for higher rewards.

More notes:

* Take into consideration that they will become unavailable to use in fights during the Mission.
* Each Mission costs Gold to start.
* Once you dispatch your Bots, you will have to wait until the countdown reaches zero to claim the rewards. Make sure that you claim the rewards within 3 days of Mission Completion or they will be lost. 
* Only one Mission can be run at a time. 
* Away missions can be canceled. However, you will not receive the rewards for the mission, and the Gold used to start the mission will be lost.
* You are prompted prior to beginning one of these missions to help avoid mistaken entries and prevent Gold loss. The warning can be turned off permanently from that prompt for any future away missions.
* Four Missions are presented at a time, which you have 2 hours to complete until they are updated with a new selection.
* You can re-roll the mission selection for 10 Energon if you don't like the rewards you see. No mission types are guaranteed and each re-roll will utilize the same mechanics that provide you with missions normally.

Rewards you could initally earn in Away Missions are Gold, Arena Chips, Raid Chips, Ore-13, and from Rare and Epic Missions, Tier 1 Spark Essence and Premium Bot Crystal Shards. There were also Missions for Tier 1 Mission Crystal Shards, but have since been removed.

sections.heading: July 26, 2019 update
sections.text:
New, improved away mission rewards! This update does away with the Arena Crystal rewards, but in exchange gives Commanders something bigger... the new T1, T2 and T3 Ore-13 Crystals, containing materials to upgrade your high-ranking Bots! As well as that, the cost to run Away Missions and their duration have been reduced significantly, so no more 2,000+ Gold and 5 hour Away Missions!

Then a few hours later they decided to rework the TX Crystals slightly - it was causing wayyyyy too much imbalance. Post-rework, T2 Crystals drop a boatload of Ore-13 and Gold, with zero chances of rare Sparks at the moment. This Away Mission update has just released. It may take some time to compile the list of missions. Note that as the tier of the Crystals given in Uncommon Missions may change depending on Commander Level, these Crystals will be referred to as TX Ore-13 Crystals.

Teletraan has uploaded optimized routes allowing us to send teams on Away Missions at the cost of less Gold, and for easier access to Gold and ORE-13, with a rare chance at Bot Chips and Bot Crystal Shards! Before we get into what you’ll be seeing, let’s talk about why we’re making these changes. We’re working towards creating more clearly defined reward identities for different Game Modes. We intend for Away Missions to be a place for Commanders to steadily earn Gold and ORE-13, and want it to be more accessible to more of our Commanders. We’re doing this by reducing the length of time these Away Missions take, and the cost of running them, but also by putting a bigger portion of the total rewards in the Base Rewards, with a slightly reduced focus on the Success Rewards. Keep your eyes on the Away Mission list Commanders, because you’ll quickly find the new Ore Crystals as a reward! Ore-13 Crystals scale from Tier 1 to Tier 3 based on your progression as a Commander, and contain rewards such as Ore and Gold, with rare chances at Basic, Class and Alpha Sparks. The higher the Tier, the rarer the Sparks. Tier 3 Ore Crystals even contain very rare chances at 1000x T4 Basic, Class, and T3 Alpha Spark Essence! You’ll see these Away Missions live in game around 10am PT July 25 , Commanders, but may need to wait until your Away Missions refresh.

sections.heading: In-Game Chat
sections.text:
The early days of the Global Chat was certainly... crazy colorful.

There are two main chat channels within our game: global and alliance.

Global Chat: This is the chat room for all players in your region.

Alliance Chat: If you are in an alliance, this is the chat room for all active members.

To turn on or off your ability to see these channels:

# Tap on the settings cog icon near the upper-left section on the home page.
# Tap on the CHAT tab.
# Under the CHAT ENABLED section, you will see checkboxes next to the GLOBAL and ALLIANCE fields. A checked off box means that you will be able to view that chat.

sections.heading: INVITES
sections.text:
There are two types of invitations you may receive while playing the game: alliance invitations and friend requests.

Alliance Invitations: If you are not part of an alliance, having this feature turned on lets alliances looking for members know that you are open to an invitation. You will still have to accept that invitation to join their alliance, however. Having this turned off or being part of an alliance will stop those invitations from coming to you.

Friend Requests: In order to accept friend requests from others, you need to have this feature turned on. That does not prevent you from sending your own friend requests, however. Having this feature turned off prevents others from sending you friend requests.

To turn on or off your ability to see these invitations:

# Tap on the settings cog icon near the upper-left section on the home page.
# Tap on the CHAT tab.
# Under the CHAT ENABLED section, you will see checkboxes next to the GLOBAL and ALLIANCE fields. A checked off box means that you will be able to view that chat.

There are two types of invitations you may receive while playing the game: alliance invitations and friend requests.

Alliance Invitations: If you are not part of an alliance, having this feature turned on lets alliances looking for members know that you are open to an invitation. You will still have to accept that invitation to join their alliance, however. Having this turned off or being part of an alliance will stop those invitations from coming to you.

Friend Requests: In order to accept friend requests from others, you need to have this feature turned on. That does not prevent you from sending your own friend requests, however. Having this feature turned off prevents others from sending you friend requests.

To turn on or off your ability to see these invitations:

# Tap on the settings cog icon near the upper-left section on the home page.

# Tap on the CHAT tab.

Under the INVITES section, you will see checkboxes next to the ALLIANCE INVITES ON/OFF and FRIEND REQUESTS ON/OFF sections. A checked off box means that you have turned those features on.

sections.heading: BLOCKING PLAYERS
sections.text:
If you wish to stop seeing what a specific player is saying, for whatever reason, you can.

In order to block the chat from a player:

# First tap on their Commander icon in whichever chat you see them in.
# From the mini-menu that pops up, select the BLOCK button.

To unblock a player:

# Tap on the BLOCKED USERS button in the CHAT drop-down
# Tap the UNBLOCK button next to their name.

sections.heading: Synergy Bonuses
sections.text:
* Allies – Ultra Magnus, Arcee - +2~3~8% Armor.
* Enemies – Soundwave, Tantrum, Cyclonus - +2~3~8% Attack Rating.
* Shield Amp – Soundwave, Mirage, Rhinox - 1.5~4~10% Damage Reduction while Shielded.
* Brain Drain – Shockwave - Shockwave generates 1~2~3 Energy Charges at the start of the fight and every 25 seconds.
* Brain Gain – Shockwave - 10~15~25% Increase to Attack against Demolition Bots. Shockwave only gets this benefit if all bots on his team have this synergy.

sections.heading: Player
sections.text:
For longer battles, "amp-it-up" by using Special 1 three times for maximum amp charges. He is great against Bots with powerful ranged attacks. Keep the opponent's ranged attack speed down by constantly shooting; Interference is inflicted any time the projectiles are close to the opponent . After inflicting some interference, try counter-shooting after sidestepping slowed opponent projectiles.

His absorption shield is not practical for sustainable repair and survivability, as he will still take damage from energy attacks even if absorbed.

sections.heading: Opponent
sections.text:
Melee bots such as Optimus Primal or Tantrum will take down the noisy Autobot. Also, try not to get hit by his basic ranged attacks. You don't want your shots to be slowed to a halt.

If this boombox gets to Special II, block or Sidestep as soon as possible - this attack, much like Shockwave and Prowl's Special II, is a hard one except it’s much harder.

(Somehow, abilities that causes Blaster's Interfering shots to Miss will still go through the Evade and cause your Bot to get inflicted with the Interference.)

sections.heading: Strong Match-ups
sections.text:
*Galvatron – Galvatron greatly relies on his Ranged Damage, something Blaster is an expert at reducing.
*Soundwave – Blaster is able to Repair himself with his own Reflected Projectiles. Let the Rivalry Begin.
*Waspinator - Disrupting where most of his damage comes from will put the Predacon bug to an end.
*Megatron (ROTF) - Blaster is the perfect counter to the decepticon leader. He drops the tunes which slow down Megatron's powered up Ranged Attacks and his specials 2 and 3 will bypass Megatron’s tough cybertronian armor. Decepticon leader, defeated by a mere autobot; exit stage right, Megs.
*Megatronus - The Fallen’s wrath will be considerably easier to avoid if his blasts are slower.

sections.heading: Weak Match-ups
sections.text:
*Bumblebee (GS) – The little gold speedster will break through Blaster’s Shielding, inflicting Shock damage on him every time he blocks.
*Bludgeon – This tanky warrior does not use energy projectiles and will not allow Blaster to Repair when struck by his projectiles. The same goes for Drift and Kickback.
*Kickback - The Insecticon is especially deadly against the Boombox. Activating special ones and heavy attacks fuel Kickback's power. 
*Grimlock - The king mostly relies on melee attacks which Blaster’s interference has no answer to and if Blaster thinks he can shock Grimlock, the Dino rage signature ability will put a stop to that idea.
*Hound - The military warrior relies on Precision Ammo, something Blaster's interference can't reduce as an exception.
*Other Bots who rely on melee attacks - these bots will put the noisy bot down.

sections.heading: Recommended Modules
sections.text:
Start the party with Blaster on these Mods!
*Laser Guidance Module - This module will greatly increase Blaster’s Ranged Damage and Speed, a perfect fit for a bot that can do the inverse to his opponent.
*Repair Module - The Repair Module will add to the constant Repairs he gets with his Signature Ability unlocked.
*Strange Refractor - Blaster's Interference will force the opponent to fight melee. A feat will be difficult when the strange refractor is around him.
*Superconductor 2000 - Good Luck dodging this one!
*Robot Resource - More power equals more specials which allow for Blaster to quickly gain amp charges. 
*E.M.I Module - Interference will be on 24/7. (Blaster's and the mod's debuffs do not stack)

Boosts.lead:
Introduced in v.2.0, Boosts give a temporary boost to all Bots' stats for a limited time.

Boosts are consumable items that offer a variety of different effects or advantages for a limited time. There are a variety of different effects that range from increasing a bot’s health to increasing the amount of experience you earn to aid your growth as a Commander. There are also certain boosts that only work in certain modes, like a boost that can reverse the effects of mods in the spotlight mission.

While you can apply multiple boosts to your account, you will not be able to activate more than ONE boost of each kind at a time. For example, if you activate a Tier 1 Damage Boost, you will not be able to add another one on top of it. If you choose to activate a new Tier 1 Damage Boost (or one of a higher tier), it will replace the previous one.

Some boosts will be available for purchase in the store, while others will only be attainable as rewards throughout the game.

Bot Chip.lead: Bot Chips are the primary method of obtaining Featured Bots of the month. currency in the game.

sections.heading: History
sections.text:
Bot Chips started out as Raid Event exclusive chips, 1,000 of which could be exchanged for a featured 2-Star Bot. Around 60 chips could be won per raid.

3-Star Featured Bots made their debut with Shockwave, which cost 10,000 Chips and specialized to each Bot.

With the debut of Galvatron, Bot Chips came to the forefront, introducing many more ways to obtain them. 4-Star Featured Bots were also introduced which cost 100,000 Chips. For Galvatron only, remaining chips could be exchanged for Premium Bot Crystal Shards or 4-Star Bot Crystal Shards.

For all featured Bots starting from Tantrum, 5-Star Bots were made available for 1,000,000 Chips.

The debut of Cyclonus saw a drastic increase in Raid Event and Arena Bot Chips, but the amounts were slightly decreased in raids the following month.

From 2019 onwards, the permanent generic Bot Chips can be used for any 3~5-Star Bot featured in the store.

November 2022 was the very last month to spend Bot Chips on Motormaster, Windblade, Ultra Magnus, and Barricade. You'd think they could buy Bots galore for the finale events but there were absolutely no provisions. And routine Bot Chip Arenas kept running despite nothing to spend them on!

When Netflix came knocking on Kabam's door, allowing the game a second lease on life, a lot of Bots became available on the store. Not all the Bots, but a majority of them.

sections.heading: Costs
sections.text:
Each event's bot Bot Chip cost in the store will increase for each duplicate of a Bot bought. There is a 21-amount limit for each tier, enough for a bot with a maxed Signature Ability. The Netflix version removes this.

*1-Star - 100
*2-Star - 1,000
*3-Star - 10,000 + 5,000 per purchase
*4-Star - 100,000 + 40,000 per purchase
*5-Star - 1,000,000 + 300,000 per purchase
(The first 3-Star bot is 10K, the 2nd is 15k, the 3rd is 20k, and so on.)

sections.heading: Strategy
sections.text:
If you are super casual and only want a 3-Star Bot, you should get more than 25,000 Chips passively.

If you are a level 40+ Commander who plays regularly, and unwilling to drop money and Energon on Crystals' luck, mastering Spotlight Missions, playing a full arena or two, regularly participating in Alliance Missions, raiding daily, and a couple of bot crystals should get you 100,000 chips and then some for a few 3-Stars. Getting 140,000 chips more is a stretch goal that would involve completing almost all the bot arenas. Now that Raid Events give nearly 2000 chips per raid for a 1500 Medal-range Commander, you only need to raid regularly 6-9 times a day with no need for arenas to get more than enough chips for a duplicate.

As Bot Chips are becoming more commonplace in the game's economy, you'll want to save up eventually.

sections.heading: Class Clash Chip
sections.text:
Chips in June 2019 to introduce a new type of Arena.

A Clash of Classes is coming! Join us for a Special Week-long event where you can participate in special Arenas and Raids every day to earn class-specific rewards, including 4-Star Class Bot crystals and T4 Class Spark Essence! This event kicks off on June 27th, 2019 at 10am PT and runs until July 4th at 10 am PT!

* Each day, one class will be featured in its own special 24 hour arena. You can only enter that Arena with Bots of the same Class or Bots that have a Class Advantage. For example, on Tech Arena Day, you will be able to use both your Tech and Scout Bots to compete.
* Take on the Class Clash Special Team everyday to earn Extra Points and Class ORE-13! You can also purchase Counter-Class Sparks and ORE-13 in the Store with Class Clash Chips, and Class Premium Bot Crystals for Energon!
* Note: There are Daily Purchase limits on all of these items, and the items in the Store are for the Class that Counter the Class of the Day.
* Class Clash Chips?
* For the duration of the Event, you can earn Class Clash Chips for every successful Raid you complete. Use these Chips in the Store to purchase Class Spark Essence and ORE-13!
* There will also be a 7-Day Raid Ascent event running alongside the Class Clash Event. This event features the regular rewards for Raid Ascent, but also includes a small amount of Class Clash Chips in the rewards!
* Raid Event? That Means Quintesson Bases again…
* We understand that during Raid Events, the amount of Quintesson Bases you run up against might increase quite a bit, but we’ve made some changes!
* During this event, Raid Chips awarded for Quintesson bases will be increased significantly, and they will now award Medals as well! They still won’t match what you get from Raiding another Commander’s base, but will be more comparable.
* Which Bots are in the Crystals?
* We’ve updated the Class Crystals to include all of our regularly available Bots! This means that the only ones not available are Thundercracker, and Bumblebee (Generations), while Bumblebee (DOTM) will be available as a 2 and 3 Star, but not as a 4-Star.
* This is a 7 Day event but there are only 6 classes…
* On July 3, a free-for-all Arena will be available featuring all the class special teams. The top rewards for this event will be 6x 4-Star Class Bot Crystals (1x OF EACH CLASS)!
* This is also your last chance to spend Class Clash Chips on a variety of Class Spark Crystals! This is the only day that the Class Sparks are NOT Class Specific and will be in Crystals!
* What days will each class be featured?
* The arena schedule is:
** • Warrior Clash Arena - June 27
** • Scout Clash Arena - June 28
** • Tech Clash Arena - June 29
** • Demolition Clash Arena - June 30
** • Tactician Clash Arena - July 1
** • Brawler Clash Arena - July 2
** • Free-for-All Clash Arena - July 3
* **** For clarity purpose: Rank up materials are in the Store for Raid Currency (Class Clash Chips) while the Class Shards for Bot Crystals are Arenas.
*Chips after the event were converted 1:1 gold and then Shards remained for future events.

sections.heading: Beast Wars Chip
sections.text:
Chips for a December 2019 Beast Wars event.

The year is ending and the Beasties are running wild! While timelines and dimensions keep clashing, we take a trip back (or is it forward...and then back again) in time to witness as Dinobot changes from a Predacon to fight with the forces of the Maximals! Will this timeline stay strong, or is it just the start of these Beast Wars?

* This event starts December 19th at 9AM EST and lasts for a total of three weeks!
* As soon as this kicks off you’ll have the chance to get your hands on Beast Wars Chips by completing various activities and can be used to purchase event specific Bots. These bots are changing daily between Predacons and Maximals and will repeat for a total of 3 times before giving everyone the chance at purchasing Crystals with all 6 Bots in them.
* How do we earn these chips? There are several ways!
* PROVING FIELDS
** This entire event starts with a 6-Day mission where you must prove your worth with a specific Beast War bot given to play with. You will be challenged to three fights with varying difficulties of your choice. You’re not going to want to miss this! Each day comes with new and unique dialogue.
* CHRONO-VECTORS: REBEL RAPTOR
** In the second and third week of this event, test your might in our unique story mission centered around Dinobot and his change in loyalty. If you can get through this you will be greatly rewarded with Beast Wars Chips as well as Awakening and Signature Upgrade Programs specific to difficulty chosen. Keep in mind, you’ll only be able to bring a roster of three for this! Choose wisely, Commanders.
* ARENA
** In week two, you will get your chance to earn more Beast Wars chips (alongside the usual rewards) by hitting Milestones in Arenas, earning Rank Rewards, and fighting Special Beast Wars teams.
* OBJECTIVES
** During the event there will be special objectives put into place. By completing all Objectives you’ll be awarded the 4-5 Star Beast Wars Crystal. By completing eight, you’ll receive the 3-4 Star Beast Wars Crystal. Some objectives can reward you 2-4 Star Featured (BW) Bot Crystal. Don’t worry, you’ll get chips alongside these victories!
** • Win Arena Fights using specific Bots.
** • Win Solo Mission Fights using specific Bots.
** • Complete “PROVING FIELDS” missions.
** • Complete “REBEL RAPTOR” missions.
* LOGIN CALENDAR
** There will be a Special 7-Day Calendar weekly to give you login rewards of Beast Wars Chips. Login in daily so to not miss out!
* ENERGON PACKS
** As this event is going on you have the chance to earn Beast War Chips when purchasing Energon Packs!

Bots.lead:
The term 'Bot' refers to any Transformers character, be they Autobot, Decepticon, Maximal or Predacon. There are six classes of bots: Brawler, Warrior, Scout, Tech, and Demolitions, and Tactician.

Each class has a Class advantage over each other, so it is smart to plan out your squad. Bots can also interact with each other by Synergy Bonuses. There are three Transformers universes from which these characters come from: Generations (with designs based on toys from various toylines) Cinematic (live-action film series), and Beast Wars.

Bots vary in star rarity, from 1-Star to 5-Star. Each Bot has a Rating that can be increased by leveling and ranking up the Bot.  Each Bot has three unique Special Attacks, as well as a Signature Ability that is awakened from getting a duplicate.

sections.heading: Squad
sections.text:
Using the correct strategy to create an effective team will help you optimize your performance in battle. There are several tools that will help you choose the right bots for the task ahead. To edit your squad before you begin a mission, tap on the EDIT SQUAD button.

Tap on the bots on your squad to remove them from the team, and tap on available bots to add them to it.
 
Preview the bots in the mission and filter your available bots to find the most suitable options for your improved squad by tapping on the buttons of the upper-right corner of the screen.

sections.heading: Ablilities
sections.text:
Abilities are bonuses that augment how bots fight and protect themselves. Each bot has its own set of abilities, including a signature ability. To view a bot’s abilities, tap the BOTS tab, choose the specific bot, and tap on the INFO button.

Screenshot showing an example of a bot’s signature ability

Abilities can be permanent or temporary bonuses. Permanent bonuses are passive or activated on Critical Hit. Temporary bonuses have a chance to activate when you use your special attacks. All abilities are typically themed around the background story of each bot.

A screenshot showing the explanation of a bot's abilities in depth

The amount and strength of abilities for each bot may change, depending on their Tier and Rank. For example, Optimus Prime at Tier 1 (1 Star), Rank 1, will only have the ability Guardian Slash available. When you rank him up to Rank 2, the ability I’ll Take You All On! (special) will become available.

PERMANENT ABILITY BONUS

This bonus will always be active during a fight and may be triggered at any time, depending upon its description. These abilities are not related to special attacks.

SPECIAL ATTACK BONUS

This bonus has a chance to activate with the use of a special attack. The effect of this attack increases with the level of the bot’s special attack.

sections.heading: Bot Level, Rank, and Tier
sections.text:
Each bot has a Tier, Rank, and Level. You can see this information by going to your BOTS tab on your home screen, then tapping on your bot, and opening the INFO panel.

Tiers range from 1-star to 4-stars, and cannot be changed. The higher the tier, the better the stats of your bot. Tiers control synergy bonuses and allow your bot to rank up higher.

Levels and Ranks can be increased.

Levels increase the power of a bot. Ranks increase the max level of a bot. For example, your bot can reach level 10 in rank 1, and level 20 in rank 2. The level cap is always 10 times as much as the rank.

When your bot reaches the maximum level for the rank, you will be required to rank up in order to unlock new levels. Ranking up will also increase the effectiveness of normal abilities like Bleed, Armor Break, etc.

sections.heading: MAXIMUM RANK FOR EACH TIER:
sections.text:
1 Star: Rank 2

2 Star: Rank 3

3 Star: Rank 4

4 Star: Rank 4

sections.heading: MAXIMUM LEVELS FOR EACH RANK:
sections.text:
Rank 1: 10 (1 to 4 Stars)

Rank 2: 20 (1 to 4 Stars)

Rank 3: 30 (2 to 4 Stars)

Rank 4: 40 (3 to 4 Stars)

Remember that you will need to rank up 2-Star and 3-Star Bots to unlock their tier 2 and tier 3 specials (respectively). This system was dropped in v.2.0 or v3.0.

1-Star Bot: Starts with a one-bar special attack

2-Star Bot: Starts with a one-bar special attack

3-Star Bot: Starts with a two-bar special attack

Brawler.lead: {{Class_Template|number_of_champions = 8|non-playable = 0|class_bonus = Warrior|weakness = Tactician|image1 = File:Class Use Brawler.png}}Brawler is one of six Bot Classes. It has a Class Bonus against Warrior, but is weak to Tactician.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: Brawler Bots are armored allies and furious foes that value strength at any cost.

sections.heading: Class Bonus
sections.text:
*The low Critical Rate and high attack of Brawler Bots give them an advantage over Warrior Bots.
*Brawlers have a high Health rating.
*Brawlers love to dash to their opponents.
*All brawlers rely on melee attacks.
*Most Brawlers utilize Armor Buffs and Melee Buffs. These buffs, however, can be neutralized by Tacticians.
*Some Brawlers take advantage of damaging debuffs, like Bleed.

sections.heading: Ruckus Identified
sections.text:
Part 1
*Ratchet: Optimus, we're getting readings of audio disturbances from the southern region with seismic ramifications.
*Optimus Prime: What could be causing such a ruckus?
*Ratchet: Not what, but who. Audio diagnostics I ran indicate a bot is responsible for this voluminous "disturbance.
*Optimus Prime: Soundwave?
*Ratchet: Uhh, no. The audio signature is Autobot in origin.
*Bumblebee: There is only one Autobot that could bring that ruckus... Blaster is in the house!
Part 2
*Ratchet: Commander, Optimus, the audio levels are getting worse... to the point of being destructive.
*Optimus Prime: Recommended course of action?
*Ultra Magnus: With all due respect, Optimus, the course of action is obvious. We have to find Blaster and unplug him.
*Optimus Prime: "Unplug" is an extreme measure.
*Ratchet: I'm sure he means that figuratively. But, we do need to "unplug" him until he realizes the damage his decibels can do in the unstable atmosphere of New Quintessa.
Part 3
*Blaster: Look who dropped in to get down! My main bot, Optimus!
*Optimus Prime: We did not come here to get down. We are here to turn down... the noise.
*Blaster: Aw c'mon. I know Primes don't party, but this place needs to get its groove on. The bots here are too uptight for their own good.
*Ratchet: I know you mean well...
*Ultra Magnus: But the party is over. Let's go, and hold it down.
*Blaster: No can do, Ultra Serious. The music is in me and there's no stopping it. Get beat or get beats... it's your choice.

sections.heading: Party Getting Started
sections.text:
Part 1
*Bumblebee (DOTM): Yo' Bee.
*Bumblebee: Yeah, Bee?
*Bumblebee (DOTM): Man, the whole alternate reality doppelganger thing is weird. Anyway, what do you know about this Blaster bot?
*Bumblebee: Aw, Blaster is a stand up, get down Autobot. He's loyal to both the Autobots and his love of getting the party started. Why do you ask?
*Bumblebee (DOTM): Well, there's been bit of a problem. The Commander and Ultra Magnus tried to bring him in to HQ and turn down the volume.
*Bumblebee: Oh-oh.
*Bumblebee (DOTM): Oh-oh is right. They had him under control when his cassettes ejected and sprung him loose.
*Bumblebee: That means the party is just getting started.
Part 2
*Optimus Prime: What are you doing here, soldier? You were assigned to recon patrol in the northern sector.
*Bumblebee (DOTM): Sorry, but I got sidetracked helping a friend help a friend.
*Optimus Prime: If this is about Blaster, the Commander and I will handle it. You have your orders. Carry them out.
*Bumblebee (DOTM): You're not the boss of me. Sure you're a Prime, but you're not my Prime.
*Optimus Prime: In times of duress we must endeavor to remain united. Return to the base, do your duty.
*Bumblebee (DOTM): Some other time... Prime.
Part 3
*Optimus Prime: Commander, the heavy reverb and pulsating bass suggest Blaster lies ahead.
*Bumblebee (DOTM): Lay off him. As someone that spent years with a broken vocal box cranking out random radio hits and movie quotes, I know what it's like to be misunderstood.
*Optimus Prime: That was not of my doing or my concern. My concern is our present safety.'
*Bumblebee (DOTM): C'mon Optimus Downer, sometimes you have to let a bot find himself. You've gotta let Blaster be Blaster.
*Optimus Prime: That is a terrible idea. Blaster's audio input endangers us all.
*Bumblebee (DOTM): Does it? Or, does it just annoy you that someone is enjoying the right of all sentient beings... to be free to be oneself?

sections.heading: Fight the Power
sections.text:
Part 1
*Optimus Prime: Optimus, if I may be so bold... what has possessed "your" Bee? His stubborn insubordination worries me.
*Optimus Prime (MV1): I fear stubbornness is a trait all Bees may possess.
*Optimus Prime: The Bee I know would never disobey me.
*Optimus Prime (MV1): I would not be so sure. My Bee said they are united in allowing this Blaster bot of yours to... I believe he said... "find his groove".
*Optimus Prime: If we are to restore a semblance of order and stability, Blaster and his "groove" must be found.
Part 2
*Bumblebee: Yo' Bee, what's the deal?
*Bumblebee (DOTM): I tried to hold them off, but that Commander has a stacked squad.
*Bumblebee: Thanks, bud, but it's my turn now. I'll slow them down and buy him some time.
*Bumblebee (DOTM): Time for what?
*Bumblebee: I talked with him and he says he's working on a new jam. He's claiming it's good enough to soothe a savage Dinobot.
*Bumblebee (DOTM): Wow, quite the claim.
*Bumblebee: Yeah, but I figure we oughta give him a shot at it. Grimlock's been acting rowdier than usual lately.
Part 3
*Optimus Prime: Say it is not so. You too?
*Bumblebee: Me too, what... Optimus?
*Optimus Prime: You too are in league with Blaster as he lays sonic waste to the land.
*Bumblebee: I'm not in league with anyone. I'm just trying to help a bro-bot find his groove.
*Optimus Prime: Translation?
*Bumblebee: I know you don't get it, but Blaster is an artist. It's in his park. He has to get it out, then he'll be fine.
*Optimus Prime: Get it out?! Bumblebee, get out of the way!
*Bumblebee: Not yet, sir. Blaster needs to kick out his jam. If that means I need to fight the power... so be it!

sections.heading: Primes Don't Party
sections.text:
Part 1
*Megatron: Are we not through with you yet?
*Starscream: Are you through with winning?
*Megatron: You are hardly one to speak of winning.
*Starscream: But, I have a plan. One that exploits the Primes' weakness.
*Megatron: And I have a brain and a giant gun. But, I suppose it would not hurt to discuss the Primes' weaknesses. What do you propose?
*Starscream: Recently, the Autobot Blaster has surfaced on new Quintessa. All reports are that he is driving the Primes mad with his incessant music playing.
*Megatron: Everyone knows Primes don't party. So what?
*Starscream: So we grab Blaster, trick him into playing his annoying ditty, and zap him with a T-Cog Disabler...
*Megatron: And use him to push the Primes over the edge. Create chaos of the sonic persuasion. Hmmm...
Part 2
*Blaster: Starscream? What are you doing here? Don't you have a back to stab somewhere?
*Starscream: Tsk-tsk, my fellow Cybertronian. I am a non-aligned bot of peace here on this deranged planet. You might say I follow the beat of own drummer.
*Blaster: I can get behind that, kinda going solo myself. But, what's that funky gadget?
*Starscream: A T-Cog Disabler.
*Blaster: What does it do?
*Starscream: You are as dumb as you are loud. I'll show you what it does if you show me that song everyone says you're working on.
*Blaster: I'm always down to get down, but I've got to transform first.
*Starscream: Sucker.
*Blaster:Argh!!!!
Part 3
*Sideswipe: Hey Optimus, looks like bringing me on the mission was a good call. Look who I found... Blaster!
*Optimus Prime: So I can hear. His choice in music is still as terrible as ever.
*Bumblebee: Yo, Blasty... it sounds like you've found your jam. Now, transform and let's roll out.
*Optimus Prime: You heard Bumblebee. Transform, it is time to go.
*Starscream: Why the rush? Maybe he just wants to bump his beats. Or maybe, he can't transform. Either way it sounds like we've got a party.
*Optimus Prime: What have you done to him?
*Starscream: Why, I've merely set him free to bring the noise.
*Bumblebee: Oh yeah, Decepticreep? You're going to see what it's like when a Killa Bee brings it!
Part 4
*Sideswipe: Jeez, what a piece of work. As soon as we save his beat blasting butt he lays down a circuit jamming track and takes off.
*Bumblebee: He's on a mission... a mission from Primus!
*Optimus Prime: That just means our mission continues. Roll Out!

sections.heading: Superior Beats
sections.text:
Part 1
*Megatron: Let me guess you sniveling sycophant, you have failed me again. And, as always, I'm sure it wasn't your fault.
*Starscream: But, it wasn't.
*Megatron: Of course.
*Starscream: The plan was sound, but I didn't account for Bumblebee's love of Blaster's wretched noise pollution.
*Megatron: Failure is failure.
*Starscream: A setback is not a failure. It is a learning opportunity. Blaster still has the potential to be a weapon of mass distortion. You'll see.
Part 2
*Soundwave: Lord Megatron, Shockwave has informed me that you collude with Starscream.
*Megatron: There is no collusion. I merely let the fool carry out an attempt to disrupt the Autobot forces using their own Blaster against them.
*Soundwave: Starscream and Blaster are both inferior bots. The potential for success was minimal. You only need to enlist the services of a superior bot... me.
*Megatron: If my datadrive serves me correctly, did Blaster not prove superior at your infamous Dancitron beat battle?
*Soundwave: That was an anomaly. My sub-woofer was malfunctioning.
*Megatron: Yet another excuse for another flunky that fails me.
*Soundwave: Your assessment is incorrect. I will prove my worth in the realm of audio warfare.
*Megatron: Actions speak louder than words. Prove it.
Part 3
*Soundwave: Cease your forward movement.
*Sideswipe: Huh?
*Bumblebee: I think he wants us to stop.
*Sideswipe: Why didn't he say so?
*Bumblebee: Whatever, we aren't stopping till we get our block rocking buddy Blaster back.
*Soundwave: That will not happen.
*Sideswipe: What's the deal, Soundwave... your cassettes need rewinding?
*Soundwave: Megatron needs verification.
*Bumblebee: Verification of what?

sections.heading: Time to Dance
sections.text:
Part 1
*Bumblebee: Things are popping out in the Wastelands, Optimus.
*Optimus Prime: I am sure they are, whatever that means. Do you have any word on Blaster?
*Bumblebee: Other than that he is a peacock and you've gotta let him fly?
*Optimus Prime: If my knowledge of Earth ornithology is correct, peacocks do not fly. But, that is beside the point. Clarify.
*Bumblebee: I'm just saying that he's an artist... he needs to express himself.
*Optimus Prime: He will be a dead artist if Soundwave and the Decepticons have their way.
*Sideswipe: Optimus is right, Bee. This has to end.
*Bumblebee: I suppose you're fight. But, I'm thinking Blaster has one more encore in him.
Part 2
*Blaster: What's cracking, Bee? I haven't seen you in a hot minute.
*Bumblebee: Ah, you know... just been doing the scouting, fighting, looking for you thing.
*Blaster: That's heavy, but I understand, bro-bot.
*Bumblebee: The thing is, Optimus has a point. It's time for you to come in and jam with us... your band, your alliance... The Autobots.
*Blaster: Yo' Bee, I'm not sure if I can give up the solo life just yet. Tell Optimus we need to get down one last time, a last chance to turn the funk out.
*Bumblebee: He wins... you come home?
*Blaster: Sounds like a deal for real, homebot.
Part 3
*Optimus Prime: Has Blaster come to his senses?
*Bumblebee: He's got one more track to lay down. Trust me, it's bad!
*Optimus Prime: I know, that's why this must end.
*Bumblebee: No, not bad meaning bad, but bad meaning good!
*Optimus Prime: Bumblebee, this nonsense is over. Point the way to Blaster.
*Bumblebee: Ok, Optimus. But, let him in on his own terms, to his own beat.
*Optimus Prime: I make no promises, but if he is ready to deal... we will deal.
Part 4
*Blaster: What's shaking, Optimus? Bee told me you'd be rolling through my hood.
*Optimus Prime: Yes, I tend to roll everywhere. For the last time, please return with us to HQ... in silence.
*Blaster: Before we do, it's time we dance... or we dance.
*Optimus Prime: You know Primes do not party... nor dance. Explain yourself.
*Blaster: I guess you're choosing to dance. Here's the deal. We get in on one last time while I play you my latest, greatest jam. You win... I leave with you. You lose, I get to keep kicking it solo.
