sections.heading: Bio
sections.text: Long known as Optimus Prime's faithful scout, "Bee" has evolved into a highly skilled fighting machine. He's still as loveable and protective as ever, but don't be fooled: Bee is fully capable of decapitating Decepticons in a variety of creative ways.

sections.heading: Basic Abilities
sections.text:
* Agility
* Attack Buff

sections.heading: Abilities
sections.text:
*Melee Calibration Mode: 13.3~25.5% chance to Evade the opponent's Basic Melee Attacks.
*Ranged Calibration Mode: 11.3~21.6% chance to Evade the opponent's Basic Ranged Attacks.
*Passive: Bumblebee is furious when his teammates are hurt, granting him +30% Attack per fallen teammate for 8 seconds at the start of the fight.
*When Knocking Down Opponents: Gains a permanent Attack Buff, increasing Attack by 8.8~13.5%. The bigger the size of the opponent, the larger the Attack bonus. (Max: 15 stacks)

sections.heading: Special Attacks
sections.text:
#Buzz Kick - He may float like a butterfly, but he stings like a Bumblebee.
#* (+v8.0) Each hit has a 40-60% chance to inflict an Armor Break, removing enemy Armor and applying 16-20% Armor reduction for 3.5 seconds.
#Bug Shot - You can still see the youthful joy in his eyes between the kicks and energy blasts.
#*Inflicts Shock damage for 80% Attack over 10 seconds. Opponents with an Armor Buff takes additional 150% damage.
#Shell Shock - After giving opponents the trip of a lifetime, he gets up close and personal for an uppercut blast.
#*Inflicts Shock Damage for 80% Attack over 10 seconds. Opponents with an Armor Buff takes additional 100% damage.

sections.heading: Synergy Bonuses
sections.text:
* Allies - Ironhide, Optimus Prime (MV1), Hot Rod - +2~3~8% Armor.
* Till All Are One - Ratchet, Optimus Prime (MV1) - +2~3~8% Attack Rating for Autobots. +6~8~12% Debuff damage for Autobots in Raids.
* Enemies - Barricade, Megatron (ROTF) - +2~3~8% Attack Rating.
* Medic Support - Ratchet - 1.3~2.5~7% of base Health Repaired at the start of the fight. +3~4~5% extra Repair in Raids.
* Espionage Specialists - Mirage - 14~24~70% less likely to activate the opponent's abilities when hitting with Special 2 or 3.
* Speed Chasers - Sideswipe, Mirage - +6.5~15~40% Attack on the next hit when dodging the Opponent's attacks.
* Brothers in Arms - Hot Rod - +2~3~8% Armor for Autobots as well as +4~6~8% Melee Damage in Solo Missions.

sections.heading: Player
sections.text: Bumblebee has a lower health rating and hitting power compared to other Tacticians, but he is very evasive. Another thing about him is that he is purely an anti-Armor bot, he won't nullify other Buffs that Brawlers use.

sections.heading: Opponent
sections.text: You will struggle if you try to hit Bumblebee with only melee attacks or only ranged attacks. Alternate between successful ranged attacks and melee attacks to make him switch evade modes (which takes 6 seconds at no signature level and 3 seconds if awakened). Fighting as a bot with ranged heavy attacks will be most helpful.

sections.heading: Strong Match-ups
sections.text:
* Bumblebee's Special 2 or 3 can Shock right through Optimus Prime (MV1)'s Signature Ability.
* Grindor (and Megatron (ROTF)) are big bots that give bigger attack buffs when knocked down.
* Optimus Primal's Critical Armor can become a conduit for Bumblebee's Shock.
*Barricade - The more Bumblebee knocks down, the faster the bad cop falls.

sections.heading: Weak Match-ups
sections.text:
* Precision buffs from Warrior Bots like Arcee, Drift, and Hound will make sure Bumblebee has nowhere to evade to.
* Hot Rod's time gun can Decelerate Bumblebee and prevent him from evading.
* Starscream, Cyclonus, Ultra Magnus and Sideswipe can Nullify Bumblebee's many Attack Buffs and in particular, Cyclonus alternates between melee and ranged attacks making Cyclonus hard for bumblebee to defeat.
* Grimlock will find bee’s shocks to be a minor nuisance turning bee’s strengths against him despite the class type advantage.
* Megatronus’s relic of obedience can prevent bumblebee from switching modes and that will prevent him from evading too much and allow him to gain attack buffs.

sections.heading: Recommended Modules
sections.text:
* E.M.I. Module - Making projectiles less likely to hit Bumblebee and switch evasion modes will ensure he will constantly evade attacks and counterattack.
* Nightbird's Mark - Float like a butterfly, sting like a bee.
*Superconductor 2000 - It would be difficult to completely avoid the flurry of Attacks from Bumblebee's Special 2.

sections.heading: Obtainment
sections.text:
Bumblebee is an exclusive of sorts, the higher tiers are not part of the main Bot crystal pool.
* Tier 2 pre-registration gift (1-Star)
* Cinematic Crystals
* Goldwheels Crystal (4~5-Star)
* Good as Gold Crystal (3~4-Star)
* 2018 Holiday Calendar, Day 5 (4-Star)
* 5-Star: 130,000 Titan Fragments

Calendar.lead:
The Login Calendar is a feature introduced in v2.0. Each monthly calendar has 28 days of prizes which can be claimed by logging in every day. The remaining days of a month are grace days. If a day is missed, the next prize will remain unclaimed until the Commander/player logs in, but then they will not be eligible to claim the prizes at the end of the calendar if all grace days have passed. 

As of January 2019, months with more than 28 days have extra reward days as 5-Star Bot Crystal shards.

There are also weekly 7-day calendars for Premium Bot Crystals and Gold. These calendars will reset if a day is missed.

Occasional special calendars may also appear. These are consecutive and have no grace days.

For lack of a better place, these are the times for all in-game events (when it's not daylight's savings)

* 9 AM EST - Next Special Mission, Objectives, Titan Cycles, Arenas, Alliance Missions, Alliance Quests
* 12 PM EST - Next rotation of Raid Store items
* 0:00 UTC / 7 PM EST - New Calendar day and daily Objectives
*2 AM EST - Alliance Help reset,
* 3 AM EST - Next Daily Mission
* 4 AM EST - Next Class Use Alliance Quest

sections.heading: Kabam Support Page
sections.text:
* These are the types of calendars used in Transformers: Forged to Fight:
* 
* STREAK CALENDAR
* Login streak calendars reset upon completing the seventh day in a row or missing a day. You will continuously have to log in to build and sustain a calendar login streak. This is important to get the best rewards for the week!
* 
* Screenshot of a sample 7-day login calendar, showing the rewards for each day
* 
* Weekly login calendars help players by rewarding bot crystal shards. Players that log in all seven days within the calendar login week will earn enough crystal shards for one complete Premium Hero Crystal.
* 
* PROGRESSIVE CALENDAR
* Unlike streak calendars, progressive (monthly) calendars will not reset your progress if you miss a day. However, this may prevent you from claiming a prize found later in the calendar. Calendar progression does reset once the calendar duration has concluded.
* 
* Screenshot of a sample monthly, progressive login calendar, showing the rewards for each day
* 
* This calendar is loaded with a variety of items such as Gold, sparks, and Energon, as well as crystals and shards
* 
* Each monthly calendar will consist of 28 days, and excess days within a calendar month will be considered "grace days." While grace days may allow users to miss a couple of logins in a given month and still receive all of the rewards, missing too many login days will result in not being able to claim all the prizes in the calendar.
* 
* The monthly calendar will reset on the first day of each month. We expect to occasionally change up the reward structure for each login calendar, so check back regularly to see what is new!
* 
* ALLIANCE CALENDAR
* Alliance calendars are also seven-day calendars but are only available to Commanders that are currently in an alliance and reward Gold.
* 
* Screenshot of a sample alliance login calendar
* 
* SPECIAL EVENT CALENDAR
* The frequency and rewards of special event calendars will vary. They could last for any number of days and might repeat like a seven-day calendar which will reset if you miss a day. Alternatively, they may be 14, 21, or 28 days in the calendar without having any grace days. For the specific rules and rewards of any currently active special event calendars, see the DAILY LOGIN menu in the game.
* 
* Screenshot of a sample special event login calendar
* 
* Important: All calendars’ daily change time is 00:00 UTC (5:00 PM PT).

sections.heading: Bio
sections.text: As the youngest and quickest of the Maximals, Cheetor is one part soldier and one part daredevil. With the addition of rocket boosters and the power of flight, his Transmetal upgrade only intensified the recklessness of this fast feline.

sections.heading: Story
sections.text: * Feral Phenomena

sections.heading: Basic Abilities
sections.text:
*Power Gain
*Evade
*Bleed

sections.heading: Abilities
sections.text:
*Passive:
**This bot’s Transmetal exterior provides 10% passive Energy Resistance and reduces the effectiveness of enemy abilities that Drain Power by 100%.
*End of a Light or Medium Melee Combo:
**Each time Cheetor completes a Light or Medium Melee Combo he gains 0.5~2% of his Max Power over 1 second.
*Critical Melee Hits:
**Critical Melee Hits have a 30~40% Chance to inflict Bleed, dealing 40~60% of attack over 4 seconds.
**Bleeding opponents generate 30% less power when struck.
*Dashing and Heavy Attacks:
**Cheetor has a 100% chance to Evade Ranged Attacks and a 20~30% chance that the projectiles will Miss completely.

sections.heading: Signature Ability
sections.text:
Feral Strike

Cheetor’s jovial nature can be quickly overcome by beastly aggression. Once he has hit his limit, his feral spark grants him incredible speed allowing him to decimate opponents before they are able to react.

*When Filling a Bar of Power:
**Cheetor gains a Feral Strike Buff, granting 10~40% Critical Rate and his attacks ignore Armor, Shielding, Evasion, and do not trigger enemy abilities for 4 seconds. Additionally, while Feral Strike is active, Cheetor gains a 25% chance to Evade Melee Attacks.

sections.heading: Special Attacks
sections.text:
#Transmetal Trauma - Cheetor gives his opponent the tail end.
#*100% Chance to inflict Bleed, dealing 70~90% of attack over 8 seconds.
#*100% chance to inflict Repair Block. The opponent stays Repair Blocked from this attack for as long as they are Bleeding.
#Quasar Blaster - Blasters set to full power.
#*100% chance to gain Power Rate Up, increasing this bot’s flow of Power by 50% for 10 seconds.
#*This Attack deals up to 50% more damage based on the opponent’s percentage of Missing Power.
#Maximal Overdrive - Faster than a Transwarp bullet.
#*100% to Power Lock the opponent for 10 seconds and drain up to 3% of the opponent’s Max Power.
#*This Attack deals up to 100% more damage based on the opponent’s percentage of Missing Power.

sections.heading: Synergy Bonuses
sections.text:
* Allies – Rhinox, Dinobot, Optimus Primal - +2~3~8% Armor.
* Enemies – Waspinator, Scorponok - +2~3~8% Attack Rating.
* Beast Purification – Optimus Primal - Heavy Attacks: Beast Wars characters gain 4~12~20% Attack Rating for 5 seconds and Purify Damaging Debuffs as long as there are 2 or more Beast Wars bots on Primal's team.
* Speed Chasers – Sideswipe, Mirage, Bumblebee (DOTM) - +5~15~40% Attack on the next hit when Dodging the opponent's attacks.
* Beast Ancestor - Tantrum - After each Heavy Attack, this bot gains a Beast Fury buff that grants Attacks a 5~8~15% chance to be Unblockable for 6 seconds. 
* Leadership (5-Star) - All lower tier teammates gain +10% Critical Rating.

sections.heading: Commander
sections.text:
An awakened Cheetor can bypass Armor, Shields, Evasion Buffs, and do not trip any enemy abilities, for example Optimus Prime (MV1) won't be able to make his epic last stand and even Wheeljack's Force Shield will be bypassed. However, the resulting buff only lasts over 4 seconds, so you have to act fast and the only thing that the feral strike can’t bypass are Unstoppable buffs and Megatronus’s relic of immortality.

Dashing into the enemy and Heavy Attacks are a great way to avoid potentially deadly ranged attacks, but it must be timed right or you could get hit from dashing in too early. Heavy Evades are not effective at dodging multi-hit ranged attacks like Waspinator's eye lasers.

An awakened Cheetor on a Robot Resource will be pushed to gain Feral Strikes more often like Cyclonus and his Dark Fields on that mod, try this combination out!

sections.heading: Opponent
sections.text: There's no way to drain Cheetor's power, so try to focus on anti-evade and power locks (Evasion can activate while Cheetor is feral). Hot Rod prevents Feral evasion from activating 100% of the time and power locks will be your friend since it will prevent Cheetor from gaining feral strikes.

sections.heading: Bots
sections.text:
* Ratchet - Cheetor's Repair Block and Power Locks will take the autobot medic back to the repair bay.
*Shockwave – Shockwave will have a hard time hitting Cheetor, and if he does, he’ll have an even harder time Draining his Power. The same also goes for Prowl.
*Ultra Magnus - Cheetor will remove and not shift any Resistance buffs when Feral Striking.
*Optimus Primal – Cheetor’s signature ability will allow him to punch through Primal’s Crit Armor, and if the ape thinks he’s going to heal from Bleeds, Cheetor’s Repair Block will put a stop to that idea.
*Jetfire - Cheetor will evade many of Jetfire’s primary attacks while Blocking any chance the big flyer has to Repair.
*Wheeljack - Cheetor's Feral Strike/Bleeds will ignore the Force Shield. This is one of the most effective counters to the shield.
*Optimus Prime (MV1) - Cheetor’s repair block will prevent Optimus Prime from repairing while Bleeding and an awakened Cheetor can punch through even the toughest armor, stopping the Autobot leader from making his epic last stand.
*Megatron (ROTF) - Bleeds and feral strikes will bypass Megatron’s tough armor and the repair block will ensure Megatron will not make his comeback.

sections.heading: Mods
sections.text:
*Paralyzer - Cheetor will be completely unaffected by the Stun Ray.
*Repair Module - Cheetor will ensure that bots that rely on repair like Wheeljack won't make their last stand.

sections.heading: Weak Match-ups
sections.text:
*Anyone with power locks - Like Rhinox, bots that inflicts power locks can prevent this transmetal maximal from gaining power and feral strikes.
*Hound – Hound’s Precision Ammo will make short work of this bot as he attempts to Dash-in for an attack.
*Megatron – Cheetor requires constant buffs to stay on top, some that an awakened Megatron would love to steal from. In the former case, Megatron would be the one who’s on top instead.
*Hot Rod - Decelerations will disable Cheetor's Feral Strike, Dash Evades and weaken down Cheetor’s power gains
*Kickback - While this insecticon may not be able to leak Cheetor’s power, he can consume his power gain and if Cheetor thinks he can uses his heavies to ram or evade while the opponent tries to counterattack, the T-Clog sabotage will put a stop to that idea.
*Cyclonus, Sideswipe and Starscream - Cheetor wants to win; but what is a winner without buffs?
*Grindor - Cheetor gains a lot of power because of his power gain. The more power Cheetor gains, the stronger Grindor gets and special locks can disable Cheetor from using his specials and if he has the synergy bonus, he can prevent Cheetor from gaining feral strikes that will bypass his armor. Grindor will crush this transmetal maximal.
*Grimlock - The transmetal armor will do nothing to protect Cheetor from the massive damage Grimlock has with his melee buffs and specials and the bleeds Cheetor throws will be purified.
*Megatronus and Barricade and Mixmaster's shieldmasters synergy - These 3 have the abilities that can counter Cheetor. They can steal Cheetor’s power to gain it as their own rather than draining it. Barrricade can also stack backfires and Cheetor will be backfired in his face when he uses his specials(same goes with Jazz and Scorponok who also inflict powerful backfires) and with the synergy bonus active, power locks will prevent Cheetor from gaining feral strikes. On the other hand, Megatronus’s relic of obedience can weaken Cheetor’s abilities and prevent him from gaining any buffs even feral strikes and dark burns will ignore the transmetal armor thought Cheetor can power lock Megatronus which will delay relic switching.

sections.heading: Recommended Modules
sections.text:
Pair these Mods with Cheetor on your base!
*Scout's Sentry - Increasing his Critical Chance will enable this bot to dish out more damage and punish the opponent for missing their attacks.
* Nightbird's Mark - Increases Critical Damage, allowing Cheetor to deal substantial damage.
*Robot Resource - Cheetor wants to win; this mod is like his dream-come-true.

Chips.lead: In Transformers: Forged to Fight, Commanders will eventually - if not inevitably - come upon Chips. These act as some sort of secondary currency (next to Gold and Energon) which can be used to purchase items in the Raid and Featured Bot Stores. Specialized chips also exist for events.

sections.heading: Raid Chip
sections.text:
{{Main|Raid Chip}}

Raid Chips are a currency used to purchase items in the Raid Store. They are primarily earned through Raids, but they can be also earned through Away Missions (prior to the Away Mission Update) and Alliance Quests.

sections.heading: Featured Bot Chip
sections.text:
{{Main|Bot Chip}}

Featured Bot Chips (Jetfire's seen left) are the primary method of obtaining new featured Bots of the month. For the 2019 year Featured Bot Chips were replaced with Generic Bot Chips (seen right).

sections.heading: Arena Chip
sections.text:
{{Main|Arena Chip}}

Arena Chips were a currency used to purchase Arena Crystals. They were earned from Away Missions, and in Arenas, but have been replaced with whole Arena Crystals.

sections.heading: Class Clash Chips
sections.text: Class Clash Chips were rewarded in the Class Clash Event and were used to purchase Class Crystals. (Image needed)

sections.heading: Generations Chips
sections.text:
Generations Chips are the main reward for September 2019's 35th Anniversary Celebration.

Category:Gameplay

sections.heading: In-game
sections.text: In-game, Chrono-Vectors are a type of Special Mission. The difference from these Missions and regular Spotlight Missions is that they have fewer rewards, and reward the Bot that was featured.

sections.heading: Forum description
sections.text: {{quotes|Chrono-Vectors are mini-Quests designed to challenge and reward our Commanders. Each will be scattered across the many time-lines converging on New Quintessa, and will require your assistance to correct the past or stop it from splintering off.}}

sections.heading: List of Chrono-Vectors
sections.text:
* Grimlock Saves the Day (Featured Bot: Grimlock)
* Generations (Featured Bots: Jetfire and Wheeljack)
* Rebel Raptor (Featured Bots: Dinobot)
Category:Special Missions

sections.heading: In-universe
sections.text: In-universe, Chrono-Vectors are devices invented by Wheeljack that could utilize Energon boosts to time-travel. In one specific case, Grimlock took one of these untested devices and time-travelled to alter the outcome of the Great War. Wheeljack would later be revealed to possess a spare device.

sections.heading: Abilities
sections.text: The only abilities Wheeljack's Chrono-Vectors so far have are teleportation and time-travel.

Amidst all this bickering, our Bots have forgotten the number one priority of any list:

Code of a Hero/Transcript.lead: Note: All formatting and grammar errors are left as is.

sections.heading: An Ally No More
sections.text:
Part 1
* Bumblebee: Optimus, the One-Optic Wonder is back.
* Shockwave: I detect a level of derision in your greeting. It is uncalled for.
* Optimus Prime: But it is understandable. You are a Deception, Our difference, though not insurmountable, are significant enough to earn you our mistrust.
* Shockwave: Understood. But I come to offer information... And a warning. The advice is that one of your kind has knowledge of incalculable power. The warning is: Stay out of my way as I seek it.
Part 2
* Bumblebee: Optimus, do you have any idea what Shockwave was talking about? Some object... One of our kind?
* Optimus Prime: I checked with Ratchet. he suspects it as a golden artifact of great value to generations that came after ours. But, one of our kind?
* Rhinox: No, Optimus, one of my kind. If Ratchet's suspicions are correct, the object Shockwave seeks is the Golden Disk. And, if that is true, the "one of our kind" he speaks of can only be... Dinobot!
Part 3 

* Shockwave: Has the obvious become apparent to you?
* Optimus Prime: It is obvious we will prevent you from obtaining the Golden Disk.
* Shockwave: Your feeble processors cannot fathom nor harness its power. Do not impede me.
* Optimus Prime: "Our kind" can fathom the potential destruction the Disk could create in your hand. That is why the Commander is here to prevent that. Commander, you know what to do...

sections.heading: Golden Race
sections.text:
Part 1
* Rhinox: Commander, I'd advise you to hurry up and find the Golden Disk.
* Optimus Prime: Why the haste, Rhinox? I am not familiar with the Disk's power. What makes the object so alluring and powerful?
* Rhinox: It holds knowledge of our collective history.
* Optimus Prime: As does the Matrix of Leadership.
* Rhinox: But the Decepticons believe the Disk contains much more than a simple history. What it contains could change the balance of power. Surely others will quest to obtain it.
* Optimus Prime: Then we must not delay. Commander, roll out!
Part 2
* Rhinox: Oh-oh, Commander, it's Galvatron. Looks like the scraps are gonna hit the fan.
* Galvatron: Speaking of scrap, you did quite a job on Shockwave. I just ran across him and he was barely functioning. Seemed stuck on repeat... Something about a precious Golden Disk.
* Rhinox: He sounds delirious.
* Galvatron: Really? I don't think so. Not his style, I think the Disk is a trinket worth it's weight in Energon.
* Rhinox: Don't waste your time.
* Galvatron: Oh, I won't be wasting my time. I'll be wasting if you get in my way.
Part 3
* Galvatron: So, the race is on.
* Rhinox: To the Golden Disk?
* Galvatron: No, to the destruction of you and your vermin human commander. The Disk will be a bonus reward for me to be rid of you nuisances.
* Rhinox: We can't let that happen.
* Galvatron: The choice is not yours, you armor-plated horned buffoon. Prepare to taste the wrath of Galvatron!

sections.heading: Dinobots and Confused
sections.text:
Part 1
* Grimlock: Hey, Hornbot. Ratchet tell me, that there is a new Dinobot.
* Rhinox: Not a new Dinobot. His name is Dinobot.
* Grimlock: Me Grimlock king of Dinobots. Why me not know about new Dinobot?
* Rhinox: Because he is like me, a Maximal, from my reality.
* Grimlock: A Maximal? Me thought he was a Dinobot?
* Rhinox: I get your confusion, big guy. His name is Dinobot. He is a Maximal like me. His alt-form is a dinosaur, and he is a mighty warrior.
* Grimlock: {{RedText|ARGHHHH! You hurt my head with Dino-babble. Me Grimlock say let's find him and then me understand your no-sense words.}}
Part 2
* Dinobot: Commander, your squad fights well. I should have assumed as much with Rhinox by your side.
* Rhinox: Dinobot, come with us. The Commander can be trusted.
* Dinobot: As much as I respect you, no one can be trusted as long as the Golden Disk exists to corrupt the power lust of the weak.
* Rhinox: Its power can be harnessed, in the hands of the righteous... In the hands of the Commander.
* Dinobot: That is a risk I cannot take. The Disk must be destroyed. Pray I find it before you.
Part 3
* Grimlock: The Commander crushed that puny Dinobot guy. Me thought you say he was a mighty warrior.
* Rhinox: He was merely testing us.
* Grimlock: Me, Grimlock, think the Commander need a real test... With a real DINOBOT!
* Rhinox: As crazy as that sounds, it might be a good idea, Commander. The Dinobot you fought earlier was holding back to size you up. Sparring with Grimlock might just be the warm up you need.

sections.heading: Destiny Deja-Vu
sections.text:
Part 1
* Prowl: Optimus, Commander, I'm worried about Rhinox's commitment to our mission. I mean, why didn't he bring Dinobot back with the party when he had the chance?
* Optimus Prime: Why do you not raise your concern with Rhinox directly?
* Prowl: I would, but he left the base hours ago and has disabled all communications.
* Optimus Prime: I see, that is perplexing. He does have a bond with Dinobot. Perhaps it clouds his judgement.
* Prowl: Commander, let's go and clear up his judgement.
Part 2
* Prowl: Thundering hooves and the whir of chain guns... Sounds like Rhinox.
* Rhinox: Your auditory processors do not deceive you. What can I do for you?
* Prowl: To start, you can explain what you're doing out here and why you didn't bring Dinobot in when you had the chance.
* Rhinox: The answer is one and the came. I am here to aid a friend, a hero. You may not understand, but he needs to given the chance to fulfill his destiny... A destiny wrapped in his past.
* Prowl: He needs to be stopped.
* Rhinox: Ne needs to fulfill his destiny... Yet again.
Part 3
* Prowl: Listen Rhinox, we mean you no harm. But Dinobot can't be allowed to destroy the Golden Disk before we study it. What is wrong with you? What is wrong with him?
* Rhinox: You wouldn't understand. He lives by the Code of a Hero.
* Prowl: Yeah? Well, I live by the Code of the Soldier and my marching orders are to bring him and The Disk back to Optimus for study.
* Rhinox: You don't comprehend the Disk's potential for total destruction. Dinobot does. He has destroyed it before. I will see to it that he fulfills his destiny... A second time.

sections.heading: Hizzz Disk
sections.text:
Part 1
* Prowl: Optimus, I'm afraid we have another one of those beastie things acting up. Waspinator has been talking crazy about the Golden Disk.
* Waspinator: Acting up? Wazpinator thought free speech is the right of all sentient beings everyone. Right, Optimus?
* Optimus Prime: He has a point, Prowl. But Waspinator, I caution you not to act rashly. The Disk holds great power, do not let it sway your actions.
* Waspinator: Wazpinator not act rashly. Wazpinator just tired. Tired of taking orders. Tired of obeying others. Wazpinator thinks the Disk might change things.
* Optimus Prime: You have the right to speak. But be warned, words and the actions that may accompany them have conesquences.

Part 2
* Prowl: I'm not the told you kind of bot, Optimus, but I told you so.
* Optimus Prime: Told me what? Is this about Waspinator.
* Prowl: Bingo! He was last seen buzzing away from the base ranting about it being his time now. Or, should I say "hizzzzz" time now?
* Optimus Prime: No offense to our ally, but how serious do you consider this? After all, he is not the most fearsome of Predacons.
* Prowl: Have you seen that bomb he rides around on? He's deranged. I wouldn't want to take any chances, especially if he gets his hands on the Golden Disk.
* Optimus Prime: I suspect you are right, old friend. Waspinator does have a willingness to blow himself up. Let's go get him.
Part 3
* Optimus Prime: Waspinator, I am glad we found you. I suggest you report to base before things get out of hand.
* Waspinator: Wazpinator not leaving without the Disk.
* Optimus Prime: Head home now. That is an order.
* Waspinator: Wazpinator not take orders from Truckbot.
* Optimus Prime: But you are one of us now.
* Waspinator: Wazpinator not one of anything. Wazpinator tried being evil, tried being an Autobot friend with the Maximals. No more.
* Optimus Prime: Let us talk about this.
* Waspinator: No more talk. Everyone talk to Wazpinator ... "Fly here, zap that, scout this." Nobody takes Wazpinator seriously. That will change when Wazpinator hazzzz the Disk!

sections.heading: The Golden Code
sections.text:
Part 1
* Bumblebee: It's good news, bad news time.
* Optimus Prime: Have we not been through this before? Report your findings.
* Bumblebee: I hear ya', boss. I think I've found the Golden Disk.
* Optimus Prime: I assume that is the good news.
* Bumblebee: The problem is... I think Dinobot has found it, too.
* Optimus Prime: Yes, that would pose a problem. You saw him?
* Bumblebee: Yep. And he was on a direct route to where I saw it.
* Optimus Prime: Why did you not retrieve the Disk?
* Bumblebee: He was packing serious firepower. I'm no coward, but I'm also no fool.
* Optimus Prime: Sometimes prudence affords the opportunity to tilt the odds in your favor. Let us hurry and see if that is true. Commander, roll out!
Part 2
* Optimus Prime: So, you continue your quest. I do not share your history, but I seek to understand your motivation.
* Dinobot: A wise Maximal once said, "A deed once done cannot be undone. But perhaps it can be mitigated." The Disk must be "mitigated".
* Optimus Prime: And who was it that said that?
* Dinobot: A soldier, that's who. *Snarl* Now stay out of my way. The Disk calls for its destruction.
Part 3
* Optimus Prime: The Disk lies ahead. Allow us to study the wealth of knowledge it possesses.
* Dinobot: You are ignorant to its inherent dangers.
* Optimus Prime: But knowledge cures ignorance.
* Dinobot: It must be destroyed! I have seen it fall into the wrong hands before. *Snarl* Never again.
* Optimus Prime: It is only dangerous in the wrong hands.
* Dinobot: Whose hands can be trusted?
* Optimus Prime: Trust is what keeps us alive in this Primus-forsaken planet. The Commander has proven worthy of our trust, give him yours.
* Dinobot: A soldier does not blindly give his trust. It must be earned. *Snarl* So earn it.
Category:Transcripts

Commander.lead:
The Commander is the term for players in Transformers: Forged to Fight.

On the game's top taskbar, you can view at a glance your strongest Bot, Alliance name, level and experience, and unused Mastery points. Your avatar is the strongest Bot you have.

All Commanders have a Commander Profile, from which anyone can view a Commander's in-game name, his/her three Top Bots, and other stats.

On the left side of a profile, you can view: (those marked 'private' can only be viewed by yourself)
* The Commader's name and XP Level.
* Masteries (private)
* Medal count
* Alliance name, total rating, and position
In the overview tab you can view:
* Shield activity (private)
* Total Bots
* Total Rating
* Defense Rating
* Top 3 Bots and their rank and level
* Top 3 Mods and their rank and level (private)
In the Boosts tab, you can view your active Boosts, including those received from Alliance help

In the Stats tab, you can view a Commander's Mission stats:
* Total Missions Completed
* Daily Missions Completed
* Mission Fights Won
* Arena Fights Won
* Highest Arena Win Streak
* Raid Attacks Won
* Raid Defends Won

sections.heading: Level Up Rewards
sections.text:
When a Commander earns enough XP to advance to the next level, he/she will be rewarded items, as well as unlock new features. The current level cap is 60.

sections.heading: Be Not Afraid
sections.text:
Part 1
*Marissa Faireborn: Teletraan is reporting a new abnormality in Deception activity. I'm requesting all Primes and the Commander on deck for this one.
*Optimus Prime: What seems to be the quandary?
*Marissa: Everything within range of scans is swapping signals! First a desertion of Deceptions, then a flood of them.
*Optimus Prime (MV1): Can you propose a location for us to rally?
*Marissa: Up ahead there's one specific signal that is reading Autobot, with a background radiation of Decepticon circuitry.
*Optimus Primal: A Decepticon in disguise? Seems like a place to start.
Part 2
*Jetfire: That's far enough Decepticons! Posing as Primes, have you no shame?
*Optimus Prime: Skyfire! Is that you?
*Jetfire: My designation is Jetfire! Calculate carefully before you speak next, imposters.
*Optimus Prime (MV1): Too young to be the Jetfire I know. Same blunt attitude however.
*Optimus Prime: An Autobot by any name is a welcomed sight. If you just allow us to explain-
*Jetfire: Enough of your charade! There is not a Prime amongst you, one of your ranks couldn't even copy the form correctly!
*Honestly, an APE?! As a PRIME?
*Optimus Primal: If I wasn't sympathetic to your confusion, I may begin to take offense.
Part 3
*Jetfire: I have been studying this world since my arrival. Duplicates, Dark Energon pockets, and timelines overlapping or rewritten.
*Optimus Primal: It can be a lot to take in, time travel is never a simple thing to accept.
*Jetfire: From my observations, I can only assume you represent a threat and I must take preventative measures.
*Optimus Prime: What can we do to prove we are Autobots through and through?
*Jetfire: I believe in what my optics report and my sensors measure. When you and your human can fight like Primes, I'll start trusting you.
*Optimus Prime (MV1): You heard him Commander, show what kind of Sparks burn inside us!

sections.heading: Of Greatness
sections.text:
Part 1
*Jetfire: I've searched this area to track the pulse of Decepticon energy. I've returned with a few...contradictory findings.
*Optimus Prime: In what way?
*Jetfire: I've seen Autobots turn on each other. Bases defended by Decepticons and Autobots alike. A path to a war that I wish to never see.
*Optimus Primal: It can be a strange world. But many of us remain as you remember.
*Jetfire: There is one whom I remember, their signal is nearby. I have hopes that this world changed them for the better.
*Optimus Prime (MV1): Hope is a luxury we are often not afforded.
Part 2
*Starscream: Are my optics faulty? Have the fates brought me closure and delivered Skyfire to me?
*Jetfire: My designation is Jetfire. Chaos and misfortune brought me here Starscream, but perhaps we may serve a purpose.
*Optimus Prime: This is who you were seeking out, Jetfire?
*Jetfire: Back on Cybertron he and I were paired as scouts. For the sake of efficiency, he would be an ideal candidate as we can scan for the source of Decepticon abnormalities.
*Starscream: Feeling homesick? I'm not in a nostalgic mood.
*Jetfire: It's for a greater good!
*Starscream: Since when is being good so great?
Part 3
*Starscream: I've detected a thing or two, but I don't share secrets with weaklings. You'll have to prove yourself worthy of my assistance.
*Jetfire: It would be hypocritical of me to deny a challenge I so recently requested.
*Optimus Primal: Agreed, I say we indulge him.
*Jetfire: I take no pleasure in this, Starscream.
*Starscream: Don't worry, I'll take plenty for both of us.

sections.heading: Uneasy Lies the Head
sections.text:
Part 1
*Jetfire: Starscream, what is waiting for us ahead?
*Starscream: Suffering, punishment, and ultimately defeat.
*Optimus Prime (MV1): You may wish to adjust your tone, or we shall make adjustments for you.
*Starscream: Old habit, my new and fearless leader. the Decepticons are gathering fresh forces.
*Optimus Primal: More Decepticons leaders are being brought over? Another beastly Megatron?
*Starscream: No, they're brining over those who are known to follow orders. A Tactician in this case.
Part 2
*Bumblebee (DOTM): I was told some Autobot scrap heaps were headed over here for a fight.
*Optimus Prime (MV1): Bumblebee? What is your malfunction?
*Starscream: He's not your Bumblebee, Prime. He is part of the Decepticon plan.
*Optimus Prime (MV1): Dark Energon again? Hardly a new tactic.
*Starscream: Not quite, they are using a Spacebridge to access an ancient Dark Realm. This Bumblebee is a Decepticon loyalist.
*Jetfire: Confirmed, the only Autobot sources registering from him are on...
*...his knuckles.
*Bumblebee (DOTM): A bit of sparring practice, but don't worry I have plenty of fight left in me for all of you.
Part 3
*Megatron (ROTF): Enjoying yourselves, Autobots?
*Optimus Prime (MV1): This is your plan? Break our spirit by forcing us to destroy reflections of those under my command?
*Megatron (ROTF) Do not pretend to be a leader, Prime! You are a butcher. you have torn apart many a Bot whom you deemed unworthy!
*Optimus Prime (MV1): Our world knew more brutality than most. However, I only did what was necessary to protect innocent lives.
*Megatron (ROTF): Then you understand that when I snuff the Sparks of three Primes, I do it to save all Decepticons kind!
*Optimus Prime (MV1): I understand...that you will try.

sections.heading: That Wears a Crown
sections.text:
Part 1
*Jetfire: How are they accessing the Spcebridge? The Energon required for transreality transfer is near incalculable.
*Starscream: They weren't exactly keeping me in the loop. I just know the general area that everyone seemed to be headed.
*Optimus Prime (MV1): Are you telling us that even the Decepticons do not trust you?
*Starscream: I may have a reputation for myself. It's not as though I'm the only disloyal Decepticon, is it Jetfire?
*Jetfire: I am loyal to logic and science. All the facts presented proved to me that the Decepticons served only as instruments of destruction.
*Starscream: Ah, but what lovely music those instruments make.
*Optimus Primal: Less chatter, more movement. We need to stop this plan as soon as possible.
*Starscream: As you command.
Part 2
*Bumblebee: Well, well...if it isn't a platoon of Primes and turncoats looking for another beehive to bother.
*Jetfire: Commander, this duplicate Bumblebee is not the same model as the one we previously encountered. Fresh tactics and no mercy is advised.
*Starscream: No mercy? Perhaps I am on the right team. Human participant or not.
*Bumblebee: You brought a human with you? It has been some time since I made one fear my fury.
*Optimus Prime: You will find our Commander is made of sterner stuff.
*Bumblebee: Oh, I plan to discover EXACTLY what they are made of.
Part 3
*Megatron: Does it awaken anything in you? This unrestrained violence against your friends?
*Optimus Prime: You lack originality Megatron. Will you all be just retreading the same plan over and over?
*Megatron: Prime, until you can repeat the results of a test...you've not really progressed in your findings.
*Jetfire: I am reluctant to agree with the details, but not the purpose, of that observation.
*Megatron: However, while my counterpart left you functioning, I shall take you offline.
*Jetfire: You'll find the conclusion of this contrary to your hypothesis.

sections.heading: Passing Through Nature
sections.text:
Part 1
*Jetfire: I'm having concerns that you're leading us to these battles intentionally, Starscream. 
*Starscream: I understand your fears, but truly I am leading you to the source of all this!
*Galvatron: The truth? From you Starscream? This is bad comedy.
*Starscream: Autobots! What you seek is just beyond this quadrant. Meet with me there!
*Galvatron: Typical cowardice, this is why I have chosen a worthy opponent to serve as my personal lieutenant.
*Ultra Magnus: Did you summon me, Leader Galvatron?
*Optimus Prime: By the Architect!
Part 2
*Ultra Magnus:Come to donate your scrap to the cause? Our army requires fresh salvage.
*Optimus Prime: Ultra Magnus! It has been months, I thought you were lost to the wastelands.
*Ultra Magnus: My last memory was fighting YOU Optimus, until both our Sparks were extinguished...then I awoke here with a purpose, and a duty.
*Optimus Prime: This duplicate madness must come to an end.
*Ultra Magnus: If you are looking for an end, it will be provided.
Part 3
*Optimus Prime (MV1): Galvatron! If yo have access to a Spacebridge why pervert its purpose to terrorize us rather than use it to escape?
*Galvatron: This world does not wish for our escape, something more all-encompassing and consequential is at hand!
*Jetfire: Would you care to clarify your terms, or is cryptic speech your only refuge?
*Galvatron: You shall understand the grandeur of my words...when I send your Sparks to meet with oblivion.

sections.heading: To Eternity
sections.text:
Part 1
*Starscream: DECEPTICONS! THE PRIMES AND TRAITOR HAVE BEEN LEAD TO YOU!!!
*Optimus Prime: I wish I had a single circuit that could register this as a surprise, you triple-faced betrayer!
*Jetfire: Why? Why brother?! What could this madness possibly have to offer you?
*Starscream: FOOL! I gain that which I have always wanted! AN ARMY TO COMMAND!
*Jetfire: Who would follow your twisted will?
*Sharkticon: WE AWAIT YOUR ORDERS LEADER STARSCREAM!
*Optimus Primal: Primus save us...the inmates have taken over the asylum! All that's missing is-
*Megatronus: Welcome to your doom, Autobots. We have been eager for your arrival.
*Optimus Primal: Well...that's just PRIME.
Part 2
*Optimus Prime (MV1): I thought our Commander and their team sealed you in the bowels of this world, Megatronus.
*Megatronus: Yes, and I thank them for the glorious honor they bestowed upon me!
*Optimus Primal: Your higher functions pick up a virus? What madness are you spouting?
*Megatronus: You call this world New Quintessa...the Quintessons barely touched the skin of it. I have awoken the TITAN we dwell upon.
*Optimus Prime: You are a Cityspeaker now?
*Megatronus: We share a more ancient understanding. An alignment beyond what Caminus and his mere messengers could have hoped for.
*Jetfire: I shudder to think how broken a mind needs to be done before it could align with yours.
*Megatronus: Have you not seen the replication of other worlds in the midst of their destruction? This plante begs for war, and is a nemesis of life. This Titan is ...
*A DECEPTICON.
Part 3
*Megatronus: I have lived in the yawning expanse of the beyond. Unfathomable darkness has been awaiting and embrace us as it kin.
*Jetfire: I turned from the Decepticon cause. I'm certain this world can be shown the light of truth as well.
*Megatron: YOU ARE MISTAKEN, DESERTER! 
*Cyclonus: WIN OR LOSE...
*Megatron (ROTF): ...THIS WORLD IS OURS...
*Galvatron: ...AND WE BELONG HERE! 
*Megatronus: Make you last stand, Autobot scum. Eternity awaits.
*Optimus Prime (MV1): Commander...
*Optimus Prime: ROLL OUT!

Crystal.lead:
Crystals are special items that can be used in the Space Bridge to obtain various items in the game, such as Gold,  Bots, Mods, Ore-13, and other resources. All Crystals that have Crystal Shards are formed from 2,000 of them, with a few exceptions and highest-end ones cost 10,000 Crystal Shards, like Tier 3 and 4 Class Spark Crystals and 5-Star Bot Crystals. 

To open a Crystal, drag it into the Space Bridge. While a Crystal is being activated, you can stop the scrolling roulette early, but it does not affect the outcome. Crystals can also be opened at once, up to ten at a time.

sections.heading: Drop Rates
sections.text:
Our drop rates are set in our back-end administration platform for the game.

Drop rates indicate the likelihood that you will receive the specified item. Here are a couple of quick examples to help explain how drop rates work:

* If you have a coin, the likelihood of tossing this coin and getting heads versus tails is 50%. Each time that you toss the coin is independent of the previous coin toss, and the likelihood of getting heads versus tails does not change because you tried again. If you toss this coin 10 times, it is possible that it may turn up heads every time, just once or twice, etc. Each coin toss is independent and not affected by the previous coin toss.
* In relation to the game, if you buy a Premium Bot Crystal, and the drop rate for a 4-Star bot is 3%, this does not mean that if you buy 100 Premium Bot Crystals you are guaranteed to receive three 4-Star bots. This means that you have a 3% chance to get a 4-Star bot each time you open a crystal. If you purchase one Premium Bot Crystal, you could receive a 4-Star bot, or you could purchase multiple Premium Bot Crystals and not receive any 4-Star bots.

sections.heading: WHICH ITEMS DISPLAY DROP RATES?
sections.text:
You will see the drop rates displayed for crystals purchased in the following stores or areas of the game:

* Crystal vault
* Special event-driven stores
* Shard crystal stores
* Other crystals purchased with real money or Energon (within the stores or as special promotions)

sections.heading: WHERE WILL I FIND THIS INFORMATION?
sections.text: Within the game, when you go to any of the stores mentioned above to purchase a crystal, you will find an info icon.

sections.heading: DROP RATE MISCONCEPTIONS
sections.text:
We strongly believe in keeping Transformers: Forged to Fight fair for all of our players, and as such:

* There are no specific drop rates for individuals.
* Drop rates are not affected by how much money is spent within the game.
* Specific bots do not have a higher drop rate than another bot unless otherwise noted in the drop rates of the crystal.

There is no easy answer for a streak of bad luck, and we certainly understand that misfortune can lead to disappointment and frustration.

Our drop rates are set to ensure that there is not only a balance maintained between the opportunity to obtain valued items, but the rarity and integrity of these items as well.

While the drop of a specific bot is not guaranteed, there are many ways to get the one you want:

* 3-Star & 4-Star Bot Crystals
* Random drop from Premium Bot Crystals
* Ranked rewards from arenas
* 3-Star bot chance from your Daily Crystal
* Specialty crystals which increase the chance of getting the bot you want

Make sure that you check the game for new offers and events!

sections.heading: Specialty Crystals
sections.text:
These crystals are temporarily available in the CRYSTAL tab and change after the countdown reaches zero. Exchange Energon for specialty crystals that contain better and more specific rewards than Premium Bot Crystals. 

These limited-time crystals are available to earn or purchase for 150 Energon each whenever Bots are featured. They are like Premium Bot Crystals, but with a slight chance to give a 3 or 4-Star version of the character featured, or previous recent featured Bots. Listed are drop rates, revealed in v5.2:
* 4-Star Featured Bot: about 0.5%
* 3-Star Featured Bot: about 3%
* 4-Star Bot: 1.5%
* 3-Star Bot: 26%
* 2-Star Bot: 72.5%

There are crystals with unique names for each Bot, but they mostly share one of three themed crystal appearances. Crystals of older Bots were initially the first available method of obtaining the 4-Star version of that Bot.

Starting with Galvatron from October 2017, new bot crystals are unique and were discounted from 150 to 120 Energon for a time.

Starting with Tantrum from July 2018, an elite version of Featured Bot Crystals were introduced. They cost 300 200 Energon each and have a chance to give a 3~5-Star Bot. They are only available to Commanders who are at least level 40.

*5-Star Featured Bot: 0.5%
*4-Star Featured Bot: 1.5%
*3-Star Featured Bot: 8.96%
* 5-Star Bot: 1.99%
*4-Star Bot: 13.43%
*3-Star Bot: 84.58%
For awhile from August 2019, 5-Star Featured Bot Crystals were made available on the second week of the month for three days for 12,500 5-Star Bot Crystal Shards and other means of purchase. It gives a 5-Star Bot with a 15% increased chance for the featured bot.

sections.heading: Bio
sections.text: Resurrected by the same dark energies as his master Galvatron, Cyclonus leads a mighty armada provided by Unicron himself. Loyal, patient, and skilled, Cyclonus is ultimately the counterbalance to Galvatron’s chaotic rule.

sections.heading: Basic Abilities
sections.text:
* Dark Energy - Grants increased Attack Rating and powers the Dark Field.
* Dark Field - A close range of pulse of dark energy that inflicts Dark Burn and has a chance to Nullify Buffs.
* Discipline - This bot's extensive training allows it to excel in many situations.

sections.heading: Abilities
sections.text:
*When Filling a Power Bar 
** Each bar of power grant’s Cyclonus a Dark Energy Charge, increasing Attack Rating by 22~30% for 6 seconds.
*Dark Field 
**When Cyclonus gains Dark Energy or completes a full Melee Combo with Dark Energy active, his Dark Field pulses.
** The Dark Field inflicts Dark Burn, dealing 20% of Attack as instant Energy Damage and has a 60~76% chance to Nullify an enemy buff. If the opponent is Unstoppable this chance increases to 100%.
**If an opponent with an Unstoppable buff Dashes toward Cyclonus, he instantly gains Dark Energy, Nullifies the Unstoppable buff, and inflicts Stun for 1.5 seconds.
*Discipline
** After being struck 5 times by Melee Attacks, Cyclonus gains a 18~28% Physical Resistance Buff for 7~9 seconds.
** After landing 6 Ranged Attacks, Cyclonus gains a Ranged Bonus, increasing damage from Ranged Attacks by 15~25% and Projectile Speed for 5~7 seconds.
** After landing 10 Melee Attacks, Cyclonus gains a Melee Bonus, increasing damage from Melee Attacks by 15~25% for 5~7 seconds.

sections.heading: Special Attacks
sections.text:
#Cosmic Edge - A blade rivaled only by the Star Saber itself.
#* 100% Armor Piercing.
#Galaxy Gun - A blast of cosmic proportions.
#* 100% chance the last hit of this attack is Unblockable.
#Interstellar Ride - Cyclonus takes a precisely calculated trip through the center of his opponent.
#* Cyclonus Gains Dark Energy and begins to automatically pulse the Dark Field for 10 seconds.

sections.heading: Synergy Bonuses
sections.text:
* Allies – Kickback, Tantrum, Megatronus - +2~3~8% Armor
* Enemies – Ultra Magnus, Arcee, Blaster - +2~3~8% Attack
* Hand of Chaos – Galvatron - All Decepticon Special Attacks gain +2~6~15% Special Attack Damage and Critical Damage.
* Dark Ally – Nemesis Prime - Increase Dark Burn damage by +4~4~5~5%.
* Leadership (5-Star) - Acting as a beacon of leadership for the team, all lower tier teammates +10% Armor Rating.

sections.heading: Player
sections.text:
Staying close to the enemy is a very good idea. While Cyclonus can fight at a distance, his dark field will not deal any damage or nullify. Cyclonus's Nullify is more suitable for removing otherwise permanent damage or resistance buffs rather than removing a stack of buffs. Starscream is more suited for quick nullification.

Cyclonus is a very good bot to use in raids. His Dark Energy is useful against Exo-Filters and is an obvious counter to defending Motormasters, while his Special I is very useful against Security Modules.

sections.heading: Opponent
sections.text:
Conversely, don't engage in melee combat very often. Ranged combat will help you stay away from his dark field and prevent pain and the removal of your buffs. Preferably, set off his field with a ranged heavy when he is close to a bar of power.

Also please don't rush in if you have Unstoppable, you don't want to trigger an immediate Stun.

sections.heading: Strong Match-ups
sections.text:
* Anyone with buffs - The buffs the bots gain will be Nullified and will cause extra damage with those buffs nullified especially bots with unstoppable buffs
* Motormaster - Motormaster’s Unstoppable will become a major disadvantage when fighting against Cyclonus and his Dark Field.
*Optimus Prime (MV1) - Cyclonus’ sword will pierce even the toughest armor, stopping the Autobot leader from making his epic last stand.
*Tantrum - Dark Fields will Nullify Tantrum's Melee Buffs and Stun him if he tries to Dash In to deal that extra damage while Unstoppable.
*Megatron (ROTF) - Cyclonus can nullify Megatron’s unstoppables(if he attempts to dash at Cyclonus while unstoppable) leaving him vulnerable for a few seconds, ensure that he doesn't repair at the end of the fight and stacking special ones will pierce through Megatron’s tough armor despite the class type advantages.
*Megatron (G1) - The original Decepticon leader too will struggle a lot against Cyclonus every time he gets knocked down.
*Grimlock - What’s a king without melee buffs?

sections.heading: Mods
sections.text: * Any Mod with Unstoppable Buffs - Bots with an Exo-Filter will have their Mod used against them as Cyclonus Nullifies Unstoppable buffs replacing them as Stuns.

sections.heading: Weak Match-ups
sections.text:
* Galvatron - The master of chaos, Galvatron, will be able to deal most of his damage at range, avoiding the Dark Field. It is also important to note that Galvatron’s Unstoppable cannot be Nullified.
*Shockwave - Shockwave can ensure that Cyclonus never reaches a bar of power to gain his Dark Energy and Shockwave generates no buffs at all which means Cyclonus dark fields will have nothing to nullify.
* Megatronus - The master of demolitions comes with relics which Cyclonus’s dark fields won’t be able to nullify.

sections.heading: Recommended Modules
sections.text:
* Robot Resource - Robot Resources will push Cyclonus to gain Dark Energy faster.
*Harm Accelerator - Not taking damage from Cyclonus will be a rare occurrence; add another constant tick of damage and watch the opponent wilt.

Daily Mission.lead:
Daily Missions are solo missions in which Spark Essence can be earned.

* There are two types of daily missions: the spark trials and the class-specific daily missions.
* 
* DAILY MISSIONS:
* Daily spark trial missions contain chances at basic sparks and basic spark fragments.
* Daily class missions contain chances at class-specific sparks and class-specific spark fragments.
* A screenshot showing daily mission examples
* 
* DAILY MISSION REWARDS:
* Completion rewards require that you simply complete the mission at least once, regardless of exploration percentage.
* Exploration rewards require that you fully explore and complete the mission map, having visited every tile and node.
* Each map will have guaranteed completion rewards and exploration rewards that vary depending on the difficulty of the mission: Easy, Medium, or Hard.
* 
* EXAMPLE OF COMPLETION AND EXPLORATION REWARDS:
* A screenshot showing examples of daily mission completion and exploration rewards
* 
* EXAMPLE OF EXPLORATION REWARDS:
* A screenshot showing examples of completion and exploration rewards
* 
* Note: As seen in the previous image, if you have earned either completion or exploration rewards, you will see a green checkmark next to earned rewards.
* 
* GETTING SPARKS FROM DAILY MISSIONS
* Sparks are NOT awarded for the successful completion of any class spark mission, only spark essence.
* Sparks are rewarded for exploration in easy mode, but not the other modes. The drop is chance-based. Spark essence, however, is guaranteed.

sections.heading: Map
sections.text:
All days have Spark Trials map, in which there are two maps; An Easy map for Tier 1 Basic Essence, and a Medium map for Tier 2 Essence. Each day focuses on one class, with Sunday a free-for-all for Tier 1 Class Essence for all classes. v6.0 added medium maps to Sunday missions, and in a later update Hard difficulty; and v8.3 added auto-complete and overhauled Sunday to be a T1-3 Class Crystal Trial.
* Monday: Brawler Bash
* Tuesday: Warrior Wars
* Wednesday: Scout Skirmish
* Thursday: Tech Tantrum
* Friday: Demolitions Derby
* Saturday: Tactician Trouble
* Sunday: Crystal Trials

Spark Trials are present all week.

Note that the maps and ratings for all Sparks are identical except for Class Spark and Bots encountered on the map.

sections.heading: In-Game Description
sections.text:
Demolitions Bots are burst damage experts that buff their Special Attacks for bigger, bolder, explosions.
*The fewer, but critical high-damage attacks of the Demolition Bots give them an advantage over Tactician Bots.
*Tech Bots' shields and Power reducing abilites are effective against Demolition Bots.

sections.heading: Strategies

Staying true to their name, Demolitions bots bring the noise by amping up their Special Attacks in their quest to overpower and overrun. Their Crit chance is fairly low but their Crit damage is very high. Their affinity for burst damage flows in their blood and they deal massive damage with their special attacks.

Tech Bots love to play antics against a Demolitions Bot by draining their power and defending against their heavy-hitting Special.

sections.text:
* Special 1 - Triassic Turbulence - Dinobot and his opponent are sent skyward.
** 50~70% to inflict a 10~30% Armor Break for 5~7 seconds.
*Special 2 - Jurassic Justice - Dinobot gives his opponent no quarter.
**20~40% Armor Piercing, that chance increases to 100% with Critical Hits.
**80% Chance to gain Critical Rating Up, enhancing Critical Chance by 20-30% for 9 seconds.
*Special 3 - Cretaceous Carnage - Dinobot finishes his opponent off in a fit of primal rage.
**50% chance per bite to Repair 3% of Health over 4 seconds.
**100% Chance to gain Critical Rating Up, enhancing Critical Chance by 20-30% for 14 seconds.

sections.heading: Synergy Bonuses
sections.text:
* Allies - Rhinox, Cheetor. Optimus Primal +2~8% Armor
* Enemies - Waspinator, Scorponok +2~8% Attack Rating
* Swordmasters - Windblade, Drift, Bludgeon +2~10% Critical Damage for each Sword Attack that isn't a Critical Hit until the next Critical Hit. +4~12% more Critical Hits in Solo Missions.
* Shieldmasters - Mixmaster, Jetfire Well timed Blocks against Melee Attacks gain +5~20% Block Proficiency.

sections.heading: Player
sections.text:
Dinobot Armor Breaks passively when opponents dash into his damaging block, which might be a risky playstyle for Commanders who are willing to reflect and take some reduced damage than no damage from dodging. Alternatively he can actively Armor break with Special 1. Special 3's Repair is more of a bonus than a sustainability tactic, at worst he'll get no repairs and at best he'll get 3~4 stacks for 9~12% health.

Try to pair him with Swordmaster Bots to gain more Crit Damage and Crit Rate.

sections.heading: Opponent
sections.text: Whatever you do, don't make a habit of dashing into his blocks. Also, try not to make a habit of dodging in the middle of his Special I, as the last two hits will register and when Dinobot use his special l, dash back as quickly as possible to avoid getting hit.

sections.heading: Strong Match-Ups
sections.text:
*Brawlers – Opponent’s that Dash into Dinobot’s Block are punished with Armor Break, but Brawlers like Motormaster and Grimlock loves to Dash into their enemies because they rely on melee attacks.
*Grindor – Dinobot’s particular skillset make him adept at cutting through the armor of this thick-skinned helicopter.
* Bumblebee - This gold speedster is rewarded for dashing at opponent’s and staying near them, but dashing into and hitting Dinobot’s block would be a painful mistake.
*Megatron (ROTF) - Dinobot has strong critical hits and is the master of Anti-Armor which means All of Dinobot’s attacks will easily bypass Megatron’s armor despite the class type advantages.

sections.heading: Weak Match-Ups
sections.text:
*Waspinator – Dinobot is perfectly suited to fighting opponent’s that rely on Melee Attacks while Waspinator is adept at fighting from range.
* Mirage – Mirage’s Power Burn can drain Power through an opponent’s Block, bypassing Dinobot’s punishing Block abilities.
*Grimlock - With the ability to purify bleeds and no armor to break or pierce, Grimlock will show this maximal who is the real dinobot in this game despite the class type advantages. However an Al Grimlock loves to dash to his enemies so as long as you don’t dash, you are alright.
*Megatronus and Galvatron - These bots can dark burn though dinobot’s punishing blocks and Megatronus’s relic of obedience can prevent dinobot from gaining critic buffs putting the master of anti armor in a serious disadvantage.

sections.heading: Recommended Modules
sections.text:
the master of anti-armor will protect your base with these mods
*Strange Refractor– Granting Dinobot greater Block Proficiency and the ability to Stun when Blocking is a potent way to add to his already formidable abilities.
*Nightbird's Mark – This mod will drastically increase Dinobot’s Critical Rating, improving his Armor Piercing and Bleeding attacks.
*Superconductor 1000 - Good luck dodging this one.

sections.heading: Commander
sections.text: Dirge's Bleeding Fear will suit Commanders who prefer to dodge as much as possible.

sections.heading: Opponent
sections.text: Commanders like to make their bots dodge frantically to bait out AI enemies' attacks, But Dirge's Fear is a strong counter and deterrent. You'll have to make deliberate offensive counterattacks with as few moves as possible to overcome Fear. The Bleed runs it course so fast it may still take a toll before capable Bots can manually Purify it. Stay in Unstoppable combats, you won't be struck by Dirge's attacks or Fear.

sections.heading: Strong Match-ups
sections.text: *Scouts have a lot of Evade abilities, meaning that they will be affected by Fear for a lot of the battle. Their low health also means they’ll want to remove Fear quickly to avoid Bleed damage.

sections.heading: Weak Match-ups

*Any bots who have Unstoppable buffs will be your friend.
*Grimlock’s rage will only be fuelled if he keeps on bleeding and the fact that he loves to dodge put the Ramjet reskin at a serious disadvantage.
*When Megatronus’s relics of preservation and obedience comes in play, Dirge will be fearing the Fallen instead.
