sections.heading: Echoes
sections.text:
Part 1
*Marissa: Commander, Teletraan has provided coordinatos for a new quadrant ripe with variable resources.
*Windblade: And, I've been chosen for escort duties.
*Marissa: "Chosen?" You asked for the assignment.
*Windblade: Indeed I did. This new area harbors ancient auras...echoes of beings from a distant past.
*Echoes that might tell us more about this planet's history, and the Quintessons' schemes.
Part 2
*Death: A party approaches. One among the group is possessed of a high degree of ... shall we say... "intuition?"
*Wisdom: Yes, she appears to sense some parts of New Quintessa's past.
*Death: Probability that she may learn something of value to her comrades?
*Wisdom: 47%. Probability of her surviving long enough to use said information?
*Death: 0% I have Bludgeon positioned up ahead to enforce that probability.
Part 3
*Bludgeon: Ah, Windblade. the wayward pupil. Are you back to study with the master?
*Windblade: I was never your student! I was under the control of the Quintessons, just as you are now.
*Bludgeon: Control is your choice of words. I choose to think I'm under their tutelage. A true warrior is always studying, always honing their techniques and skills.
*Windblade: I'm glad you like learning, because the Commander is about to teach you your last lesson.

sections.heading: Butt Heads
sections.text:
Part 1
*Windblade: Our last excursion confirmed my suspicions... "others" were here before the Quintessons. I'm going to scout more in search of residual readings.
*Rhinox: I'm not sure exactly sure what "residual readings" are, but I gotta respect someone on a mystical mission.
*Windblade: Those from my planet Caminus have a history of unique connections. I'm off now,
*Rhinox: Whoa, heady stuff. Commander, I'm afraid our mission today is a little more grounded in the here and now.
*Intel indicates the Quints have a Deception named Motormaster waiting up ahead. They say he's kinda headstrong. Luckily, I am, too.
Part 2
*Motormaster: Looks like the Commander's squad of flunkies has brought a ...what are you? Some kind of beast?
*Rhinox: The name's Rhinox and you must be Motormaster.
*Motormaster: That's right...the one and only King of The Road.
*Rhinox: Is that so? Pretty empty title...I don't see many roads around these parts.
*Motormaster: Take a good look at that gill on my arm, tough guy. Next time I see you, you're gonna meet it up close and personal.
Part 3
*Motormaster: The Beastie with the big nose returns.
*Rhinox: You knew we'd find you eventually, Prince of the Dusty Path.
*Motromaster: Argh! I hope you're ready to butt heads!
*Rhinox: Nah, I don't think so...don't like wasting my time on the lightwwights. Commander, choose your warrior and shut this Motormouth up!

sections.heading: Who's Your Master?
sections.text:
Part 1
*Marissa: Commander, Teletraan has detected contrails of a distinct Decepticon signature in the area. Starscream's to be specific.
*Prowl: Those would be chemtrails.
*Marissa: Prowl, we don't deal in ancient unproven theories.
*Prowl: Listen, if it emits from that Decepticlown's engines, it's noxious and deadly. I'm sticking with chemtrails.
Part 2
*Starscream: Your squad grows in size. Surely you must concede the odds are stacked in your favor
*Prowl: What's your point?
*Starscream: The point is that it is prudent for me to take flight. I'll let the masters' minions weaken your squad before I engage you and your insect Commander.
*Prowl: You can fly but you can't hide.
Part 3
*Prowl: Step forward, Starscream. You were warned that you couldn't hide from us.
*Starscream: I do not obey you, Autocretins. I serve only myself and my masters.
*Prowl: Masters? Don't you mean master ...Megatron?
*Starscream: Hardly, that overrated blowhard keeps promising the universe and delivering abject failure.
*I side with those that will lead me to the power I so deserve...The Quintessons. I am more valuable to them alive than non-functioning. Therefore, I won't lose!

sections.heading: Scout's Honor
sections.text:
Part 1
*Optimus Prime (MV1): As we continue our investigation of this new secotr, evidence of the Quintesson's impact on the planet grows larger.
*Bumblebee (DOTM): My scouting forays confirms this. Quintesson architecture, structures, and devices are everywhere in the territory.
*Optimus Prime: This would suggest we may be getting closer to the source of their power.
*Bumblebee: Commander, carry on with your mission. Optimus, with your permission, I'd like to do some scouting...solo. Our party is too big to be effective in this endeavor.
*Optimus Prime: Permission granted. May the primes guide you.
Part 2
*Rhinox: You better stop, lock, and load...because The Chainguns of Doom are itching for some action.
*Optimus Prime: Rhinox, don't succumb to the Quint's control. It's a question of survival.
*Rhinox: No it's not, Autobot. It's a question of integrity and dignity.
*Laughter: Hahahaha, the Maximal is right. A few cycles ago, Motormaster openly mocked him, but the rhinobot ducked the fight.
*What self-respecting soldier could live with the shame of such cowardice?
Part 3
*Bumblebee: Optimus, Commander! My scouting proved fruitful, and frightening. The scale of the Quintesson facility to the northeast is shockingly ominous!
*Optimus Prime: Bumblebee, now is not the time for a debriefing. The enemy is within earshot. Let's take this offline.
*Laughter: Bahaha! The yellow bot with bug eyes has been deceived by those very same optical sensors. He knows not what he thinks he's seen.
*Rhinox: Yeah? Well, I know what I think. It's time to bash heads and give some bots a taste of the horn!

sections.heading: Believe the Mirage
sections.text:
Part 1
*Optimus Prime: Commander, Bumblebee's scouting report from our last mission was quite concerning. He indicated there is a giant Quintesson facility in this sector we're exploring.
*Mirage: It sounds like more recon with a heavy dose of stealth is in order.
*Optimus Prime: That is precisely why you're on this mission, Mirage. I want you to use your special talents to infiltrate the facility and determine its function.
*Proceed with extreme caution; I'm sure there will be a strong Sharkticon presence.
*Mirage: Don't worry, I'll be fine. You know I always think inside the box.
Part 2
*Wisdom: Our sensors reveal a Cybertronian presence in the area...a bot not under our control.
*Scientist: You worry too much. My security measures are foolproof. Our secrets are safely guarded.
*Rage: You better be right, Scientist. You will not like the consequences if you fail us again.
Part 3
*Mirage: Commander, Optimus...I can verify without question the gravity of your concerns. I was able to locate and enter the Quintesson facility undetected.
*Optimus Prime: Findings?
*Mirage: It's an enormous stasis chamber containing dozens upon dozens of bots, spanning a range of realities I am unfamiliar with.
*More disturbing? They were all hooked up to some sort of Energon infusion machine...Dark Energon!
*Optimus Prime: That does not seem feasible.
*Bonecrusher: Yeah? Well do I seem feasible? Your little blue spy is right. The Quintessons do have such a facility. And, it's an amazing place.
*Optimus Prime: Amazing place?
*Bonecrusher: Yes, an amazing place to recharge your batteries and refresh my hate for life...and Autobots!

sections.heading: Machinations
sections.text:
Part 1
*Ratchet: The optical data dump form Mirage's foray into the Quintessson Stasis Chamber was very fruitful.
*The consensus between Marissa and Optimus is that we may learn more about the Quintesson's real machinations if we engage in their so called "gladiatorial" combat.
*Death: "So called?" "Real machinations?"
*There are no machinations here. Just machines...mere machines such as yourselves that we built and brought here to amuse us. Nothing more.
*Ratchet: I am a student of many things, history among the subjects I am versed in. Your history belies the deceit in you words. Commander, carry on!
Part 2
*Death: The Scientist failed our Quintesson cause yet again. First, he guaranteed the new Sharkticons would prove to be useful minions.
*Wisdom: They grow stronger yet need further upgrading.
*Death: And now I've heard the human insects and rebellious Autobot forces discussing the desire to divine our "real machinations." It's as though they have some deeper knowledge of the master plan.
*Rage: He has been duly warned. If this is true, he will pay...with his life!
Part 3
*Ironhide: Optimus must be desperate if he's letting you out of the retirement home to join a mission, Ratchet.
*Ratchet: You're no spring bot fresh off the assembly line yourself.
*Ironhide: I'm experienced, not obsolete. That's why I run the latest tech, like my new mod.
*Ratchet: Commander, I'm a doctor not a gambler, but if I were a betting bot, I'd put put plenty of Energon on that he's using affecting his alt mode heavy attack.
*Ironhide: Astute, but that won't save you from my Helix missiles.

sections.heading: Spy Games
sections.text:
Part 1
*Mirage: Commander, our intel gathering indicates a split among the Quintesson leadership council...
*Arcee: ...with Marissa and Optimus believing the Scientist is the weak link.
*Mirage: I'm heading back to the Quints' stasis chamber to see if I can learn more...
*Arcee: ...and I'll be providing protection via my sniper scope in case things get hectic.
Part 2
*Mirage: Well, that was interesting.
*Arcee: And predictably dangerous. We entered the chamber and were beginning our reconnaissance when a swarm of heavily armed Sharkticon guards flooded the area.
*Mirage: But before we were flushed out and forced to retreat, we did see something interesting...
*Arcee: Yes, the Scientist was filming some sort of ...I don't know what to call it...but it seemed he was recording a journal entry of sorts.
*He closed up the device he was using to document it when the Sharkticon commotion erupted.
*Mirage: Hmmmm...
Part 3
*Grindor: Halt! Do my optic sensors deceive me?
*Arcee: That depends on what you think you see.
*Grindor: I think I see a human insect approaching with some of the puniest bots I've ever seen. It must be a joke.
*Arcee: Oh, we're no joke.
*Grindor: The Commander must be joking to bring such lightweights to face me. It's as futile as bringing a couple of firecrackers to a rocket flight. Get ready to be destroyed!

sections.heading: Just an Illusion
sections.text:
Part 1
*Marissa: Commander, I have some distressing news. Last night we were understaffed with numerous teams on away missions.
*Optimus Prime: I fear I overestimated the strength of those on guard duty.
*Marissa: The Quintessons deployed a squad of Sharkticons that somehow infiltrated out base undetected. We don't know their true motives, but we do know Ultra Magnus is missing.
*Optimus Prime: We believe they have taken him hostage.
*Marissa: Your mission? Get him back.
Part 2
*Marissa: As a security precaution, the EDC had homing beacons installed in all our troops. Autobots and human. Readings indicate Ultra Magnus is nearby.
*Ultra Magnus: Nearby as in standing before you. Wait...can it be? It it you? Rodimus...Rodimus Prime?
*Marissa: What are you talking about? Rodimus is not amongst our party.
*Ultra Magnus: He's there, before my eyes. The one with the Matrix of Leadership.
*Marissa: No, Ultra Magnus, you are being manipulated by the Quintessons. They've done this to us before. History is repeating itself. Don't let them use you.
Part 3
*Ultra Magnus: Rodimus, in this land of chaos, it is good to see a friend such as you.
*Marissa: No, you are being deluded by Quintesson technology. They are using an Illusion Sequencer to trick you into think it's Rodimus Prime. They're testing you.
*Ultra Magnus: If what you say is true, then I confront a thief, a thief of the highest magnitude. A thief that would dare steal the Matrix of Leadership...a thief that must be punished.
Part 4
*Marissa: Ultra Magnus, what's your status? Do you function well enough to travel back to the base with us?
*Ultra Magnus: Well, I do see a few novas interfering with my optical readings, but it's nothing that a little stasis back at our base won't repair.

sections.heading: T-Cog Probs
sections.text:
Part 1
*Rage: That meddlesome female leader of the EDC is really twisting my tentacles.
*Death: Agreed. Her past interactions with us afford her a dangerous knowledge of our technology and operations.
*Wisdom: She was able to dedcuce our use of the Illusion Sequencer on her ally.
*Death: Yes she poses a distinct threat to our future endeavors.
*Wisdom: Thus, we must take precautions against using devices or methodologies she may have encountered in our shared past.
*Judgement - Might I suggest we recruit some help? Say, a shifty Decepticon whose lust for power will allow us to exploit him endlessly?
*Wisdom: Of course! Starscream!
Part 2
*Ratchet: Hmmm...our engagements thus far on this mission have between relatively tame.
*Starscream: You spoke too soon Autowrech, guess who's going to send you to the infirmary? ME!
*Ratchet: I said relatively "tame", not "lame." Commander, a cursory diagnostic rundown suggests this pretender to power is operating with a malfunctioning T-Cog. He can't change form.
*Starscream: I have the spark of a warrior and the programming of a great leader. I don't need cheap changes into alt mode to beat the likes of you!
Part 3
*Ratchet: Back for more humiliating punishment. Typical Starscream.
*Starscream: Stick a cog in your carburetor. You trash talk as well as you fix voice processors...you can't!
*Ratchet: At least I have a T-cog.
*Starscream: Your little diagnostic device is as inept as you are. I'm quite fully functional.
*Scientist: Thanks to me. It wouldn't do to have the noble Autobots involved in an unfair fight, would it now?

sections.heading: Origins
sections.text:
Part 1
*Marissa: Rhinox, I've requested that you accompany myself and the Commander on this mission.
*Rhinox: I'm always ready to rumble, but any reason why?
*Marissa: I have a hunch that the "uniqueness" of our backgrounds causes the Quintessons a certain degree of distress...particularly in their decision making calculations.
*Rhinox: Uniqueness?"
*Marissa: Look at you and me. What do we have in common?
*Rhinox: Totally devastating weapons and a willingness to use them?
*Marissa: No, we're earth creatures...or at least kind of in your case.
Part 2
*Wisdom: They continue their missions, but sense they are not just part of a game for our entertainment.
*Judgement: Of all the "visitors" we have brought into the realm of New Quintessa, these pose the greatest threat.
*Death: They must be extinguished!
*Scientist: Fear not, I have enchanted both the combat skills and the intelligence of our Sharkticon minions.
*Rage: What!? You created a potential problem, not a solution. If this proves to be another failed genetic experiment, your cycles upon this planet are over.
Part 3
*Sharkticon: Proceed no farther, earthling curs.
*Marissa: Don't you see? You have earthbound origins.
*Rhinox: She has a point. We may be have sparks born of Cybertron of Quintessa, but we share a certain kinship with the species of Earth. Just look at yourself.
*Scientist: Stop this blathering nonsense! He is a product of me and Quintessa technology. Nothing else!
*Sharkticon: I am simply your "product" ...your possession?! We shall discuss this further, once I have disposed of this earth trash.

sections.heading: Dear Diary
sections.text:
Part 1
*Marissa: Mirage, I've been thinking about that device you saw back in The Quintesson stasis chamber, You described it as a large, golden cylinder.
*Mirage: Yes, what of it?
*Marissa: Call me crazy, but my intuition is screaming at me.
*Mirage: And, what is it saying?
*Marissa: That device is a Quintesson journal...like the one that got them in so much trouble cycles ago.
*Mirage: But it doesn't make sense for them to be so stupid.
*Marissa: Call it a hunch, but we need that cylinder, How about using your special skill set to go procure it?
Part 2
*Mirage: Super stealth master Mirage reporting back and delivering the goods.
*Marissa: You got it?
*Mirage: Was there any question? I've been sneaking around their stasis chamber so much, I may need to pay rent.
*Marissa: Ah, judging from the looks of this, I'd say we have ourselves a Quintesson journal. Take it back to the base and get Teletraan deciphering its contents!
Part 3
*Rage: Scientist:, float toward and explain yourself!
*Scientist: Explain what?
*Rage: Explain how the humans were able to get their hands on what appears to be a Quintesson journal?
*Who keeps a journal? Have we learned nothing of the incriminatory potential they possess??!!!!
*Scientist: Of course I keep a journal. I'm a scientist. It's what we do.
*Death: And excruciating punishment is what I do...FOOL!
Part 4
*Wisdom: The humans and their traitorous bot allies think they can come and go as they please...stealing that which is not theirs.
*Laughter: And with impunity no less. It is to laugh...
*Judgement: Decepticon, make sure they don't make it back to their base.
*Motormaster: Once they're done dealing with my Cycloine gun, their cerebral circuits will be so dizzy they'll have a case of permanent amnesia.

sections.heading: History on Repeat
sections.text:
Part 1
*Marissa: Commander, Teletraan is making headway on downloading and analyzing the Quintesson journal.
*Arcee: How foolish can they be? We all know the trouble their journal caused them cycles ago.
*Marissa: The Quintessons have succumbed to the mistake of not learning from their history.
*Arcee: Now they are bound to relive it if I have any say in matters.
Part 2
*Marissa: Arcee, the first batch of intel from the Journal is coming through.
*Arcee: Anything of interest?
*Marissa: For someone with your skills, perhaps. We've gotten coordinates to a new area of the planet under Quintesson control.
*Arcee: Isn't it all under their control?
*Marissa: Teletrann suggests this terrain contains much more Quintesson technology and architecture. It needs to be investigated.
*Arcee: A scouting mission behind enemy lines? Count me in.
*Marissa: Proceed with caution.
*Arcee: My sniper scope provides all the caution I need. Later.
Part 3
*Rage: The idiot Scientist allowed Autobots to "acquire" a device of ours that holds great value to us.
*Scientist: I didn't allow anything.
*Death: Silence! By simply creating the device, you allowed it.
*Rage: Deception officer, I command you to beat the Commander and then go confiscate our property!
*Barricade: Confiscate? No problem. I've got my own warrant to conduct such a confiscation. It's locked and fully loaded!

sections.heading: Warriors at the Gate
sections.text:
Part 1
*Marissa: Commander, master scout Bumblebee has been a busy ...er ...scout.
*Bumblebee (DOTM): I'm glad you didn't go there. But, I am glad we came here. I discovered a passage to a whole new Quintesson territory.
*Marissa: The preliminary data you sent to Teletraan suggests a region overrun with Quintesson technology and architecture.
*Bumblebee: It looks like they're turning this planet into their new homeworld. Get ready to explore deeper into the five faces of darkness.
Part 2
*Marissa: Word from HQ is positive on decoding the Quintesson journal device. Initial findings suggest we aren't merely players in some sort of game arranged for their pleasure.
*Bumblebee: Of course we're not merely "players". We're warriors entering the gates of the Quintesson stronghold!
Part 3
*Bludgeon: Who dares to break the sanctity of my training grounds? 
*Bumblebee: Training grounds? You mean prison.
*Bludgeon: Prison? Hardly. My Quintesson patrons have provided me this area, a dojo if you will, to further master the art of Metallikato. An art you will soon know all to well.
*Bumblebee: Metal-what-o? You've been downloading too many Kung Fu movies. Commander, you've got this. I'm going to practice the art of fighting without fighting.

sections.heading: Join the Army
sections.text:
Part 1
*Marissa: It's good to see you, Ratchet. Our communications with HQ are being jammed the deeper we head into Quintesson territory. Any progress unravelling the contents of the Quintesson journal?
*Ratchet: Yes, there's been progress, and it chills me to the spark. What we can decipher...they're collecting an army of mind controlled Cybertronian bots, from across multiple realities.
*Marissa: To what end?
*Ratchet: To end any and all resistance to their goal...of recreating their intergalactic empire.
Part 2
*Wisdom: Surveillance detectors in our southern region indicate an Autobot and human contingent are venturing further into sensitive areas.
*Judgement: What's worse, audio sensors revealed they are cognizant of our plans. They know of our desire to create an army of Transformers.
*Rage: HOW?! (red)
*Wisdom: That inept Deception Barricade failed to retrieve the cerebrally challenged Scientist's journal.
*Death: Summon the Deception. He has sealed his fate.
Part 3
*Death: Barricade! Step forth. You have no say in the matter.
*Barricade: I will have something to say when I break free from your control.
*Death: Such futile words shall be your last.
*Barricade: Last? I think not.
*Judgement: Deception fool, your failure to confiscate our journal from The Autobot enclave has determined your sentence.
*You shall battle the Commander's forces again. But this time you shall battle...till you cease to function!

sections.heading: Miner Relief
sections.text:
Part 1
*Death: The Commander did us a favor by culling the herd and ridding us of the Decepticon Barricade.
*Wisdom: Minor relief but the bigger problem persists. They are learning more of the true nature of our work here.
*Judgement: The combination of the human's unpredictability and Autobot's considerable tenacity do not bode well for our Council.
*Wisdom: Numerical calculation of their success is difficult, but a strengthening of defense and acceleration of Dark Energon mining would be ...wise.
Part 2
*Sideswipe: Whoa, Commander ...get a load of that. I'll bet you my weight in Energon it's some sort of mine.
*Bonecrusher: Of course, it's a mine you Automoron. It's also a hell, and my accursed home thanks to the Quintessons.
*Sideswipe: Well, it sucks to be you, buddy. Too bad my sympathy programming doesn't extend to freakish looking Deceptions. Why don't you just change form and roll out of here?
*Bonecrusher: I can't. The Quintessons are infusing us with the very Dark Energon we mine. It controls us...compels us...enslaves us.
Part 3
*Bonecrusher: Ack...awk...you should have gone back when you could. Now...ack...you've reached the end of the line.
*Sideswipe: Ease up there tall, grimy, and hacky. You should get someone to take a look under your hood, you sound awful.
*Bonecrusher: You try mining Dark Energon cycle after cycle. I've got a bad case of ...awk...ack... The Black Carburetor. And, there's only one cure...ack...decimating your wretched party.
*Sideswipe: Hey, that's as harsh as your backfire. What gives?
*Bonecrusher: It's simple. The Quintessons made me a deal. Kill you and... ack...I'm free. Prepare to die because I intend to roll as far away from here as possible. Accccck!

sections.heading: Insecurities
sections.text:
Part 1
*Optimus Prime (MV1): Seismic surveillance readings reveal that The Quintessons are reinforcing their defenses.
*Drift: Seismic readings? That suggests something of large proportions...
*Optimus Prime (MV1): Teletraan indicates of T-Rex proportions, Looks like we're heading for a showdown with Grimlock. But it's not the Grimlock of our reality.
*Drift: Did Teletraan offer a scouting report?
*Optimus Prime (MV1): Teletraan did suggest Grimlock loves his stories and has certain "insecurities." He doesn't like people questioning his power, his intelligence...or his little arms.
*Drift: Really? I have a plan...
Part 2
*Drift: Commander, I sense a large creature of diminished intellect ahead.
*Optimus Prime (MV1): Yes, diminished intellect, and lacking in significant power.
*Grimlock: Me Grimlock hear words, but not understand meaning.
*Drift: Precisely, because you, Grimlock, are weak and stupid.
*Grimlock: Braaarw! Me Grimlock not dumb. Me tremendous and strong!
*Drift: "Tremendous?" That word is bigger than both your arms combined.
Part 3
*Grimlock: Me Grimlock says stop. Tell me a story, or you bozos can't pass.
*Drift: Optimus, tell this dino dodo about the time you showed the Grimlock from our reality who is Prime.
*Grimlock: Me not know your reality, but me Grimlock owned? That not true story?
*Optimus Prime (MV1): I'm afraid my sword wielding friend is correct, Grimlock. In our reality you were a frightened Dinobot hiding in the woods.
*In dire times I was forced to best and tame you...
*Grimlock: Bah! No one bester than me! King Grimlock CRUSH YOU!
*Optimus Prime (MV1): Be wary commander, the mod he has equipped grants him increased attack as he takes damage!

sections.heading: Head Gamezzz
sections.text:
Part 1
*Marissa: Commander, our analysis of the Quintesson journal divulged a rift in their faction is occuring.
*The Scientist is under fire by the judges on their council and he is highly suspicious of interference by none other than Starscream.
*Ratchet: This may be an opening we can exploit. I calibrated our Spacebridge to call in uniquely qualified reinforcement to deal with Starscream...
*Marissa: Autobot? Deception?
*Ratchet: No, Predacon. His name is Waspinator. He hails form our distant future. Let's just say he's had a special psychic encounter with Starscream that should prove invaluable to our mission.
Part 2
*Ratchet: Waspinator, welcome to the mission. It's good to have you on board.
*Waspinator: Wazzzpinator not want to be on board. Wazzzpinator just want to get that evil Plane Bot out of hizz head.
*Ratchet: Explain. Staracream...he's in your head?
*Waspinator: Yezzz. Since Wazzzpinator came to this strange place I get many flashes of Starscream's mind.
*It is like many cycles ago when he entered my head. Why does Wazzzpinator always get short end of the stinger?
Part 3
*Waspinator: Ugh! The plane bot is here. And he wants to trick the Quintessons. Plane Bot always tricking someone.
*Starscream: Waspinator, it's you. You've looking alive...and in one piece.
*Waspinator: Stop the friendly talk Liar Bot. I want you and your plan to join the Quintesson squid things out of my head.
*Starscream: Join the Quintessons? Hardly. I am a Decepticon, forged to rule the universe, not play lackey to floating fools.
*Waspinator: You lie. Wazzzpinator knows it. Commander, Plane Bot is so stupid. Wazzzpinator knows what he will do when he fights. He will use power gain and his special attacks more. Finish him fast.
*Starscream: Enough, you wannabe Insecticon! First I'll silence the Commander. Then I'll silence you...permanently!

sections.heading: No Petty Relic
sections.text:
Part 1
*Optimus Prime: Unfortunately, team, I must share bad news. Motormaster managed to breach our perimeter and steal a recently found relic we were researching.
*Prowl: Motormaster? That oversized load of anger issues? How?
*Optimus Prime: We're not sure. Ratchet and Marissa are looking into the how, but we must deal with the now. Preliminary scans on that relic suggests it was enhanced with Dark Energon with Dark Energon sub particles.
*Prowl: Motormaster and Dark Energon? That's a recipe for a heaping help of head butt.'
*Optimus Prime: You just track him down. I'll handle getting under his paint job.
Part 2
*Prowl: Motoramster is up ahead a couple klicks. I scouted his position and can confirm, he's in possession of the Dark Energon relic.
*Optimus Prime: Excellent work old friend. If we prey on his weakness, his temper, we can defeat him and secure the relic.
*Prowl: It can't be that simple.
*Optimus Prime: It is. Motormaster is similar to our comrade Grimlock. Attack the ego and the mind falters. If the mind falters, the body soon succumbs.
Part 3
*Optimus Prime: Well, if it isn't Motormaster, King of the Petty Thieves.
*Motormaster: That's King of The Road to you, and there's nothing petty about the relic I possess.'
*Optimus Prime: Perhaps it allows you to drive straight and not swerve to safety? Or maybe it makes your little wind gun actually do damage? Whatever the case, the Commander and I are here to retrieve what is ours.
*Motormaster: Me, SWERVE?! Never. Your stupid insights ensure your demise! My wrath shall roll out...all over you and your puny Commander!

sections.heading: Are You Not Sentient?
sections.text:
Part 1
*Rage: Scientist! Present yourself!
*Scientist: You bellowed?
*Rage: I demand your analysis of the state of the Sharkticon minions!
*Scientist: They serve their function adequately and are benefiting from my continued upgrade programming.
*Rage: WRONG!!! They allow Autobot infiltration of our stronghold, and we have witnessed growing instances of insubordination! If this is not corrected immediately...
*Death: ...you will be eradicated!
Part 2
*(Demoltions) Sharkticon: Who dares trespass through the home of the Sharkticons?
*Megatron (ROTF): Home? You call this pit of sludge a home? Surely, you deserve better.
*Sharkticon: It is the dwelling provided us by our Quintesson masters.
*Megatron (ROTF): Are you not beings worthy of a more dignified existence? You possess sentience, do you not?
*Sharkticon: I know the meaning of the word, so yes.
*Megatron (ROTF): Do you not know that freedom is the right of all sentient beings?
*Sharkticon: We carry out our orders and do what we are told.
*Megatron (ROTF): Perhaps the time has come for that to change.
Part 3
*Rage: Sharkticon, the Commander's party violates our sanctum. Eliminate them.
*Sharkticon: Yes, my master.
*Megatron (ROTF): Or don't, and live to see another day.
*Rage: Such talk is dangerous and foolhardy you Deception wretch.
*Megatron (ROTF): Prepare to hear much more of such talk for I neither fear nor respect you and your Council of Ineptitude!
'

sections.heading: By the Blood of Unicron
sections.text:
Part 1
* Marissa: We are getting readings inconsistent with beings under Quintesson control. They are forces, but seemingly not Quintesson.
*Optimus Prime: Commnander, I would suggest that forces of dissension within their ranks, or outside forces are at play. I would also suggest we proceed with courage and caution.
Part 2
*Megatron (ROTF): Ah, the deluded troops march on to their futile ends.
*Optimus Prime: Megatron, your return does not surprise, but your unwarranted confidence does. You've been defeated in this alien land before and The Commander will see that it is happens again.
*Megatron (ROTF): While you still stand among the weak, fighting for dreams you'll never realize, I have been availing myself of the precious commodities within the Quintesson mines.
*Optimus Prime: By the blood of Unicron...
*Megatron (ROTF): Precisely! It does wonders for one's Spark. My associate Grindor shall demonstrate the effects for you soon enough.
Part 3
*Megatron (ROTF): The Commander and his pet Optimus have arrived for a demonstration of Dark Energon's power in the hands of a master.
*Optimus Prime: Let us forego the banter. Search for any last semblance of Cybertronian honor within you and commence the fight!
*Megatron (ROTF): Me? Battle now? You're not ready. Grindor, dispose of these weaklings.
*Optimus Prime: Like you, Grindor has been trounced before. I do not see how he would fare better now?
*Megatron (ROTF): That is because you underestimate my oneness with the power of Dark Energon.

sections.heading: Descent into Depravity
sections.text:
Part 1
*Marissa: Commander, I am sending Optimus with you on the next mission.
*Optimus Prime (MV1): Yes, my counterpart, as surreal as it has been to digest, states that Megatron from my reality is hatching a plot.
*Marissa: A plot that is littering the landscape with savage carnage...
*Optimus Prime (MV1): Marissa is right. An away mission reports finding disturbing debris. The debris includes the remains of the last bot you defeat...Grindor.
Part 2
*Megatron (ROTF): So, the Commander and his accomplices left the doppelganger at home and brought me a more familiar victim.
*Optimus Prime (MV1): Familiar I may be...but a victim? Never. Primus willing.
*Megatron (ROTF): My memory banks would suggest otherwise, or have you forgotten our encounter in the woods of that vermin infested planet Earth you care so much for?
*Optimus Prime (MV1): I do not dwell in the past. I plan for the here and now. You are here, and now you must be held accountable for your murderous actions. We found Grindor.
*Megatron (ROTF): He was weak, like those that you side with. Extinguishing his spark was the price he paid for failure. A fate that you shall experience yet again...when the time is right.
Part 3
*Optimus Prime (MV1): Commander, this is the place. The path strewn with bots torn asunder and empty Energon casings provide ample evidence.
*Megatron (ROTF): Was it really that hard to find me? I wasn't hiding. In fact, I was simply biding my time until I could sharpen my skills...and claws...on a semi-worthy adversary.
*Optimus Prime (MV1): Your disregard for the sanctity of life and descent into depravity ends here, Megatron.
*Megatron (ROTF): I beg to differ my old, pitiful foe. It ends when I say so. And I say...we're just getting started!

sections.heading: Who's Superior?
sections.text:
Part 1
* Marissa: Commander, our situation grows increasingly complicated. Megatron executed a timely retreat in the wake of his defeat on our last mission.
* Mirage: Typical Megatron, but it leaves us vulnerable.
* Marissa: Also troubling are multiple Laserbeak and Ravage sightings. That can only mean one thing...
* Mirage: Soundwave is now in the mix.
Part 2
* Starscream: I know we have had our differences in the past, my fellow Decepticon.
* Soundwave: Yes, your treacherous ways have often been at odds with the Decepticon cause.
* Starscream: We cannot reside in the past if we are to survive in the present. The Megatron that infests New Quintessa is deranged beyond reason. He murders Decepticons without compunction.
* Soundwave: I agree. Laserbeak recorded him extinguishing the spark of a being called Grindor. Grindor served ar Megatron's pleasure, yet Megatron took pleasure in his death. Soundwave cannot trust this Megatron.
* Starscream: Exactly. The time has come for us to ally with each other ... and the only creatures capable of thwarting this psychotic Megatron... The Quintessons.
Part 3
* Starscream: Esteemed Judges of the Quintesson Council, I come before you with a proposition, and a new ally.
* Judgement: State your proposal. The annoying Commander approaches.
* Starscream: As much as you may deny it, you need help with this Commander and the Autobot partners. And I can provide such help.
* Judgement: You are infamously traitorous. Why should we accept such an offer?
* Starscream: Because we know these adversaries better than anyone...
* Soundwave: ...and we understand the even more foreboding enemy that is fomenting serious trouble for you... Megatron.
* Judgement: The council shall take your proposal under consideration. But, now we mus take leave and let our warrior lay waste to the Commander's party!

sections.heading: Assurance
sections.text:
Part 1
* Judgement: So, The Council is in agreement?
* Wisdom: We are. I shall summon the Decepticon.
* Starscream! We have made a decision.
* Starscream: ...a beneficial one to all concerned, I hope.
* Judgement: We shall pass judgement on the benefits later. For now, we have decided to align with you, if you prove your loyalty.
* Starscream: My word is worth its weight in Energon. But if a test is in order ...so be it.
* Wisdom: Wise decision. To prove yourself, we'd like you to take care of a slight "problem".
* Judgement: To clarify, the problem he refers to is our treasonous ex-associate - The Scientist.
Part 2
* Starscream: The wheels of our plan are in motion. The Quintessons need an assurance of our trustworthiness.
* Soundwave: Understandable given your history.
* Starscream: Shut your annoying vocoder up and release Laserbeak.
* Soundwave: For what purpose?
* Starscream: To help me provide our assurance. I want your little bird bot to locate the Quintesson Scientist.
* Soundwave: Why?
* Starscream: Because your leader ... ME... told you so!
Part 3
* Prowl: Commander, Soundwave has Laserbeak flying in overdrive. He must be searching for something.
* Mirage: Or someone. I just got back from a surveillance patrol at the Quintesson's Comm Center. Soundwave and Starscream were there...
* Prowl: This can't be good.
* Mirage: It's not. I overheard them discussing an alliance with the Quintessons. And something about "assurance" and the Quintesson Scientist.
* Prowl: I assure you that's not good news for us... of the Scientist. Commander, take care of business and let's get back to our base.

sections.heading: And Then There Were Five
sections.text:
Part 1
* Starscream: Soundwave, where is your little bird and cat? What's taking them so long to find the Scientist?
* Soundwave: The Quintesson's technology and excessive Dark Energon radiation has delayed their efforts. But the search is over. He has been located.
* Starscream: Excellent. Leave the rest to me.
* Soundwave: Do not resort to the barbarism the alien Megatron displayed. Soundwave predicts such an action will backfire.
* Starscream: I said leave it to me. But, you do know "our" Megatron was no saint.
* Soundwave: He never shot his own for no reason.
* Starscream: {{RedText|Speak for yourself!}}
Part 2
* Starscream: Greetings, respected Council members. Your "situation" has been taken care of. Trust me.
* Rage: Trust is something you must earn.
* Starscream: And earn it I shall. But rest assured, your problems with Science will no longer be an issue.
Part 3
* Judgement: The time has come for a final test of your worthiness for a position with our Council. The meddlesome Commander invades our inner realm. This must be out to an end. What say you?
* Starscream: I say my T-Cog is acting up on me, and we want to put our best bot forward, don't we?
* Wisdom: One needs not perform calculations to know that is wise.
* Starscream: Then I offer my comrade, Soundwave to battle the Commander. One might say he is superior, too... as he holds a numerical advantage with his minions Ravage and Laserbeak.
* Soundwave: He is correct, I am superior. I accept the challenge in the name of the one true Megatron.
* Starscream: Err ... I'm sure he means me... Lord Starscream!

sections.heading: Epilogue
sections.text:
S03 p01.png|"Bah! Although Soundwave proved to be inferior, my willingness to sacrifice a loyal follower must account for something."
S03 p02.png|"Beyond proving your treachery, it does suggest a useful pragmatism The Council might benefit from."
S03 p03.png|"Yes, yes... you're right!"
S03 p04.png|"My pragmatism and wealth of insight into Autobots and Decepticons shall make me an invaluable asset to The Council." "Invaluable? We shall see. For now the arrangement is probationary."
S03 p05.png|"But I do get something right? Like a title? How about a crown?"
S03 p06.png|"How about the title... "Lucky to Be Alive"?"

Dodging Special Attacks.lead:
If you're struggling to dodge Special Attacks, this article, made by [https://forums.transformersforgedtofight.com Forum] user BonesetterHUN will help you tremendously!

Hi guys!

I just want to collect the dodge patterns in one big thread. Maybe it helps for new players or help someone who is struggling with some enemies.
Correct me of course if I know something wrong or I missed someone! - BonesetterHUN

*Backstep - bs
*Sidestep - ss
*Pause - p

Arcee:
Sp1: bs-ss
Sp2: bs-bs

Blaster:
Sp1: bs-p-ss
Sp2: ss-ss(you have to time the first dodge precisely, maybe it's a little hard at the beggining )

Sp1: bs-p-bs (or be continuosly)
Sp2: bs-bs-bs (the third bs will be timed like Prowl's special 2 shots.. If he sticks his short sword/knife/wakizashi into the ground, do the third bs.. but learn the rhythm is easier if you practice against him)

Sp1: bs

Sp1: bs-ss

E.M.I. Module.lead: The E.M.I Module is a Defense Module that interferes with opponent's ranged attacks.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: Electrostatic Interference obstructs even the most sophisticated guidance systems, preventing enemies in the vicinity from landing effective projectile attacks.

sections.heading: Max Stats
sections.text:

** Health: 257
** Attack: 17
** Rating: 39

sections.heading: Abilities
sections.text:

* Ranged Attacks: Decreases Ranged Speed by 15~31%.
* When Attacked:

sections.heading: Defense
sections.text:
Some Bots and their abilities have a weakness against Ranged Attacks; with the E.M.I Module, opponents would have to fight up close for attacks to be effective, which would give Bots with melee playstyles or Bots with range-boosting abilities a great advantage.
* Bumblebee (DOTM) - Bumblebee will stay in Melee Calibration Mode, constantly Evading melee attacks. 
* Bumblebee - Forcing opponents to stay close to Bee will charge his Signature Ability. 
* Optimus Primal - Optimus Primal’s biggest disadvantage is his reliance on Melee Attacks. This module will help ensure he can thwart ranged opponents like that pesky Starscream. 
* Hound - This Module will punish any gunslingers who attempt to outshoot this warrior. 
* Ultra Magnus - Opponents won't be able to shift his physical resistance easily. 
*Rhinox - No one will ever escape from his shield easily. Giving more chance to shock them

sections.heading: Raiding
sections.text: This module doesn't give a boost to the Base Defender as much as it hampers attackers. Bots whose abilities rely on their Ranged Attacks and Bots with Heavy Ranged Attacks will struggle against Bots with this module. It is better to use strong melee Bots instead.

sections.heading: Weak Match-ups
sections.text:
* Ironhide won't be able to tear anything apart if his missiles are weakened.
* Starscream won’t be able to nullify much buffs and his opponent will build up buffs without getting nullified
* Waspinator loves to stay in the range however it will hamper his ability to use heavy attacks or basic ranged attacks.
* Shockwave will shock less with his ranged attacks.
* Galvatron's potent Heavy Attacks won't be able to deal their damage most of the time.
* Megatron will have a hard time fusing debuffs.
* Megatronus's wrath will be easier to avoid for the defender.

Emergence.lead: Emergence is a Spotlight Mission featuring Cyclonus and Megatronus that ran from September 6th to October 4th.

sections.heading: Changes/Rewards
sections.text: Medium and Hard Map energy consumption per node has now been reduced from 2 and 3 to 1 and 2 respectively.

sections.heading: Friends?
sections.text:
Part 1
*Starscream: Oh, by the curse of the Primus, say it's not true. You're here now?
*Cyclonus: You have optics, don't you? Of course I'm here. But the question is...where is hers?
*Starscream: So, you're fresh out the Spacebridge? Perfect!
*Cyclonus: Look, I don't know where I am or why I'm here...and frankly, how you're here. Last I saw of you, you were reduced to a pile of ash and a meaningless crown.
*Starscream: That's not how I remember historic occurrences...but misaligned pasts don't mean anything here. I suggest...friend, we work together to assure our survival.
*Cyclonus: I serve but one...Galvatron!
*Starscream: Galvatron?! Why...err...there's no one here on New Quintessa by that name. But...there are a couple of Megatrons, multiple Optimus types, and a mess of Autogoons. I suggest you consider an alliance. Perhaps we can find this Galvatron you speak of?
*Cyclonus: I'll consider it.
Part 2
*Starscream: So, how have your deliberations gone? You ready to join me in a quest for survival...and conquest?
*Cyclonus: I have seen the carnage that possesses this planet. And I do suspect that those here may treat me with hostility.
*Starscream: Precisely why you should join me.
*Cyclonus: But hwy join you when Decepticons of Megatron's stature could provide better prospects of success?
*Starscream: Because knowledge is power...and I know something they don't.
*Cyclonus: Which is?
*Starscream: Megatronus is here...and I know where. He's the key to our survival.
*Cyclonus: MEGATRONUS?! That changes things...
Part 3
*Starscream: You've got to be kidding me. What are you doing here?
*Ultra Magnus: We're here to ask you a few questions. It's about a new arrival...one I'd like to keep from connecting with Galvatron.
*Starscream: Why, whatever do you mean? You know that now I'm simply a [https://tfwiki.net/wiki/NAIL Non-Aligned Indiginous Life-form.] I consort with no-one...
*Ultra Magnus: ...because no-one will consort with you? I suspect that would not stop you from pursuing an alliance with a new-comer ...like, say ...Cyclonus.
*Starscream: I...err ...have no idea what you're talking about.
*Ultra Magnus: Perhaps we can do something to jog your memory banks.

sections.heading: Welcome to the Madness
sections.text:
Part 1
*Starscream: They know you're here.
*Cyclonus: Who knows I'm here?
*Starscream: The Autobots, Ultra Magnus, and the one they call The Commander.
*Cyclonus: The Commander?
*Starscream: Yes, a human vermin they somehow allowed to lead them.
*Cyclonus: So, you told them of my presence?
*Starscream: Of course not! Why would I betray an ally?
*Cyclonus: Because it is what you do.
*Starscream: I'm a changed bot. They have their intel, and I have mine. I suggest it would be prudent, though, to get our jets in gear and find Megatronus.
Part 2
*Cyclonus: You lied to me!
*Starscream: I swear, I didn't tell Ultra Magnus a thing.
*Galvatron: He's not talking about that, he's talking about me!
*Starscream: I...uh...ah...was just about to...
*Galvatron: To leave? Or be vaporized, again? Be gone... I have business with Cyclonus.
Part 3
*Galvatron: So, you've found your way to my side again.
*Cyclonus: By chance...and good fortune. The traitor said there is one here of ultimate power.
*Galvatron: You stand before him you fool.
*Cyclonus: No, an ancient power, an original Prime...Megatronus.
*Galvatron: Megatronus? I see you still serve a purpose. Keep serving it and you may share in the glory when I crush this so-called ancient power.
Part 4
*Ultra Magnus: The rat was right, you are here. I assume your mater is not far behind.
*Cyclonus: I concur that Starscream is indeed a rat. But, I can neither confirm nor deny your assumption.
*Ultra Magnus: I'll confirm my own assumptions.
*Cyclonus: I doubt that will be possible once I turn you into a pile of blowhard scrap.

sections.heading: The One That We Want
sections.text:
Part 1
*Marissa: So, it's true, Ultra Magnus?
*Ultra Magnus: I'm afraid so. Cyclonus and Galvatron are back together again.
*Optimus Prime: But I was made aware you and the Commander did battle with him. How did you fare?
*Ultra Magnus: We're ok, but unfortunately...he escaped.
*Optimus Prime: The Decepticons do display a skill for doing that.
*Marissa: So what do we do?
*Optimus Prime: Whatever we can to prevent the Megatrons...and now Galvatron...from finding and joining forces with Megatronus.
Part 2
*Galvatron: Why must I always be surrounded by inferiors?
*Cyclonus: Because you are superior?
*Galvatron: Bah! Do not patronize me, Once again you confront the Autobots and once again you retreat in cowardice!
*Cyclonus: Strategic disengagement so one may reevaluate the situation and function to fight another day is a sound tactic.
*Galvatron: When will I find a bot that can just win and not make excuses?!
*Tantrum: Today's your lucky day, because you just found me.
*Galvatron: And why should I trust you to fare better than Cyclonus?
*Tantrum: Because I'm bored and have a serious need to bang heads with Autobots.
Part 3
*Tantrum: You're the best they could do? I was expecting someone a little more challening.
*Ultra Magnus: And we were expecting Galvatron.
*Tantrum: Sorry, the boss is busy. But I'm sure I can accommodate you...by crushing your diodes, mutilating your gears, and stomping out your sparks.
*Ultra Magnus: That is not very accommodating, but let's get this over with. Galvatron is the one we want.

sections.heading: Deserter
sections.text:
Part 1
*Tantrum: Who is firing on us?! The shots are getting closer.
*Cyclonus: Who do you think? Galvatron. Obviously he's become unhinged again.
*Tantrum: Has he ever been hinged?
*Cyclonus: No, not really. Even the therapy session on Torkulon couldn't curb his penchant for lashing out.
*Tantrum: Then why do you still serve him? He rewards your loyalty with abuse and laser blasts.
*Cyclonus: You're right. I believe the time has come for me to seek a new alliance...a more powerful one.
*Tantrum: Let me know how that works out for you. But me? I'm laying low for a while. This place is getting too volatile.
Part 2
*Galvatron: So the failure presents himself.
*Cyclonus: With all due respect...quit with the hostility, and especially the blasting.
*Galvatron: THE INSOLENCE! HOW DARE YOU QUESTION ME?!
*Cyclonus: Don't worry, my questions for you are done. I know the answer. It is time for me to move on.
*Galvatron: WHAAAAAAT?! NEVER...EAT THIS!
*Cyclonus: You missed me...you're slipping. Good luck, Galvatron...my master you will be no longer.
Part 3
*Optimus Prime: It appears someone's minions have deserted them.
*Ultra Magnus: They always do.
*Galvatron: Desert in not the right word. Rendered useless is. Just as I soon render you.
*Optimus Prime: When will you learn that loyalty demanded but not returned is the path to destruction?
*Galvatron: When will you learn that me standing before you is your path to destruction?

sections.heading: New Allegiances
sections.text:
Part 1
*Cyclonus: I thought you were going to lay low.
*Tantrum: This is about as low as a bull can go. How's your search for Mega-mega going?
*Cyclonus: He's near, I know it. Others have been distracted by Galvatron's antics, but I remain focused on finding him...one of the original Primes.
*Tantrum: What if he's worse than Galvatron?
*Cyclonus: What if he's not? It's a chance I'm willing to take in this chaotic land I have been brought to.
Part 2
*Cyclonus: Has my quest come to fruition? Does a god stand before me?
*Megatronus: A god? That is a word for you to use, not I. Fruition? If your desire was to cease to function, perhaps.
*Cyclonus: I come to you in subservience, for I know who and what you are.
*Megatronus: As do others. I know they all seek me. How is it that you have found me first?
*Cyclonus: It must be the will of the Primus.
*Megatronus: You say you come in subservience? Then display your fealty. I need time to prepare. Give me that time and I shall consider your entreaty.
*Cyclonus: Your word is my command.
Part 3
*Optimus Prime: Ultra Magnus says despite your loyalty you can be made to understand reason. Understand this - your master has been defeated. Stand aside and avoid undue conlfict.
*Cyclonus: My master? I believe you are mistaken, for a god cannot be defeated.
*Optimus Prime: Galvatron is hardly a god...more a maniacally deranged sadistic Decepticon that cannot be trusted.
*Cyclonus: I would never mistake Galvatron for a god, and he is no longer my master.
*Optimus Prime: God? That means...you've found him?
*Cyclonus: If it gives you solace, yes. But, to what does that help you once I extinguish your spark in the name of Lord Megatronus?

sections.heading: Who's your Deity?
sections.text:
Part 1
*Marissa: His presence has been officially confirmed?
*Optimus Prime: Second hand confirmation by Cyclonus...but yes. What we assumed has been confirmed.
*Marissa: Course of action?
*Optimus Prime: Nothing has changed. We must pursue this potential threat and see if reason can prevail.
*Marissa: And if we don't reach him first?
*Optimus Prime: Forces of immeasurable destruction may collide.
Part 2
*Megatronus: You failed. Predictable. Your kind does not have the capacity to serve one such as I.
*Cyclonus: It was not due to a lack of trying. The Commander has arrayed a formidable group of combatants.
*Megatronus: The Commander? Do you speak of 13? Is he here?
*Cyclonus: I don't know who 13 is, but The Commander is a human those Autobot wretches have put in charge of their forces. For what reason, I do not know.
*Megatronus: A HUMAN?! The pestilent species from the planet called Earth? Surely you jest.
*Cyclonus: Jesting is not my nature, but be warned. Those that come for you, and there are others, pose a serious threat.
Megatronus: Ha. You say you do not make jokes, and yet you say such a thing. Someone poses a threat to me? I think not.
Part 3
*Megatronus: 13? Is that you?
*Optimus Prime: I am Optimus Prime. I am not a number.
*Megatronus: You cannot escape your past.
*Optimus Prime: The past follows us, but the future leads us to what must be done.
*Megatronus: Then tell me, what must be done?
*Optimus Prime: Secure the peace, and return those of us trapped to our proper homes.
*Megatronus: And if I say otherwise?
*Optimus Prime: That would be something I wish to avoid.
*Megatronus: Too late 13...I say otherwise. It is time to teach you your first lesson in what it means to be an original Prime.

Energon.lead:
Energon is the premium currency typical of a freemium mobile game with microtransactions.

In the Netflix cersion of the game

sections.heading: Where to Spend
sections.text:
Energon can be spent on, among other things:
* All items in the store other than those in the Raid store.
* Premium Bot Crystals, Premium Mod Crystals, Gold Crystals, and Featured Bot Crystals
* Refreshing selection of Away Missions (5)
* Selecting another opponent in Raids (2, 6, 10, 14)
* replenishing a Raid Ticket (10)
* Changing opponents in Arenas (5)
* Cooldown of Bots in Arenas (5, 10, 15, 30)
* Limited-time 24-hour flash offers, ranging from 100 to 5,000 Energon
*For the game's final two events. more resources were made available to buy with Energon: (limit 21 for each Spark)
**T2 Alpha Spark - 80
**Tier 3 Basic Spark - 40
**T3 Alpha Spark - 400
**T4 Basic Spark - 200
**5-Star Bot Crystal - 500
**T4 Bot Crystal - 100
**(seriously none of the highest-end T4 Class and T5 Basics?)

sections.heading: Obtainment
sections.text:
Without paying with real money, Energon can be obtained in various ways:
* Completing Solo and Special Missions; completing a stage will give you 10 Energon, while fully exploring it will give you another 15. (15 and 20 for Prime difficulty respectively)
* Some Solo Mission crates rarely give 5 Energon.
* Arena Crystals have a slight chance of giving a small amount of Energon.
* 10, 20, 30, and 40 Energon can be claimed from the login calendar on the sixth day of each week.
* 10 bundles of 20 Energon are sometimes available in the Raid Store for 3,000 Raid Chips each, up to 200 Energon for 30,000 Raid Chips.
* From v5.0, three ads can be watched to get 5 4 Energon per video each day every 12 hours.
*15 Energon from watching 4 ad videos Daily Objective.
*10 Energon from completing 7 Daily Objectives.
*A myriad of ways. (Netflix) By the time you've completed Act 1, you'll already have an excess of over 500 Energon.

Should you want to bribe your way to victory, several different amounts of Energon are available in the Energon store to purchase with real money.
* Soundwave's Superior Stocks - 135 - $6.99 USD
* Starscream's Embezzled Stores - 275 - $13.99 USD
* Bumblebee's Trunk - 850 - $39.99 USD

Occasionally, more Energon and additional items are included with these purchases, such as Energon Daily Cards, Crystals, and Bot Chips, before defaulting to Bot Chip bundles.

On October 14, 2022, all ads and in-app purchases were removed, per the announcement of the game shutting down and removal from the App Stores.

From October 2022 onwards, the 7-Day Calendar gave a consecutive 200 to 800 Energon each day, along with 75~750 Premium Bot Crystal Shards.

Energy Refill.lead:
Energy Refills are items that, like what the name implies, recharges your Energy. There are two types of Refills: Mission Energy, and Alliance Mission Energy.

The Mission Energy Refill can be bought for 40 .

Alliance Mission Energy Refills are only available to buy on Alliance days, and the first costs 30 , then 45, 60, 75, and 90, limit 5 each day.

Both of these items can be obtained as prizes for completing certain Objectives, or in the case of the Alliance Mission Energy Refill, the Alliance Crystals and the Raid Store. The Mission Energy Refill completely refills your Mission Energy, while Alliance Mission Energy refills only recharge 1. If you don't use the refills, Mission Energy takes 6 minutes to recharge, and Alliance Misison energy 60 45 minutes.

It isn't wise to use your refill when you have at least 3 Mission energy left over; you're wasting the energy and in return, you lose three extra "advances". Use it when you have no energy left, or if you can't travel any further if the mission requires more than 1 energy to keep exploring.
Category:Items

Energy.lead:
Energy is required to advance through Solo Missions. Depending on the difficulty, each node on a map consumes 1~3 Energy.

It takes six minutes for each unit of energy to recharge.

If you do not have enough Energy to proceed to the next node, there are some ways you can get more. If you are in an Alliance, you can ask for help with mission energy, and immediately get three energy. Completed requests reduces the time for one energy and gives a small boost. You can only ask for help once per hour. (originally six hours)

From v5.0, you can watch an advertisement to get nine energy, once every six hours.

Your maximum amount of Energy increases by 1 each Commander level, and upon leveling up, your Energy will be completely refilled.

sections.heading: Full Mission Energy Refills
sections.text:
You can also use Full Mission Energy Refills to replenish your Energy. Listed are ways you can obtain energy refills:
* 40 Energon in the Store
* Included in Spotlight Mission bundles and Mission Supply Cache bundles
* Spotlight Mission Completion Alliance Quest
* Raid Ascent Alliance Quest
* Monthly Objective - Win 10 Solo Missions fights with the current Featured Bot

sections.heading: Alliance Mission Energy
sections.text: Energy in Alliance Missions is separate from normal Energy. You can only have a maximum of five, and it takes one hour 45 minutes as of 8.4 to recharge each unit. Only some central nodes and nodes with Bots consume Alliance Energy; empty, cleared nodes do not.

sections.heading: Alliance Mission Energy Refill
sections.text:
Introduced July 23, Alliance Mission Energy Refills give 1 energy when used. These items can be bought in the Store only during an Alliance Event and have a purchase limit of 5 per day, with scaling costs on each. The first will be 30 Energon, followed by 45, 60, 75, and finally 90 Energon - an increase of 25 Energon per purchase.

From v6.1, Alliance Crystals can give Alliance Mission Energy Refills. Unclaimed refills expires in 4 days, but was extended to 14 days from v6.3.

Evil Tread: From Rust 'Til Dawn.lead:
{{Spoiler Warning}}Evil Tread: From Rust 'Til Dawn is a mini Spotlight Mission featuring Arcee, Blaster and Mirage that ran from October 17th until October 31st, 10am PT.

From November 1 to 4, 12-hour Evil Tread Missions were available and awarded Hallowed Crystals and Shards.

sections.heading: Synopsis
sections.text:
Grisly ghouls from every tomb are closing in to seal your doom... Something strange has been awakened in New Quintessa and it is manifesting with new Buffs, Nodes, and THE ROLLING DEAD!

Zombies have been awakened and it's up to Arcee, Blaster and Mirage to see if they can undo the evil that has been released in this special Mini-Mission: EVIL TREAD: FROM RUST 'TIL DAWN!

This special Mini Mission will be live on October 17th at 10am PT until October 31st at 10am PT.

sections.heading: Mods
sections.text:
* Hunger - This Bot slowly loses health, but gains health whenever it does damage.
**No way to prevent this except possibly for Repair Block, but the health gain is very negligible.
* Revive - Bot has a chance to revive, purify all debuffs and heal every time it is defeated. (Reduced chance to revive each time it is defeated.)
**Watch the health bar. The lower it gets per revive the less chance the Bot has to revive.
* Critical Weakness - Bot suffers -40~55% Armor Break from Critical Hits, but gains 40~50% Armor Up against non-Critical hits.
**Scouts and Crit-lovers are particularly useful.
* Burn It - High chance to revive, unless it is on fire.
**Use Grimlock or Ironhide, as they are the most reliable, and see an affected Bot burn to the ground with little chance to come back.

sections.heading: Mission 1 - BITE
sections.text:
Part 1
* Arcee: Blaster, I've been told that there's a strange signal emitting from here.
* Blaster: I'm here to hear! Even brought along Mirage to see if he can see what we can't!
* Mirage: Making things vanish is more my speed...but I do spot come code wavelengths floating about. Perhaps we can scan them.
* Balster: Won't take me but a tick to tune it in! 01001110 01101001 01100011 01101011 01100101 01101100.
* Mirage: Just reading out any code you find now? Earth reference table has that as Atomic Number 28. Nothing fancy. I'm a fan of 79 or 45 myself.
* Arcee: Guys! Something is wrong. A massive energy pulse just went through this area.
* Kickback: Autobot scum-scum. I hunger for fresh metal-metal! Face my mighty new friends-friends!
Part 2
* Kickback: Think you can just leave Kickback behind-behind? I am mighty-mighty!
* Arcee: Something is corrupting him. Readings off him and all the bots have been...strange.
* Blaster: It's like all these creeps caught a nasty bug that's uglier than old hop-long here.
* Kickback: New power is inside me-me. Need to spread it-it. NEED TO FEED-FEED!
* Mirage: It's not enough for these brutish Bots to be rotten inside, now they've gone viral?
* Arcee: I don't want to consider what this world will look like if the virus takes over, lets shut him down and see how far this has spread!

sections.heading: Mission 2 - CONTAMINATION
sections.text:
Part 1
* Arcee: These opponents seem different...hollow...Their optics are on but the lights behind them are so troubling.
* Mirage: It's getting real "Night of the Living Dead Battery" around here.
* Blaster: There's dark doings gettin' done that's for sure. It's getting complex just to shut these folks down.
* Arcee: But shut them down we must, there's too much weirdness going on here lately. I just want one less mystery.
* Mirage: Ask and you shall receive. A series of expert thrashings coming up!
Part 2
* Cyclonus: Halt, a reformatting is in progress. A glorious refragmation of code...and I must thank you for it. 
* Arcee: A "thank you" from you sends a creep along my chassis. What are you talking about? 
* Cyclonus: The binary code you carelessly transmitted, every byte was dripping with hidden purpose. Elemental instructions have begun seeping into fallen Bots! 
* Mirage: See what you've done Blaster? You uploaded without a virus scan! You voided every warranty on the books! 
* Blaster: I read things out loud! I'm a public speaker not a public silencer! 
* Cyclonus: I have been remade before, my weaker form fell and this form rose. I am eager to see what will rise next. 
* Arcee: So what you're saying is you've been destroyed before. Time to give you a reminder.

sections.heading: Mission 3 - INFECTION
sections.text:
Part 1
* Arcee: I have a question I don't think I want the answer to.
* Mirage: How can the Decepti-creeps have bad breath when they don't have digestive systems? Like...are they doing it on purpose? To be more evil?
* Arcee: ...no....something more relevant to our situation. Why have none of us turned?
* Nemesis Prime: Because you have yet to cease your functions...but that shall soon be remedied by the ghoulish grouping you now face.
* Blaster: You wish, Imposter Prime! We're gonna thrash this crew then we're coming for you!
Part 2
* Nemesis Prime: Every step you take on this world, you spread corruption. You break realities. You are a walking infection.
* Mirage: You forgot handsome and talented. We're the whole package Mr. Tall, Dark and Deadly.
* Nemesis Prime: I see I mus fight you on your own terms, I shall allow this plague into my circuitry to strike you down.
* Arcee: If you wanna' get the sniffles before we kick your tailpipe, by all means breathe it in your pathetic shadow of a Prime.
* Nemesis Prime: You shall not live to regret those words.

sections.heading: Mission 4 - OUTBREAK
sections.text:
Part 1
* Blaster: I hate to say it, because it ain't on the level...but this all stinks of dark magic.
* Mirage: "Any sufficiently advanced technology is indistinguishable from magic" a quote from Earth author Arthur C. Clarke. Some would call us rather magical. I know I do.
* Arcee: Prose aside, Blaster's not wrong. This coding is beyond anything I've seen.
* Bludgeon: Beyond anything ANY Bot has seen! You wouldn't believe what sins I had to commit to bringing my plan to fruition.
* Arcee: How does any of this follow your strict code of Metallikato, Bludgeon?
* Bludgeon: I wish to find the ultimate opponent, one that cannot fall to my blade seems worthy indeed.
* Blaster: Well we're gonna mow down a few if your zombie-bots and we'll show you who's not failing!
Part 2
*Bludgeon: I found the codes. They were bound in the panels of fallen Bots, inked in their oil, a cursed drive of forbidden knowledge...
*It had to be read by one "pure of spark and clear of intention". I assumed this meant empty headed and without drive. I was apparently correct.
*Blaster: Started kinda' complementary then took a sharp turn there.
*Mirage: Hold on I have try something...KLAATU BARADA NIKTO!
*Bludgeon: What gibberish are you spouting? Are you so brain-dead the code is taking you already?
*Mirage: More Earth pop-culture references. Was worth a shot.
*Arcee: It was a spoken "spell". It's just code. There must be a revert state, an anti-virus, a cure!
*Bludgeon: They obey my will, perhaps they shall crumble if I fail. But it matters not...you're ALL going to die down here.

sections.heading: Base Defense
sections.text:
You can pair this module with any Bot, especially Bots with their own Unstoppable abilities to make them more Unstoppable often, or with Bots who are likely to be attacked by debuffing opponents due to their Class advantage/disadvantage.

sections.heading: Raids
sections.text: The Exo-Filter is especially effective against Bots who inflict several damaging debuffs at once, and Bots who inflict permanent debuffs. If you must use attacks that inflicts three or more debuffs, do so immediately after a purification activates.

sections.heading: Weak Match-ups
sections.text:

* Ironhide
* Megatron (GS)
* Rhinox
* Shockwave
* Kickback
* Scorponok

sections.heading: Strong Match-ups
sections.text:
Generally, Bots who don’t rely on debuffs are recommended to use against Bots with Exo-Filters.

* Cyclonus can nullify the Unstoppable buff if the opponent dashes at him.
* Megatron (ROTF) relies on impair charges which are actually not debuffs.

sections.heading: Synopsis
sections.text: The time has come to leave this world, its many realities, its countless timelines, and seek adventure in the infinite multiverse. However, dark forces still look to claim what power remains and perhaps corrupt all worlds beyond. One final mission remains, as Optimus and the Commander initiate the EXODUS PROTOCOL.

sections.heading: = Part 1 =
sections.text:
* Optimus Prime: Wheeljack, the time has come, I am giving permission to activate the EXODUS PROTOCOL.
* : The Exodus Protocol means opening ALL the Space Bridges and more, every untested travel tool l've invented will be activated, that'll CERTAINLY destroy the planet.
* : Indeed, it is a last hope, but still a hope, Use the weapon of our foes against them, While it will scatter us all across realities we still may survive.
* : I'm totally fine with this plan, just wanted to double check on the whole "blow it all up" part! I have prepared a giant button JUST for this occasion, I'll go push it,
* : Blaster, get the word out. Abandon planet, take any transport you can find. Inform all Autobots, Decepticons, and independent operators alike.
* Blaster: What about JUST the Autobots? I may have time to round THEM up.
* : This is bigger than any feuds, they all deserve a chance, EVERY, ONE.
* : Confirmed, I'll get the word out. Let's hope folks are willing to listen!

sections.heading: = Part 2 =
sections.text:
* Megatron: What right do you have to give orders to those under my command?
*: I assumed you wished for them to survive the coming calamity, was I mistaken? The sun never sets on Cybertron so long as some of us survive.
*: Those who are worth saving will find a way to continue to function, the rest can burn in the fires of New Quintessa.
*: As always you are deeply charming, Mega-trash. Now move out of the way I have gates to open,
*: I do not listen to lesser life forms such as you, I have found finer company to keep, Is that not right, my lieges?
* Megatronus: Indeed, the multiverse still has treasures to find. Power to control, MUCH MORE TO GIVE,
* Necrotronus: We should have put aside our squabbles and joined forces LONG ago,
*: Now then, hand over control of the Space Bridges OR BE DESTROYED!

sections.heading: = Part 1 =
sections.text:
* : Thanks for the assist, Commander, I flipped EVERYTHING on and there are bridges, lots of bridges, one could argue TOO MANY bridges.
* Jetfire: Blaster's evacuation message was sent, everyone was VERY eager to not explode. Wheeljack, what you're doing here is TRIULY astonishing in its apocalyptic scale,
* : Awww thanks bud, appreciate you too!
* : Good work, once everyone jumps through slam the bridges closed behind them,
* : Luckily everything is overloading and exploding so that's going to pretty much happen naturally, but I'll speed it along.
* : Fools! What are you doing?! We'll all be doomed!
* : No, not all of us, just you and your power hungry compatriots, The rest shall find refuge in the infinite realities of the multiverse.
* : Then I shall enjoy hunting each and every traitor who dared to deny me of a kingdom to rule.

sections.heading: Part 2
sections.text:
* : Jetfire and I are making the jump, you'll be right behind us right Optimus?
* : I'll see you on the other side, Wheeljack.
* : Weird way to phrase it but alright! It's been a trip! Jetfire wait up! I made a travel playlist!
* : You have bought them seconds, this planet contains an undead titan and astounding power. We shall use both to destroy you,
* : The Space Bridges have destabilized this world and drained ALL the power within it, soon you'll be ruling nothing but dust.
* : You wouldn't dare do that much damage to the timelines. You're bluffing. We will always find a way to succeed.
* : Perhaps in some strange universe you will. But in this world, in this reality, you have gone this far, and no further.
* : Then I have nothing left to lose, and shall make the most of this chance to destroy ONE LAST PRIME!

sections.heading: = Part 1 =
sections.text:
* : So it has come to this... a single Autobot, their weak human, and certain doom.
* : Marissa, is everyone off world?
* Marissa Faireborn: As far as I can tell It's just us, the Commander, and a trio of 'Tronuses left here.
* : The rest will need guidance and communications, get out of here while you can, Marissa.
* : Prime I can't just leave you both behind, You'll be trapped as the realities collapse when the bridges close!
* : Someone needs to ensure we have stopped the plague of Necrotronus from escaping. Leave NOW! That is an order!
* : Don't worry, you'll all be joining up soon in OBLIVION!
* : Optimus, it has been an honor, Commander, knock 'Tronus out for me, This is Officer Marissa Faireborn, signing off of coms on New Quintessa.

sections.heading: = Part 2 =
sections.text:
* : Hold the line, we just need to give the others enough time to get away and this will all be over.
* WE SHALL NEVER END! OUR FURY WILL ECHO THROUGH THE AGES!
* : Commander, without question THIS is our darkest hour, but you have always been a light to those who found their way here.
* : Words, words, words. Spare us the monologue, We have heard enough.
* : Ignore them, Commander. You were forged to fight and have proven yourself again and again. If this is our last fight then... I thank you.
* : I thank you for your time, your support, your passion, your friendship. Though your squad was often a curious mix of teams, know that you are forever a TRUE Autobot.
* ENOUGH! ATTACK US, PRIME! ACCEPT YOUR FATE!
* : It is a strange time for field promotions, but you have more than earned it. I proudly dub you: COMMANDER PRIME, PROTECTOR OF CYBERTRON.
* : I look forward to the day where all are one with the Matrix, and we meet again my friend. But for now... ROLL OUT!
