sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text: See rewards list for Bring the Noise.

sections.heading: Cat Scratch Fever
sections.text:
Part 1
*Marissa Faireborn: Teletraan, identify the senior officer on duty.
*Optimus Primal: No need for Teletraans' services, that would be me. Why?
*Marissa: Because Blaster's audio detectors have picked up some disturbing readings.
*Optimus Primal: Disturbing in what way?
*Blaster: Disturbing as in we're talking big, bad, feral audio emissions are harshing the acoustic vibe on our HQ's perimeter.
*Optimus Primal: Feral?
*Blaster: Yeah, dig it boss bot, this is some heavy stuff... savage cat type readings.
*Optimus Primal: Cats? Feral? Uhhh... I'll go investigate. Rhinox, come with me.
*Rhinox: Roger that, Optimus. Lead the way.
Part 2
*Optimus Primal: Rhinox, did you see those claw marks on that mod back there?
*Rhinox: How could I miss them? Deep scratches raking through metal. Reminiscent of someone we know.
*Optimus Primal: I sense you share my suspicions.
*Rhinox: Our feline friend is here?
*Optimus Primal: It stands to reason. And if he's here, indications are he's out of sorts.
*Rhinox: Like everyone new to this bizarre place. But, if he's in a Transmetal feral state...
*Optimus Primal: Things can get problematic. He's one of ours, we have to help him.
Part 3
*Optimus Primal: Quite the squad accompanying the Commander. Hunting for something?
*Prowl: Someone. Let's not beat around the bush.
*Ironhide: The cat's out of the bag, Primal.
*Optimus Primal: I'm not sure I know what you're talking about.
*Prowl: There's no need to pretend he's not here. Waspinator told us who we're dealing with. The Maximal Cheetor is on the loose. And all signs are... he's dangerous.
*Optimus Primal: Perhaps, but he's still my responsibility. Rhinox, go find Cheetor while I "negotiate" with the Commander's hunting party.

sections.heading: Bushy-Tailed Problem
sections.text:
Part 1
*Optimus Prime: Explain your actions, Primal. Why did you engage the Commander's search party.
*Optimus Primal: You mean hunting party? Because the quarry is of mine.
*Optimus Prime: Do not let allegiances and loyalties cloud better judgement.
*Optimus Primal: Surely you can't fault me for protecting one of my own. In many ways, he's like your Bumblebee... young and earnest... but with a bit more of an edge to him.
*Optimus Prime: Bee with claws and a thirst for Energon! Mirage found a pile of barely functioning Sharkticons three clicks from here.
*Optimus Primal: I ask you to let me deal with this on Maximal terms.
*Optimus Prime: I am afraid I cannot let that happen.
*Optimus Primal: So be it. You make your decisions... I make mine.
Part 2
*Optimus Primal: Any progress in the search for Cheetor?
*Rhinox: Yes and no. I did find him. He was in a quasi-stasis mode... muttering Blackarachnia's name.
*Optimus Primal: That can't be good, but it could be explain some things. What's the no?
*Rhinox: He snapped out of stasis, turned on the jets, and took off. I couldn't keep up. Sorry.
*Optimus Primal: Don't fret my friend. We'll find him.
*Rhinox: I hope we do before he does too much damage. I'm telling you, Optimus, he has that old "bushy-tailed" look.
Part 3
*Prowl: Check it out, Ironhide. The horned one is here.
*Ironhide: Which means Cheetor has got to be nearby.
*Rhinox: Guess again, my Autobot brothers. I have no idea where he is.
*Prowl: I find that hard to believe. He's here, I know it. But, before we cage the cat, enlighten us. Why is he acting so crazed. Is it the Dark Energon atmosphere?
*Ironhide: Cyber-puberty?
*Rhinox: He's a bot in love.

sections.heading: Lovestruck
sections.text:
Part 1
*Optimus Primal: Finally, we've found you.
*Rhinox: You've been a tough cat to track down.
*Cheetor: So, it must be true. If you're here, she must be here.
*Optimus Primal: By "she" I assume you mean Blackarachnia?
*Rhinox: Who else could get the kid so wound up?
*Cheetor: I'm not a kid and I'm not wound up. She said she was coming here. I came to protect her.
*Optimus Primal: She said she was coming here? How?
*Cheetor: Well, I don't know if she meant here 'cuz I don't know where she is! What I do know is all you guys started disappearing... she found a weird spacebridge... she said she was going after someone... I couldn't find her... so I used the Spacebridge! Arrrggghhh!
Part 2
*Dinobot: You summoned, Optimus?
*Optimus Primal: I did. We have a Maximal problem. One I'd like to contain before the others start considering us untrustworthy.
*Dinobot: I concur, we need to stay allied with the Autobots, after all, you are Autobots when you get down to it.
*Optimus Primal: You too.
*Dinobot: Debatable. What do you want me to do?
*Optimus Primal: Cheetor is here, and acting shall we say... odd.
*Rhinox: He's in full Transmetal lovestruck mode.
Part 3
*Ironhide: Feline spotted.
*Prowl: I get it, you see him and he's got spots. Good one Ironhide!
*Cheetor: Jeez, fellas, enough with the dad jokes.
*Prowl: Huh? I don't get it. I don't have a dad, I was forged.
*Cheetor: It's a figure of speech... sheesh. What do you guys want?
*Ironhide: For you to quit your night prowling and come back to the safety of our HQ.
*Cheetor: Is Blackarachnia there?
*Prowl: Black-a-who-nia?

sections.heading: Tough Love
sections.text:
Part 1
*Optimus Primal: Dinobot, I told you to track down and monitor Cheetor.
*Dinobot: I did.
*Rhinox: So what happened? Where is he? We got reports he was ambushed by the Commander.
*Dinobot: I'd say your wayward Maximal did the ambushing, but he is ok. I got there just in time to get him to safety. He took a beating, but he is ok.
*Optimus Primal: Good work. Hopefully we can afford him the time he needs to rid himself of her influence.
*Dinobot: Her? You don't mean... is she here?
*Optimus Primal: Yes, her... Blackarachnia...but no she's not here. But for some reason he thinks she is. We need to get to the bottom of this before he gets hurts worse, both physically... and emotionally.
Part 2
*Rhinox: I was able to access Teletraan's planetary surveillance monitoring system. I can confirm unequivocally that Blackarachnia is not on New Quintessa.
*Optimus Primal: As we suspected. But why, is Cheetor convinced that she is?
*Dinobot: I can answer that. Waspinator. That stuttering Insecticon wannabe meddled with Cheetor's lovestruck circuitry. He told him he was here.
*Rhinox: But why?
*Dinobot: I deduce it has something to do with Cheetor's history of swatting down the annoying bug. Remeber that time Waspinaotr claimed he was Wonko the Sane? Didn't end well for Waspinator.
*Optimus Primal: I'll deal with Waspinator. Dinobot, make sure Cheeotr remains safe till we can set him straight.
Part 3
*Prowl: Ironhide, Commander... it's him.
*Ironhide: Cheetor?
*Prowl: No, his raptor savior, Dinobot. He's the one that abducted the crazed feline just when we had him dead to rights.
*Dinobot: And. I'm the one that would do so again. Your tough love policy isn't the right approach with Cheetor.
*Ironhide: You don't strike me as the sentimental type.
*Dinobot: I'm loyal... and a Maximal... not sentimental. Proceed at your own risk.

sections.heading: Love Bug
sections.text:
Part 1
*Optimus Primal: Waspinator, explain yourself.
*Waspinator: Wazzzpinator not understand. Explain, "explain yourself."
*Optimus Primal: You know what I'm talking about. Dinobot said you were meddling in affairs of the Spark. Cheetor's Spark.
*Waspinator: Errr... ummm... Wazzzpinator still confused.
*Rhinox: Cut the act, bug breath. We know you got Cheetor's tail in a tizzy by saying Balckarachnia is here when you she's not. Why'd you do it?
*Waspinator: Wazzzpinator wazzz bored. Kittybot wazzz acting crazzzy. I had some fun with the silly Maximal.
*Optimus Primal: Well, that fun is going to cost you. You're on duty to protect him... until we can persuade him to some to his senses.
Part 2
*Ironhide: Prowl, did you ever stop to think about what Cheetor is going through? You know, the love thing?
*Prowl: No.
*Ironhide: Good talk, Prowl. Let's go fix that cat.
Part 3
*Prowl: Bust out the bug spray.
*Waspinator: Why the attitude, Autocop?
*Prowl: So, you aren't here to stop us from wrangling the cat?
*Waspinator: Well, the big, bug Monkeybot did tell me to delay anyone looking for the furry bot with spots.
*Ironhide: That would be us. Move or become functionless.
*Waspinator: Wazzzpinator thinks we should dizzzcuss this.
*Prowl: Talking's not really our thing.
*Waspinator: Wazzzpinator wazzz afraid of that.

sections.heading: Respect for Love
sections.text:
Part 1
*Prowl: Look what we have here, the heartbreak kitty.
*Cheetor: Save the nicknames, funny guy. You could never understand what I feel.
*Ironhide: Thank Prime.
*Cheetor: That's a shame, because you'll also never know the depth of your emotions.
*Ironhide: Do I look like someone that cares?
*Cheetor: No, I guess you don't.
*Prowl: Ironhide, quick, grab him. He's got those rockets flaring. He's going to take off.
*Cheetor: Correction, I am taking off. Later, haters.
Part 2
*Optimus Primal: Cheetor! You're ok. I'm glad we found you.
*Cheetor: I'm not ok. I can't find her.
*Optimus Primal: That's because she's not here. Never was.
*Cheetor: But Waspinator said...
*Optimus Primal: Lies. Fake news. He was messing with you. But it's ok, now, come back with us.
*Cheetor: I...I can't. The others that have been hunting me think I'm a fool...a lovestruck idiot. They don't respect me. If I come back, I need to earn their respect...on my terms.
*Optimus Primal: Don't do anything rash.
*Cheetor: Don't worry. I'll be ok. After all, us cats have nine lives.
Part 3
*Prowl: We meet again, Romeo.
*Ironhide: Cool your jets and come back with us, ok? We're just following orders.
*Cheetor: Don't worry, I'm done running. But, I have one piece of unfinished business.
*Prowl: Oh yeah?
*Cheetor: Yeah, it's a small matter of respect. You don't respect me. But, you will when I'm done with you.
*Ironhide: Is this really necessary?
*Cheetor: It is for me.
**ROAR*

Fog of War.lead:
Fog of War Special Missions are a new type of mission that allows Commanders to stock up on Class Sparks of all kind, T1 to T4, by battling cloaked Bots.

Since January 2020, these Fog of War missions have existed:

* Null-Field ran from August 15 to 22, 2019.
* Apparitions ran from November 14 to 20, 2019.
*Moving Target ran from January 16 to 23, 2020.
*Pity ran from April 16 to 23, 2020.
*Declared ran from May 14 to 21, 2020 
*Gorilla in the Mist - June 24th~July 1st, 2021, a huge gap since the last one... 
*Spirit of Ember Future - December 23rd ~ December 30th, 2021 
*Gorilla in the Mist again from October 22, 2022

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text:
The 6x6 square map appears completely empty, but every node is an Ambush from a random bot. The final boss remains uncloaked. They give class spark essence of their respective class when defeated, though this changed in Apparitions to be randomized. The Completion rewards are awarded once but the node rewards can be repeated as many times as one likes.

There are four difficulties of the Null-Field:

*Deception - 10 T1 Class Spark Essence per Fight, 3 energy per node
*Deceit - 60 Class T2 Spark Essence per Fight, 4 energy per node
*Disguise - 135 (Null) 130 (App) T3 Class Spark Essence per Fight, 5 energy per node
*Darken - 35 (Null) 40 (App) T4 Class Spark Essence per Fight, 6 energy per node

Added in Apparitions are special Modules:

*Harness Power on all difficulties. 
*Stagger on T3 and T4.
*Special III on T4.

There are occasional stronger enemies which give four times the essence when defeated.

I kept trying to explain that TARGET practice usually requires targets you can SEE...

He responded "I see them when they blow up, that's good enough for me". So...watch your step I guess?

sections.heading: Final:

sections.heading: Intro:

It looks like we may have a jailbreak from the alternate universe evil Jazz. He's using the Fog of War to hide...for now.

My guess is he'll try and bring reinforcements. So shut him down and send him back home!

sections.heading: Final:

You know I look good as I smash you. Because you gotta' destroy with style, or don't bother destroying at all!

sections.heading: Intro:
sections.text:
Marissa Faireborn: Commander, it look like the Fog of War has become a literal fog...of WAR.

Tantrum', controlled by Necrotronus, is taking his role as the embodiment of "War" rather seriously.

We need to clear the field and end this before he can gather more forces.

sections.heading: Final:
sections.text:
Tantrum: YES, COMMANDER! See how the battle makes you glorious. How it feeds you with violence.

I almost feel bad for ending you now. You have fought well, but you seek to end War. I shall see it spread across the Universe.

Forge.lead:
Forging is the process of powering up Bots or Modules by consuming lower-tiered Bots or Modules. This will raise the Attack, Health, and Class Power of the higher-tiered Bot. 

The higher the Tier, Rank, Level, and Signature Ability of the Bots and Mods put into the Forge, the greater the benefits they provide. Bots and Mods consumed in the Forge also payout class Ore-13 and Gold based on their aforementioned stats. Bonus items, mainly Bot Crystal Shards, can be given as well.

Bots will only be able to consume other Bots, as Mods will consume other Mods. Only 2-Star and above can be forged. 

The Class Power of your Bot and Module governs the strength of their Class Bonus. The higher your Class Power, the more your Attack increases and the more the enemy Attack decreases when you have a Class Advantage. For example, Scout Bots have Class Advantage over Tech Bots, which have a Class Advantage over Demolitions Bots, and so on.

sections.heading: Requirements
sections.text:
To access the Forge, select “Bots” from the main menu to open your Bot inventory. Tap on any Bot for a list of actions that may be performed on that Bot. Select “Forge” to enter the Forge screen. Switch to the “Modules” tab to access Forging for Mods. You must own a minimum of 13 Bots or 8 Modules before Forging becomes available, and those Bots must be across more than one Tier.

Only Bots whose Tier is lower than the target Bot can be Forged. For example, a 4-Star Bot accepts 1~3-Star Bots, but a 2-Star Bot only accepts 1-Star Bots. The same applies to Modules.
Bots that are the same Tier cannot be Forged. You cannot consume a 4-Star Bot in order to power-up another 4-Star Bot. The same applies to Modules.

sections.heading: Benefits
sections.text: You can unlock the maximum potential of your target Bot using the same Bot one tier below the target. This one-time only bonus will raise the max Forge Level from 75 to 100 of the target Bot permanently. The above bonuses also apply to Modules.

sections.heading: Why remove Bots from your Inventory?
sections.text:
As you progress through the game, you acquire and upgrade many different Bots. Eventually, you may acquire Bots that are so powerful that you use them everywhere and leave your other weaker Bots behind. 

The Forge ensures the effort your put into those “weaker” Bots can be carried forward into your strongest Bots. In essence, Forging ensures Bots are never obsolete, even if you stop using them, because they can still serve the purpose of enhancing those at the top of your roster. 

All forged points in a Bot will be carried over if that Bot is forged.

sections.heading: Statistics
sections.text:
* 2-Star Bots can have from 75% to 110%, then if dupe-forged 125% Class advantage boost.
* 3-5~Star Bots can have from 100% to 147~150%, then 167% Class advantage boost.

Sharkticons, when forged, give Sharkticon Crystal Shards in greater amounts instead of regular Bot Crystal Shards.

Galvatron Rising/Transcript.lead: This is the transcript dialogue for the Spotlight Mission "Galvatron Rising."

sections.heading: Part 1
sections.text:
* Optimus Prime (MV1): Bee, what did your latest scouting foray reveal?
* Bumblebee (DOTM): Nothing less than an off the charts seismic reading of Decepticon badness.
* Optimus Prime (MV1): The Commander will need more than that to go on...
* Bumblebee: I know, it's just that the whole area is on edge. There's a sense of craziness... as though a deranged presence has arrived.
* Optimus Prime (MV1): More deranged than usual?
* Bumblebee: Yeah, next level deranged.

sections.heading: Part 2
sections.text:
* Bumblebee: Commander, remember when I talked about deranged? This is what I was talking about.
* Motormaster: Shut it you insipid yellow blather-bot! This isn't the time or place.
* Bumblebee: You seem nervous, motor-mouth, What's rattling your chassis, big guy?
* Motormaster: Isn't it obvious? There's a new boss calling the shots... and he definitely likes shooting.
* Bumblebee: Don't suppose you'd care to share who we're talking about?
* Motormaster: What?! And have him shoot me in the back? I'll take a pass. You'll have the pleasure of his insanity soon enough.

sections.heading: Part 3
sections.text:
* Bumblebee: So, we meet again.
* Motormaster: That's right, and now it's time to show the new boss what I can do.
* Bumblebee: So you just bow down and do whatever he says? Sounds pretty weak...
* Motormaster: We have history. I crossed him once, and he didn't like it. It's something I won't do again.
* Bumblebee: You Decepticons live in fear of your crazy bosses. When will you learn?
* Motormaster: It doesn't take long to learn... the new boss is pretty much the same as the old boss. Comply or die. I'm complying, you're dying!

sections.heading: Half the Battle
sections.text:
Part 1
*Bumblebee: The insanity continues. We haven't got a line on who the Energon disturber is, but reports are he has Ramjet locked and loaded for destruction.
*Optimus Prime (MV1): Didn't we just dispatch that Decepticon?
*Bumblebee: We did, but fear is an over-riding factor when it comes to whoever is out there.
*Ultra Magnus: Only one Deception could induce such fear.
*Optimus Prime (MV1): Megatron?
*Ultra Magnus: In a sense. If it's who I suspect, it's more like... Megatron reborn!
Part 2
*Bumblebee: Hey big, tall, and stoic, you going to tell us who we're facing? Or, are you just going to let the Commander fight on blind?
*Ultra Magnus: I'd prefer not to create undue fear or concern that may distract.
*Bumblebee: And I'd like to win the Galactic Olympics. But, I'm not gonna unless I know who I'm up against.
*Ultra Magnus: Fair enough, knowing is half the battle.
*My fear is, Ramjet now calls GALVATRON his master.
*Bumblebee: And...? We beat him into full retreat mode in my reality.
*Ultra Magnus: Not in mine...
Part 3
*Ultra Magnus: Galvatron's minion shows his ugly conehead.
*Ramjet: Galva-who? I'm no snitch. Who says I need a boss?
*Ultra Magnus: Starscream is scum. Megatron has abandoned you, and Galvatron would scare you into compliance. The question is why he chose you?
*Ramjet: The boss said he likes bots that use their heads.
*Ultra Magnus: He thought you used your head?! Like you actually were programmed with a brain? That's a laugh...
*Ramjet: With me he meant it literally, not figuratively. Get ready to see what he was talking about!

sections.heading: First Test
sections.text:
Part 1
*Ultra Magnus: Commander, the flunky parade keeps on rolling. This time Galvatron is showing how low he'll go.
*Starscream: Flunky? FLUNKY!? I think not you poor, delusional do-gooder. How dare you suggest that the mighty Starscream is somehow low.
*Ultra Magnus:: Lower than your back stabbing brother Seeker Ramjet? I think so. But it must pain you to realize he is as capable of treachery as low as yours.
*Starscream: Bah! His misguided actions were committed in an absence of true leadership. Now we have a partner... a fellow leader for all Deceptions... Galvatron!
*Ultra Magnus:: Yeah, right...
Part 2
*Starscream: You and your little party of weak link Cybertronians and human vermin roll around in search of your demise.
*Ultra Magnus: Demise? Hardly. We search for your master in order to bring a semblance of sanity to the area.
*Starscream: Be careful what you search for... oh, who am I kidding giving hollow warnings? Keep searching! I am sure you'll find what you're looking for. Like right about now!
Part 3
*Galvatron: My minions were correct in suggesting I size up my adversary. Perhaps I'll let them live. You, on the other hand, shall not be so fortunate... next time we meet.
Part 4
*Starscream: Galvatron told me to expect you. Your first test served him well. He says he now has all he needs to know.
*Ultra Magnus: Don't worry, he'll learn some more next time we meet, But what we want to learn is why you are such a glutton for abuse, Megatron, Galvatron... it always ends the same for you.
*Starscream: It ends with me where I want to be... on top!
*Ultra Magnus: Really? That's interesting because we heard Galvatron vaporized you at your "coronation."
*Starscream: Well, I still function, don't I? That must be wrong.
*Ultra Magnus: Yeah, there's a lot of that going around.

sections.heading: Over My Dead Chassis
sections.text:
Part 1
*Ultra Magnus: Optimus, may I have a word with you?
*Optimus Prime: Of course, what is it?
*Ultra Magnus: I fear this situation with Galvatron is my fault. I have had many chances to thwart his crazed ambitions. And, yet, here he is endangering my friends and colleagues again.
*Optimus Prime: Many have encountered this mad bot and many have failed. It is not upon you.
*Ultra Magnus: No, Optimus, this is my burden to bear. I must rectify that which I caused. I have had the chances, now I must succeed, once and for all.
Part 2
*Optimus Prime: Commander, there is troubling developments.
*Bumblebee: Judging from the oversized tire tread marks, I'd say he's up ahead.
*Optimus Prime: We should proceed with caution. Our old friend is wracked with guilt and highly unstable.
Part 3
*Ultra Magnus: I'm afraid I can't let you proceed.
*Optimus Prime: What are you talking about?
*Ultra Magnus: This is my fault. No more Autobots or our allies shall pay the price for my failure. I alone shall face him. I will not allow anyone to pass.
*Optimus Prime: Stand down, soldier. This is madness.
*Ultra Magnus: No, he is madness incarnate.

sections.heading: The One and Only
sections.text:
Part 1
*Bumblebee: Holy exploding spark plugs! Remeber that off the charts seismic reading of Decepticon badness I was talking about?
*Optimus Prime (MV1): Yes, and indeed your dire predictions proved to be correct.
*Bumblebee: Well, things just got mega-sized! Our old nemesis is rumbling through the wastelands and by all accounts he's angrier than usual.
*Optimus Prime (MV1): Commander, ready the squad, things just took a turn for the worse.
Part 2
*Bumblebee: The readings were right... mega-trouble dead ahead.
*Megatron (ROTF): If death is what you're looking for, indeed you're on the right path.
*Bumblebee: We're not looking for anything other than the one they call Galvatron.
*Megatron (ROTF): Why does the wasteland cower when this imposter's name is mentioned?
*Surely it is known that "Galvatron" is merely a name given to me by the human insects when they sought to control all Cybertronians.
*Bumblebee: Maybe in our reality, but this one claims to be different. Word is, their Megatron was vanquished. But, this Galvatron arose from his ashes with the help of Unicron, making him the most powerful Decepticon ever!
*Megatron (ROTF): LIES AND FALSEHOODS! Silence, or you will taste the wrath of the true owner of the title MOST POWERFUL DECEPTION EVER!
Part 3
*Bumblebee: Commander, no signs of Galvatron, but it looks we've found his bit wannabe daddy.
*Megatron (ROTF): How dare you cast such idle insults and baseless accusations, lest I remind you of what true power is?
*Bumblebee: Save your exhaust, Megatron. We've heard it before.
*Megatron (ROTF): Although, you're not the victim I seek, your carcasses should provide ample proof who the lord of the Wastelands is.
*The imposter Galvatron will be served notice.. there is only one...and that one is MEGATRON!

sections.heading: Feared and Deranged
sections.text:
Part 1
*Megatron (ROTF): Prepare to die, pretender to my power.
*Galvatron: Please, save your empty threats.
*Megatron (ROTF): Megatron never issues empty threats.
*Galvatron: Oh, really!? You leak Energon and your parts are in obvious need of repair. The human Commander left you with one option. Lick your wounds and begone!
*Megatron (ROTF): This isn't over...
*Galvatron: That's what they all say.
Part 2
*Galvatron: I see you two failures dare to make your presence known to me.
*Ramjet: But Boss, The Commander's squad was too strong.
*Galvatron: And you were too weak. Failure is unacceptable, but I'm feeling magnanimous.
*Motormaster: You'll let us live... and serve you?
*Galvatron: I'll give you a head start on the rest of your life. Turn around and run. GO!
*Mottormaster: But if we do that you'll just shoot us in the back.
*Galvatron: Precisely! Muhahahhaha! 
Part 3
*Optimus Prime: Deceptiocn bodies litter the Wasteland... indiscriminate destruction everywhere. Galvatron is near.
*Bumblebee: He has a seriously dark spark. Did you see Ramjet and Motormaster's bodies? Shot in the back! That's cold.
*Optimus Prime: That's Galvatron.
*Galvatron:No, I'm Galvatron... the master of all that surrounds you!'
*Optimus Prime: The Autobots and our allies have no master... only the promise of freedom and determination to serve that which is just.
*Galvatron: Well you have one now. Me... Galvatron... born of the power of Unicron and destined to destroy any who possess the Matrix of Leadership.
*You have met your master, now prepare to meet your destiny!

sections.heading: Controls
sections.text:
*Right Tap: Light attack or shoot ranged attacks when far away
*Right Swipe: Medium attack or Dash forward when far away. Swiping right can be performed from either the left or right side of the screen.
*Right Hold: Heavy attack - Transform into alt mode and break through an opponent's block
*Left Swipe: Dash backward, sometimes referred to as a backstep. Swiping left can be performed from either the left or right side of the screen.
*Left Hold: Block - reduce incoming damage
*Swipe Up/Down: Sidestep up/down

A Bot can hit an opponent with melee attacks up to five times at a time (seven for agile bots like Mirage, Arcee), which is achieved by using a mix of three light and two medium attacks. You can rack up a combo streak by successfully hitting the opponent consecutively until your bot is hit by an unblocked attack.

Basic Ranged Attacks are fired up to three at a time. As opponents can easily block or sidestep a barrage of projectiles, it is recommended to strategically shoot when the opponent is dashing forward or right after he/she completes a melee Special Attack. You can dash in immediately after a successful projectile hit or two and start a melee combo. Shooting one at a time is the safest and can be good for establishing a "good" map position or disrupting certain mods, e.g., bots that gain power while blocking can have their block disrupted by single ranged shots because they will dodge instead of block. Two consecutive shots is a bit riskier but can be useful in setting up 7a -hit combo but a miss on the second one will make you vulnerable to the opponent dashing in at you and getting their combo on your face! Three consecutive shots is the riskiest of all and should only be used when your bot has a RANGED SPEED buff, e.g., Arcee, Mirage, Starscream after a SP1.  In these cases, the opponent cannot dash in fast enough, keep in mind, this will only be temporary for the length of the buff.

Heavy Attacks can be used to deal more damage in a single hit and break an opponent's block. Some Bots have heavy melee attacks, while others have ranged heavy attacks. It is ideal to use a heavy attack when an opponent is at the edge of the arena.

Blocking can be used to reduce damage from attacks, but your block may be broken by heavy attacks. Backstep or Sidestep away from them to continue blocking. Some Bots have abilities that activate through Blocking, for example Optimus Prime's Armor or Hound's Projectile Switch. Block Proficiency can increase the damage that is reduced. Some Special Attacks may bypass Blocks, like Megatronus' Special II.

Sidestepping can be used to dodge ranged attacks at a distance. This is particularly useful if you're Blocking for a while and want to keep doing so. Some Special Attacks are hard to sidestep, like Shockwave's Special II.
Category:Gameplay

sections.heading: Special Attacks
sections.text:
Special Attacks are three powerful attacks that Bots have access to. A Special Attack can only be used once a Bot has gained enough Power to do so, which is generated when a Bot lands and receives enough hits, along with some other abilities. Once enough Power has been acquired, the Special Attack bar will glow a certain color, depending on which Special Attack it is (Green for Special Attack 1, Yellow for Special Attack 2, Red for Special Attack 3).

All Bots have access to all three of their Special Attacks from the start. Before then, 1~3-Star Bots unlock their Special 3 at Rank 2. Before v2.0, Bots had to unlock each Special by Rank (Special 2 at Rank 2, Special 3 at Rank 3), while 1-Star Bots only had 2 Special Attacks.

Only one Bot can use a special attack at a time and is invulnerable while performing it. Special 1 and 2 attacks can be normally blocked or dodged, so be sure to use your Specials when your opponent is vulnerable, and be wary of the opponent's Specials as well. Abilities that disable Special Attacks also exist. (Jazz, Grindor)

An in-depth guide to dodging Special Attacks, made by Forged to Fight Forum user BonesetterHUN, can be seen here ([https://forums.transformersforgedtofight.com/discussion/9040/dodge-patterns Original forum post]) This guide is particularly helpful if you're trying to dodge a particular Special (for example, Bumblebee (DOTM)'s Special II).

sections.heading: Kabam Support Guide
sections.text:
Special attacks depend on your bot. Each one has a different set of special attacks that is based on their tier and rank. This combat style will charge while you are fighting and glow green once the first charge is full, yellow for the second charge, and red for the third and final charge.

This move cannot be interrupted, as the cast is instant, though the first two levels can be blocked.

The higher the level of your special attack, the stronger the effect of your move. For example, if your bot has unlocked the set of three specials, it will be able to charge its level one attack and cast it. You can also continue fighting and charge up to its second or third level, and then cast a more powerful move.

A bot will always perform the highest available move when the attack is activated. For example, you cannot have three charges and activate a level one attack.

Remember that you will need to rank up 2-Star and 3-Star Bots to unlock their tier two and tier three specials (respectively).

1-Star Bot: Starts with a one-bar special attack

2-Star Bot: Starts with a one-bar special attack

3-Star Bot: Starts with a two-bar special attack

4-Star Bot: Starts with a three-bar special attack

Some attacks have special effects. As some examples, bots can have an increased chance at critical damage and a chance to stun or have the ability to remove armor. There are several different kinds of special effects. Here is an example of the first two special attacks of Optimus Prime:

* Sideswipe: Swagger - % Increase in critical rate and chance to inflict Stun for a given period of time.
* Optimus Prime: Guardian Stash - Energon Axe strikes have a % chance to inflict Armor Break, removing enemy armor and applying a % armor reduction for a given period of time.
* Optimus Prime MV1: Energon Chop - % chance to inflict Bleed on slashing attacks, dealing % attack over a given period of time.

Make sure that you check out the special attacks of your bots by opening the bot profile and tapping on the INFO button for more information about each move.

Good luck with your battles!

sections.heading: Combinations
sections.text:
* R = basic ranged
* H = heavy ranged
* L = light melee attack
* M = medium melee attack (this is effectively the same as what some people call "dash in" when it's executed from a distance)
* SP = special attack
* BS = backstep
* SS = sidestep
All of these combos presume there is distance between you and the opponent at the start of the combo. They follow a general pattern [setup]-[combo]-[bonus]-[reset] with many variants.

sections.heading: General use, setting up an "opening"
sections.text:
R SS

 RR* SS

 RRR* SS
* see notes above on basic ranged attacks and the associated risks with consecutive ranged shots

sections.heading: Auto-Fight
sections.text: At Commander level 19, Auto-Fight becomes available in Solo Missions and Arenas, allowing your Bots to be automatically controlled. (Special Attacks can still be manually activated) It is recommended to only use this feature with high-ranking Bots to grind though easier maps. Full manual control is recommended against Bots in harder difficulty maps.

Generations.lead: Generations is a Chrono-Vector Special Mission that ran from Sept 12th to Sept 25th.

sections.heading: Synopsis
sections.text:
Wheeljack and Jetfire have teamed up to monitor “Chrono-Vector” effects. To better research timeline disturbances, they have found a way to generate moments from all the Bots from their origin point. They’ll need the help of the Commander as they gather samples from EVERY Generation 1 Bot on New Quintessa! Get ready for a blast from the past as you enter CHRONO-VECTOR: GENERATIONS.

This is a brand new Challenge Mission with 4 difficulties (from 2-Star to 5-Star) and will feature Bot specific Mods for an increased challenge! It will be available Sept 12th at 10am PDT - Sept 25th at 10am PDT.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text:
Each Map features 6 themed Bots for a total of 24 encounters! Mission Rewards include GENERATION CHIPS which can be used to acquire Generation 1 Bots in the Store.

Out of the Generations Bots encountered in this mission, Windblade, Kickback, Megatronus, and Nemesis Prime are not present.

sections.heading: Evil Forces
sections.text:
Part 1
* Jetfire: Wheeljack, I've altered your Chrono-Vector Device to analyze fractures from our timeline.
* Wheeljack: That why you got the Autobot and Decepticon crews all standing around?
* Jetfire: What you see are Chrono-Anomalies. By battling them we can ping their Chrono-Reference-Alignment-Parameters.
* Wheeljack: Yeah...I'm just going to call them Time-Slices.
* Jetfire: If you must. We should begin our research immediately.
* Wheeljack: Fighting and learning, sounds up my alley! Let's start with some Decepticons!
Part 2
* Shockwave: Prepare for termination!
Part 3
* Soundwave: Escape is impossible! Autobots inferior, Soundwave superior!
Part 4
* Megatron: Everything I touch is food for my hunger. My hunger for power!
* Wheeljack: Hey Jetfire, the Time-Slices keep shouting at me!
* Jetfire: Each interaction with them pierces a unique Chrono-Vector, it is possible we were mid-conversation before we engage them.
* Wheeljack: ...Knowing why somehow makes it worse.

sections.heading: No Place to Run
sections.text:
Part 1
* Jetfire: We must engage with Autobot-Vectors.
* Wheeljack: Seems we've got a road race to join.
* Jetfire: Indeed. We must be quick, and don't hold back.
* Wheeljack: So to be clear, you want this drag race to be fast AND...
* Jetfire: Fully within the parameters of our experiment.
* Wheeljack: Never going to launch a franchise with that title.
Part 2
* Ratchet: No more backtalk, or I'll short your mouth circuit.
Part 3
* Mirage: Sorry Prime, the ship was full!
Part 4
* Bumblebee: Prime told me there'd be days like this.
* Wheeljack: And you didn't believe him?
* Jetfire: (hitting Wheeljack on the head) Wheeljack, they can't interact with you like that.
* Wheeljack: Ow! Sorry, it just felt so familiar! Alright, let's rumble Bumble!

sections.heading: From the Sky Above
sections.text:
Part 1
* Jetfire: The road is clear, time to take on some of the Decepticons in the sky.
* Wheeljack: There's a familiar face right in front of us.
* Jetfire: Indeed! It appears that one of my own..Time-Slices...has materialized.
* Wheeljack: Well, I'll just go up there and punch you as hard as I can.
* Jetfire: For science?
* Wheeljack: ...yeah. Science.
Part 2
* Starscream: Megatron has fallen! I, Starscream, am now your new leader!
Part 3
* Cyclonus: Warriors such as you and I should meet their end in battle.
Part 4
* Galvatron: Cybertron and all its moons belong to me!
* Wheeljack: There's a lot of ego on these guys, huh?
* Jetfire: I am here to analyze the impossibly complex chrono-vectors of our timelines, not their mental states.
* Wheeljack: I'm writing down that they're jerks.
* Jetfire: Remain scientific and impartial, Wheeljack.
* Wheeljack: Fine. I'll just shoot them a bunch.
* Jetfire: That is preferable for our research, thank you.

sections.heading: Wage Their Battle
sections.text:
Part 1
* Wheeljack: One more group of Autobots to get through.
* Jetfire: I see your Time-Slice in the distance, when we reach it shall I take care of the battle?
* Wheeljack: N'ah, I've always wanted to know if I could beat me in a fair fight.
* Jetfire: How would fighting yourself be ... not fair?
* Wheeljack: I'm a complicated Bot. Also...I fight dirty.
Part 2
* Grimlock: ME GRIMLOCK KING!
Part 3
* Jazz: Do it with style or don't bother doing it.
Part 4 - finale
* Optimus Prime: So long as freedom exists. We shall remember you...
* Jetfire: ...curious.
* Wheeljack: What's up Jetfire?
* Jetfire: Nothing. It...it was just an odd moment to recall. We need to finish this research.
* Wheeljack: More data coming up. Go get him Commander!

Get the Horns.lead: Get the Horns is a Spotlight Mission featuring Tantrum that ran from July 13th to August 9th.

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text: Instead of new relics, Relic Tickets are now rewarded for mastering missions, which can be used to purchase previous relics or new special relics.

sections.heading: Go Big
sections.text:
Part 1
*Blaster: I'm not one to be looking for double trouble, but we have to go back.
*Jazz: I hear ya' man, but now?
*Optimus Prime: Blaster is correct. If we do not stop Megatron now, we surely will face dire consequences. Megatron is searching for seomthing...
*Blaster: Yeah, a blast from the past.
*Jazz: Yo' I see what you did there. But, what is he looking for?
*Optimus Prime: This planet holds many secrets... and a past shaped by the ancient Primes. I do not know what he seeks, but I do know we must hurry... before he secures the power of the Primes.
Part 2
*Prowl: I'm glad Optimus finally sent me out on a mission. I was getting stir crazy back at HQ listening to Ratchet rambling on about Megatron's plans.
*Jazz: But check it, Prowl, that's why we're out here. Ratchet and Optimus say Megs is cooking up something big.
*Prowl: I got the debrief. They think he's searching for a game changing artifact... something Primal.
*Jazz: Whatever it is, we've gotta find it first.
Part 3
*Prowl: Trouble ahead... in the form of Galvatron.
*Jazz: Great... just what we needed. Is he running with Megatron now, too?
*Galvatron: I run with and from no-one you insipid fool. I am Galvatron... I need say no more.
*Jazz: So this is just a random encounter? We good?
*Galvatron: We are never good. I am Galvatron... you are a pathetic waste of metal and circuitry.
*Prowl: You just said more.
*Galvatron: Bah! Time for you to die!

sections.heading: Random Encounter
sections.text:
Part 1
*Soundwave: Laserbeak has returned from his reconnaissance mission. The Commander and the Autobots continue their pursuit.
*Megatron: Do I care? Hardly. Once we attain what we seek, their demise is imminent.
*Soundwave: With all due respect, I cannot say I share your confidence.
*Megatron: Do not pull a Starscream on me. Question me not. We're going big, and the Enigma is the key. Now, go summon Bludgeon... I have a mission for him.
Part 2
*Bludgeon: Soundwave said you wanted to see me.
*Megatron: Indeed I do. How would you like to get serious about ending this Autobot nuisance?
*Bludgeon: I'm always serious, especially when it comes to eradicating Autobots. What do you have in mind?
*Megatron: Recent revelations suggest a device of unimaginable power is nearby.
*Bludgeon: Yeah? I've heard that before. Care to share a little more?
*Megatron: Let's just say it's time to go big... as in Combiner big.
*Bludgeon: Combiner? That would turn the tide. But, I'm not one one of those... you know... Combiner pieces.
*Megatron: But you could be... if we secure The Enigma of Combination. It's almost within our grasp. Buy us some time and devastating power will be yours.
Part 3
*Jazz: You sure this is the way?
*Blaster: Yeah, don;t you remember? Megatron's excavation site is on this path.
*Prowl: Uh, squad, we've got a slight problem.
*Blaster: No, I'm telling ya', this is the route.
*Prowl: That's not the problem...
*Bludgeon: I am.

sections.heading: Bull Scrap
sections.text:
Part 1
*Megatron: Do you believe in fate, Soundwave?
*Soundwave: Fate does not equate. Why?
*Megatron: Because a valuable piece of our Combiner puzzle just Spacebridged its way here. Tantrum has been spotted nearby. We need to find our way to him.
*Soundwave: It would be wise to grab that bull by the horns.
*Megatron: Precisely. His experience as a Combiner fits perfectly with our plans. It's time to go wrangle us a bull.
Part 2
*Magatron: Tantrum, I presume?
*Tantrum: You got the name right, but I don't take kindly to strangers. Who are you?
*Megatron: The name is Megatron... leader of the Decepitcons.
*Tantrum: Last I remember, Galvatron was boss.
*Megatron: That was another time.., another reality. If you want to survive here, you'll do best to listen to me.
*Tantrum: And why's that?
*Megatron: Because I'm putting together something special. Something big... something that will destroy all Autobots.
*Tantrum: I like the sounds of that. What do you want me to do?
*Megatron: Slow the Autobots roll while I uncover the power... the power to combination!
Part 3
*Jazz: What the heck is that? Looks like a mascot for one of those Earth basketball teams.
*Blaster: Ah, man... you don't know him? He's the cow that likes to go kapow.
*Tantrum: A COW?! Try bull. A bull that's going to teach you a harsh lesson in biology, Autobot scum!

sections.heading: Headmaster
sections.text:
Part 1
*Motormaster: You got the call from the boss?
*Mixmaster: Your boss, but yeah, I'm here. Can't hurt to listen.
*Motormaster: I wonder what he has in mind.
*Mixmaster: That Bludgeon guy said it was something big... something about combining forces.
*Motormaster: Combining forces? Sounds like something I can get behind.
Part 2
*Megatron: I assume you are wondering why I summoned you.
*Motormaster: I have an idea...
*Mixmaster: But why don't you fill us in?
*Megatron: You both have experience being part of something bigger. I;m talking about Combiner bigger.
*Motormaster: Yeah, so what? Our partners in combining aren't here. Combining isn't possible.
*Megatron: Don;t be so sure. Have you heard of the Enigma of Combination? The primal device that created the very power to combine? I have reason to believe... it is here.
*Mixmaster: You're saying there's a chance we could combine and crush the Autobots?
*Megatron: That's what I'm saying.
*Motormaster: I call head.
*Megatron: You'll need to earn that.
Part 3
*Prowl: Ah, great. Look who we have here, the wannabe King of the Road.
*Motormaster: That's right, talk trash rent-a-cop-car. Words won't matter when you see what's in store for you.
*Prowl: Is that supposed to scare us?
*Motormaster: Does the power of combination scare you?
*Prowl: It might, if it was a possibility.
*Motormaster: Anything is possible... including your death. Step up and test the possibilities.

sections.heading: Devastation
sections.text:
Part 1
*Optimus Prime: Prowl, are our suspicions confirmed?
*Prowl: Based on the way the big rig was running his mouth about the power of combination... I'd say yes.
*Optimus Prime: That mean Megatron thinks he's found...
*Ratchet: The Enigma of Combination.
*Prowl: Which means?
*Optimus Prime: Which means Megatron is going to take things to a whole new level if he gets his hand on it. by the power of Primus, we must stop him.
Part 2
*Megatron: Motormaster failed to stop the Autobots.
*Mixmaster: That matters not to me. More importantly, have you found the Enigma of Combination?
*Megatron (ROTF): Patience, my friend. Soundwave and Shockwave have the situation well in hand.
*Mixmaster: They better. This Commander and the Autobots need to be dealt with.
*Megatron: I couldn't agree more. It's time to escalate, elevate...
*Mixmaster: And DEVASTATE!
Part 3
*Optimus Prime: We know what you are up to, Megatron.
*Megatron: Oh really? That is of little concern to me.
*Optimus Prime: We will not let you get the Enigma of Combination. It is not happening.
*Megatron: That is not for you to decide. Mixmaster, dispatch of these nuisances then meet me at the site.
*Mixmaster: No problem. Scrapping Autobots is always a pleasure.

sections.heading: Something Else
sections.text:
Part 1
*Megatron: You're back, feeling better? Looked like the Commander's team got the better of you.
*Tantrum: It's been awhile since I locked horns with the Autobots. Next time will be different.
*Megatron: I admire your enthusiasm. The time is almost upon us. Soundwave and his crew have broken through to a new chamber at the excavation site.
*Tantrum: What does that mean?
*Megatron: That means the end to those infernal Autobots and their human pets is at hand.
Part 2
*Soundwave: Lord Megatron, I have news to report.
*Megatron: So... do so.
*Soundwave: Progress has been made in our excavations.
*Megatron: I am aware of that. Tell me something I don't know.
*Soundwave: Shockwave believes our search for the Enigma may be in vain. The chamber we located was not an artifact.
*Megatron: You're testing my patience.
*Soundwave: We believe it was a stasis chamber. One with inhabitants... ancient inhabitants.
*Megatron: Now this is an interesting turn of events. So no Enigma of Combination?
*Soundwave: It is too early to tell affirmatively, but we surmise this could be something... or someone... far more powerful. Shouldn't you tell Tantrum?
*Megatron: Why? He's a pawn that got played. He'll learn soon enough.
Part 3
*Jazz: Looks like someone wants a rematch.
*Blaster: Don't they ever learn?
*Tantrum: I've learned something. I've learned I like to kick Autobot tailpipe.
*Jazz: Funny, that's not how things played out last time.
*Blaster: Ah, give the guy a break, Jazz... second time's a charm.

Gold.lead:
Gold is the standard currency in the game.

Gold is used to upgrade and rank up Bots and Mods, to start Away Missions, to start Arena fights, to start Alliance Missions (formerly), and to upgrade Masteries.

Gold can be earned by completing fights and in all game modes, from successfully completing Away Missions, helping other Commanders in an Alliance with help requests, from some Alliance Quests, from certain crystals like the Arena Crystal and the Gold Crystal, Daily Deals, duplicate Bots and Mods, and Forging.

Gorilla in the Mist.lead: Gorilla in the Mist is a Fog of War mission featuring Optimus Primal as the boss that ran from June 24th to July 1st, 2021. It returned on October 27, 2022 and ran for the remainder of the game's life.

sections.heading: Synopsis
sections.text:
The multiverses are still open and Beast Bots are spilling in from all over. There are reports that a leader of these dangerous animals is deep within the latest Fog Of War and it's up to the Commander to see if they can capture the GORILLA IN THE MIST!

Mods: Ranged Timed 1-4, Stagger 2-4

sections.heading: Transcript
sections.text:
Intro

* Marissa Faireborn: Commander, there is reports of wild beasts somewhere in the fog, With all this multiverse madness I would advise you to stay on high alert.
* We can't be sure who's friend or foe out there...all I've been hearing is howls and growls. Best of luck.

Boss

* Optimus Primal: POACHER! YOU DARE FACE THE POWER OF PRIMAL AGAIN!?
* I MAY NOT KNOW WHERE I AM. OR WHO YOU ARE. OR WHAT IS GOING ON!
* BUT I KNOW THAT IF YOU ARE LOOKING FOR A FIGHT ... THAT'S JUST PRIME!

Grave Consequences.lead: Grave Consequences is a Spotlight Mission featuring Megatronus that ran from October 4 to November 1.

sections.heading: Changes/Rewards
sections.text: "For this month only, rewards have been updated in Expert and Master Difficulty. We've added T4 Basic Spark Essence to the Completion and Mastery rewards for Expert, and have bumped up the T3 Class Spark Crystal Shards and T4 Basic Spark Essence, and introduced T3 Alpha Spark Essence to rewards available in Master!"

sections.heading: Warning Signs
sections.text:
Part 1
*Prowl: Commander, the situation is dire. It has been to long since our last contact with Optimus or Ultra Magnus. We have assembled a team to seek them out.
*Ratchet: I'm still getting a readout from Optimus' vitals, but the signal is almoat as weak as his chart is. We're going to need to get moving.'
*Jazz: I'm ready to lay down track! Let's save the big boss Bots!
*Arcee: I'll take up the rear, but I'll checking in through my scope for trouble ahead.
*Prowl: Everyone keep your optics open and your blasters hot. Let's just hope to Primus that we're not too late.'
Part 2
*Arcee: Trouble incoming!
*Bludgeon: Trouble? I am here only to give you valuable information.
*Prowl: Move aside, Bludgeon. We have no quarrel with you today.
*Bludgeon: You are not the first to come this way, and none have returned. Why not end your journey here?
*Ratchet: You'll have to excuse us if we don't take your advice.
*Jazz: It's just that you're a massively untrustworthy skull-faced scrapheap.
Part 3
*Prowl: One last warning Bludgeon, stand down. We can avoid needless violence.
*Bludegon: I have never encountered violence that wasn't needed, I'm certain there will be a good reason for it.
*Ratchet: I don't think he's the type of Bot we can reason with, Prowl.
*Bludgeon: There is a dark power waiting beyond here. I had hoped to challenge it while I was fully rested. But I suppose I can consider your destruction a warm up.
*Ratchet: It still may be wise to stretch first, because we're going to make sure you break something!

sections.heading: The Dark Path
sections.text:
Part 1
*Ratchet: The closer we get to the signal, the weaker it seems to be getting. That just doesn't add up.
*Prowl: Maybe your readouts are faulty. Have you run a self-diagnostic?
*Ratchet: My internals are clicking along just fine. It's something out there that's causing the feedback.
*Jazz: The spooky vibes are nasty and they are everyone.
*Arcee: I'm seeing more movement ahead, and it's coming toward us.
*Prowl: Whatever challenge lays ahead we'll head it off as we push towards the last received signal. Out friends need us.
Part 2
*Soundwave: Autobots! Cease your interference. Your inferior methods are causing faults in my tracking.
*Jazz: One of your tapes pop a spool big guy? You're probably the one spinning our dials.
*Soundwave: I spin nothing. The Electro Map was fully functional until you approached.
*Prowl: Electro Map? I haven't seen one of those in ages. What are you following?
*Soundwave: I do not have time for your pointless interrogation.
*Ratchet: I highly advise you make time.
*Soundwave: Time cannot be made. But if you insist on delaying me I shall use these extra moments to end you.
Part 3
*Soundwave: I am on a priority mission to track and retrieve Megatron. You will remove yourselves from this path.
*Arcee: We're trying to find Optimus, perhaps we can align our goals? Whatever is out there may require all of us to defeat it.
*Soundwave: My preference is to render you all non-functional, eliminate the interference, and continue alone.
*Prowl: We tried asking nicely. Let's put him down and continue along.
*Jazz: I am so ready to drop a beatdown on this overgrown Megatron megaphone.

sections.heading: One of Us
sections.text:
Part 1
*Ratchet: Soundwave's Electro Map is simplistic but functional. I've tuned it so Optimus' signal is amplified. But...there's something else.
*Jazz: Don't stress us with the anticipation Doc, what's the diagnosis?
*Ratchet: I'm not just receiving a tracking signal, something seems to be sending pretty heavily encoded data bursts as well.
*Arcee: Our tracker is being tracked?
*Prowl: That does present a distinct tactical disadvantage.
*Ratchet: It's still our best chance for finding Optimus. I'll continue decoding while we're on the move. Hopefully it's just some background distortions.
Part 2
*Prowl: Ratchet, you will cease tracking Optimus.
*Ratchet: What? I've just about figured this out. Give me a moment.
*Prowl: That wasn't a request. Something is wrong. The code...I can feel it. You will stop tracking immediately.
*Jazz: Ease up there, Prowl. You're gonna pop a siren.
*Prowl:YOU WILL OBEY MY COMMANDS.
*Ratchet: Quintus wept ... it isn't a tracker. It's an override!
Part 3
*Prowl:WHY CAN YOU NEVER JUST FOLLOW PROTOCOL?
*Ratchet: Prowl, please focus! This isn't you. Something is taking control.
*Prowl:CONTROL IS ALL I'VE EVER ASKED FOR. OBEDIENT, LAWFUL, CONTROL!
*Jazz: Hey buddy, Barricade already has the bad cop side covered. Maybe make a swerve to protect and serve?
*Prowl:CEASE YOUR PRATTLING! OR SHALL I CEASE YOUR FUNCTIONS FOR YOU?
*Arcee: Ratchet, is there any way we can safely shut down Prowl?
*Ratchet: It's not medially advisable, but lacking anesthetic and based off the hand twitching over his blaster, I suggest rendering him unconscious manually.

sections.heading: Corruption
sections.text:
Part 1
*Jazz: Did you see Prowl's face back there? Gears are grinding in my gut when I think about him goin all Zombie-Bot on us.
*Arcee: We'll check in on him once we've eliminated whatever is causing this.
*Ratchet: My friends...I am...sorry.
*Arcee: What is it Ratchet?
*Ratchet: I've been trying to fight it off. But I can feel the same corruption that took Prowl burning through every firewall to the core of my circuits. A last word of advice...
*Jazz: Any help you need we've got your back!
*Ratchet: Not help for me...a task for you...
*Arcee: What should we do?
*Ratchet: SEND ... MORE ... PARAMEDICS!
Part 2
*Jazz: We've got no map, no medic, and no chance in the Pit of getting where we're going. Time to call in reinforcements?
*Arcee: I can't seem to get a signal back to base. Besides, with whatever is changing us still active I wouldn't want to throw more of our friends at it.
*Jazz: Yeah, that's not a party I want to attend! Well, long-shots are your specialty, you got a plan?
*Arcee: We've journeyed too far to turn back. We keep going until we locate whatever corruption is out there...and hopefully Optimus and Ultra Magnus.
Part 3
*Shockwave: Autobots, perfection. I required sacrifices.
*Jazz: The perfection part I understand, I don't even got a ding on my panels. but what part of your cracked cycloptic cranium is talking about sacrifice?
*Shockwave: The force which lays beyond is emanating an ancient energy. Utilizing archaic displays of worship is the logical choice to gain its praise.
*Arcee: You're so ready to follow any evil that comes along? I thought you were made of stronger steel than that.
*Shockwave: Incorrect. I wish not to serve. I have checked odds for survival and this is an ideal start. Your appearances presents an opportunity for a calculated advantage.
*Jazz: So we throw down gladiator style? Make sure the mystery evil is entertained?
*Shockwave: Negative. Something more primitive is required. Solution: present your disconnected heads as a sign of fealty.
*Jazz: You want to play medieval? Come pay the iron price!

sections.heading: Chapter 3 - The Tomb of the Relics
Deception
sections.text:
Part 1
*Jazz: Arcee, that new beat Prowl and Ratchet were sining to...it's not good...but it's catchy.
*Arcee: That may mean we're getting close to the source. Just try and hold on.
*Jazz:MAYBE I"M FED UP WITH HOLDING ON. WHAT IF I WANT TO PLAY FROM A LOWER KEY?
*Arcee: You're better than this, push through! We're close to Optimus I can feel it.
*Jazz:THERE'S A VOICE SCREAMING IN MY HEAD! I'M JUST TRYING TO BRING IT SOME HARMONY!
*Arcee: Voice? Jazz, you just need to get away from this. Point back to base and floor it.
*Jazz:IT IS TELLING ME TO HANG YOUR BROKEN OPTICS FROM MY REAR VIEW MIRROR!
*Arcee: I'm so very sorry old friend. I hope you survive the attempt.
Part 2
*Arcee: There's got to be something out here. I can't have traveled all this way for nothing.
*Optimus Prime: Arcee...Is that you?
*Arcee: OPTIMUS! You're wounded! We need to get out of here.
*Optimus Prime: We cannot leave. I have sustained heavy damage but there is still work to be done.
*Arcee: We can't! Something has been taking control of our friends!
*Optimus Prime: It is the work of Megatronus. Ultra Magnus and I attempted to contain him, but his wave of corruption has been sweeping the area. You need to seal him in.
*Arcee: What can we do Optimus? What if I lose control? Or you? I just can't...
*Optimus Prime: You are an exemplary soldier, Arcee. I believe in you. We were creating a seal using so of the relics within Megatronus' lair. But something is preventing it from closing.
*Arcee: Alright Optimus, wait here. One way or another, the Commander and I are going to end this.
Part 3:
*Starscream:BEHOLD THE HERALD OF MEGATRONUS!
*Arcee: Starscream, is there no limit to your treachery?
*Starscream:YOUR PETTY JEALOUS WORDS MEAN NOTHING!
*Arcee: But what is there to be jealous of? You're a puppet! You should have refused Megatronus!
*Starscream:GALVATRON ATTEMPTED TO REFUSE! FOOL!
*I AM NOW THE EMISSARY OF DECEPTION! NONE ARE MORE DECEPTION THAN I!
*Arcee: You are truly deceived, Starscream. If you think this is a fight you are going to win.

sections.heading: Place of Shadows
sections.text:
*Note that this map is unique as it only has one path and two versions of Megatronus. 

Part 1
*Arcee: This is definitely the right place. I can feel the pulses of corruptive energy all around me. But why is it not affecting me like the others?
*Megatronus: Perhaps you are not like them. Perhaps you were destined for more.
*Arcee: Know that I am not here to bargain with you Megatronus. I'm here to to stop you.
*Megatronus: But you do not even know what you are stopping. You merely follow orders. Why not take them from a being more powerful than you have ever encountered?
*Arcee: I don't follow power. I follow my morals, and I upload the freedoms which are a right of all sentient beings.
*Megatronus: Hollow words, echoed from 13. I tire of this. I am from the place of shadows, you and your vermin Commander shall soon understand what awaits you in my darkness.
Part 2
*Megatronus: Child of Solus Prime, Do you know that it was by the destruction of your ancestor that I first fell? Now as I slay you I shall rise again!
*Arcee: I know that I am not a pawn in your melodrama! But, if you're looking for closure I can provide it, by shutting a horror like you down.
*Megatronus: You know not of horrors. Horror is an endless life spent serving those weaker than you. Watching worlds rot and not lifting a digit to truly save them. I have had my fill of horror.
*Arcee: For all your talk what have you done? Slain those you love and spent an eternity exiled?
*Megatronus: I have planned. I have waited, I have gathered relics and soon all shall feel the will of Megatronus.
*Arcee: No, you have prepared a tomb for yourself...and I intend to bury you in it.
Part 3
*Megatronus: Blast and damnation! Why prolong the inevitable? I was one of the first online and I will still function long after you turn to rust.
*Arcee: Being older doesn't make you any better. I've stood at the side of Primes before, eventually all it takes is one good shot.
*Megatronus: Can you even comprehend how many have fallen while trying to oppose me? Know that even if you think you can defeat me, you will never be rid of me.
*Arcee: We will never cease pushing back against you. Stop or be stopped, it's all going to end the same.
*Commander, let's finish this and seal him in.
Conclusion
*Arcee: THE SEAL IS CLOSING!
*Megatronus: NO! THE DARKNESS! YOU CANNOT HOPE TO CONTAIN ... THE ... DARKNESS!
*Arcee: As long as one Autobot Spark still burns, we can always shine a light on your darkness.
*Optimus Prime: Thank you for all you have done. Communications are back online and your team is getting the help they need.
*The Tomb of the Relics is now sealed...we just have to hope that will be enough.

Grimlock Saves the Day.lead: Grimlock Saves the Day is a Spotlight Mission (promoted as a Chrono-Vector) featuring Grimlock, Wheeljack and Optimus Prime that runs from June 6 to the 20th.

sections.heading: Forum Description
Part 1
sections.text:
*Wheeljack: Hey Optimus? There's a slightly... massive problem we need to address.
*Optimus Prime: What is the quandry, Wheeljack?
*Wheeljack: Well it's not great, so I'm going to attempt to power through it in one sentence...
*Grimlock took a Chrono-Vector device I was working on and used an Energon burst to time-travel so he can alter the outcome of the [https://tfwiki.net/wiki/Great_War_(G1) Cybertronian War].
*Optimus Prime: That could cause our timeline to unravel, could it not?
*Wheeljack: Haven't really tested that far ahead. I'm assuming it'd result in something ranging from unnoticed to fully apocalyptic.
*Optimus Prime: Sounds like we're going to have to follow him.

sections.heading: Part 2
sections.text:
*Wheeljack: So it's probably best if no one remembers doubles of us appearing in the war.
*Optimus Prime: Agreed. If we only had a way to erase our errant appearance from their memories.
*Wheeljack: Yep. Memory-Jammer! I crafted one ages ago and brought it with us.
*Optimus Prime: That appears to be a rather large and elaborate magnet. Does it work?
*Wheeljack: Don't you remember? Then it definitely works.
*Optimus Prime: ...
*We should get moving.

sections.heading: Part 3
sections.text:
*Wheeljack: Powering up spare Chrono-Vector device. I got a lock on Grimlock's location. Prep for jump and strap down your loose parts.
*Hound: I don't think you should be doin' that fellas. Way I figure it, Grimlock has a point.
*Optimus Prime: He told you about his plan? We move forward Hound, we can not risk changes to our past.
*Hound: You ain't got a right to say that Prime. Maybe it changes for the better! You think of that?
*Optimus Prime: I think of nothing but what is best for us all, and unforeseeable ripples in time serve nothing but chaos.
*Hound: All I have to do is stop you from making that jump and we can all see those ripples come in together.
*Optimus Prime: What happens next, happens to ensure the timeline. I assure you this is not personal.

sections.heading: Part 1
sections.text:
*Optimus Prime: The transfer here was deeply unsettling.
*Wheeljack: Count your digits and limbs. I'm almost certain all of us made it across the jump.
*Optimus Prime: Is this fully untested technology Wheeljack?
*Wheeljack: Of course not, I watched Grimlock do it and recorded notes as it happened. That's at least one test.
*Optimus Prime: Cybertron... It is good to be back, even under such dire circumstances.
*Wheeljack: I'm trying not to think about it too much. We have work to do.
*Optimus Prime: Agreed. We have a grave task ahead of us.

sections.heading: Part 2
sections.text:
*Ultra Magnus: Optimus! Why are you attacking Autobot troops?!
*Optimus Prime: It is too complicated to explain Ultra Magnus. It is a matter of utmost importance that we are not taking lightly.
*Wheeljack: We're preventing an errant time-loop collapse. It mostly makes sense from our end.
*Ultra Magnus: There's something faulty in both your circuits. I'll not sacrifice the safety of my friends to your ramblings.
*Optimus Prime: I'm no stranger to sacrifice. I burst with pride to see you stand up to adversity, but I must complete our mission.
*Ultra Magnus: It pains me to say this Prime but... stop now or be shut down.
*Wheeljack: Don't worry, you'll never recall this moral struggle. Commander, let's get moving.

sections.heading: Part 3
sections.text:
*Grimlock: {{RedText|ME GRIMLOCK SAVE DAY! WHY YOU FOLLOW HERE?!}}
*Optimus Prime: Grimlock, I understand your noble intent. Truly. But this is too large a change to the past.
*Wheeljack: You make too big a splash old friend. It could destroy things. You get that right?
*Grimlock: You want... Grimlock to lose?
*Optimus Prime: A win here could mean larger loses [sic; "losses"] elsewhere. What if it means we never go to Earth and leave it exposed to attack?
*Grimlock: {{RedText|ME GRIMLOCK NEVER EXPOSED! ME BEST THERE IS! ME KING!}}
*Wheeljack: We tried to talk this out bud, but you may not remember that later.

sections.heading: Synergy Bonuses

* Leadership (5-Star) - All lower tier teammates gain +10% Attack Rating.

sections.heading: Player
sections.text:
Grimlock has one of the highest health ratings of any Bot, with melee buffs and instant purification (if Awakened), and a pretty powerful Burn. but otherwise a pretty simple tank with few needs for buffs.

Grimlock can gain Melee Buffs from his Dino Rage, being hit, and Special Attacks, so constantly use heavy attacks to renew and stack up the buffs. He is one of the few Bots who only need one level on his Signature to be effective.

Grimlock is the best bot in Raids. Bots with harm accelerators will give Grimlock a free melee buff at the start of the fight. He also makes a big joke out of Utility Modules that inflict damaging debuffs (such as Unstable Energon).

sections.heading: General
sections.text:
Avoid inflicting Damaging Debuffs. Bleed or Shocks will be unable to deal out their maximum damage and Grimlock has no weakness against any attacks. However, instant damage debuffs can bypass his Dino-Rage ability. Backfires inflicted by Barricade, Jazz and of course Scorponok will ignore the signature ability. Megatronus and Galvatron can inflict instant heat damage which will ignore his signature ability too.

Grimlock is immune to damage in Dino mode, which is during Heavies and Special Attacks. As such the technique of a Heavy Attack after the opponent finishes a special is ineffective unless it's launched late enough.

Also keep your dodging skills in check! An Al Grimlock loves to dash at opponents like Motomaster and will not stop attacking with his melee attacks no matter how many times you dodge his melees. He really needs to learn how to stop trying to hit opponents while they are dodging continuously. 

Bots that rely on inflicting damaging debuffs and has a low health rating will not fit well with the dino-rage signature ability. Those like Bonecrusher, Shockwave, Ironhide, Megatron (ROTF), Optimus Prime (M1), Ultra Magnus, Bumblebee (DOTM), Sideswipe and others will struggle with defeating Grimlock. Optimus Prime is also a weak choice because his signature ability will only fuel Grimlock’s rage despite the class type advantages.

sections.heading: Rulers of Kaon
sections.text: Grimlock might be the easiest fight in the entire mission. He remains unbuffed and serves as the intermission.

sections.heading: Bots
sections.text:
*Everyone who have low health, inflict damaging Debuffs and isn’t a Tactician - These bots stand no chance against the King.
*Megatron (ROTF) - Megatron will find this bot formidable enough to be his worst nightmare.
*Think Optimus Prime has the type advantage against the King? Think again. Bleeds will only fuel the Dinobot's rage.
* Bonecrusher - Grimlock will quickly Purify Bleed abilities, putting ‘the master of bleeds’ at a serious disadvantage.
* Shockwave - The decepticon scientist will find this fight to be most illogical fight.
* Arcee - Constant Head Shots will fuel Grimlock's rage and considering that she has low health, Grimlock would crush her before she knows it.
* Drift - The samurai's deadly bleeds will be quickly patched up and be turned against him. Sometimes there is a fighting style with angry rage.
*Optimus Prime (MV1) - Grimlock will easily turn Prime’s strengths against him.
* Wheeljack - Burns will breach the Force Shield and Shocks and (if he's on a Harm Accelerator) Bleeds will be easily Purified. Remember, the scientist made Grimlock, and sometimes, there is a time for revolution.
* Ironhide(ROTF) - The master of burn’s powerful Burns will be Purified and He wouldn't be able to tear him apart so easily because of the high health rating the king has.
*Himself - Grimlock can purify his own burns and get immune to his own attacks in dinobot mode.

sections.heading: Mods
sections.text:
*Every Mod - There is no mod that Grimlock cannot overpower.
* Harm Accelerator - Grimlock's main strength is the purification of Damaging Debuffs like Bleeds, this is best demonstrated on a Harm Accelerator.
* Certain utility modules inflict damaging debuffs, Grimlock loves using damaging debuffs to his favor.
* Unstable Energon - Grimlock doesn't have to successfully hit bots with Heavy Attacks and Unstable Energon will not be deactivated immediately.

sections.heading: Weak Match-ups
sections.text:
Bots

* Ultra Magnus and Starscream can pacify the king Dino by Nullifying Grimlock’s Melee Buffs with their ranged attacks though Grimlock can purify the burns and turn them to melee buffs but they can be nullified in return.
* Similarly, Cyclonus if he stay in melee range, can Nullify these buffs and Cyclonus has no damaging debuffs to purify and the damage won’t so devastating compared to having melee buffs.
*Motormaster and Grimlock are 2 kings who love to dash at their opponents but Motormaster will always win when it comes to dash to dash collision and Motomaster inflicts debuffs that ignores the signature ability.
*Hot Rod’s decelerations will outright ignore the signature ability leaving the King unable to purify one of Hot Rod’s most powerful tools despite the class type advantages.
*Nemesis Prime is a surprise counter to the King. Though Grimlock can counter the autobot leader, his evil clone can counter the king by copying the melee buffs Grimlock gains and nullifying them with his heavy attacks.
*If Ramjet has his Enforcers Synergy, Grimlock will not be able to purify the burn debuffs. Same can be said with Motormaster’s and Kickback’s. 
*Ironhide’s ability to melee reflect would only put a damper on Grimlock’s plans especially if he has the melee buffs on him. In the former case, Grimlock will only crush himself with his own melees 
*Megatron can steal Grimlock’s melee buffs and use it against him and the only debuff that grimlock can purify is the shock debuff from his special lll which Megatron can take advantage off and steal from. The only way Grimlock will crush him is when Megatron is not awakened yet. Otherwise he will be crushed by his own melee buffs.
* Galvatron and Megatronus' ability to deal instant heat damage will outright ignore his signature ability and Megatronus’s relics of obedience, Preservation and Immortality can prevent him from dealing devastating damage.
* Barricade, Jazz and Scorponok can stack Backfires which ignores the signature ability. Sometimes, a king can fall but remember to dodge the hits or be smashed.
*Grimlock can purify his own burns and get immune to his own attacks in dinobot mode.
*S-1000 Sharkticon can replicate the melee buffs.

sections.heading: Mods
sections.text: * No Mods - No mod stands as a serious challenger to the might and Dino rage of Grimlock

sections.heading: Recommended Modules
sections.text:
Me Grimlock protect base with these Mods!
* Repair Module - Grimlock’s high health will pair well with this mod, allowing him to repair more health than other bots could hope to dish out.
* Exo-Filter - this mod will enable Grimlock to remain the king of the fight and the fact that he loves to dash into his opponents meaning most raiders will have a field day with this.
* Superconductor 2000 - It is hard to avoid the high Melee damage done by this Special, this Module will make that even harder.
* Transwarp Cell - The longer the Melee buffs, the more pounding the king can do.
* Paralyzer - The king can’t control when he wants to stop attacking when his opponents try to dodge his attacks continuously. Paring this module on him will make him stun the opponent and leave them vulnerable to the king’s melee attacks and their power will be drained too and this is when the raiders will quickly find themselves in the scrap pile.

sections.heading: Player
sections.text: Grindor is a basic Brawler bot who will deal more damage the more Power the enemy has (and amplified if awakened). Due to his high health and Special Attack denial, he can be used in very long fights. He can't gain Melee buffs, though he makes for it gaining attack bonuses against anyone with high Power. Keep in mind Power Locking is not the same as Power draining, so if an AI bot has max Power and doesn't use any Specials until the locks expire, their Power will still be there and then you're screwed.

sections.heading: General
sections.text:
Grindor's tough armor, health along with Critical Rate Debuffs makes it hard to take down high-leveled Grindors. Careful evading and endurance should help in defeating him though. Grindor uses his Melee Special 1 often, so dash back from his predictable Special Attacks, then quickly counterattack. If his Sig is awakened and you have a lot of power, make sure to dodge his attacks! They deal a lot of damage, especially through Special II, and Special Attack Denial also is another reason to dodge these things.

He is a very tanky bot health-wise. Instant energy attacks, damage over time and powerful Armor Breakers (even more so when the Armor Break can be permanent) will be your friend, as Grindor has no answer to these. 

Even more so when he is on a Security Module, or an Utility Module which grants him more Armor, like the one in Rulers of Kaon, in which he becomes absolutely impervious.

sections.heading: Rulers of Kaon
sections.text: As stated above, unless you have an anti-armor bot or abilities that bypass defensive buffs like Dark Burns, Grindor becomes near-invincible and cannot be hurt regularly. However, if you have abilities that can get around that, Grindor turns out to be one of the easier fights in Rulers of Kaon. Just prepare for a long fight as Grindor's massive health pool will take a long time to drain.

sections.heading: Bots
sections.text:
* Anyone with power rate buffs will feel the force of Grindor’s perforation damage and before they will know it and they will have their specials disabled.
*Bots with strong specials like Mixmaster will have no chance at all from using the specials 2 and 3.
*Hot Rod generates a lot more Power because of his signature ability. Grindor gets stronger the more Power the opponent gets, enabling him to deal a lot of damage.
* Arcee will be prone to Grindor's Perforation and Crit Rate Debuffs.
* Kickback’s dinner relies on Critical Hits, and Grindor serves Crit Rate Debuffs.

sections.heading: Mods
sections.text: *Robot Resource - Defenders gaining a lot of Power through this Module will feel the full force of Grindor's Peforation Damage and he can disable the opponent to use even the special 3 when having full power.

sections.heading: Bots
sections.text:
* Anyone who Armor Breaks and Armor Pierces will put Grindor to sleep easily.
* Unlike most Brawler bots he had no cleanse so he will be susceptible to damaging debuffs like bleed, shock or acid will bypass his amor
* Galvatron, Megatronus and Megatron (ROTF) deal pretty strong energy damage, which will ignore Grindor's tough armor.
** Megatronus in particular also has an Armor Break and gains power very slowly, and Grindor won't be able to make full usage of Peforate. Though he can disable Megatronus' Special Attacks.
* Dinobot’s particular skillset make him adept at cutting through the armor of this thick-skinned helicopter.
* Megatron will ensure Grindor never toughens up.
* Grimlock’s burn debuffs and devastating specials will ignore Grindor’s tough armor.

sections.heading: Recommended Modules
sections.text:
Turn Grindor into a flying tank with these Modules!
* The Security Module will ensure Grindor always toughens up.
* The Repair Module will keep Grindor in battle for longer periods.

sections.heading: Defense
sections.text:
A preferred pairing used by many Commanders is with defenders with high health, notably Grindors and Motormasters. If the Mod's signature ability is unlocked, using it with Bots that deal damage debuffs often is recommended. 

Another strategy is to give players an ultimatum. For example, pairing a Tech class with a Harm Accelerator brings players to choose between type advantages or potentially losing a bot early on. A good example is a duplicated Wheeljack with his near impenetrable force shields.

* Bonecrusher
* Bludgeon
* Drift
* Rhinox
* Windblade
* Pretty much everyone who can Bleed

sections.heading: Raids
sections.text:
A basic rule of thumb to follow if you're facing a Bot on one of these: NEVER GET TAGGED BY A SPECIAL ATTACK. More stacks of Bleed won't and will not be pleasant.

* Optimus Primal - With Optimus Primal and two other Beast Wars bots, the Beast Purification Synergy will let bots other than Brawlers purify the Bleed with heavy attacks
* Grimlock - with his Purify signature ability. He'll quickly neutralize the Bleed debuff that would normally eat away significant amounts of health. More melee buffs to crush your enemies!
* Optimus Prime (MV1) - Willpower will recover some of his health bleeding out while attacking.
* Thundercracker can purify normal Bleeds and Harm Accelerators using Heavy Attacks.
* Tantrum - No holding back. It's best to keep charging into the opponent to build frenzies and melee buffs. No more bleeding the bull.
