sections.heading: The Art of Fighting
sections.text:
Part 1
* Marissa Faireborn: Teletraan's readings are going haywire. I fear the unthinkable has happened.
* Optimus Prime: Unthinkable?
* Marissa Faireborn: Megatron has arrived. Our Megatron!
* Optimus Prime: Not unthinkable. In this reality, inevitable.
* Marissa Faireborn: Commander, you know the mission...
* Optimus Prime: Hunt Megatron down, before he can amass the power he will so desperately seek.
Part 2
* Bludgeon: So, it is true. The rumours have proved correct.
* Megatron: The rumour that I have been sucked into this world of chaos? That is correct.
* Bludgeon: The loyal among us have long awaited your arrival.
* Megatron: And, how do you express your loyalty? By hiding in the wastelands and avoiding confrontation.
* Bludgeon: I am not hiding. I have been saving and focusing myself for this occasion by practicing the art.
* Megatron: The art? The art of cowardice?
* Bludgeon: No, my master. The art of fighting without fighting. When the time comes, I will be fully energized to destroy the Commander and any who stand in our way!
Part 3
*Megatron: Bludgeon, the time to test your faith in the "art" is at hand. The Commander approaches.
*Bludgeon: My faith will be proven fruitful when I decimate our foe. But, before I do, be warned, Lord Megatron.
*Megatron: Warned of what?
*Bludgeon: There will be Decepticons that claim fealty now that you've returned, but their sparks are not with you.
*Megatron: Let me guess... Starscream?
*Bludgeon: No, less obvious, and more problematic. Shockwave.
*Megatron: SHOCKWAVE?! Never. You test my patience and credulity. It is time to prove your loyalty. End the Commander... NOW!

sections.heading: Another Arrival
sections.text:
Part 1
* Bumblebee: Optimus, Optimus... We've got to get a squad together and go find Megatron!
* Optimus Prime: Your enthusiasm is admirable as always, old friend, but relax. Like Megatron, you just got here.
* Bumblebee: I know, I know, but we have to stop him!
* Optimus Prime: The Commander is aware of the situation and emarking on a mission now. Let us accompany The Commander and utilize your scouting prowess to apprehend Megatron.
Part 2
* Bumblebee: Wow, Optimus... There are so many familiar faces here on New Quintessa.
* Optimus Prime: I take it your scouting proved fruitful?
* Bumblebee: If fruitful means successful, then yes. I saw your Decepticon twin up ahead.
* Optimus Prime: Motormaster! Excellent, I know just how to get under his hood and rattle his carburetor. If we play this right, he should lead us to Megatron.
Part 3
* Motormaster: Look who it is, Optimus Slime, Gold Bug, a squishy human vermin and their band of Cybertronian rejects.
* Optimus Prime: Slights and insults are all you posses. Step aside, Decepticon, we are looking for someone of real consequence.
* Motormaster: Ah, so you heard Megatron has arrived in the Wastelands.
* Optimus Prime: I did not say that, but thank you for the confirmation. Now we know where to look. Strong you may be, smart you are not.
* Motormaster: Argh! It doesn't matter what you know, because I will end you.. ONCE AND FOR ALL!

sections.heading: A Question of Functionality
sections.text:
Part 1
*Bumblebee: Holy spark plugs, Optimus! This place really is full of chaos and danger.
*Optimus Prime:That is true. We are thankful to have you here. Despite the peril, it is good to have trusted allies by our side.
*Bumblebee: You know I would do anything for you and the Autobots.
*Optimus Prime: And... Our human allies.
*Bumblebee: That goes without saying. Now, let's go find us a Megatron!
Part 2
*Megatron: Guess who's here, my spineless underling.
*Starscream: Is it, can it... Be you!? How do you still function?!
*Megatron: You seem surprised. Why would that be?
*Starscream: B-but I saw you....
*Megatron: Cease to function? I think not. Others have told me of the timeline where you sought to lesson your load by sending me into the void of space.
*Starscream: Lord Megatron... Y-you know I would never do su-such a thing.
*Megatron: Save the groveling or you'll become the one that ceases to function.
*Starscream: Of course, of course, Lord Megatron. I function to serve you.
*Megatron: Rest assured, I shall see if that statement is true.
Part 3
*Megatron: Greetings, Optimus. And I assume you are the one they call the Commander.
*Optimus Prime: Spare us the niceties. Your presence on New Quintessa is not welcome.
*Megatron: And it was not sought by me. But, here I am. Shall we dispense with small talk and get to business?
*Optimus Prime: I fear there is no other way. Commander, introduce Megatron to the "Welcoming Committee."
Part 4

(This part, by error in Hard difficulty, is exactly the same as Part 3.)
*Megatron: Starscream, the time has come to serve your function.
*Starscream: Why should I? You failed to defeat the Commander. Perhaps your powers are not what they once were.
*Megatron: How dare you question my abilities! That was just a warm up! I was shaking off the oxidation.
*Starscream: But, the Commander is...
*Megatron: More forgiving than I. Do battle in my name, or cease to function. You have no other choices.

sections.heading: Be Prepared, Be Very Prepared
sections.text:
Part 1
* Optimus Prime: The time has come to fortify our forces. The threat from multiple Megatrons and Galvatrons is too great.
* Bumblebee: Multiple Megatrons!? What are you talking about?
* Optimus Prime: Yes my trusty scout, there are multiple Megatrons here. Just as there are multiple Bumblebees.
* Bumblebee: Huh? I'm one of a kind!
* Optimus Prime: Indeed you are. But, in this land of converging realities, we all exist in multiples. "Our" Megatron is the latest to arrive, but I fear there may be more.
* Bumblebee: What should we do, Optimus?
* Optimus Prime: Like any good scout, be prepared. Taht is why I am giving you a special assignment. The Commander and I will track down Megatron, you put together a training regimen that will ensure we are always prepared.
Part 2
* Soundwave: All hail Lord Megatron!
* Megatron: Ah, Soundwave, my trustworthy lieutenant. How does this strange planet treat you?
* Soundwave: It treats me like all others. Without mercy and full of treachery.
* Megatron: My arrival may change that.
* Soundwave: This is what I and all true Decepticons have been waiting for. The return of true Decepticon power.
Part 3
* Soundwave: Lord Megatron, The Commander has arrived. It will be with great satisfaction that I end the Commander's existence.
* Megatron: Starscream professed similar sentiments only to fail me.
* Soundwave: That is becasue he is inferior. I am superior. To have Lord Megatron here and to serve the true Decepticon cause is all Soundwave desires.
* Megatron: Do not fail me.
* Soundwave: Failure does not compute.

sections.heading: Serve Your Masters
sections.text:
Part 1
* Optimus Prime: Commander, the circumstances surrounding Megatron's arrival grow ever more dire.
* Marissa: Optimus is right. Megatron is recruiting a team of his most loyal followers...
* Optimus Prime: The worst of the Decepticons. Shockwave, Soundwave...
* Marissa: Back together with Megatron? And with all the scheming Shockwave has been up to? That's a recipe for disaster.
* Optimus Prime: Which is why we must stop them before the power of their reunification can be fulfilled.
Part 2
* Megatron: I have been here barely enough to lube my bearings, and already I hear rumors of machinations being carried out behind my back.
* Shockwave: Interesting choice of words... "Machinations."
* Megatron: You know Megatron has the best words.
* Shockwave: And, the most loyal of lieutenants.
* Megatron: Soundwave has proven himself loyal, although somewhat inferior to the Commander's forces. Soon it will be your turn to prove your loyalty.
Part 3
* Optimus Prime: Shockwave, if you are here, I would assume it is to serve your master, Megatron.
* Shockwave: I serve two masters - Logic and Megatron.
* Optimus Prime: Are not those two things mutually exclusive?
* Shockwave: They are not. Logic dictates that I align with the most powerful in order to further my research. Megatron is the most powerful. You compute the math.
* Optimus Prime: The Commander shall prove your math to be quite illogical. Commander, show Shockwave the error in his calculations.

sections.heading: The One and Only
sections.text:
Part 1
* Optimus Prime: Teletraan's latest intel report reveals two Megatrons roaming the Wastelands.
* Marissa: Things just went from bad to the worst. What if they join forces?!
* Optimus Prime: Their egos would never allow them to join forces. My concern is the devastation and planet-wide carnage that would result from their engaging in all out battle.
Part 2
* Megatron (ROTF): The weak and the righteous travel the wasteland. In search of what I wonder? Perhaps they seek the pretender to my power.
* Optimus Prime: You are not the Megatron we seek.
* Megatron: But I am the Megatron you found. Prepare to die.
Part 3
* Optimus Prime: Two Megatrons in one mission. Commander, I suggest that today is our luck(y) day.
* Megatron: Another Megatron?! Impossible! There can be but one. Any others are imposters and frauds.
* Optimus Prime: Not in the reality of New Quintessa. You are merely one of many.
* Megatron: I am the one and only. I am MEGATRON!
Conclusion
* Megatron: You know this is not over.
* Optimus Prime: It never is.
* Megatron: Next time it will be different.
* Optimus Prime: It rarely is.
* Megatron: You'll be regretting your confidence when you see what Shockwave has in store for our rematch.
* Optimus Prime: As always, we will be waiting... And up for any challenge. It is the way of the Autobots and our human allies. It is the right way.

sections.heading: Synergy Bonuses
sections.text:
* Allies - Soundwave, Bludgeon, Cyclonus - 2~3~8% Armor.
* Enemies - Prowl, Grimlock, Jetfire - 2~3~8% Attack Rating.
* Enforcers - Motormaster, Ramjet - Debuffs last 20~25~40% longer and cannot be Purified.
* Leadership (5-Star) - +10% Critical Rating.

sections.heading: Player
sections.text:
Kickback is an obvious counter to most Tech bots. Consuming power gains, shocks, power leak, power locks, and typically most buffs/debuffs Tech bots gain/inflict. Gaining power and inflicting power leaks will fuel your assault. Heavy attacks will give you the chance to inflict more critical hits.

Kickback is an especially good bot in raids. Bots that utilize the Robot Resource or bots that somehow have Tech Consoles, Super Conductors or Transwarp Cells will be easy prey for Kickback.

sections.heading: Opponent
sections.text: As long as you don't have power buffs/ debuffs and inflict shocks, nor transform (if you're T-Clogged), you'll do good against Kickback. It is also noted that Kickback will evade bots with heavy melee attacks so you cannot use heavy attacks on Kickback if you are using bots with heavy melee attacks unless you are a Warrior as the precision buffs will not allow Kickback from evading while using heavy attacks.

sections.heading: Strong Match-ups
sections.text:
*Anyone who spams heavy attacks will face the consequences of using a heavy attack while T-Clogged.
*Other bots like Techs that inflict Power or Shock debuffs will make them to think twice.
*Shockwave would find this matchup to be illogical as his Shock charges will be quickly consumed by this voracious Insecticon and his range attacks are physical so he won’t be able to gain shock charges. 
* Once Megatron (ROTF) has been infected with T-Clog his proclivity to fire off Heavy Attacks while enraged could leave him Stunned and vulnerable.
* Soundwave’s constant heavy attacks, buffs and debuffs mean he's a buffet for the Insecticon making him the perfect counter to Megatron’s most loyal decepticon.
* Ratchet too, in which he will not be able to activate self diagnostics while T-Clogged and even if he does in which Kickback can easily evade his heavy attack since ratchet’s heavy is a melee attack, it can still be consumed and the fact that Ratchet loves to spam heavies means that the autobot medic is at a serious disadvantage when facing this insecticon.
* Hot Rod is also suceptible to Kickback's diet. Hot Rod's acceleration buff and deceleration debuffs count as power buff/debuffs respectively. Buffs that the insecticon can consume despite the class type advantages. Though the deceleration will prevent him from evading though.
* Wheeljack will be Kickback's favorite food. Shocks and Power Leaks will only be consumed, and T-Clog will prevent him from Upgrading. However, be wary not to get stunned.
* Cheetor’s power rate buff can be consumed and if he thinks he can uses his heavies to ram or evade while the opponent tries to counterattack, the T-Clog sabotage will put a stop to that idea.
* Ramjet loves to recklessly ram his opponents which will lead his way to win but Kickback’s signature ability will teach the crazy rammer a lesson that spamming heavies will be a big mistake when he’s T-clogged.
* Megatronus will not be able to tap into his true power as the power leaks will delay relic switching.
* Windblade's Special 1 Stormfall Blast is both a Shock and a power debuff that will be turned into Kickback's diet.
*One of Motormaster's ram debuffs that Kickback can consume is the Power Rate debuff. Putting a T-Clog on the Road King will be also this Insecticon's advantage to ensure that he will never reduce Attack Rating or Armor Break.
*Necrotronus’s power rate debuff can be consumed by Kickback every time he has more power than Necrotronus despite the class type advantages

sections.heading: Mods
sections.text:
*Robot Resources are on the menu, Kickback can eat up the Power gain, leaving enemies without passive Power.
*Tech Consoles will be Kickback's appetizer. He can also eat Shocks inflicted on him.
*Transwarp Cells are also on the menu; Kickback will T-Clog Base Defenders more often, which means more Stuns.
* Utility Module: Stagger will make the enemy Bot use Heavy Attacks more often. T-Clogging them will Stun them more.

sections.heading: Weak Match-ups
sections.text:
*Hound's ability to inflict Critical Rate Down with his Special Attack 1 will leave Kickback unable to inflict Power Leak with his basic hits.
*Optimus Primal will completely negate Critical Hits, disabling much of Kickback's ability set that revolves around Critical Hits.
*Grindor's frequent Critical Rate Down debuffs will end with a squished Insecticon. 
*Mirage’s Power Burns are instant debuffs which will ignore Consumption despite the class advantage.
*Cheetor will not leak any Power even with the debuffs on him in spite of his disadvantage
*Grimlock will purify the bleeds and shocks that Kickback throws at him while having to be careful with T-Clog. War of insecticons and dinobots begin. Though the bleeds and shocks won't be purified if he has Enforcers Synergy.
*Prowl’s Signature ability doesn't generate Power buffs at all.
*Bonecrusher's power debuff is mainly a Bleeding type rather than Shock, which Kickback's Consumption has no answer to.

sections.heading: Recommended Modules
sections.text:
Increase Kickback's diet with these modules!
*Scout's Sentry / Nightbird's Mark – Increasing Kickback’s Critical Rate and ability to Evade will ultimately help him survive while dishing out those potent Critical Hits.
*Transwarp Cell – Ensuring Kickback routinely slams into his opponent with Heavy Attacks will allow him to take great advantage of his Consume and Signature abilities.
*Superconductor 1000 - A quick, ranged Special 1 is more likely to hit an attacking Commander's bot.

Masteries.lead:
Commander Masteries, introduced in Version 3.0, are a selection of offensive and defensive bonuses that apply to your entire roster of Bots. Commander Masteries provide you with permanent bonuses to all Bots; at all times, though some may be restricted or modified based on the game mode, Bot, or other situational criteria.

Masteries can be accessed through the base or the Commander profile. By the point a Commander reaches level 60, they will have 43 mastery points to allocate.

The bonuses provided by Commander Masteries can range from enhancing your damage output through various means, to providing you with a stronger defense by raising the armor rating of your Bots. Prefer utilizing ranged attacks? Build up your mastery of dodging and counterattacking. Are you an aggressive attacker? There are Commander Masteries that will enhance your damage output! Get hit often? There are Commander Masteries that will raise your armor!

There are plenty of different strategies you can utilize when building out your Commander Masteries, but they all have one thing in common… They’re here to bolster your team in a fight!

Commander Masteries are separated into two different categories: Offensive and Defensive; which bolster your damage output or your ability to negate or minimize damage respectively. Additionally, Commander Masteries may have multiple ranks for you to unlock, each of which will power up the benefits you receive from that Commander Mastery, or unlock additional benefits.

sections.heading: Utilizing Commander Masteries
sections.text:
. (Max 10)]]

Mastery Points are a unique resource that determine how many Commander Masteries and Ranks of Commander Masteries you can have active at any given time. You gain Mastery Points by raising your Commander Level, starting at Level 18. This means that at this time, the most points any Commander can have is 33. Commanders that are Level 18 and higher will retroactively be awarded Mastery Points based on their current level.

Next, you have to unlock the Commander Mastery that you would like to utilize. Most Commander Masteries will have a prerequisite that must be met before you are able to activate it. This could mean having unlocked the Commander Mastery that comes before it, having placed enough Mastery Points in the Offensive or Defensive category before being able to unlock its benefits, or having reached a high enough Commander Level.

Some Commander Masteries have a cost to unlock it. This comes in the form of Mastery Cores. Mastery Cores are rare items that can be purchased in the game, or won through different events or Missions. There will be some Commander Masteries that require different kinds of Mastery Cores to unlock, and will require additional Mastery Cores to unlock the next level.

Each Commander Mastery also has an activation cost after unlocking. For most of Commander Masteries, it will be a Gold cost, but some of the higher tier Commander Masteries will require small amounts of Energon to rank up. 

* Tier 1 (green) have no core unlocks

sections.heading: Resetting Commander Masteries Build
sections.text:
You can reset your Commander Mastery Build at any time! When you choose to reset your Masteries in a certain category, all Commander Masteries in that category are disabled, and your Mastery Points are returned to you for reinvestment! Any Commander Masteries you have unlocked will remain unlocked. There is no cost to reset your Commander Masteries, but there will be a cost to activate your Commander Masteries again.

Some Commander Masteries are more effective in certain modes of the game, while they may be less effective in others. The option to reset your choices allows you customize a build for whatever challenge that you choose to focus on!

sections.text: Space Bridges, Wormholes, and other Time-Space Anomalies have been thrown open all across New Quintessa. Some Bots have been finding their way here who may not have even noticed they crossed over. Such is the case with SKYWARP who finds himself once again on the Seeker Squad as they reintroduce themselves and begin their plots to take control of their destiny. Who will fall to these severe Seekers, and will they be ground up by their MEAN GEARS?

Medal.lead:
Medals are awarded to the Commander after successful Raids on other Commanders, and successfully defending your Base from incoming Raids. Medals have no commercial use; they are simply currencies used to rank a player towards the Raid leaderboard.

The Superconductor 2000 requires you to have 1000 Medals in order to purchase it with Raid Chips.

28~33 Medals are won or lost for each Raid or Base attack.

Meet Your Makers/Transcript.lead: Additional and modified dialogue for the Netflix relaunch is underlined.

sections.heading: 1. A Beast to Start
sections.text:
Part 1
*Marissa Faireborn: Teletraan's scanners have detected a valuable cache of resources.
*While we search for Megatron we should continue to upgrade our squad using what we find on our missions.
Part 2
*Optimus Prime: It seems every bot here has been programmed to do one thing... fight!
*Marissa: Preliminary readings from Teletraan corroborate your assessment.
* Teletraan confirms there are numerous beings of Cybertronian descent in the area, and all show traces of Dark Energon.
* Optimus Prime: Dark Energon?! The path to our survival grows more perilous indeed.
Part 3
* Rhinox: I don't know who you are, but I'd advise to slow your roll.
* Optimus Prime: Stranger, we mean you no harm. We are simply on a mission to gather resources to repair our ship.
* Rhinox: Oh yeah? Well, we got a problem, friend. Resources are scarce and everyone wants 'em.
* You want mine? You're gonna have to talk to my little friends.
* Optimus Prime: Friends?
* Rhinox: {{RedText|Yeah, I like to call them the Chainguns of Doom!}}

1. In With a Boom

2. A Slow Learner

Part 1:
*Marissa: Teletraan has plotted two possible courses for the next cache of resources. One path appears to contain formidable combatants likely protecting items of value.
*Starscream: Or you can take the other "easier" path. Demise at my hands await you either way you choose.
*Optimus Prime: Starscream! Don't you ever learn?
*Starscream: Oh, I've learned lots Autofool! I've learned that the power of Ore-13 has enabled me to do what Megatron has failed to do time and again...crush you.
** ...what Megatron has failed to do... RULE OVER YOU!
**As your GLORIOUS King I shall, perhaps, allow you to continue destroying all those in your path.
*Optimus Prime: We do not seek to destroy, Starscream.
*We are simply knocking some sense into those whose circuitry has been corrupted and controlled.
*Starscream: Well then I have no room in my story for your pathetic existence, prepare yourself for my reckoning!

Part 2:

*Ratchet: Commander, We've found repair kits on this planet that could help our cause. I added one to your inventory prior to the mission. If needed, I suggest using it before your next battle.
*Starscream: Yes, "Commander", listen to your antiquated medical officer if you like, but it won't matter. When I'm done with you, Ratchet's famed sick bay will be your FINAL destination! There is no relief from the pain I have planned!

3. Me Have Mod

Part 1:

Marissa: Commander, Prowl just got back from surveying the terrain ahead. There's a brewing dust storm of Beta 4 proportions ahead. Through the dust he thought he saw what appeared to be a dinobot.

Grimlock: Me no Dinobot. Me Grimlock! King Dinobot!!!

Prowl: Uh-oh, things just took a turn for the dimwitted.

Grimlock: Dumbwhatted? What you mean?! Me smash you...when me ready!

Part 2: 

Prowl: I have more intel on Grimlock. He's up ahead, and from what I can gather, he is preparing some sort of object to strengthen his defenses.

Grimlock: BAAAAAAH!!! Prowl talk too much! But, him right. Me have secret for fight. Me big smart!

Prowl: Commander, you take care of the task at hand. I'll investigate his "secret" and report back.

Part 3: 

Prowl: I've got some bad news. King Dimlock has somehow rigged a device that modifies his powers.

Grimlock: That's right! Me told you me no bozo! Me have mod. You a fleshie with weak bots! BAH! You lose!

Prowl: Commander, you distract him in battle. I'll see what I can do about getting this "Mod" tech back to the base for analysis. It could be of use someday.

4. Good Cop Bad Cop

Part 1: 

Optimus Prime: The urgency of our mission grows great. Teletraan's analysis of our hostile encounters suggest my worst fears my be true.

Dark Energon and advanced alien technology are likely behind this madness that has befallen us.

Barricade: Halt! Are you LadiesMan217?

I said, are you LADIESMAN217?!

Optimus Prime: As I said, madness surrounds us. Commander, roll out!

Part 2:

Prowl: We were able to get a read out on that bot you met back there...the Ladiesman217 Decepticon with more than one screw loose.

Teletraan says he's from a parallel reality. And get this, his alt form is a cop car.

Barricade: That's POLICE CAR! I don't know who you are, but I detect Autobot. Let me duly notify you that my job is to make Autobots cease to function...permanently. Proceed if you dare.

Part 3:

Prowl: We're here, It's good cop vs bad cop time.

Barricade: Let me assure you, step a foot forward and it will be bad cop vs dead cop time. And, there's only one bad cop here.

5. The Way Of The Blade

Part 1: 

Windblade: This path is not yours to take.

Optimus Prime: Windblade! We have fought many battles as allies...as friends. What possesses you?

Windblade: It is true I recognize you, Prime. But, here is this insufferable planet, I am compelled to serve a new master - a master that has taught me the ways of...Metallikato!

Bludgeon: Fools! Enough with the discourse. Windblade, show them the way of the blade!

Part 2:

Optimus Prime: Strangers, friends, foes... they all act deranged.

Windblade, Grimlock, Bumblebee...it would take an innate knowledge of Cybertronian physiology and mechanics to turn these sparks so dark.

Marissa: Teletraan occurs. The research points towards a technology that is Cybertronian in origin.

Part 3: 

Windblade: Step no further, The first fight was a warning. This will be an ending.

Bludgeon: Windblade! Stand down. You are but a student. Let a master teach them the power of the One True Path.

Optimus Prime: Decepticon, I respect your dedication to your art. But it is one of darkness. Commander, go forth and show him the light, so that we may find the answers we seek.

6. Hail Who?

Marissa: We ran diagnostics on the "Mod" Grimlock was using. Teletraan has confirmed what you suspected...The Quintessons are behind it's creation.

Mods exist to enhance certain properties of the bot it is connected to.

Optimus Prime: As I surmised, our creators - The Quintessons. They would have the capability and desire to inflict a planet such as this upon it's inhabitants.

Marissa: If what you say is true, repairing our ship may be the least of our worries.

Part 2:

Optimus Prime: Commander, your squad fights bravely. This mission's end is within reach.

Megatron (ROTF): Broadcast your platitudes and encouragement, misplaced though they are. Regardless of where you're from. I can smell the human stench and Autobot righteousness.

Optimus Prime: Your appearance is not from our reality...but that voice is unmistakable...MEGATRON!

Megatron(ROTF): Yes, and it appears the Quintessons have delivered yet another victim for me to destroy. In due time, Prime, in due time.

Part 3: 

Megatron(ROTF): So, you made it this far? Surprising, given the inherit weakness of your human commander.

Optimus Prime: If you stand in our way, you will learn the depths of your own weakness...for you shall fall.

Megatron(ROTF): Save your hollow threats for another time, Autobot. I have other business to tend to. For the time being, why don't you talk to my associate in hate - Bonecrusher!

sections.heading: Chapter 2 - Revelations
sections.text:
1) In Due Time

Part 1:

Optimus Prime: Commander, the missions have been successful in strengthening our base and defenses. Yet, Megatron's mention of the Quintessons has me concerned.

He implied they are here. When will they reveal themselves?

Laughter: Hahahaha...ask and you shall receive. Before you stands one of your creators...and future master.

Optimus Prime: You may be a creator, but my master you will never be.

Laughter: In due time, Prime. That is, if you manage to survive that which awaits you. Hahahahah!

Part 2:

Laughter: Prime. it's time for you to meet and old friend.

Ironhide: I may be old, but I'm not sure about friend.

Optimus Prime: If you are Ironhide, you are a friend.

Ironhide: If you travel with humans, you must be an Optimus. Trouble is, here I don't care who you are.

If you keep advancing, you'll face the consequences...me and a whole lotta guns!

Part 3: 

Ironhide: Optimus, you've always lacked the gift of practicality. A practical move would have been to end this mission while you still could.

Optimus Prime: The Quintessons have rotted your cerebral circuits. I do not blame you for your misguided words.

Ironhide: Misguided? I think not. Hardened wisdom from one who's seen it all. It's time to get practical!

2) Anger Management

Part 1:

Rage: HALT! Where is The Prime?!

Arcee: That's none of your business. I'm riding shotgun on this mission. Mind telling me who you are?

Rage: Such INSOLENCE! It matters not, though. I, the Quintesson judge, Rage, have placed before you a gauntlet of foes that will silence your INSOLENCE!

Arcee: A "gauntlet of foes"? Nice, great way to keep our skills sharp and aim true. And, by the way, there's no need to shout, my auditory sensors work just fine.

Part 2:

Motormaster: Argh! What is this?! The Quintessons told me to expect a formidable squad of Cybertronians to head my way. And, what do I get?!

Arcee: You get an assassin and a Battle Commander with a squad that's going to teach you...

Motormaster: TEACH ME WHAT!? A lesson? Impossible!

You are weak, your human Commander is frail and the so-called squad isn't worthy of my time.

Arcee: I was going to say, "teach you a lesson in...anger management." School will be in session soon.

Part 3:

Arcee: Hey, Motormaster, we're here to help you sort out your anger issues.

Motormaster: Really? What took you so long?

Arcee: We wanted to give you some time to get your Stunticons together. They probably could use an attitude adjustment, too.

Motormaster: I don't need The Stunticons to demolish you. When I'm done here, you'll be nothing but a pink pile of scrap metal ready for the junkyard!

3) Don't Go Judging

Part 1:

Marissa: Commander, we're sending Mirage with you as an escort of today's mission.

Mirage: This isn't another test of my loyalty is it? We've been through that before.

Marissa: Of course not, Optimus believes the more of us that can study the terrain, tech, and enemies we face, the better we are able to formulate an effective plan.

Mirage: Good, because you know I'm down for the cause...and I'm even more down for survival!

Part 2: 

Judgement: What manner of worthless scrap ventures forth? Or is it worthless too praiseworthy a term for the likes of you?

Mirage: Whoa, stranger. Don't go judging the value of me and my comrades. You don't know us.

Judgement: Judging is by definition what I and my colleagues on The Council of Adjudication do. Your ignorance is outstanding.

Mirage: There you go again. Why don't you enlighten us rather than being so judgemental?

Judgement: Here's all the enlightenment you need for now...you fight, I judge your performance. Now, carry on.

Part 3:

Mirage: Sideswipe, old pal...you're a sight for sore eyes! Surely you haven't succumbed to the Quintesson brain washing.

Sideswipe: Listen, Mirage, I haven't succumbed to anything except proving that I simply am..the best of the bestest!

Judgement: I'll be the judge of that...

Sideswipe: Judge away! When I'm done with these losers, I'll be wearing a gold medal around my neck and signing a lifetime sponsorship deal with Energex Sports Drink!

4) A Scout No More

Part 1:

Optimus Prime: Teletraan has pinpointed an Energon reading with a distinct signature. It's the Bee I faced in combat earlier! 

Marissa: Granted, he was a valuable lieutenant and a trusted friend. But this Bee is different. He's been corrupted somehow.

Optimus Prime: The histories between these converging realities may differ, but a Bot's true spark doesn't lie, regardless of the reality they are from.

My duty is clear. Bumblebee must be freed from the grip of the Quintessons.

Part 2:

Bumblebee (DOTM): So, you've returned for a rematch? Bad call. This time I won't go so easy on you.

Optimus Prime: Bumblebee...Bee...please listen to what I'm saying. The Quintessons are using you. They're using all of us.

Wisdom: "Using" is such a loaded word. Is it "using" if a bot imbued with such obvious potential grows to become the warrior he was always destined to become?

Bumblebee(DOTM): The Quintesson speaks the truth. In this reality, I am not a scout cowering in the shadow of the great Prime. Here...I am a warrior!

Part 3:

Optimus Prime: Bumblebee! You're better than this. You can be so much more than a pawn in the Quintessons' twisted mind game.

Bumblebee(DOTM): Don't be so patronizing. You're not my father. I am a sentient being and I enjoy this newfound freedom.

Wisdom: Hahaha, yes, young warrior, taste the freedom. Show Prime and his allies what it means to be free!

Optimus Prime: If that is how it transpires, then you shall fall...yet again.

5) Loyalty Points 

Part 1: 

Prowl: Commander, you've run several mission now. Our forces grow, yet the danger grows even more. What manner of world is this?

Death: I can answer that for you. It's a world ruled by your masters and creators...one where you will meet your demise. It is a world called...New Quintessa!

Prowl: You show your face you floating mechanical squid?!

Death: Yes, and I'll show you more than my face. I'll show you a betrayed comrade seething with vengeance in her spark. I'm off now, but she awaits ahead.

Part 2:

Arcee: You have some nerve, Prowl! 

Prowl: Arcee! What are you talking about?

Arcee: I know what you've done! You kidnapped Daniel and are holding hostage back at your base! How could you?!

Prowl: You should know better than to believe that. We've fought side by side on countless missions.

Arcee: Bring him to me or you'll be staring down the barrel of my rifle!

Part 3:

Arcee: Your party stands before me, but I don't see Daniel. It's time for you to pay the price for your betrayal!

Prowl: We've been through this before. The Quintesson's used illusion and deception to test our loyalty before. But we beat them. Search deep in your memory banks...remember!

Arcee: You are loyal to nothing but your twisted version of the Autobot Code. It distorts your sense of decency.

Prowl: You leave us no choice. Perhaps extreme measures will bring you to your senses.

 Part 4:

Arcee: Wha..what happened? My casing aches and my circuits are fried.

Prowl: Quintesson mind control and what our human friends call tough love. That's what happened., but fortunately you appear to be shaking off the Quintesson manipulation.

Death: Wishful thinking, Autobot...wishful thinking.

6) The Quintessance

Part 1: 

Prowl: Commander, a sound strategy to combat the Quintessons requires info. And so far, what we have amounts to a pile of scrap. It's time we changed that. 

Scientist: Oh really now? How do you propose to do that? 

Prowl: By any means necessary. 

Scientist: "By any means" ...I hypothesize you mean violence. An associate of yours named Ratchet told me you lack the intellectual capacity to solve problems any other way. 

Prowl: You have Ratchet?! 

Scientist: Oh we have Ratchet...and so much more. 

Part 2: 

Ratchet: Halt, you protocol pariah! 

Prowl: Ratchet, friend, my adherence to protocol is what's saving your rusty old undercarriage. 

Ratchet: Saving me from what? Knowledge? Enlightenment? These Quintessons are light cycles ahead of us in technology and learning. 

Scientist: Your antiquated medical officer is right. Stand down or I decree that you shall face him in battle. 

Prowl: Sorry, but I don't follow orders from Quintessons. 

Part 3: 

Prowl: We've come to end your Age of Enlightenment. 

Ratchet: Prowl, you don't know what you're doing. This planet is at the forefront of intellectual advancement. 

Scientist: The ambulance is right. New Quintessa has all the resources to ensure a new Quintesson golden age. The galaxy is entering...a Quintessance, if you will. 

Prowl: One fueled by Dark Energon? I think not.

sections.heading: 1) We'll Need A Bigger Blaster
sections.text:
Part 1:

Judgement: Ah, Commander. We have found your efforts at survival to be entertaining.

Before you stands a new challenge. Prepare to encounter our universally feared minions...the Sharkticons!

Prowl: Sharkticons? Formidible perhaps, defeatable...absolutely.

Judgement: You seem mistakenly confident. Obviously you've never felt the bite of the Sharkticons before.

Prowl: Maybe, but my pal Ultra Magnus gave me the lowdown on these horror movie rejects. The Autobots have beat them before and we'll do it again.

Judgement: It was a different time and different place. And, the power of Dark Energon didn't course through the circuitry of The Sharkticons like it does now.

You have been warned!

Part 2:

Judgement: Your journey continues, but it is not to late to turn around and spare yourselves.

Prowl: Turn around? Retreat? I follow the Autobot code of conduct...and retreat is nowhere to be found in the code I abide by.

Judgement: Suit yourself. My minions are hungry, and you look to be a suitable meal.

Part 3: 

Death: The Commander and his party of scrap yard rejects stand before us.

Judgement, have you reached a verdict? Guilty or innocent?

Prowl: Save your breath. I've seen this routine before. We're innocent...

Judgement: Precisely! Feed them to the Sharkticons!

sections.heading: 2) Appearing Act
sections.text:
Part 1:

Laughter: I've added someone I suspect is an acquaintance of yours to my gauntlet of pain. He has certain abilities that I have modified and adopted for Quintesson purposes.

Prowl: Quintesson purposes? As far as I can tell you've only got one purpose, and that's being on the receiving end of a beat down.

Scientist: Really? The powers of invisibility and stealth harnessed to unleash ambushes may curb your boastful manners.

Prowl: Invisibility and stealth? Mirage!

Scientist: A logical deduction. Proceed.

Part 2:

Scientist: I trust you enjoyed your surprise courtesy of the technology I gleaned from your so called colleague.

Mirage: In this new reality, Scientist, I'm not sure anyone is a colleague.

Prowl: Mirage! How could you?

Mirage: With the powers The Quintessons are exercising over us all... how could I not? 

Part 3:

Prowl: Mirage, all those years ago, Cliffjumper was right,. You are a double-crosser.

Mirage: Don't you see Prowl? It's The Quintessons. They compel me to...

Prowl: What I do see is a Cybertronian that aided the enemy with advanced technology.

Mirage: If I can't reason with you, perhaps it's time to drop some invisible box-jitsu on you.

Prowl: "Invisible box-jitsu?" Man, you need to work on your trash-talking skills. Let's do this, traitor!

sections.heading: 3) Are You Not Entertained?
sections.text:
Death: If it isn't the famed Orion Pax.

Optimus Prime: That is a name from the distant past. It no longer applies to who I am today.

Death: Of course, I know that. After all, we created your race. We know well, the history of you and your violent, war torn kind.

Optimus Prime: If you know our kind, you know we do not seek war. We seek resolutions...and answers to why we are here.

Death: If the mood strikes me, I may enlighten you more...provided you do not perish first.

Part 2:

Death: You soldier on...a foolhardy if not suicidal strategy.

Optimus Prime: It is not foolhardy to face the challenges that stand in the way of one's freedom.

Death: BAH! I am Judge Death! Your insolence assures you the harshest and most permanent of verdicts!

Optimus Prime: "Judge Death?" I have seen worse. When your spark has faced extinguishment as many times as mine, you learn not to fear those like you.

Part 3: 

Death: You've reached your termination, Prime. Your ex-ally Ironhide shall end your party's journey.

Optimus Prime: And if we refuse to fight... ?

Death: Refuse? You can't, it's in your species' spark to fight. We know, we created you.

At first we forged your kind to serve us for military and consumer purposes. When we grew bored, you entertained us in gladitorial combat.

Optimus Prime: That is ancient history.

Death: Your recent history suggests your Energon lust has not abated. Fight, now, or the might of the Quintessons will exterminate all who remain at your pathetic base.

Optimus Prime: Very well, for now we shall play your game. Commander, he says we were forged to fight. Show him how we do it.

sections.heading: 4) It's In Our DNA
sections.text:
Part 1:

Laughter: Megatron, it is time for you to partake in our "games?"

Megatron (ROTF): I leave that for the weak willed Autobots and their even weaker Earth Defense Force allies.

Laughter: Your arrogance is equal parts annoying and amusing. Eventually you will fall under Quintesson control and the last laugh will be mine.

Megatron (ROTF): Hahaha...that is as humorous as Starscream thinking he'll ever be anything other than a second rate tailpipe kisser.

Part 2:

Barricade: Of course you know, I let you win. That was a study session, nothing more.

Marissa Faireborn: That's what they all say, especially when they get their butts kicked.

Barricade: Your party contains human and your garb denotes military. Do you serve with that cowardly Autobot and Human alliance NEST?

Marissa: NEST is not of our reality, but if it's humans and Autobots on a mission for freedom, we support the concept. It's kind of what we do.

Barricade: Foolish primitive DNA flesh buckets. You'll be made to suffer when we next meet.

Part 3:

Barricade: Just the party of genetically inferior losers I was looking for.

Marissa: Big talk for a bot that's currently 0-1 and looking to keep your winless record intact.

Barricade: My talk is backed up by a mod specially enhanced based on our last battle. A particularly corrosive fate awaits you.

sections.heading: 5) Power Seeker
sections.text:
Part 1:

Wisdom: What's this I see before me? Your desperation is evident. You seek aid from a Decepticon of reowned ill repute.

Marissa: Yes, we did use our Spacebridge to call reinforcements.

However; the power of The Matrix of Leadership and Soundwave's dedication to logic offset concerns over reputations.

Soundwave: Quintesson, I have analyzed historical data banks. You have been defeated multiple times before. I calculate that this will be the case again.

Wisdom: You will soon learn that your calculations and logic are indeed very fallible.

Part 2:

Starscream: Soundwave, why do you and your new-found allies insist upon attacking our hosts?

Soundwave: That is not factual. They are not hosts. They are captors and slave masters. They only use bots for their pleasure.

Starscream: Those are your choice of words. I do not let semantics prevent advantageous relationships from developing.

Soundwave: Advantageous only to you...temporarily. Your logic is inferior.

Part 3:

Soundwave: Starscream, do you continue your pursuit of sycophantic talks with the Quintessons?

Starscream: I speak truth to power.

Soundwave: Incorrect. You speak lies to seek power. Your methods are inferior. The Quintessons will detect your ploy.

Starscream: Silence, you auto-tuned moron! It is time for our hosts to see the power I possess!

sections.heading: 6) School The Sharks
sections.text:
Part 1:

Rage: For countless cycles, The Sharkticons served us well in our travels spreading fear and carrying out our verdicts.

Unfortunately, my fellow Quintessons have besmirched the honour of our Sharkticon minions with their ill training and lack of discipline.

Grimlock: You talk too many words. You waste time. Your story not like Kup's. Be quiet or fight.

Rage: Rest assured, the Sharkticons I have waiting for you will tell you a story you'll never forget.

Part 2: 

Rage: Accept your fate. You are merely pawns, disposable pieces of machinery, here on New Quintessa for our pleasure.

Grimlock: Why you call me a prawn? Me not a shrimp. Grimlock is HUGE. You need to fix your eyes.

Rage: In time my Sharkticon warrior will fix more than just your eyes. He'll fix your attitude, you brain dead hunk of prehistoric metal.

Part 3: 

Sharktion Brawler: ERRRAAAB!

Rage: Well put my minion. Today you shall feast on Cybertronian miscreants!

Grimlock: Where your army? I see one fish. Me like challenge. Me not like big words with no meaning.

Rage: I see. I need to keep it simple. Sharkticon...ATTACK!

sections.heading: 1.Voices
sections.text:
Part 1:

Scientst: The Quintesson council requested that I put your team to a greater test, so a test you shall receive.

I've developed a device to vapourize and disperse a particularly powerful strain of Dark Energon we've refined.

Optimus Prime: Those fortified by the righteous pursuit of freedom shall not succumb to plots of the wicked.

Scientist: Is that so? Perhaps your Cityspeaker ally world suggest otherwise.

Part 2:

Windblade: Ahhhhhh! The voices. They're deafening. Can't you hear them?

Optimus Prime: The ill effects of the Dark Energon are amplifying your inherent ability to communicate with dormant Titans. You can overcome this. Focus.

Windblade: The voices demand my focus, as well. They compel me to focus on destruction. Yours.

Part 3:

Windblade: They're here!

Optimus Prime: Who is here?

Windblade: The spirits of the Titans. They demand retribution for the wars and destruction you have wrought across the galaxies.

Optimus Prime: Windblade, resist. This is not reality. They are figments of a Dark Energon delusion.

Windblade: You can tell them they are delusions and figments when my blade terminates your ability to function. Vengeance is upon you!

sections.heading: 2. Hold It Down
sections.text:
Part 1
* Ratchet: Commander, the effects of this Dark Energon vapor is having a disturbing effect on the bots we encounter.
*Marrisa has sent me with you to take atmospheric samples for analysis.
*Sideswipe: Can you guys hold it down? I was catching a little beauty stasis time.
* Ratchet: Sideswipe, I advise you to get back to base.
*Sideswipe: Yeah right, whatever. First I'm going to give my chassis an overhaul and look into buffing out my chrome. This vapor in the air is killing my finish.
Part 2
*Sideswipe: You're back.
*Ratchet: An obvious deduction. I told you to head back to base. You're interfering with my research.
*Sideswipe: And I told you to hold it down. Your "research" sure does involve a lot of clanking, blasting, and exploding.
* Ratchet: Hostiles in the grips of Dark Energon poisoning need to be dealt with.
*Sideswipe: Well, you're making me hostile. All this racket is causing me stress. And stress is bad for my paint job.
Part 3
*Sideswipe: That's it. You've raised your final ruckus. It's time I sent you back to the seniors' care center.
*Ratchet: Oooh, that stings. But I'll let it pass, I know it's the Dark Energon talking.
*Sideswipe: You'll be more than stung when I'm done with you. Just don't scratch the paint job you geriatric meat wagon.

sections.heading: 3. Code Violation
sections.text:
Part 1 
*Wisdom: Once again, your vile transgressors venture forth to bring us entertainment.
*Marissa Faireborn: We fight for our survival, not transgression or entertainment.
*Prowl: Do not deny it. The Quintesson is right. You have committed punishable transgressions. You have violated the Code of Interplanetary Conflict.
*Wisdom: It seems my enforcer has seen the light of galactic reason. And, what is the punishment for those that violate the code, Prowl?
* Prowl: Death.
Part 2
*Prowl: In the interest of our shared history. I issue you a warning: proceed further and you will be punished.
*Marissa Faireborn: But in what way do we violate your code?
*Prowl: The Code of Interplanetary Conflict states clearly that it is illegal to sell or distribute Cybertronian technology.
*Yet, that is precisely what your mission to New Quintessa entails.
*Marissa Faireborn: Our mission was to bring shared human and Autobot technology to Cybertron to breathe life back into your homeland.
*Prowl: Silence. You indict yourself further by repeating such lies.
Part 3
*Prowl: You have arrived at your final destination. Your punishment will be swift and sure. Do you have any final statements?
*Marissa Faireborn: The technology we possess is the only thing that's keeping us alive in this nightmare known as New Quintessa. We use it to save ourselves.
*Prowl: It is too late to save yourselves.
* Marissa Faireborn: Then we will use it to save you.

sections.heading: 4. The Long Game
sections.text:
Part 1
*Starscream: Yet another glorious day amidst the magic that is New Quintessa.
*Laughter: Hahaha. I find your exuberance to participate in our little gauntlets curious... and amusing, of course.
*Starscream: Exuberance and resiliency are the foundations of my existence. Your delectable vapors that permeate the air only enhance these traits.
*Laughter: Word of your conniving flattery is demonstrated with every utterance from your vocal emitter.
*Starscream: Thank you!
Part 2
*Starscream: A Cybertronian of great stature approaches. A Quintesson ally in the making?
*Barricade: Your bright paint job and colorful oratory can't hide your duplicitous ways. It doesn't matter the reality; once a Starscream, always a Starscream.
*Starscream: But friend, you bear the Decepticon insignia.
*Barricade: Insignia's are meaningless in this hell I find myself in. The only thing that matters is survival. I've chosen the means of my survival... as apparently, have you.
Part 3
* Laughter: A party approaches. Perhaps you can persuade them of the benefits of the New Quintessa lifestyle. Hahahaha.
* Starscream: It would be my pleasure to pound the virtues of Dark Energon and the Quintesson way into those that require it.
* Barricade: You're a pathetic joke, Starscream. They use and abuse you, yet you continue to do their bidding.
* Starscream: I may be a joke to you, but it's a joke you don't get.
* {{RedText|While you battle step by step for your very survival, I play the long game. And a very long game it is.}}

sections.heading: 5. Optimum Outcome
sections.text:
Part 1
*Optimus Prime: Quintessons, your machines test the sanity and courage of my comrades. Know this foul creatures, dread does not fill my spark, only determination to seek freedom.
* Judgement: Oftentimes, to face one's greatest fear, you have to look no further than the closest mirror. That time for you is now.
*Optimus Prime (MV1): Optimus...
*Optimus Prime: ...Prime!
Part 2
*Optimus Prime: You are possessed of the greatness and weight of the Primes. Do not waver from the pursuit of ...
*Optimus Prime (MV1): ...Freedom? Spare me.
*I have seen too much of our own Energon spilled by the humans you align yourself with. They do not deserve my loyalty or protection.
*Optimus Prime: Look about you. The Darkest Hour approaches. We must unite till...
*Optimus Prime (MV1): ...all will never be one.
Part 3
*Optimus Prime (MV1): I have studied the accounts of your reality. Like me, your hubris was the downfall of Cybertron! Unlike me, you have yet to realize the errors of your ways.
*Optimus Prime: My way is sacrifice for the greater good, protection of the innocent, be they Cybertronian or human.
*Optimus Prime (MV1): Traitor! You value the humans over your own kind!
*Optimus Prime: Wrong. I value sentient beings of all kinds.
* Optimus Prime (MV1): I bled for these insects countless times! My spark is extinguished, and driven to the abyss.
*It was there where I realized the truth - True victory can only come when you dismiss consequence.

sections.heading: 6. Shackle Me Not
sections.text:
Part 1
*Rage: Scientist! Explain yourself. The Commander is enroute with a Prime in tow.
*Scientist: What is your point? Many, many Primes have been summoned to New Quintessa to provide us entertainment.
* Rage: BUT this ONE was supposedly under the control of your Vaporizer contraption mere cycles ago! Your technology is in question, your effectiveness as well!
*Scientist: There is no need to shout. Look about you. The air is thick with Dark Energon.
*Rage: SO?! 
*Scientist: So wait till you see its effect on my latest pet... Megatron!
Part 2
* Megatron (ROTF): The insufferable Quintesson Scientist was right. He predicted your arrival, so here I stand, ready to inflict pain upon the bane of my existence.
* Optimus Prime (MV1): Surely you have help. What of your minions I have seen a uniquely colored Starscream grovelling at the feet of The Quintessons.
* Megatron (ROTF): Lord Megatron needs no help!! The low tech flunk that's been desperately currying favor with The Quintessons is a failure here, just like the Starscream that inhabits our reality was a failure there.
*Optimus Prime: Failure consumes you, and it will again soon enough.
Part 3
* Optimus Prime: I have come to open dialogue with you, as a fellow Cybertronian trapped together in a situation I fear grows dangerous beyond measure.
*Megatron (ROTF): Trapped? I am not trapped. I am merely intrigued.
*Optimus Prime: How can you say that? Can you not survey your surroundings?
*Megatron (ROTF): You always were myopically naive. If you truly worship your precious freedom, then free yourself! Free yourself from the shackles that bind you, be they Quintesson, Autobot...or human.
*I have not forgotten what they subjected us to. Neither should you.

Megatronus is a powerful Boss-level Demolitions bot.

sections.heading: Bio
sections.text: One of the Thirteen Primes created by Primus himself to defeat Unicron, Megatronus is a being of unparalled strength. His quest for greater power led him to betray his fellow Primes, resulting in a millennia of banishment. That banishment has ended, and his presence again looms large through the cosmos.

sections.heading: Story
sections.text:
Megatronus' arrival into New Quintessa was part of an elaborate plan by Generations Megatron to gather the power of the Primes, spanning multiple Spotlight Missions.

Megatronus' main story arc is the Decepticon Titan Story Arc.

sections.heading: Awakening
sections.text:
* What Could Go Wrong? (teased)
After having Shockwave taking possession of the Forge of Solus Prime, Megatron sets up a quest to gather the power of the Primes. During Jazz, Tantrum and Wheeljack's arrivals, Megatron sets up an excavation site to secure pod from which he believes bears another ancient Relic. However, further research by Soundwave demonstrates a living Bot is inside.

sections.heading: At full power
sections.text:
* Emergence
Now at full power again, and with his Relics gathered in his Tomb, Megatronus came to Cyclonus, who needed help with defeating Optimus Prime. The god told Cyclonus that he needed to bide his time before he could face the Autobot leader.

Later, Megatronus contacts Optimus, calling him "13". However, Optimus tells the god he is not a number. Megatronus tells the Autobot leader that he cannot escape his path. Optimus and the Commander manage to successfully subdue Megatronus.

* Grave Consequences
He would later unleash a wave of corruptive energies over New Quintessa and captures Optimus Prime, Ultra Magnus and Megatron. The pulse ends-up picking a Squad of Autobots composed of Ratchet, Jazz, Arcee and Prowl, leaving only Arcee in full sentience after corrupting and driving her teammates mad. 

After freeing Optimus and Ultra Magnus, Arcee stands up to Megatronus with the help of the Commander. At the end of the struggling showdown, the Commander, Optimus, Ultra Magnus and Arcee are able to lock Megatronus once again inside his Tomb of Relics, hoping it would be enough to contain the Fallen God's power for now.

*Crossfire
However, Megatronus would later escape the Tomb, and afterwards awakened a Decepticon Titan. He is joined by Megatron, Cyclonus, Megatron (ROTF), and Galvatron as they threaten the Commander. However, the Commander manages to defeat Megatronus.

The Titan that Megatronus awakened would send New Quintessa into a time storm, which would open up the gates to a "ReForged" portal.

*Fog of War
Prior to this Spotlight, Megatronus apparently spoke to the Titan he awoken and learned some "secrets". He is also the main cause of the temporary cloaking across New Quintessa.

*Awaken and Corrupt

*Alliance Mission: Dark Horizons
While not directly interfering with New Quintessa, Megatronus is the final boss of Map 3 before being changed to Necrotronus.

* Exodus Protocol

sections.heading: Basic Abilities
sections.text:
* Relic of Fury - Significantly increases Attack Rating and reduces enemy Block Proficiency.
* Relic of Preservation - Increases Damage Resistance and limits the amount of damage that can be done to this Bot in a single blow.
* Power Steal - Instantly Steals Power from the opponent and transfers it to this bot.
* Life Steal - Instantly Steals Health from the opponent and transfers it to this bot.

sections.heading: Abilities
sections.text:
* Passive:
** Now in possession of powerful Relics, Megatronus does not generate Power as normal, he instead generates 1.2% of Max Power every second.
** Megatronus begins the fight with the Relic of Fury active, each time he gains a Bar of Power he alternates between the Relic of Fury and the Relic of Preservation.
* Relic of Fury
** The Relic of Fury grants 30~60% Attack Rating and reduces the opponent's Block Proficiency by 20%
* Relic of Preservation
** The Relic of Preservation grants 40~60% Damage Resistance and limits the amount of damage Megatronus can receive in a single blow to 10% of his Max Health.
* Relic of Immortality
** Once per fight, When Megatronus hits 10% of his health he activates the Matrix of Immortality in addition to his other Relics for 8 seconds. While the Relic is active Megatronus is Indestructible and immune to all damage.
* Last Hit of a Light or Medium Combo
** +40% Critical Chance.
* Heavy Attacks
** 100% chance to apply Dark Burn, dealing 40% of Attack as instant Energy damage.

sections.heading: Boss
sections.text:
As a boss, Megatronus has no class and has these stronger and additional abilities:

* Passive:
** Now in possession of powerful Relics, Megatronus does not generate Power as normal, he instead generates 1.5% of Max Power every second.
* Relic of Fury
** Megatronus begins the fight with the Relic of Fury active, granting ~50(rank 3) ~% Attack Rating and reduces the opponent's Block Proficiency by 20%
** If the Relic of Fury is active, Special Attack 1 and 3 have 100% chance to Steal 30% of the opponent's Current Power.
* Relic of Preservation
** At 80% Health Megatronus activates the Relic of Preservation, granting Damage Resistance and limiting the amount of damage Megatronus can receive in a single blow to 20% of his Max Health. Addtionally, it grants him 100% Block Proficiency.
** Blocked Attacks grants either a Ranged or Melee Buff, increasing either by 5% for 6 seconds. If Megatronus' Block is ever broken by a Heavy Attack while these buffs are active, the Relic will instead replace Megatronus' buffs with debuffs.
** If the Relic of Preservation is active during Special Attack 2 or 3, 100% chance to Steal Life from the opponent equal to 10% of Max Health.
* Relic of Chaos
** At 60% Health Megatronus activates the Relic of Chaos, which radiates intense heat. Being close to Megatronus for longer than 1 second inflicts a Burn Debuff on opponents, causing Heat Damage for 30% Attack every second. Moving away will extinguish this Burn.
** If the Relic of Chaos is active during Special Attack 2 or 3, 100% chance to inflict Burn, dealing Heat Damage for 25% Attack over 6 seconds.
* Relic of War
** At 30% Health Megatronus activates the Relic of War, granting his dashes a 100% chance to activate an Unstoppable Buff for 4 seconds. The Unstoppable Buff refreshes if he lands a medium attack while it's active.
** For every 5 hits Megatronus gains on the Combo Meter, he also gains an Attack Buff that raises his Attack by ~9~%
** For every 4 hits on the opponent's Combo Meter, Megatronus loses an Attack Buff. When an opponent reaches 16 hits on their Combo Meter, Megatronus becomes Power Locked.
** If the Relic of War is active during a Heavy Attack, Megatronus purifies all Debuffs.
* Relic of Immortality
** Once per fight when Megatronus has dropped to 5% health or lower, he activates the Relic of Immortality for 12 seconds. While the Relic is active Megatronus is Indestructible and immune to all damage. This ability will not activate if Megatronus begins the fight with less than 5% Health.

sections.heading: Signature Ability
sections.text:
Relic of Obedience - The Relic of Obedience weakens enemy abilities and may completely prevent them from activating.

When Filling a Power Bar: 
*When Megatronus gains a Bar of Power, he has a 12.9~65% chance to activate the Relic of Obedience, preventing opponents from activating Buffs or Debuffs for 8 seconds. Additionally, when the Relic is not active, Buffs and Debuffs the opponent activates are 20% weaker.

sections.heading: Synergy Bonuses
sections.text:
* Allies - Cyclonus, Galvatron - 2~3~8% Armor.
* Enemies - Optimus Prime, Optimus Prime (MV1) - 2~3~8% Attack Rating.
* The Fallen - Megatron, Megatron (ROTF) - All Decepticons on your team gain +2~3~5% Armor while fighting Decepticons and +5~12~20% Power Rate while fighting Autobots.
* Leadership (5-Star) - Acting as a beacon of leadership for the team, all lower teammates gain +10% Special Damage.
* Aspiration - Necrotronus - Start the fight with 5~6~8 Titan Charges.
* Power Consumed - Nectrotronus - 2~3~4% Crit chance when Megatronus has more Power than the opponent.

sections.heading: Commander
sections.text:
Megatronus is an extremely powerful bot who is ruthless and unchallenging, as should be his playstyle. Melee and ranged attacks deal very good damage so utilize them. Dark burns deal more damage through heavy attacks. However, his best damage lies in his special attacks. 

One disadvantage Megatronus has is that his passive power gain and situational power steals are his only ways of getting power that is greater than his passive generation; he cannot gain power from hitting and being hit. As such, mods or abilities that constantly drain power are his greatest weakness. 

His other weakness is his Relic of Immortality only activates when 10% is reached; If a single hit deals enough damage from 11%< to 0% it is over and finished.

sections.heading: Specific Relic Effects and their Effects on Special Attacks
sections.text:
To use Megatronus effectively, you must switch his relics strategically. This section covers how to activate a specific relic effect on Special Attacks (excluding Immortality). First, let's look at when the relics activate and their effects.

*Relic of Preservation: Filling first and third Power Bar; Life Steal on Special II and III
*Relic of Fury: Start, filling second Power Bar; Power Steal on Special I and III

The order that the relics switch:

Fury (starting relic) -> Preservation (1st bar) -> Fury (2nd bar) -> Preservation (3rd bar)

If you have used a Special Attack and mixed up Relic switching:

Preservation (starting relic) -> Fury (1st bar) -> Preservation (2nd bar) -> Fury (3rd bar)

It takes 15 seconds to fill one Power Bar, up to 45 seconds for all three; this doubles on a Robot Resource.

To activate:
* Power Steal on Special I - Use Special I while the Relic of Preservation is active. By the time your first Power Bar is filled, the Relic of Fury is active and Special I can steal Power. This is recommended if the opponent has very strong Special Attacks, but this method is slower compared to Prowl's Special I.
* Life Steal on Special II - Use Special I while the Relic of Preservation is active, then wait until your second Power Bar is filled. By the time your second Power Bar is filled, the Relic of Preservation is active and Special II can steal Health. This is recommended if you're in a tight spot and have low health, or if the opponent has a lot of Health (eg. Grindor or health boost mods). A life steal can also speed up battles exponentially.

What must matter on both Special Attacks is that THE FIRST HIT MUST CONNECT to activate the effect. If it doesn't, the effect won't activate.

What comes out of your Special III is up to you. The first hit of that Special can either Steal Power or Life (though it is less reliable compared to his first two Specials), but either way, is intended for raw power.

sections.heading: Opponent/AI
sections.text:
Megatronus has an Improved Aim Enhancer mod in Expert and Master Spotlight Missions, and as the final boss in Alliance Missions, so Blocking will be useless. Keep your dodging skills in check. Frequent dodgers like Sideswipe and Barricade will be useful, though risky in the long run as they have lower health than the average Bot. 

However, there are also bots to counter his Relic of Immortality. Ramjet and his large number of special buffs will enable him to keep fighting, but like Wheeljack's Force Shield he can't take damage but still gains power. Ranged fights like Galvatron's one will be challenging but not impossible.

Bots that rely on applying or gaining buffs or debuffs (respectively) will not fit well with the Deity's Relic of Obedience. Those like Wheeljack, Bonecrusher, Blaster, Mixmaster, Ironhide, Windblade, Megatron (ROTF), Ultra Magnus, Optimus Prime (MV1), even Grimlock and others will struggle with defeating Megatronus. Optimus Primal will also be a weak choice because he will only lose his critical armor and not gain any melee buffs if mistimed.

If facing Megatronus on a Robot Resource, call up Kickback or Windblade to nullify the power gain.

sections.heading: In Story Missions
sections.text:
The Megatronus in the last fight of Chapter 1 of Act 4 is most likely the hardest fight in the game (Excluding Master spotlights, Rulers of Kaon and Revenge of the King of course). With unstable Energon dealing Shock damage every 7 seconds, and the Relic of Chaos dealing constant Burn damage, we can just go off on a whim and say... A duped Grimlock, 4-star R5/50 or 5-star R2/20 is your absolute safest bet.

With these in mind, a Bot with Purification will be greatly useful. As mentioned above, a duped Grimlock will greatly help you, though there are also other options to use. For example, Thundercracker's heavy will instantly purify all damaging debuffs.

sections.heading: Bots
sections.text:
*Everyone – There is no bot that Megatronus cannot overpower.
*Megatron – Megatron will find his namesake needs no buffs to be formidable.
*Optimus Prime – Think Optimus Prime would stand a chance against the Fallen? Think again! Only the relic of obedience will put a stop to him from Rolling Out and disable the synergy bonus from his Chief Medical Officer!
*Grimlock - Dark Burns aren't regular Burns, and in turn doesn't fuel the rage. Sometimes there is a fighting style when it comes to dark burns.
*Wheeljack - Megatronus' Dark Burns will bypass the Force Shield and if Wheeljack thinks if he can activate his force shield, the relic of obedience will put a stop to that idea and it will punish commanders very badly that rely on the nano-repair mastery despite the class type advantages.
*Ultra Magnus - Megatronus will easily bypass Magnus' Resistances putting the Autobot Commander in a serious disadvantage.
*Ironhide and Megatron (ROTF) - Megatronus will easily dethrone those 2 demolition kings to become the new king of the demolitions. Remember the fallen is the real master of the demolitions not Ironhide or Megatron, and sometimes there is a time for revolution.

sections.heading: Mods
sections.text:
*Every Mod - There is no mod that Megatronus cannot overpower.
*Energon Storm - By some anomaly, Megatronus is immune to Shock damage until they're Fused or he reaches full power.

sections.heading: Bots
sections.text:
*No One – No one stands as a serious challenger to him that is the embodiment of power.
*Shockwave – Repair Block and Power Drain will help keep the master of demolitions from tapping into his true power. Shockwave too does not generate any buffs which Megatronus’s relic of obedience has no answer to.
*Windblade - Special I does serious damage because of his power gain, especially if Relic of Fury is on at the time and her heavy neuters his ranged attacks. If Megatronus' health is low (but not low enough to trigger his Relic of Immortality), her Special I or II can finish him off before the relic can kick in and protect him. The same goes for an awakened Ironhide that will inflict damage that will obliterate the opponent instantly.
*Prowl - Stacking Special Is can delay Relic switching, proving there is a need to stay silent when facing the Fallen.
*Galvatron - Galvatron's Dark Burns bypass Armor, Shields and Resistances and it can even bypass through the Relic of Reservation.
* Blaster - His tunes slow down the Demolition king's ranged attacks, making his wrath considerably easier to avoid.
* Kickback - The power leaks that Kickback grants can drain the lord of the demolitions passive power gain but when he reaches full power the relic of obedience can kick in thanks to his passive power gain.
*Hot Rod - Decelerating the Demolition king will delay relic switching and of course prevent him from using his devastating specials.
*Necrotronus - Necrotronus is a surprise counter to the Fallen. The Megatronus reskin has the power rate down which will delay relic switching and a well timed critical hit when Necro is awakened. will not allow Megatronus to activate his relic of immortality.

sections.heading: Mods
sections.text:
*No Mods - No mods stands as a serious challenge mod to him that is the embodiment of power.
*Nightbird's Mark - A Nightbird's Cull can prevent him from going immortal.
* Utility Mod: Power Wipe - Megatronus will never be able to gain two bars of power.
* Utility Mod: Power Conductor - Megatronus will gain power very very slowly.
* Paralyzer - The Stun Ray will drain Megatronus' Power very quickly.
* E.M.I. Module - This mod will decrease the potency of Megatronus' Heavy Attacks making his wrath considerably easier to avoid.

sections.heading: Recommended Modules
sections.text:
Paring these mods with The lord of the demolitions will enhance his abilities and defend your base!
* Robot Resource – One cannot even fathom the carnage Megatronus could inflict with a second source of power.
* Prime Module – The Prime Module will help the master of the demolitions stay in the fight longer and increase his stats to match any higher level contender.
* Transwarp Cell - The more the Heavy Attacks, the more dark burning Megatronus can do.
