sections.heading: Reunited
sections.text:
Part 1
*Optimus Prime: Blaster, Ratchet, Commander ... prepare to roll out.
*Blaster: What's shaking, Boss-bot?
*Optimus Prime: I will let Ratchet explain his latest findings, but suffice to say, Megatron is up to something.
*Ratchet: Indeed it seems he is. Recon missions indicate Megatron and a group of Decepticons have set up a perimeter around a series of excavation sites.
*Blaster: I don't dig. What are they looking for?
*Ratchet: My best guess, Megatron is back and looking for keys to the planet's past... and potentially destructive future.
Part 2
*Ratchet: Do you hear that?
*Optimus Prime: Of course I do. Blaster, what have I told you about playing music?
*Blaster: That's not me, Optimus. I keep my headphones on during patrol.
*Optimus Prime: That means...
*Ratchet: It can't be...
*Blaster: It is! My main bot...
*Jazz: Jazz is here to bring some glide to your stride! You didn't think you could hide from me on this planet forever, did you?
*Optimus Prime: You are a sight for sore optical receptors, old friend! We are on a mission to seek information on Megatron's latest plot.
*Blaster: You down to join the fun?
Part 3
*Jazz: Is it just me, or does anyone else feel their circuitry sizzling?
*Ratchet: EMP Readings are off the charts.
*Optimus Prime: Which means...
*Blaster: I've gotta get new batteries for the old boombox?
*Shockwave: Incorrect assessment of the situation.
*Jazz: Ah, man... I Spacebridged all the way here just to throwdown with the one-eyed purple logic eater?
*Shockwave: Correct assessment of the situation.

sections.heading: Parting Ways
sections.text:
Part 1
*Jazz: Listen, it's been a hot minute since I last tangled with Shockwave, but I'd say he was pulling his punches, like he was stalling for time or something.
*Optimus Prime: I concur.
*Ratchet: Which would corroborate my theory that his faction of Decepticons is up to something.
*Jazz: Then what are we waiting for? Let's roll out and roll those suckers.
*Blaster: Music to my ears, Jazz. Let's kick it.
Part 2
*Jazz: Yo', I've been thinking. It might be best if we split up. We can cover more ground that way.
*Optimus Prime: That sounds ill advised.
*Jazz: Ah, Optimus, don't worry. This ain't our first Boogaloo. We can take care of ourselves.
*Optimus Prime: In the interest of urgency, I shall go against my better judgement and allow your suggested course of action.
*Blaster: Word.
Part 3
*Ratchet: Roadblock dead ahead.
*Motormaster: You got the "dead" part right, meat wagon. Why don't you just load up your little Commander and head home before things get messy?
*Optimus Prime: You know that is not a possibility.
*Ratchet: Optimus, he looks pretty modded. Perhaps we should call Jazz and Blaster for back up.
*Motormaster: I don't think those musical malfunctions will be of much use to you anymore.
*Optimus Prime: Clarify that statement! Now!
*Motormaster: Kiss my tailpipe. You'll get all the clarity you'll need, once I tear you a new axle shaft!

sections.heading: Conversion
sections.text:
Part 1
*Megatron: Did you retrieve our "guests?"
*Soundwave: You know I would not fail you, Lord Megatron.
*Megatron: Then I can safely assume they are in our custody?
*Soundwave: The inferior Autobots are in our custody. Shockwave is preparing them for duty.
*Megatron: Excellent. Another brilliant plan of mine is coming together perfectly.
Part 2
+Megatron: Do you have a status report on Shockwave's "conversion" therapy for our new Autobot tools?
*Soundwave: They will be converted and ready to utilize shortly.
*Megatron: Then we'll need more time. Ramjet, prepare a painful welcoming party for Optimus and that accursed Commander. They are bound to try and interfere.
*Ramjet: No problem, Megaboss. It's always a pleasure to go nose-to-nose with that Autobot pile of scrap.
Part 3
*Ramjet: Ah, if isn't Captain Autobot and his human pet. You two look lonely. Like maybe you're missing a couple of friends, or at least some overpriced stereo equipment.
*Optimus Prime: Save the banter. Where are they?
*Ramjet: What ever could you mean? I'm just standing here minding my own business.
*Optimus Prime: Motormaster... or what's left of him... told us Megatron has Jazz and Blaster. We mean to get them back.
*Ramjet: Always the hero, eh, big guy? I'm afraid I can't help you.
*Optimus Prime: Then we will help ourselves.

sections.heading: Sonic Deducer
sections.text:
Part 1
*Soundwave: Shockwave has completed the adjustments to Jazz and Blaster.
*Megatron: Excellent, signal him that they are to be deployed.
*Soundwave: If I may inquire, deployed to do what?
*Megatron: Subterranean sonic reconnaissance. This planet holds valuable secrets. They will br my tools to reveal them.
*Soundwave: You are aware that I can do such work.
*Megatron: But, you are far too valuable to be wasted on such menial tasks. Leave that to our Autobot captives?
*Soundwave: What then are my orders?
*Megatron: Stand guard while they attend to their duties.
Part 2
*Optimus Prime: Are you sure we're on the right path?
*Ratchet: I'm getting both seismic... and sonic readings from up ahead.
*Optimus Prime: Are the readings connected?
*Ratchet: I'd surmise, yes.
*Optimus Prime: Then I think we are on the path to locating our captured friends.
Part 3
*Optimus Prime: Ratchet, have we found the source of the sonic disruptions?
*Ratchet: I'm afraid not. The readings emanate from ahead, and they are too powerful to be generated by the likes of him.
*Soundwave: Your location assumption is affirmative but your power calculations are in error. I can generate for more sonic disruption than all your inferior Autobots combined.
*Optimus Prime: So Jazz and Blaster are nearby.
*Soundwave: Affirmative or not, it is of no consequence to you. I shall see to that.

sections.heading: Boss Fight
sections.text:
Part 1
*Megatron: Do you call yourselves Decepticons?! The gall!
*Shockwave: We followed orders.
*Soundwave: You said to delay Optimus and the Commander.
*Ramjet: Which we did.
*Megatron: And, not one of you thought to permanently delay them... as in make them cease to function.
*Motormaster: Hey, Megatron, those bots are rolling deep. If you think it's so easy...
*Megatron: Do it myself? Perhaps it's time I did. This plan is too important to be left in the hands of you fools.
Part 2
*Optimsu Prime: Ratchet, any speculation as to what Megatron is up to?
*Ratchet: Based on the apparent interest in underground exploration or excavation, I venture a guess that it has something to do with the planet's history.
*Optimus Prime: Do you think he shares our hypothesis that gods... our gods... may have once inhabited this planet?
*Ratchet: If the Megatron from the other reality reached such a conclusion, it's safe to say that our Megatron would likely deduce the same.
*Optimus Prime: Which means he likely seeks the key to power that would help him rule the planet...
*Ratchet: And possibly beyond.
*Optimus Prime: Hurry, we must save our friends... and ourselves.
Part 3
*Megatron: Well, if it isn't the savior of freedom and the fools who believe in such nonsense.
*Optimus Prime: I do not have time for this. You know why we are here.
*Megatron: You want to fight the boss... a boss fight as it were?
*Optimus Prime: I do not seek to fight, but I will if that is required to secure the release of our allies and put an end to your machinations.
*Megatron: Has history taught nothing, Prime? My so called machinations will never end. And your desire to secure release for those glorified metal detectors ends here... now... at the end of my particle beam cannon.

sections.heading: Strictly Business
sections.text:
Part 1
*Motormaster: Hey, Megatron, you all done "doing it yourself?"
*Ramjet: Yeah, I'm sure there must be a pile of Autobot chassis laying around somewhere... hehehe.
*Megatron:Sarcasm will get you nowhere other than the scrapyard,
*Soundwave: But, they do have a point. You said you were executing a master plan.
*Megatron: And I am. That encounter was merely a part of it. The next part will see Jazz creating dissension amongst their ranks.
*Shockwave: How does that compute? He is our captive performing sonic reconnaissance duties.
*Megatron: Not anymore, he served his usefulness. Now he will divide the Autobots while we prepare to srtike.
Part 2
*Ratchet: Hear that big booming bass? It can only be Blaster...
*Jazz: Or me, Jazz? That's right, you've found the cat that's always down to to keep it wild, wooly, and wailing!
*Optimus Prime: It is a relief to find you safe, but where is Blaster?
*Jazz: Sorry, boss-bot, I've gotta keep that info on the down low.
*Optimus Prime: Jazz, what has gotten into you?
*Jazz: Can't tell ya' right now. Gotta roll solo or else...
*Ratchet: Or else what?
*Jazz: We're gonna have a confrontation we all want to avoid... and nobody wants that. Catch ya' on the flip side.
*Ratchet: Wait, Jazz, come back!
Part 3
*Jazz: I didn't want to come to this.
*Optimus Prime: Come to what? I do not understand. Explain.
*Jazz: The thing is I don't want to do this.
*Ratchet: Do what?
*Jazz: Fight you. But... I have to.
*Optimus Prime: That is ridiculous.
*Jazz: If I don't Megatron is going to kill Blaster. I can't have that on my head.
*Optimus Prime: Lead us to him. We can help.
*Jazz: It ain't that is easy. Megs has the excavation site rigged to blow sky high if I don't take care of business. So let;s just get this over with...and get down to business.
Part 4
*Optimus Prime: Jazz, get up. It looks like Megatron's threats were not entirely what they seemed.
*Jazz: Blaster, my man! You escaped! How?
*Blaster: C'mon, Jazz you aren't the only bot that knows use the old lightshow trick to cause confusion.
*Jazz: Damn, I wish you would have done it sooner. You coulda saved me one heck of a headache.

sections.text:
It is recommended to pair this Module with Bots who frequently deal Critical hits, and so is suited for most Warriors, Scouts, and Demolition Bots. Cheetor and Dinobot also rely on Critical Hits, Cheetor for his basic Melee Bleed and Dinobot for almost his entire skillset. Bumblebee will benefit from this Mod as his Shield Breaks will be inflicted more frequently.

Bots who also have powerful evading such as Bumblebee (DOTM), Barricade and Sideswipe will be evading more attacks.

It is unknown if Thundercracker can score a Crit while under this mod.

sections.heading: Raids
sections.text:
Avoid starting a fight below 7 to 25% health, your Bot will get knocked out instantly. This is especially true with Megatron (ROTF), whose Repair won't trigger at all, and Megatronus, who won't be able to go immortal, if either are Culled.

There are some bots that are an effective counter to this mod, like Hot Rod's Deceleration and Grindor's Crit Rate Debuffs. Optimus Primal completely resists Critical Hits, and Bonecrusher will Bleed anyone who Crits.

sections.heading: Inordinate Ordnance
sections.text:
* Boss: Hound
Part 1
*Marissa Faireborn: There's been an inordinate amount of ordnance discharge in the western region.
*Bumblebee: How about in plain talk?
*Marissa Faireborn: Tetetraan has been picking up readings that suggests lots... I mean lots of bombs, weapons, rockets, and grenades have been used or detonated in the western region.
*Bumblebee: More than normal? That area is pretty crazy. They don't call it the Wasteland for nothing. I'll go with the Commander and investigate.
Part 2
* Bumblebee: Whoa, boss, what are you doing out here? Marissa's mission log didn't say you'd be coming along.
* Optimus Prime (MV1): I am on a mission of my own.
* Bumblebee: Oh, oh. Not another one of those finding our creators ones?
* Optimus Prime: No, Bumblebee, but it does require discretion. I am afraid that is all I can share now. See to your business and roll out.
Part 3
*Bumblebee: All that bang, bang, kaboom! It makes sense now. Hound is in the house! 
*Hound: That's right, the the round mound of pound is in the house. But, all I see in front of me is a deserter running in cahoots with human scum.
*Bumblebee: That is pretty harsh, big guy, even for you.
*Hound: Yeah, well you wanna learn about harsh? Try being the last Autobot left on earth with a bunch of humans hell bent on turning you into some scrap they call Transformium.
*Bumblebee: You know better than that. Things happened that were beyond our control.
*Hound: All I know is what I see... a traitor that broke the only code that counts... "No bots left behind!" That and his human master. C'mon punks... it's time to get some!

sections.heading: Trust Issues
sections.text:
* Boss: Ironhide
Part 1
*Marissa Faireborn: The Commander has been reticent to discuss what happened on the last mission. Can you ahre details Bumblebee?
*Bumblebee: Somebody let the dogs out. Hound is here.
*Marissa Faireborn: That should be great news. Why all the grim faces?
*Bumblebee: Our Hound has developed a certain anti-human disposition. He's shooting first and not listening later.
*Ironhide: Let me talk to him. As much as he may like you Bee, I see more optic to optic with him. Firepower talks.
Part 2
*Hound: Looky here, another human lackey.
*Ironhide: You know I've had my trust issues with the shifty humans, too. But, these ones are different. You can trust them.
*Hound: Like I can trust a bot who left his brother behind?
*Ironhide:What will it take to prove we didn't leave you behind?
*Hound: You know the answer. Spill some Energon.
*Ironhide: I may not go that far, but I'll see what I can do.
Part 3
*Ironhide: No sign of old Hound. Signs are our bearded pal took off deeper into the Wastelands.
*Bumblebee: Are you serious?
*Ironhide: Serious as a carburetor failure.
*Bumblebee: Abort mission Commander. We can assess next steps back at HQ.
*Ironhide: Why waste all that mission prep? I'm here, you're here... heck, we're all here. Can't let this opportunity go to waste. Let's get some training in. I'll give you a taste of what's in store if you ever do meet up with the bouncing ballerina of bombs.

sections.heading: Divided Loyalties
sections.text:
* Boss: Drift 
Part 1
*Ironhide: Drift, I need to talk to you.
*Drift: Is this about Hound? Those that don't know him seem to be growing increasingly perturbed.
*Ironhide: That they are. His spark is in the right place, he's just going through some trust issues.
* Drift: I will do what is necessary to afford him time to resolve his issues.
*Ironhide: I thought you'd say that.
*Drift: After what he did for us in Hong Kong... It's the least I can do. To do less would dishonor my name and what it means to be an Autobot.
Part 2
*Rhinox: Optimus, what are we doing on this mission? I'm not sure this is our business. The Autobots, not Maximals, should be dealing with this Hound situation.
*Optimus Primal: I discussed this with Optimus Prime, the one who's still around. We agreed that the Autobots from Hound's reality may have... shall we say... divided loyalties.
*Rhinox: They're traitors?!
*Optimus Primal: No, nothing that extreme. But, their judgement may be clouded by their passion for their friend. It's best that we accompany the Commander to try and show this Hound fellow the light.
Part 3
*Optimus Primal: Drift, with all due respect to your dedication to a friend, we need to know... where is Hound?
*Drift: Maximals here... now, shall never overcome... devotion to Hound.
*Rhinox: Save the haikus for someone that knows or cares what they are. As Optimus said, where is Hound?
*Drift:I t was not a haiku, it was a staetment of loyalty. Such loyalty forces me to show you my blades. Regrettable, but unavoidable if you pursue my friend.

sections.heading: Curb the Cur
sections.text:
* Boss: Optimus Prime (MV1)
Part 1
*Optimus Primal: The Hound situation grows more rancorous. Something is wrong when Autobots start questioning the trustworthiness of Autobots.
*Dinobot: That is why... Maximals must solve this.
*Optimus Primal: We all must solve this. The Commander, Autobots of all realities... all of us.
*Dinobot: Right, right... but it sounds like this bot is a loose cannon.
*Optimus Primal: As were we all when first subjected to the madness of this planet.
*Dinobot: And what worked to correct that?
*Optimus Primal: Understanding...
*Dinobot: And a whole lot of corrective behavior conditioning. It's time for us to tame Hound.
Part 2
*Hound:The boss is back!
*Optimus Prime: My apologies for not communicating with you sooner. I have been preoccupied with investigations into this planet's ominous past.
*Hound: That's funny. I've been investigating its screwed up present. Like how there' a bunch of Decepticons and Autobots... and beastie bots running around taking pot shots at each other... and me!
*Optimus Prime: It is true chaos rules the land. That is why you must join us in bringing sanity to this place.
*Hound: That's a tough one boss. See, I'm done with humans and my old pals that deserted me and left me to rot on Earth. How can anyone be trusted after all they're done to us... to me?!
*Optimus Prime: I understand your reticence. I also understand what this place can do to one's thinking. That is why I will protect you... for now.
*Hound: Protect me? You better protect... THEM!
Part 3
*Optimus Prime: I know why you are here. He is not to be blamed. His reaction to the Dark Energon in the atmosphere has been especially severe.
*Optimus Primal: Unfortunately, his actions have been equally severe.
*Optimus Prime: He feels betrayed, he is wracked with confusion.
*Optimus Primal: I understand your loyalty.
*Dinobot: As do I. But, that can not excuse the havoc he creates and danger he presents. Something must be done to curb this cur.
*Optimus Prime: I will take you all on, if that is what is necessary.

sections.heading: Promise of Violence
sections.text:
* Boss: Bumblebee (DOTM)
Part 1
*Hound: I love starting my day with a gunfight. Are you back for more, little guy? Where's your human master?
*Bumblebee: Slow down, Hound. I come alone. Optimus sent me.
*Hound: I figured he might. What does the boss want me to do? Sell out to the humans? Oh, I forgot, that's your thing.
*Bumblebee: I'm not here to trade insults. I'm here to give you what you need.
*Hound: Loyal friends and human pesticide?
*Bumblebee: Funny. No, time. Time to look deep down in that spark of yours. This place is clouding your judgement. We're here for you, as is The Commander.
*Hound: Save me the sentimental scrap.
*Bumblebee: You'll come around. You have to if you want to survive here.
Part 2
*Bumblebee: You're back. Have you been thinking about what I told you?
*Hound: I've been blowing up stuff and firing my big guns. Does wonders for clearing my circuits.
*Bumblebee: Makes sense. And?
*Hound: I might...just...might...give these humans and weird others a chance. Or, I may end up fragging them.
*Bumblebee: You always resort to violence.
*Hound: I love violence.
*Bumblebee: I know, but promise me it won't come to that.
*Hound: I don't make promises I'm not sure I'll keep, but I'll think about it.
Part 3
*Optimus Primal: Where is he?
*Bumblebee: Are you talking about my main Bot, Hound? Relax, he's taking some time to get himself sorted.
*Optimus Primal: Time is not not something we can spare. He just blew up a munitions cache that caused serious collateral damage.
*Bumblebee: It's how he meditates. Trust me, he's almost where we need him.
*Rhinox: We need him here. Now.
*Bumblebee: That's not gonna happen.
*Rhinox: Says who?
*Bumblebee: Says me.

sections.heading: Bad Idea, Good Deal
sections.text:
* Boss: Hound
Part 1
*Hound: The monkey and the lizard? You're entering a world of pain.
*Dinobot:LIZARD!? Let me just extinguish this overweight bag's spark now!
*Optimus Primal: No, Dinobot, that is not our way. The Primes say there's hope he'll be swayed. But, Optimus, his antagonism and threats persist. You said he's better.
*Optimus Prime: I said he was making progress. Let me talk to him one last time.
*Dinobot: How many last chances does he get?
*Optimus Prime: All that are needed. Hound, come with me.
*Hound: Ahhh, ok. You're The Prime. The real Prime!
Part 2
*Optimus Prime: I need you to stop. Stop running, stop threatening, stop fighting. It is over.
*Hound: I know... I know. But, I ain't gonna just roll over like a punk. It ain't the Hound way.
*Optimus Prime: I am not asking you to roll over. I am asking you to do what is right for everyone for everyone concerned. Before someone gets killed.
*Hound: I've got an idea. One last fight?
*Optimus Prime: That is a bad idea.
*Hound: Yo know I'm all about bad ideas. But, on this one, I need you to trust me.
*Optimus Prime: My trust you have. My protection, however, will not last if you fail.
Part 3
*Dinobot: We meet again. This time you don't have your precious boss or shiny yellow savior to protect you.
*Hound: I'm a big bot...
*Dinobot: Big? Obese? Semantics.
*Hound: So, I'll let that slide. But, you're right. I have been talking to the boss bot and Bee, They've convinced me I can trust you and the Commander. Almost.
*Optimus Primal: Almost?
*Hound: Before I go all in on the trust thing. I'll make you a deal. You beat me in a little bit of the old rough and tumble, and I'll stop blowing up stuff. Deal?
*Optimus Primal: An odd deal, but if that's what it takes... deal!

What horrors does it hold? There is much debate, even amongst the Autobots, about what to do with this dangerous gate. Will the Autobots find a way home? Or will they discover there is NO WAY BACK?

sections.heading: Bio
sections.text: The Maximal starship Axalon, commanded by Optimus Primal was pulled into a Transwarp Portal while in pursuit of a Predacon warship. Stranded on ancient Earth, Primal and his crew of Maximals fought the Beast Wars to preserve the timeline and protect all life in the galaxy.

sections.heading: Abilties
sections.text:
*Passive:
**Armor Buffs provide 100% Critical Resistance.
**Every 6 seconds if Optimus Primal has no Armor Buffs he will generate an Armor Buff, reducing damage from attacks by 2~4%. This ability stops if Optimus Primal is Armor Broken.
*When Attacked:
**20% chance to gain an Armor Buff, reducing damage from attacks by 2~4% with a maximum of 10 stacks of Armor. This ability requires at least one active Armor Buff and stops if Optimus Primal is Armor Broken.
*Blocked Melee Attacks: Blocked Melee Hits have a 30% chance to grant a Melee Buff, increasing Melee Damage by 10~18% for 6 seconds.
*Heavy Attacks: Converts all Armor Buffs to Melee Buffs, increasing Melee Damage by 10~18% for 6 seconds.

sections.heading: Special Attacks
sections.text:
#Law of the Jungle - Optimus Primal launches into the air to bring justice to his foes.
#*If Optimus Primal has received any Bleeds this fight he will inflict Bleed on the opponent that deals 30~38% of Attack over 4 seconds. The strength of the Bleed increases by 20% for each Bleed inflicted on Optimus Primal this fight.
#Beast Warrior - The quickest way to peace, is to end the battle quickly.
#*50% chance each sword hit to inflict Bleed, Dealing 40~60% of Attack as damage over 5 seconds.
#Gorilla Warfare - When it comes to dealing with Predacons, sometimes brutal is best.
#*Optimus Primal’s rage grants him the maximum amount of Armor Buffs.
#*100% chance to inflict Attack Down, reducing the opponent’s Attack Rating by -20% for 32 seconds.

sections.heading: Synergy Bonuses
sections.text:
* Allies Dinobot, Rhinox, Cheetor- +2~3~8% Armor Rating.
* Enemies – Waspinator, Scorponok - +2~3~8% Attack Rating.
* Beast Ancestor - Tantrum - After each Heavy Attack, this bot gains a Beast Fury buff that grants Attacks a 5~8~15% chance to be Unblockable for 6 seconds.
* Beast Purification - Optimus Primal - Heavy Attacks of Beast Wars characters grant 4~12~20% Attack Rating for 5 seconds and Purify Damaging Debuffs as long as there are 2 or more Beast Wars bots on Primal’s team.
* Leadership (5-Star) - All Bots - Acting as a beacon of leadership for the team, all lower tier teammates gain +10% Attack Rating.

sections.heading: Commander
sections.text:
Optimus Primal's Critical Armor protects him from the potent Critical Hits of not only Warriors but also from the likes of Demolitions Bots and Scouts as well. 

His Heavy Attack behaves like a ranged attack, but hits like a melee attack. Consider when it is best to trade Critical Armor for Melee Buffs; a wrong move could leave Primal vulnerable to Criticals and debuffs and lose his Melee Buffs. Always unleash a Heavy Attack right before activating a Special 3, so he can pound opponents harder and gain a full stack of Critical Armor.

Like Ramjet, Primal's Special 2 had a bug where he could whiff and miss if he uses it immediately after a melee combo. Wait for a split half-second after the last hit fo a combo for the hit to connect.

sections.heading: Opponent
sections.text:
Never bleed the ape, Bleeding him will just fuel his Special I. Also, if he's Awakened, all damaging debuffs on him will expire quicker and he'll heal from bleeds.

You won't be able to score Criticals while his Crit Armor is active. An Armor Break will shut them off.

sections.heading: Strong Match-Ups
sections.text:
*Bonecrusher will lose the ability to land Critical Hits and the Bleeds he inflicts will soon become an advantage for Optimus Primal’s first Special Attack.
*Ironhide’s greatest strength is his ability to deal out incredible Critical Hits. Optimus Primal will render the master of burns unable to tear anything apart.
*Kickback’s ability to power leak will all be contained by Primal’s Critical Armor. The only way Kickback can inflict Power Leak against Optimus Primal is when he uses his Heavy Attacks and that is also the time on when Kickback puts T-Clog.
*Megatron (ROTF) relies on critical damage for his Impair Charges to take effect. Critical damage that the demolition king won't be able to inflict.

sections.heading: Weak Match-Ups
sections.text:
*Starscream will tear through Optimus Primal’s Armor allowing him to inflict Critical Hits while the Ape’s Armor is Broken.
*The permanent armor break duo, Megatron and Optimus Prime will do what they can to block Optimus Primal’s Crit Armor from activating and in doing so the Ape’s Crit armor is as good as gone. An awakened megatron in particular can steal the Ape’s crit armor and melee buffs leaving the king of the jungle with little to no buffs while fighting Megatron.
*Cheetor's signature ability will allow him to punch through Primal’s Crit Armor, and if the ape thinks he’s going to heal from Bleeds, Cheetor’s Repair Block will put a stop to that idea.
*Grimlock relies on melee buffs not critical hits to deal massive damage which Primal’s critic armor has no answer to and the bleeds Primal used against him will be purified. The burns too will deal more damage than Optimus Primal can repair.
*Galvatron and Megatronus have potent instant damage abilities that will easily bypass Primal's Crit Armor. Megatronus in particular can also Armor Break and has the Relic of Obedience, meaning that Primal will lose his Crit Armor and melee buffs rather quickly.
*Cyclonus’s sword can pierce even through even the thickest of Optimus Primal’s crit armor and can Nullify the ape’s melee and crit armor buffs with his dark fields.

sections.heading: Recommended Modules
sections.text:
The King of the Jungle will effectively protect your Base with these Modules.
*Security Module – Increasing Optimus Primal’s Armor will make him more survivable and give him more opportunity to use his high attack rating against the opponent, and who doesn't want protection of his crit armor buffs?
*E.M.I. Module – Optimus Primal’s biggest disadvantage is his reliance on Melee Attacks. This module will help ensure he can thwart ranged opponents like that pesky Starscream.
*Harm Accelerator - To other bots, a Harm Accelerator on the opponent may seem detrimental, but to Primal, it just makes his Special I more powerful, and with an Awakened Signature and Beast Purification, the Bleed debuff will just expire earlier and Primal will heal instead.
*Superconductors 1000 and 2000 - Effective when he has Melee Buffs.
*Robot Resource - Kickback might be able to consume the buff but won't able to land crits that leak his power.
*Strange Refractor - More effective melee attacks when blocking.

Ore-13 is a substance used to upgrade Bots and Mods and increase their level. 

Grey, Basic Ore-13 is obtained, among other things, by completing Solo Missions and Raids, Away Missions, Alliance Quests, from some Crystals, and duplicate Mods.

sections.heading: Strategy
sections.text:
This Mod is best suited for bots who can deal an additional debuff after stunning with a Special Attack.
* If Megatron stuns an opponent with a Special Attack, it will leave them vulnerable to a blast from the Fusion Cannon, and thus fusing a debuff.
* The chance to Stun gives Waspinator’s Sting more time to shine by keeping opponents from escaping while they’re vulnerable.
* When Windblade reaches four Bleed stacks, her Stuns will be prolonged.
* This will mesh well with Ramjet’s up-close fighting style, turning the master of Stuns into an absolute wrecking ball against his helpless opponents.
* When the opponent Stuns themselves, that’s when Jazz deals the most damage.

sections.heading: Raids
sections.text:
* Cheetor's Power will be completely unaffected by the Stun Ray.
* Power Gain bots like Soundwave can charge Power faster and get a Special 2 in before it's drained. 
* Megatronus’s ability to switch relics will only be delayed as his passive power gain will only be drained away. 
* Rodimus Prime’s stun immunity will make sure he will no longer get stunned after his health reaches below 40% 
* Ramjet can ignore stuns if he has loads of momentum

sections.heading: Synopsis
sections.text:
A Missing Leader, An Ally Caught in the Crosshairs

Commanders!

Optimus Prime is missing. The Autobot leader has vanished, and the only Bot that can track him down is the one that all of the Autobots suspect of a brutal act of malfeasance. All suspicions point at Prowl, who is hot on the case.

It’s up to you to help Prowl prove his innocence in this month’s Spotlight Mission: Prime Suspect!

sections.heading: Changes/Rewards
sections.text: Same as previous Spotlights.

sections.heading: Transcript
sections.text: {{DiaC|red|This Spotlight was written from Prowl's point of view}}

sections.heading: = Part 1 =
= Part 2 =
sections.text:
* Prowl: Suspect Ramjet has been spotted. He is, unsurprisingly acting erratically...
* ...suppose if he had any sense to his circuits he wouldn't be a Decepticon.
* Ramjet: OH! So you know all about me? See a decal on my nose-cone and you got my WHOLE story?
* Prowl: I can judge a book by its cover when the title is "Destroy the innocent".
* Ramjet: See, you already got it wrong, I wanna destroy EVERYBODY. Innocent is just more fun.

sections.heading: = Part 3 =
sections.text:
* Motormaster: Back down Mr. Goody-Two-Axles. Before I run ya' off the road.
* Prowl: Put it in park Motormaster. Behave and maybe I can let you off with a warning or community service.
* Motormaster: Warn about what? Pulling a hydraulic line as I pound you into dust?
* Prowl: You don't want to test me.
* Motormaster: So ya' scrapped Optimus, you think ya' can take down the King of the Road?
* Prowl: OPTIMUS? What are you talking about?
* Motormaster: Yeah, play dumb. It suits you.

sections.heading: = Part 1 =
sections.text:
* Prowl: Log 917-84 continued: As expected, Ramjet and Motormaster paint chips matched those found scraped off against our base...
* ...however, the case is far from closed. The head-butting buddies got it in their tchick domes that we were without leadership.
* Starscream: Oh, I heard more than just that...I hear that a certain good cop has gone delightfully bad.
* Prowl: You have the right to remain silent, Starscream. I suggest you make use of it.
* Starscream: Strong silent type isn't my brand.

sections.heading: = Part 2 =
sections.text:
* Starscream: I know a thing or two about your case. Prime is missing and they found a siren at his last known whereabouts.
* Prowl: Circumstantial evidence that will be cleared up when I show up in fully working order.
* Starscream: Yeah, but if I punch a few of your lights out...that'd complicate things wouldn't it?
* Prowl: You talk better than you fight and you know it. Tell me where you got this intel.
* Starscream: I told you everything I want to. I'm not sharing one bit more.
* Prowl: Log 917-84 continued: Witness is hostile. I'll have to try some more drastic interrogation.

sections.heading: = Part 3 =
sections.text:
* Starscream: Fine, I'll help you. But when I come back I'm going to be expecting some payment. 
* Ratchet: PROWL! I came to see that the rumors weren't true but...Starscream doesn't work for anyone with good intentions. 
* Prowl: It's not what it appears to be Ratchet, I'm finding answers and following protocols. 
* Ratchet: You want protocol? Fine...shut down so I can run a full diagnostics on you. Maybe scan your optic save-files and see what you've been looking at. 
* Prowl: We don't have time for that, the real suspect is getting further away as we argue. 
* Ratchet: Never been like you to avoid the rules Prowl, think it's time for a forced reboot to your core systems.

sections.heading: = Part 1 =
= Part 2 =
= Part 3 =
sections.text:
* Galvatron: As expected, failure. Galvatron is the only true power around here. No Megatron shall ever rule.
* Megatron: Megatronus will hear of your snide remarks.
* Prowl: Megatronus has slain Primes before...is he behind this?
* Galvatron: You're still here? I'll crush you and toss you in the Tomb that your Autobot compatriots used to delay Megatronus.
* Prowl: The Tomb of Relics...he was in there for months.
* Galvatron: Enough chatter! You shall be reduced to atoms!

sections.heading: = Part 1 =
sections.text:
* Prowl: Log 917-84 continued: Entering abandoned Tomb of Relics. Small particles of shattered glass on the ground...
* ..Glass is replicated from an automobile windshield. White metal flakes also present.
* Can't jump to any conclusions just yet. This Tomb has seen more than its share of battles, could be from a previous encounter.
* Tracker I planted on Starscream indicates he's headed towards my location. Hopefully with valuable intel...and not deadly intent.

sections.heading: = Part 2 =
sections.text:
* Megatronus: {{RedText|LEAVE THIS PLACE.}}
* Prowl: When a sinister force yells that, it always means you should stay.
* Megatronus: I am working towards a goal that will change worlds. I have not the time for your distraction.
* Prowl: What did you do to Optimus Prime?
* Megatronus: You chase 13? He is an afterthought, a weak whimper in the roar of my glory and unworthy of my attention.
* Prowl: You'll forgive me if I don't take your word on that.
* Megatronus: Know this, I may be struck down but shall soon be returning in a form that will melt the optics from your head to gaze upon.
* Prowl: I'll take that into consideration.
Part 3
* Prowl: Log 917-84 continued: Megatronus held no answers, just more questions. His Energon signature seems to indicate that--
* Starscream: {{RedText|PROWL! BEHIND YOU!}}
* Shockwave: Starscream? Truly you are a traitor to all causes.
* Starscream: Spare me your false indignity Shockwave. As though you don't turn towards whatever power is in charge.
* Shockwave: I prioritize self preservation. Now stand aside.
* Starscream: I need this Autobot to continue functioning.
* Shockwave: Pointless squabbles on a world waiting to destroy us all. So be it, I shall end your struggles this day.

sections.heading: = Part 1 =
sections.text:
* Starscream: I may double cross, but Shockwave manages to triple or quadruple cross on this world.
* Prowl: Starscream, with your constant urge to defeat other Decepticons...It could be you're on the wrong side.
* Starscream: Are you calling ME an...AUTOBOT?
* Prowl: I'm saying, you keep this up you can be something besides a Decepticon.
* Starscream: Thanks...I hate it.

sections.heading: = Part 2 =
sections.text:
* Prowl: What intel did you gather? You said you had information for me.
* Starscream: What ABOUT you than FOR you. There's a bounty on your head. I can only collect it if you're not scrapped.
* Prowl: THIS is why you stepped in with Shockwave?
* Starscream: Can't profit if you're in pieces, not until they've taken what they need.
* Prowl: Speak plainly, who is seeking me out?
* Starscream: You'll find out soon enough.

sections.heading: = Part 3 =
= Part 1 =
sections.text:
* Prowl: Log 917-84 Continued: Grimlock unlikely to be the mastermind of this, he is a blunt instrument..but who was wielding him.
* Megatronus claimed to be working on something bigger. Could be a lie. Could be a smoke-screen or some darker plan.
* ...still this world is tearing itself apart. Time itself is unraveling, it's hard to tell what's coming next.
* Arcee: Prowl...help.
* Prowl: {{RedText|ON MY WAY!}}

sections.heading: = Part 2 =
sections.text:
* Prowl: Arcee? Where are you? What's happening?
* Arcee: As expected, you fly in to battle without looking, like a white knight.
* Prowl: ...you sound different.
* Arcee: Different doesn't scratch the surface. I've passed through some doors that can't ever be shut again.
* Prowl: You're not Arcee are you?
* Arcee: Awww, look at you piecing things together. It's cute.

sections.heading: = Part 3 =
sections.text:
* Prowl: Log 917-84 Continued: A duplicate, or possessed, or ...altered Arcee seems to be behind this plot. Will be taking her back to base for questioning.
* Arcee: You think I did this all alone? We have been sneaking through since the time-space gates shattered.
* Prowl: ...You're from another timeline?
* Arcee: Another DIMENSION. We have been replacing you, replicating you, we ARE you. Look to the shadows, Prowl.
* Prowl: Log 917-84 Continued: There's a reflection here. Something is wrong. I...by the Primes...
* IT's ME! ... but one of his lights is cracked...
* THEY WERE RIGHT! PROWL DID DO SOMETHING TO PRIME!
* TRUST NO ONE!

Progression.lead: Progression in Forged to Fight was completely different prior to its second wind on Netflix.

sections.heading: Kabam
sections.text:
Exploring Story missions yielded a lot of XP to reach level 30 by the time you wrapped up Act Two or Three (faster if you've got an XP boost.

Gold could be earned by progressing through missions, putting Bots on your base, Gold, Daily, 4-Hour, or Arena Crystals, helping your fellow Commanders in your Alliance, Daily Deals, duplicated Bots and Mods, and forging.

Energon, while a "hard currency" (as in you have to pay real money for them), could still be earned through gameplay.

Ore-13 could be earned through gameplay and forging Bots and Sparks could either also be obtained through such, or buying bundles with real money.

You get Bots by spinning Bot Crystals - and most of the time, you wouldn't get the Bot you've wanted. And if you wanted a specific Bot, especially when new, you'd have to drop some real-life money to buy Energon to get those Crystals, and even then, you wouldn't get the Bot anyway. In the 2020s, Bot Chips became abundant, eventually becoming the main currency of the game, replacing the single-Bot specific Bot Chips, which were all converted. Then, say hello to Titan Fragments, which were currency earned in Alliance Missions to get the most exclusive Bots, like Megatronus.

All that, until...

sections.heading: Netflix
sections.text:
...Kabam made progression significantly easier* (kinda) in the Netflix release of the game.

This time, you can get Bots all through spending Bot Chips, with most Bots being unavailable until a set release (re: Beast Wars Bots). Working up the order in Story Missions - completing Act One, Chapter Two gives a 2-Star Dirge, Three 2-Star Motormaster, completing that Act gives you a 3-Star Dead End, Act Two, Act Two a 3-Star Shockwave, completing that Act a 4-Star Megatron, the list goes on!

All T2 and T3 Class Sparks are now obtainable with Energon that you get completely through gameplay! But Alpha Sparks are still rather difficult to come by.

Ore-13 remains obtainable through gameplay, as is Gold.

Raid Chip.lead:
Raid Chips are a currency used to purchase items in the Raid Store. They are primarily earned through Raids, but they can be also earned through Away Missions and Alliance Quests.

Your Raid Chip stash, unlike other currencies, is fluid, as they can be stolen from your Base by other Commanders. A successful attack an a base gives a Commander 10% of the opponent Commander's current amount of chips. A successful base defense gives a Commander around 500-600 Raid Chips. Defeating a Base Defender also gives a small amount of Raid Chips; the higher the Bot's rating, the more chips awarded.

It is recommended to leave Raid Chips earned in Alliance Quests unclaimed as a temporary untouchable stash so you can later use them if you are a few chips short from getting a certain item.

Raid.lead: Raids is a versus Game mode in which players attack other players' Bases to win Raid Chips and Medals.

sections.heading: System
sections.text:
Raids are unlocked at player level 7. To start a Raid, you need to spend 1 Raid Ticket, which you have up to three at a time. Each ticket takes an hour to recharge, but you can buy another ticket for 10 Energon each.

Initially, you were presented with 3 Commander you could choose to raid within one minute. Should you wish to change the selection, you had to spend another Raid Ticket. In version 3.0, this system was revamped: You are now presented one Commander according to your current amount of Medals, and selecting another base costs 2, 6, or 10 Energon, depending on the presented base's total rating.

You have 20 minutes (originally 15) to defeat the opponent Bots before time runs out or your Bots are all knocked out.

After a Bot is used for raiding, he/she cannot be placed on your Base for a period of time. Listed are cooldown times for each star rating:
* 1-Star: 5 minutes
* 2-Star: 20 minutes
* 3-Star: 2 hours
* 4- and 5-star: 4 hours
You can view your attacks and the attacks on your Base in the Raid Center. Should the raider win, you will lose about 30 Medals and 10% of your current amount of Raid Chips. Should your defense be successful, you will earn about 15-30 Medals and about 500 Raid chips.

Raid Shields can protect your base from being attacked for a period of time. But you cannot raid yourself while a shield is active, or else the shield will be removed.

sections.heading: Revenge
sections.text: When you are attacked, you have the opportunity to attack the player back, even if the attack was a failure. The same rules for raiding apply for revenge; it costs one raid ticket, and you are able to steal raid chips from the player. The opportunity to revenge expires after a period of time, usually 24 hours. But often the base attacker is unavailable to be raided.

sections.heading: Raid Events
sections.text: There are regular week-long special Raid Events when you can win Bot Chips in addition to the normal rewards. They are also accompanied with a Raid Ascent Alliance Quest. The more Medals you have, the more Chips you can earn. If you fail a raid, you will still receive half the potential amount of Bot Chips.

sections.heading: Early Raid Events
sections.text: The first raid events with Bot Chips (all-or-nothing 60-90 Chips per Raid) were available in Raids for 2-Star Bots released at the time. Each 2-Star Bot cost 1000 Chips, but Shockwave's Raid Event introduced the 3-Star version available for 10000 Chips.

sections.heading: Featured Bot Raid Events
sections.text: Starting from October, there is a Raid Event for each month's Featured Bot on the third week of the Bot's debut.

sections.heading: Throwback Week
sections.text: Running from March 8th at 10 AM to March 15th at 10 AM Pacific Time, Commanders could earn Exclusive 2-Star Bot Chips from Raids to purchase exclusive 2-Star Bots of all Bots released after launch. (586 Chips per Raid in the 1250~ Medal range) 2 to 3 Bots were available for two days in the Raid Store each day, which could be bought for 2000 Chips each, maximum 5 for each Bot. The final days of the event offered 12 x500 bundles of 2-Star Exclusive Chips for 20 Energon each, and had all 16 Bots available at once.

sections.heading: Special Abilities
sections.text:
#Impact Wrench - Maximum torque for minimum exertion.
#* 40% chance to Stun for 2.5 seconds. This chance increases by 20% per stack of Shock.
#Emergency Response - Help yourself before helping others.
#* Generates up to 20-28.8% Power based on lost Health.
#* Repairs 14-17% of damage taken.
#Diagnostic Scan - Ratchet scans his target to check for vitals... and weak points.
#* 100% chance to inflict Shock, dealing 75-90% Attack over 4 seconds.
#* Grants 50% Critical Hit Rate on Melee attacks for 16 seconds.

sections.heading: Synergy Bonuses
sections.text:
* Allies - Jazz, Grimlock - +1~2~3~8% Armor.
* Allies - Ironhide (ROTF) - +1~2~3~8% Armor.
* Chief Medical Officer - Optimus Prime - Up to 100% chance based lost Health to Repair 1.5-10% of base Health instead of gaining an Attack Buff when Rolling Out.
* Medic Support - Ironhide, Bumblebee (DOTM) - 1.3~2.5~7% of base health repaired at the start of the fight. +3~4~5% extra repair in Raids.
* Brain Drain - Shockwave - 20~90% chance to Stun the opponent for 2.5 seconds on Shockwave’s Special 2.
* Brothers in Arms - Optimus Prime - 2~3~8% Armor for Autobots as well as +4~6~8% Melee Damage in Solo Missions.
* Till All Are One - Bumblebee - +2~3~8% Attack Rating for Autobots. +6~8~10% Debuff Damage for Autobots in Raids.
* Leadership (5-Star) - +10% Power Rate.

sections.heading: Commander
sections.text:
If Ratchet is low on health, use heavy attacks and Special 2 as much as possible. (But not at times when the opponent can easily hit you with ranged attacks) This allows him to use his Repair ability and recover health. As long as his heavy attack is not disrupted, his Repair activates even if his heavy attack does not hit.

Dealing shock damage from ranged attacks and healing at the same time is a good technique, so is using his Special 3 right after a heavy. 

Ratchet's Synergy with Optimus has helped many Commanders out with Rulers of Kaon, try it out!

sections.heading: Opponent
sections.text:
Ratchet is the only Tech bot besides Shockwave who does not possess any kinds of Shields. The easiest counter to Ratchet's Repairs are Repair Blocks; Power Gains can be neutralized with Power Locks.

Try to engage Ratchet in hand-to-hand combat as often as possible, as it's not advisable to take ranged shock damage. It’s also noted that an Al Ratchet loves to spam heavy attacks which can sometimes be annoying and it’s best to disrupt the heavy attack with ranged attacks. Bots with heavy ranged attacks will help you well since bots with heavy ranged attacks will mostly win against bots who has melee heavy attacks in a heavy to heavy collision

It's also better to use several lighter attacks than high-damage critical attacks, as he may undo the damage with his Emergency Repair.

sections.heading: Strong Match-Ups
sections.text:
*Megatron (ROTF)’s abilities will be hampered if the media can undo the damage Megatron has inflicted with his impair charges and the Shocks and the Special 3 will ignore Megatron’s tough armor
* Galvatron will be less likely to activate Will of Unicron if Ratchet can keep his health up.

sections.heading: Weak Match-Ups
sections.text:
* Cheetor's Repair Block and Power Locks will take this medic back to the repair bay.
* Windblade can use her Special 3 to prevent Ratchet from activating his emergency response due to her damage-chipping method to bring down her opponent's health or use her Special 1 to neutralize his Self-Diagnosis. She can inflict Bleed by attacking him with light and medium attacks to counter his Repair.
*Bonecrusher’s debuffs will deal more damage than the medic has to repair and the medic relies on Melee Crit Rate on Special 3 which is something the Master of Bleeds can take advantage of and those Bleeds will respectively reduce Power Gain.
* Kickback is the perfect counter to Ratchet. It’s all about his heavy attacks which will consume any power gains, self-diagnostics, and shocks that Ratchet grants or inflicts as well as prevent Ratchet from spamming heavy attacks especially to activate self diagnostics with T-Clog.
* Megatron can steal Ratchet’s self diagnostics and emergency repairs if he activates them from his heavies if he has a fused debuff especially a shock debuff which can deal more damage the medic has to repair
*Grindor’s signature ability can put a damper to Ratchet’s plans because the autobot medic gains a lot of power because of his self diagnosis and special ll and the more power he gets, the stronger the deception helicopter becomes. 
*Bumblebee can lock Ratchet’s Self-Diagnosis Power Gain with his Special 2.
* Shockwave's shocks prevent Ratchet from gaining any power and health. Battle of the big brain big thomp begins. 
* Grimlock will find Ratchet’s shocks only to be a minor annoyance and the king’s attacks will deal more damage than the medic has to repair.
* Megatronus can steal power from Ratchet with the relic of fury and health with the relic of preservation and the relic of obedience can prevent Ratchet from gaining any emergency repairs or self diagnosis despite the class type advantages.

sections.heading: Recommended Modules
sections.text:
Defend your base with the Autobot Medic and these Mods!
* The Repair Module can recover more health in addition to his own Repairs.
* The Tech Console will greatly enhance his Repairs, Power Gain, and Shocks.
* The Transwarp Cell will allow Ratchet to use Heavy Attack more often, especially if he is below 50% health allowing him to activate self-diagnosis more often
* The Robot Resource/Superconductor 2000 will allow Ratchet to get to his Special II and more frequent Repairs faster.

sections.text:
* Reinforcement Crystal - The first crystal a player receives, a 1-star Ratchet can be obtained from this starter crystal.

* December 2017 offered a free Google Play exclusive 2-Star Ratchet bundle, and a 3-Star Ratchet bundle available to purchase for USD $9.99.

Rebel Raptor.lead:
{{Spoiler Warning}}

Rebel Raptor is a Chrono-Vector featuring Dinobot that ran from December 26, 2019 to January 7, 2020.

sections.heading: Synopsis
sections.text: This mission revolves around Dinobot's defection to the Maximals, shown in the Beast Wars episodes "Beast Wars (Part 1)" and "Part 2". Wheeljack, while stuck in the alternate Megatronus dimension, apparently could transmit data back to Marissa Faireborn in New Quintessa, though it is tricky to decipher what he sent.

sections.heading: 1: Buzz-Off
sections.text:
Part 1:

Marissa Faireborn: Commander, Wheeljack may not be here but his tech is still causing trouble! There's a Chrono-Event in progress, looks like a Maximal issue that needs resolving.

Make sure history happens correctly and it should close. It's a lot of guesswork on inter-reality time-travel.

Part 2:

Waspinator: More come to challenge WAZZZPINATOR? Kitty-bot sent for reinforcementzzz? Many quezzztionzzz!

Maybe Wazzzpinator should invezzztigate carefully before launching into an attack...OR

WAZZZPINATOR! TERRORIZZZE!

sections.heading: 2: Go Ape
sections.text:
Part 1:

Marissa: Wheeljack left behind some notes on how to read his tech but it's like translating a translation of a photocopy. I'm trying my best to help here.

Apparently you need to...keep the vectors in the time-box? That can't be right. I'll see what Teletraan computes and report back.

Part 2:

Optimus Primal: Seems as though the abundance of Energon on this planet is causing hallucinations.

I see a human...commanding a team of mixed timelines and realities.

I may be losing my mind, but will not lose this fight!

sections.heading: 3: Endangered
sections.text:
Part 1: 

Marissa: Alright I've aligned the Chrono-Vector readouts and I've figured out where you are.

You passed through both the future AND the past!

The Maximals and Predacons JUST crash landed on ancient Earth. The important historical event to protect is to making sure Dinobot swaps teams.

There's an incredible amount of time-deformation so just keep that one event on track and we'll be good...probably.

Part 2:

Rhinox: I heard the Predacons were up to no good. But I didn't think they'd stoop to replicating heroes and villains of the past.

You got some Spark on you kid, I'll give you that...but I'm not about to sit back as you charge through here.

sections.heading: 4: Need For Speed
sections.text:
Part 1: 

Marissa: Okay Commander, luckily the Maximals took some heavy fire when they first appeared so your battles shouldn't mess the timeline up too bad.

I'm trying to send you some coordinates to the Predacon base but something's trying to block my signals

Cheetor: What's wrong? Cat got your tounge?

Marissa: Not another Maximal, make a run for it Commander!

Part 2: 

Cheetor: You're trying to out pace me? Have you seen the spots? This kitty is made for speed!

I don't need to know who you are to know I'm going to run circles around you!

sections.heading: 5: Clamp Down
sections.text:
Part 1:

Marissa: Alright Predacon base dead-ahead. Dinobot should be standing in the docking bay.

Scorponok: Dinobot? That twerp? I just gave him double rockets and fired him into the horizon.

Marissa: Ah, that would explain some of these read-outs.

Part 2:

Scorponok: So you're all buddy-buddy with the puny dino huh? Trying to overthrow the MIGHTY Predacons?

Waspinator: THEY ARE EVIL! THEY BEAT UP ALL BOTZZZ ON PLANET!

Scorponok: That so? Well if you're so tough, I'd like to see you take ME on.

Waspinator: WAZZZPINATOR WANTZZZ THAT TOO! BEAT UP SCORPONOK!

Scorponok: Hey! Who's side are you on?

Waspinator: Wazzzpinator juzzzt enjoyzzz cheering izzz all...

sections.heading: 6: Prove Your Might
sections.text:
Part 1:

Marissa: You've made a bit of a reputation for yourself, but that can work in our favor. Dinobot doesn't respect a chain of command but he does respect a show of strength.

When you get to him, we'll just claim we're on the Maximal side and we'll get him to join us.

Worse case scenario, he doesn't help the Maximals save the earliest human ancestors...so...no pressure. I'll do all the talking.

Part 2:

Marissa: Dinobot? Can you read me! I present to you the mighty Commander of the Maximal forces.

Dinobot: This...meat thing? I only know Primal as the leader of the Maximals.

Marissa: You dare disrespect them? They have defeated ALL in their path! Join them and be on the side of might and glory!

Dinobot: Glory is it? Very well. Prove to me the strength of the Maximals, and then I will join their cause.

Relic.lead:
Relics are rare collectible items that give a small permanent boost when placed on the Commander's Base. Up to four Relics can be placed in a Base. They can be acquired in Story and Special Missions, or purchased in the Raid Store in exchange of currencies like Chips or Relic Tickets. They can be sold for a mere 500 Gold.

Starting from Tantrum's Spotlight Missions in July 2018, selections of previous Special Mission Relics are available to purchase for two months at at time with Raid Tickets earned by mastering Spotlight Missions. Tier 1 Relics cost two tickets, Tier 2 three tickets, Tier 3 four tickets, Tier 4 five tickets, and a special, rare relic for 20 tickets. Only one of each can ever be bought, so you'll end up with a huge stack of unusable tickets.

Green Revive Kits revive Bots if they are knocked out during a mission.

sections.heading: Defense
sections.text:
The Repair Module is generally useful for any Bot. But, it is recommended to pair this Module with Bots with a high health rating and armor or resistance, like Grindor, Ultra Magnus, or Grimlock.

It can also be used to give an additional Repair boost to Bots with their own healing abilities to prolong battles, such as Ratchet, Blaster, and Waspinator.

But as Bots get stronger, the fixed amount of health are pitifully negligible.

sections.heading: Raids
sections.text:
* Shockwave's and Cheetor's Special Attacks can inflict Repair Block, and as such can prevent the opponent from recovering Health if timed properly.
*Grimlock, Megatron (ROTF) and the demolitions’ massive damages will cause more health to deplete that the repair module can repair.
*Megatronus, Megatron (GS) and Nemesis Prime can steal the health that was repaired by the repair module.

Revenge of the King.lead: Revenge of the King is the second Legends of Cybertron mission, Succeeding Rulers of Kaon and preceding Rise of Kolkular.

sections.heading: Intro
sections.text:
Start:

* Optimus Prime: Grimlock, the wastelands of New Quintessa grow with bots claiming to be legends. Pretenders to the title Legends of Cybertron.
* Grimlock: Me Grimlock is only legend that matters. Me King, me rule all!
* Optimus Prime: Forgive me old friend, but I recall you did not fare as well as I would have predicted when the legends gathered last.
* Grimlock: Arrrrgh! That was stupid Megatron's fault. This time different. Me Grimlock will crush all!
* Optimus Prime: And how will this time be different? Megatron and others are out there and they are stronger than ever.
* Grimlock: Me Grimlock look past that past to real past. The ground will shake and enemies quake. This time King Grimlock is getting Jurassic!

End:

* Grimlock: Bah, you made it this far. Me Grimlock told Optimus me the only Legend that matters. Me Grimlock show you that me king!

Rise of Kolkular.lead:
{{StoryArc|Revenge of the King|TBA|Legends of Cybertron}}

Rise of Kolkular is the third Legends of Cybertron mission introduced February 14, 2020.

sections.heading: Intro
sections.text:
*Marissa Faireborn: Commander, there's Space Bridge activity but it's... strange. It's causing dark skies, bad weather, and it's raining SCRAP!
*Thundercracker: Yes, it seems someone has brought THE THUNDER! I've found a way to make something worthwhile in this wasteland.
*Marissa Faireborn: The bridge is unstable Thundercracker, No one will be able to pass through it.
*Thundercracker: I'm not looking for friends, I'm looking for POWER! I'm brining a bit of home here, Behold KOLKULAR!
*Marissa Faireborn: Commander, Teletraan confirms that pieces of the Decepticon Command have begun raining down upon New Quintessa.
*Thundercracker: Ancient power, magnificent corruption, and true doom shall come with it. None shall challenge the reign of Thundercrakcer!
*Marissa Faireborn: Commander, you should probably...challenge that reign. Be careful though, it looks like power levels in the area have been increased!

sections.heading: End
sections.text:
* Thundercracker: Pathetic beast. Formed of meat and shackled by gravity. You dare to call yourself COMMANDER?
* I have found the Cradle of the Decepticons. I have absorbed power and become stronger than you have ever known me to be.
* I shall scatter your ashes to the winds. Then at least your ghost will know the glory of residing in the sky!

sections.heading: Bots
sections.text:
"Commanders, Thundercracker has harnessed a Space Bridge to summon the power of the Decepticon Command Capitol, Kolkular, Take your best duo of Bots to face off against the strongest enemies yet! There are also 7 unique lanes of enemies to fight, with 6 of the lanes requiring specific Classes."

All bots on this mission have no mods, just Special 3 unlocked. Like arena fights but harder as they have around 1 million plus health.

You can only bring in 2 bots and there are 6 class gates to access.

Thundercracker is at the end point of the mission.

sections.heading: Base Defense
sections.text:
All Bots can generally benefit from having Power generated for their Special Attacks, but the most effective pairings are with Bots with devastating Special 2's and 3's such as Ironhide or Prowl, or with Bots with their own Power Gain abilities like Sideswipe, Soundwave, and especially Megatronus. (As if he wasn't overpowered enough) Hot Rod gains more power with his Acceleration buffs. 

Abilities that depend on filled Power Bars, like Feral Strike (if duped) and Cyclonus' Dark Fields, will activate more under this Mod.

sections.heading: Raids
sections.text:
* Rhinox can temporarily Power Lock to prevent power gain for a few seconds, and nullify Special Buffs with his Special 1.
* Windblade and Kickback can nullify the Power Gain buff until it reactivates when the opponent activates a Special Attack which can be nullified again.
* Hot Rod is a tertiary choice, as his deceleration debuffs reduce power gain.
* Necrotronus too, but he will need to inflict a debuff in order to do so.
* Grindor can Perforate powered bots and lock their Power and Specials.
* Grimlock’s high health will make sure the specials inflicted on him will only be a minor nuisance.

Rulers of Kaon.lead:
{{Stub}}

Rulers of Kaon is the first Legends of Cybertron Special Mission. It is an extremely long and difficult mission that only the strongest of Commanders could hope to complete. The next mission in this storyline is Revenge of the King, an even harder map.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text:
*Total Rating: 9,999,999
There are twelve Bots, two of each class, 4-Star and maxed. Each Bot has a rank 6 Utility Module effect and incredible amounts of Health and Attack thanks to the Megatronic Augmenter! A full roster of Rank 4~5 4-Star Bots, with activated Synergies, and loads of Repair and Revive Kits are crucial!

It is best to [https://forums.transformersforgedtofight.com/discussion/4327/rulers-of-kaon-guide read this guide by SkBirdman before you continue].

It is unknown if Rulers of Kaon had been changed for the Netflix release. Until further info surfaces, the Wiki will document information from the original game, which is historic and no longer updated.

* Optimus Prime: Commander, in the time of dire circumstances, it is wise to recall the words of the human philosopher Santayana, "Those who cannot remember the past are condemned to repeat it. "
* With this in mind, I present you with a series of challenges recalling the significant periods in Cybertron's history.
* First we explore the time when Megatron rose to power and recruited his first Decepticon warriors in the underground gladiatorial fights of Kaon.
* Megatron (ROTF): I did no such thing. You and I were once brothers in arms, until your weakness betrayed you. This fake history and alternative reality that you peddle is preposterous.
* Optimus Prime: Perhaps, in your reality things transpired differently, but not in mine.
* Megatron: You say I recruited warriors to do my bidding in these fights? Intriguing.
* I shall participate in your charade and see who amongst the assembled are worthy to join my cause. Mixmaster, do you have anything that might sway the odds in our favor?
* Mixmaster: Yes my master, I do. I've created a Megatronic Augmenter to greatly enhance the powers of your prospective warriors.
* Megatron: Excellent! I like the name. Let's try it out. You're first!

sections.heading: Mixmaster - Special Damage
sections.text:
Recommended Bots:
* Megatron to steal the buffs 
* Cyclonus and Starscream to nullify the buffs
* Shockwave to drain Power
* Wheeljack also to drain Power

Mixmaster's node consists of a Special Damage 300% mod, which will increase his Special Attack damage to catastrophic levels they will down your Bots if you don't dodge them in time.

To counter them, just make sure to close his Power Bar, or if he gets to fire them off, dodge them as much as possible. Though stealing that Special damage buff is an interesting tactic...

sections.heading: Sideswipe - Evade Power Gain
sections.text:
Recommended Bots:
* Hot Rod
* Drift
* Hound

Sideswipe's node consists of an Evade Power Gain mod, which grants him a burst of power the more he evades. Considering his already-high proficiency to evade, this will gradually become an annoyance...

To counter, try to prevent him from Evading - in that chance, any Warrior will do.

sections.heading: Grindor - Armor Gain
sections.text:
Recommended Bots:
* Optimus Prime
* Megatron
* Ultra Magnus
* Megatronus with the Relic of Obedience

Grindor's node consists of an Armor Gain mod, which grants him high Armor. With this high Armor, regular attacks won't affect him.

Grindor is one of the easier fights if you're using your favorite Tactician to get rid of his Armor buffs.

*Note: when going against grindor he appeared to not have his most recent buff

sections.heading: Starscream - Enhanced Special 2
sections.text:
Recommended Bots:
* Galvatron
* Megatronus
* Shockwave
* Wheeljack

Starscream's node consists of an Enhanced Special 2 mod, which makes it unblockable.

To counter, simply either dodge his special 2 or prevent him from using it by cutting off his power gain.

sections.heading: Bludgeon - Trigger Rate Timed
sections.text:
Recommended Bots:
* Megatron
* Optimus Prime
* Optimus Primal so Bludgeon can't score Crits
* Optimus Prime (MV1) to counter Bleeds
* Megatronus with the Relic of Obedience

Bludgeon's node consists of a Trigger Rate Timed mod, which temporarily increases his trigger rate. Outside of his Metallikato Sig activating much more, his Armor Up will trigger much more frequently too.

To counter, chip away at his armor buffs with armor breaks while avoiding critical hits.

sections.heading: Soundwave - Block Proficiency
sections.text:
Recommended Bots:
* Megatron Heavies are high-risk
* Shockwave Heavies are high-risk
* Wheeljack
* Bumblebee/Cheetor to break Shields
* Rhinox/Grindor for Power Locks

Soundwave's node consists of a Block Proficiency mod, which increases the resistance against attacks while blocking. Also note the proficiency of his Sonic Shields, which will reflect all ranged attacks when it's active.

To counter, try not to allow him Power gain on Heavies.

* Grimlock: Me Grimlock don't need help from Megatron! King Grimlock is strongest of all! Bah, stupid Decepticon!

sections.heading: Grimlock - Special Attack Stun
sections.text:
Grimlock does not have any big buffs outside of the Special Attack Stun he has.

* Grimlock: The Commander is stronger than me remember. Next time me bring special Dinobot mod!

sections.heading: Barricade - Evade Ranged Timed
sections.text:
Recommended Bots:
* Hot Rod to disable evades
* Any Bot who relies on melee attacks will be your friend

Barricade's node consists of an Evade Ranged Timed mod, which, like Sideswipe, increases his evade chance significantly. As such, the same tactics to counter Sideswipe can be used here.

But! The same basic rule when facing him applies here too - try not to use any Specials under a Backfire.

sections.heading: Mirage - Ranged Shock
sections.text:
Recommended Bots:
* Grimlock MUST have his sig
* Thundercracker
* Tantrum MUST have his sig
* Blaster

Rulers of Kaon Mirage is very infamous for being very difficult. His mod is a Ranged Shock which deals 300% of his attack over 7.5 seconds, which will stack with every ranged hit! He can also boost his ranged attacks after a special 1, which will definitely bring the pain...

To counter... Dodge. A. Lot. That way, Mirage won't get some shocks in, but if you're using Grimlock that won't be much of an issue as they're instantly purified. If using Thundercracker, use a Heavy as soon as the shocks are inflicted. If using a duped Tantrum, quickly try to gain 3 melee buffs but, considering his rush-in-and-pray playstile, be careful of any ranged attacks! Once you've gotten into such a rhythm, you can control Mirage's ranged attacks and the fight will be made easier.

sections.heading: Bonecrusher - Reflect Ranged
sections.text:
Recommended Bots:
* Grimlock Heavies are high-risk
* Optimus Prime (MV1)
* Optimus Primal Heavies are high-risk

Bonecrusher's node consists of a Reflect Ranged mod, which reflects all ranged attacks back at you.

To counter, try not to use ranged attacks too much. Melees are king here, so a Brawler will be beneficial.

sections.heading: Ultra Magnus - Armor Pierce
sections.text:
Recommended Bots:
* Galvatron
* Megatronus

Ultra Magnus' node consists of an Armor Pierce mod, which ignores your Armor.

This is the easiest fights in RoK. Unless you're running a Brawler, you should be fine.

sections.heading: Megatron (ROTF) - Adaptive
sections.text:
Recommended Bots:
* Megatron
* Megatronus
* Galvatron
* Shockwave
* Wheeljack

The final fight in Rulers of Kaon. Nominally, given that Megatron has an Adaptive Resistance Mod, you'd want to alternate different types of attacks - though it'd be beneficial to build up your combo meter and power bar. Damaging Debuffs and direct damage, like Dark Burns, will indeed blow through the adaptive resistance.

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
By completing Rulers of Kaon, these items will be rewarded:
*3 Tier 3 Basic Spark
*2 Tier 2 Alpha Spark
*1 random Tier 3 Class Spark
*4-Star Harm Accelerator
*The Fallen Titan Hand

Scorponok and Waspinator Story Arc.lead: The Scorponok and Waspinator Story Arc is a story arc that began with "Till All Are Gone" and continued with "A Tale of Two Stingers".

sections.heading: Plot
sections.text:
Waspinator and Scorponok are finding materials to construct a Space Bridge that will bring Beast Wars Megatron in. When questioned by Optimus Prime on which Megatron he considers his boss, Scorponok rejects Megatronus, considering the Predacon leader as his boss instead. Optimus and the Commander would later dispatch both Pred bugs. ("Till All Are Gone")

The following month, the duo continue their quest, bumping into various Bots and disrupting what they were doing. In the end, Scorponok realizes that he and Waspinator haven't attacked the Commander, and do so, only to get trounced. ("A Tale of Two Stingers")

Scout.lead: {{Class_Template|number_of_champions = 10|non-playable = 0|class_bonus = Tech|weakness = Warrior|image1 = File:Class Use Scout.png}}Scouts are one of six Bot Classes in Transformers: Forged to Fight. It has a Class Bonus against Techs, but is weak to Warriors.

sections.heading: In-Game Description
sections.text:
Scout Bots quickly eliminate opponents with frequent Special Attacks and a high Critical Rate.
*Frequent critical attacks and damaging debuffs from Scout Bots are effective against the high base attributes of Tech bots.
*Most Scouts have Evade abilities that help them automatically avoid attacks.
*Scouts have a high critical rate, but low Health rating.
*Scouts' abilities can neutralize Tech Bots' abilities like Power buffs and shields.

sections.heading: Strategies
sections.text:
Scouts are speedy and critical in their movements and attacks. They love Critical Hits to the point a Commander can count them as fast as they can beat story Act 1. They also love Special Attacks, and their Evasion buffs mask their low health rating. They're also able to find a way around Tech bots' abilities like defensive shields and power gains, so expect the mighty Shockwave to tremble against Generations Bumblebee in a match-up. And as stated above, Scouts, like their worst nightmares, love Critical Hits, but never increase their critical damage. (Except the Red Speedster)

Scouts are somewhat annoying to fight due to their scouty slipperiness expected from the typical scout Bot, so while any other class type works, a Warrior can neutralize their evasion, making sure they're forged not to evade, but to be stuck without evasion.

Sharkticons are fierce warriors that were created by the Quintessons as their troops. They are generally non-playable characters.

The first Sharkticon Week, which ran from February 1 through February 8, 2018, let players collect Sharkticons of the main six classes. A second week ran by the end of July 2018.

Another third Sharkticon week ran from March 1 through March 7, 2019, which introduces 5-Star Sharkticons and a 5-Star exclusive S-1000.

Starting July 25, 2019, the waters of New Quintessa became dangerous again, as the Sharkticons returned for the fourth time. This time, they brought a 4-Star S-1000 offer (that lasts for a day!) and a purchasable 5-Star S-1000 for 30,000 5-Star Sharkticon Crystal Shards (that's worth three 5-Star crystals!) with them, proving that the Sharks' leader isn't really that exclusive.

sections.heading: Story
sections.text:
Sharkticons play a major role in the original Story.

Outside of the Story, Sharkticons have had major roles in the following Special Missions:
*Well, That's Just Primal
*Crossfire
*The Thundercracker Challenge
*Till All Are Gone

sections.heading: S-1000
sections.text:
The S-1000 as an AI boss initally had no class, but became a Scout and an obtainable bot exclusively as a 5-Star exclusively in the 5-Star Sharkticon Crystal. hatt is, until July 2019's Sharkticon Week, where he was made available by other means through two ways:
* In a flash offer that offered him as a 4-Star
* By using 30,000 5-Star Sharkticon Crystal Shards in the Featured Bot Store

sections.heading: Bio

sections.heading: Basic Abilities
sections.text:
* Sharkticons gain their abilities only once their Signature Ability has been unlocked.
* Sharkticon abilities and Special Attacks are imitations of those from the various bots on New Quintessa.
* Once the Signature Ability has been unlocked abilities scales with bot Rank and Signature Level.
* Signature Level increases ability strength up to 50%.
* Sharks become much more powerful when synergized with other Sharkticons.

sections.heading: Signature Ability
sections.text:
Shark Enhancement - The S-1000 has been Enhanced with the never-before-seen ability to replicate buffs. Increase this Bot's signature level to improve its abilities.

* Passive: Replicates a 20~40% buff of a similar type the opponent activates:
**Armor Buff
**Attack/Melee Buff
**Critical Rate
**Critical Damage
**Repair (Healing abilities generate reduced 10~20% effects instead.)
**Power Gain
**Evade Melee
**Special Damage

* Passive: When at 20% health the Sharkticon has a nasty surprise for the opponent. (50% for one of the following:)
**Shark Frenzy! - Gains 3x 20~33% Armor Buffs and 3x 20~33% Fury buffs for 7 seconds.
**All Hail the Sharkticons! - Repairs 10~30% Health over 3 seconds.

sections.heading: Strategy
sections.text:
Sharkticons have a much lower PI and overall rating than regular Bots. You would be better off devoting your resources primarily to your main Bots in terms of main gameplay. But they a good option to feed excess Ore-13 into, then Forge away, then get another of.

Sharkticons can be forged to earn Sharkticon Crystal Shards for their next tier. Only regular bots give Sharkticon Crystal shards when forged, and only when the Sharkticon forged is exactly one tier less (until v8.0).

sections.heading: Obtainment
sections.text:
Sharkticons are primarily obtainable through Sharkticon Week arenas and calendars; outside the events, 2-Star Sharkticon Crystals occasionally show up in the Raid Store for 12,000 Raid Chips each.

The S-1000 for Commanders is exclusively 5-Star and only in the 5-Star Sharkticon Crystal, introduced in the Sharkticon Week starting March 1, 2019.

On July 25, 2019, a 4-star S-1000 bundle was made available.

sections.text:

sections.heading: Synopsis
sections.text:
[https://forums.transformersforgedtofight.com/discussion/9169/spotlight-mission-shattered-bridges According to this]...

Optimus is missing, Prowl is missing, Wheeljack and Jetfire have disappeared into a Chrono-Mission, new dangers are appearing at every turn. Important intel comes to the Autobot base from a questionable source and it sends two uneasy Autobots on a journey with brave new partners.

Will mysterious evil forces be sent back? Will friends and foes join together? Will anyone survive? Follow the path if you dare, because a dangerous journey awaits on the other side of SHATTERED BRIDGES!
