sections.text:
{{DiaRT|red|Marissa Faireborn|OPTIMUS! COMMANDER! LISTEN TO ME!}}
{{DiaC|red|This is not our Megatron and Starscream. Teletraan shows they are from a [https://tfwiki.net/wiki/Shattered_Glass newly discovered dimensional rip].}}
{{Dia|#4B4B4B|Megatron (Shattered Glass)|And we hold no ill-will. We know how disorienting this is. In our world we are Earth's last line of defense against the evil Autobots.}}
{{Dia|#4B4B4B|Starscream (Shattered Glass)|We knew things were off when we saw a human in the Autobot base that was well... breathing.}}
{{Dia|darkred|Bumblebee|Oh... wow... and the first thing WE did was attack you!}}
{{Dia|#4B4B4B|Megatron (Shattered Glass)|All is forgiven. We did little to brace you to our presence. We understand how hostile that may have seemed. Our most earnest of apologies.}}
{{Dia|darkred|Optimus Prime|Apologies. Yes. That being said, we have much to discuss.}}Part 2
* Starscream: We just gotta' round up the bad guys, bring 'em home, and leave you to be...but I'm always open to some help on a hard mission.
* Bumblebee: I hear words coming out of you, but my processor won't accept the order I'm receiving them in.
* Starscream: I know, right? I'm talking to the dreaded Bumblebee, the death-stinger, the doom-bringer, the most feared Autobot lieutenant!
* Jazz (Shattered Glass): Him? FEARED? You're singing the wrong tune Decepti-coward!
* Megatron (Shattered Glass): Jazz! friends find cover and protect one another! Defend the humans!
* Jazz (Shattered Glass): Oh you have meat with you? I'll grease my wheels with them as I dance on your graves!
Part 3
* Optimus Prime: If that is how Autobots behave on your world, it may indeed be wise to combine efforts.
* Starscream: Megatron, Sir! I'm showing the doctor of destruction up ahead.
* Megatron: No Starscream, call a monster by his name: Ratchet.
* Optimus Prime: Ratchet? He is our chief medical officer. What is he in your world?
* Ratchet (Shattered Glass): Someone who dedicated myself to learning the anatomy of Bots, so I can prolong their tortures or instantly snuff the Ember of say...Megatron.
* Starscream: Get behind me! No one will harm Megatron while I still function!
* Ratchet (Shattered Glass): Good, he'll get to watch you get flatlined before I pull the optics from his head!

sections.heading: Mission 1 - Splitting Up
sections.text:
Part 1
* Megatron: This is a larger escape than we anticipated, we may have to split up.
* Optimus Prime: Agreed, Bee you take Starscream. Megatron and I will head over that ridge and will be in continual radio contract.
* Starscream: May the light of the noble and honorable Liego Maximo shine on you my heroic brothers.
* Megatron: And may your loyal Ember lead you back to us, my most trusted colleague.
* Optimus Prime: Yes. Good. All of this is good. We should be on our way.
Part 2
* Bumblebee: So you and Megatron, Together forever, huh?
* Starscream: Not forever. One day I shall lead the Decepticons and he shall no longer be with me.
* Bumblebee: HAH! I knew you'd be the same deep down.
* Starscream: He has witnessed so much war, so much pain. One day he shall live his cycles out in peace. Then I shall have the great burden of requesting to lead.
* Bumblebee: ....Right. Oh hey! Look! An actual Decepticon!
* Motormaster: Little lethal lady I met said to take your heads as trophies. Says you should back off or get knocked off.
* Bumblebee: I'm weirdly glad too see you. Starscream, let's jack-knife this joker!
Part 3
* Arcee (Shattered Glass): I see that pathetic delivery-boy failed to give you my message.
* Bumblebee: Arcee? You're looking a tad aggressive.
* Arcee: Ahhh, the bumbling Bee. It would be more satisfying to cut the stinger off someone who posed a challenge. But your screams will suffice.
* Bumblebee: The Autobots of your world are very...threatening.
* Starscream: Their tongues are as sharp as their blades. They take pleasure in cutting us with their words as well as their weapons.
* Arcee: Is that your engines whining on you? I'm going to blast you open or go out swinging, wither way let's see what you're made of!

sections.heading: Mission 2 - Patched Together
sections.text:
Part 1
* Optimus Prime: Your Starscream seems to be a very trusted companion.
* Megatron: Without the trust of my team how would I have been elected their leader?
* Optimus Prime: Elected. The Decepticons of your world are a democracy?
* Megatron: Of course, we cannot rely on the whims of the universe. We must take charge and know our vision is represented. How do you rule?
* Optimus Prime: I do not...rule exactly. I was...it is very complicated. We should stay alert. Scan the area.
* Megatron: Very advisable. That will give us intel, and good intel is fifty percent of the combat engagement.
Part 2
* Megatron: Signals up ahead, one of your dimensions's Decepticons and one of my Autobots.
* Wheeljack (Shattered Glass): You pathetic, chittering, slag-heap! This garbage you brought me is worthless!
* Kickback: But Wasp and Scorpion were gathering it to make a space bridge-bridge!
* Wheeljack: So you can't even steal from thieves correctly? My materials must be absolutely flawless for my perfect designs to function!
* Optimus Prime: And just what is it you think you are building?
* Kickback: Prime-Prime! Don't worry science friend, we just found a new source of scrap-scrap!
Part 3
* Wheeljack: Well Kickback was right about new scrap, I can use parts of him for support beams at least.
* Megatron: You dastardly fiend, what is your cracked clockwork mind ticking towards?
* Wheeljack: We escaped here, but we left some friends behind. I'm just making sure the door stays open, maybe get a few more timelines in like I've witnessed on this world.
* Optimus Prime: You mean to strand more bots here? There is no escape from this vacuum of realities.
* Wheeljack: Better to rule in this pit, than kneel on Cybertron. Speaking of kneeling, a little groveling may spare you from my wrath.
* Megatron: You speak bitter lies, mercy is never part of your cruel calculations.
* Wheeljack: I forgot how well you know me Megatron. Truth then. None shall be spared.

sections.heading: Mission 1 - Animal Magnetism
sections.text:
Part 1
* Optimus Prime: Bumblebee, Starscream, what did you find?
* Starscream: Arcee has recruited Motormaster. Bumblebee and the Commander did a commendable job in settling the situation with minimal damage.
* Bumblebee: Yeah we hit them a bunch until they stopped. What about you two?
* Megatron: Took in intel, quelled a chance for this to spread. Escapes seem to be contained to the one timeline fro our dimension.
* Scorponok: You guys here to take away my new best friend? Because I swear to Primus I'm about to lose it.
* Megatron: Who or what is that?
* Optimus Prime: The answer is, as always, trouble.
Part 2
* Scorponok: He ain't a Predacon, but he sure ain't acting like no Maximal I've ever seen. Except that one time with Rhinox... 
* Bumblebee: What are you talking about? 
* Scorponok: ...Dropped those boxes on me...made me all flat. OH! Right! I'm here to protect my friend and destroy all who oppose him. 
* Optimus Prime: Your friend likely poses a threat to the delicate fabric of reality as we know it. 
* Scorponok: Yeah and he keeps trying to claw my face but friends around here are slim and I takes what I gets. So prepare for a fight!
 Part 3
* Optimus Prime: If it was a Maximal teaming up with Scorponok that means that multiple timelines from your world have diverged here as well.
* Bumblebee: And I think I'm seeing the bot that jumped all nine of their lives over here.
* Cheetor: GRRRWAAAARRRWLLLLL!
* Stascream: Good Kitty! Nice Kitty! Maybe let's put those claws away huh?
* Bumblebee: Yeah, I don't think he likes being called kitty...or chatting.
* Cheetor: METAL! ENERGON! FEED! HUNGRY!
* Megatron: I agree with Bumblebee, words may fail us here.
* Cheetor: TALK TO MUCH! FIGHT NOW! FEEEEEED!

sections.heading: Mission 2 - Second in Demand
sections.text:
Part 1
* Optimus Prime: This has been a deeply trying and troubling endeavour.
* Bumblebee (Shattered Glass): And the hits just keep on comin'!
* Bumblebee: Oh, come on!
* Starscream: Keep your distance! He is driven only to destroy. If he's this close we may be already out of time.
* Megatron (ROTF): Out of time? Yes.
* Megatron: I can not hide my disgust at this twisted abomination.
* Megatron (ROTF): I assure you the feeling is mutual.
Part 2
* Megatron: You are a Megatron! Namesake of the noble Megatronus who gave his life to protect the Prime he loved! How dare you side with this death-bringer?
* Megatron (ROTF): Your dimension sounds quaint, our Megatronus embraced all the darkness within him. So much so that he seems to have slipped into the shadows of this world.
* Optimus Prime: Megatronus is missing? I thought he was powering up to some grande finale.
* Megatron (ROFT): Well if it's any consolation, you wouldn't have lived to witness it.
* Bumblebee (Shattered Glass): Enough of your posturing Megatron, prove yourself or move aside!
* Megatron (ROTF): I must prove nothing! But I will take pleasure in eliminating this threat to our plans.
Part 3
* Bumblebee (Shattered Glass): Pathetic failure after failure. No Prime can match me, mo Megatron, none even pose a challenge.
* Bumblebee: Where is your Prime? A Bumblebee without an Optimus is lost, I should know.
* Bumblebee (Shattered Glass): Last I saw him, I was tossing his tattered body into the void of space as he tried to convince me he still functioned.
* Starscream: WHAT KIND OF MINDLESS MONSTER WOULD DO THAT?
* Megatron: Team, we may not end this threat today. We may face further terrors in the days to come. But we will not allow Bumblebee one step further into this world.
* Bumblebee (Shattered Glass): Draw a line, and watch me cross it.
* Megatron: You heard him. DECEPTICONS! ROLL OUT!

sections.heading: = Part 1: =
sections.text:
Optimus Prime (MV1): The reappearance of Ultra Magnus should be the cause for celebration, but sadly it only adds more confusion to our battle.

(SG)Megatron: My deepest condolences Optimus, I can only imagine the inner turmoil you must currently be wrestling with.

Optimus Prime(MV1): Indeed, until further notice I've placed him under confinement and observation. We have to find a way to clear this planet of duplicates and then we can deal with Magnus.

(SG)Starscream: We'll figure out a way to open a Space Bridge thingy to our alternate universe and just start herdin' bad bots across!

(SG)Megatron: Let us take a lesson from our polar-opposites and truly combine forces. Amazing how they can oppose us and yet teach us.

(SG)Starscream: To quote the wise and pure Devastator, "We shall heal this world together, and create something beautiful".

Optimus Prime(MV1): ...I am going to need you to stop quoting bots from your world. It overheats my logic-processers. But yes, we should get moving.

sections.heading: = Part 2: =
sections.text:
Tantrum: Oh, so a buncha' you coming around to call me names too?

(SG)Starscream: I mean if that's what's on the menu! Hey Tantrum, the only Bull you're full of is BULL S--

(SG)Megatron: STARSCREAM! You're not exactly setting a fine example of authority here.

Optimus Prime(MV1): Who was mocking you, Tantrum?

Tantrum: Big dumb Dino thinks he can slap on a highfalutin Britsh acceny and be all smart.

(SG)Starcream: BRITISH DINO? Oh geeze, oh man, oh gosh, Megatron! Could HE be HERE?

Tantrum: Hey, while y'all are just talking AROUND me like I ain't even here. I think I'mma get some of this anger out by givin' y'all the horns!

Part 3- 

Optimus Prime(MV1): Who has your circuits all in a tangle?

(SG)Megatron: Long ago I hoped to create soldiers, ones without Embers who ran on pure logic. Sadly I created a monster powered only by a hunger for violence.

(SG)Grimlock: Ah, thank you for such an abs-o-lutely loverly introduction Megatron. I, Grimlock, am forever in your debt. Wot.

Optimus Prime(MV1): Your world has...a smart Grimlock?

(SG)Grimlock: Our world 'as a GENIUS GRIMLOCK! Absolutely chuffed to be here. Big plans, all terrible. Speaking of hunger...I, Grimlock, 'ave already made a friend!

Kickback: I am ready to eat their micro-chips-chips!

(SG)Grimlock: YES! Chip chip, CHEERIO ol' beans!

(SG)Starscream: BRITISH PEOPLE DON'T EVEN SAY THAT!

sections.heading: = Part 1: =
sections.text:
(SG)Grimlock: I, Grimlock, 'ave utilized my magnificent mind to come 'ere, all thanks to my K.I.N.G.!

Optimus Prime(MV1): And who is your King, Grimlock?

(SG)Grimlock: Yer undone by a simple acronym, 'ow droll.

Key Interdimensional Navigation Gadget or K.I.N.G.! It is the device I, Grimlock, 'ave been usin' to bring many of us to this pathetic scrap o' dirt. Wot.

(SG)Starcream: If we get that device we could maybe send everyone back, Boss!

(SG)Megatron: I had the same idea, Starscream. I didn't shout it out loud in front of everyone. But good initiative.

sections.heading: = Part 2: =
sections.text:
Megatron (ROTF): I see that the Autobots finally have a beast worth taming.

(SG)Megatron: Stay out of this you horrifying carnival reflection!

Megatron(ROTF): I am struck, wounded, your words cut so deep my dearest doppleganger. I merely wish to woo this Grimlock to safe haven.

(SG)Grimlock: I, Grimlock, was actually 'oping for more of a situation where one was let loose to spread fear and chaos amongst the masses.

Megatron(ROTF): Also an option, let me clear this trash from your path and we can see what side you join.

Part 3:

(SG)Grimlock): A perculiar pickle. Sides battlin' so eagerly. Whatever is such a commodity as myself to do? Wot!

(SG)Megatron: You will hand over the interdimensional device, surrender to our care, and join us as we transit back home.

(SG)Grimlock: Amazin', every word of what you just said was wrong. You shall leave with nothin' ...if you leave at all.

(SG)Starscream: You expect that we aren't going to try to get the K.I.N.G from you?

(SG) Grimlock: No Mr Scream...I, Grimlock, expect you to die!

sections.heading: = Part 1: =
sections.text:
Marissa Faireborn: Windblade, just doing a check in. How is Magnus doing?

Windblade: The PRISONER who has taken Ultra Magnus' form is stable enough. They won't stop rambling though. Permission to mute them?

Marissa Faireborn: How do you MUTE another Bot?

Windblade: I find that once they're knocked out most everyone gets less talkative.

Ultra Magnus: Windblade, you must believe me. I am just as confused as everyone else about what is going on.

Windblade: Keep my name out of your speakers. I'm here to guard you not listen to your lies.

sections.heading: = Part 2: =
sections.text:
Marrisa Faireborn: WINDBLADE! Something just triggered every proximity alarm Teletraan has and all surveillance cameras have gone dark.

Windblade: I heard a blast, I think someone is breaking their way into here. Commander, keep an eye on the prisoner.

Shockwave: You will find that this Commander does not follow the pathetic will of the Autobots. They came here from the flipped dimension with Magnus, isn't that right?

Ultra Magnus: I have no clue what you are speaking of, I swear to you on my maker's circuits!

Shockwave: Enough of the facade you champion of chaos!

Windblade: First I'm going to shut you down Shockwave. Then I'm going to shut down EVERYONE ELSE in this quadrant.

Shockwave: Yes, spend your last precious moments on this world being incorrect. Why make your death any less pitiful than your life?

Part 3: 

Windblade: This still isn't settled. he may be an untrustworthy pile of living malware, but he seemed convinced you two weren't on the level.

Ultra Magnus: I can not remember much, but I know I am an Autobot to my core. Commander, tell Windblade we are trustworthy!

Windblade: ...

Can't say I'm swayed by that argument. Maybe we should settle this without words.

sections.heading: = Part 1: =
sections.text:
Marissa Faireborn: Windblade! Enough! You're here for a purpose and that purposeis not lashing out at the Commander!

Windblade: Yeah well if they're REALLY on our team they sure seemed happy enough to beat me senseless just now.

Marissa Faireborn: There's proof to confirm they're not a duplicate. Autobots in the evil dimension apparently aren't known to let humans stay in one piece for long.

Windblade: Human aren't reowned for their longevity regardless. Can't replace any parts, can barely upgrade, not exactly impressive lifeforms.

Marissa Faireborn: ...You know the coms are still open right? Coms with human friends listening?

Windblade: I'm not here to make friends. I'm here to guard possible planetary threats.

sections.heading: = Part 2: =
sections.text:
Bludgeon: I heard that an Autobot has risen from the dead to join the side of glory

Ultra Magnus: For the last time! NO! There is no world in the multiverse where I turn my back on the Autobots.

Windblade: See that's the problem. There are a lot of worlds out there, and Autobot is not a term that universally means good.

Bludgeon: You don't have to grovel in this cage longer brother. You may join the Decepticon cause, it more accurately reflects who you truly are.

Ultra Magnus: This is madness. It is an impossible task to prove to either of you my intents while I sit here to be prodded like a tested rat.

Bludgeon: How right you are, I shall disable the Commander. You make a run for it Magnus!

Part 3:

Windblade: I see you scoping out that Decepticon sized hole in the wall, prisoner. You know what...GO FOR IT. It'd give me an excuse to cut you down as you flee.

Ultra Magnus: You'd stab an Autobot in the back without mercy? You are not the Windblade I once knew.

Windblade: I TOLD YOU TO KEEP MY NAME OUT OF YOUR FLITHY MOUTH!

Ultra Magnus: I have committed no crime. I have had no trial. I demand to be let out. Freedom is the right of all sentient beings.

Windblade: You dare to twist the words of Prime at a time like this? You disgust me to my deepest core.

Ultra Magnus: My Spark is breaking in two as I raise my weapons...but I cannot stay here any longer and wait for mysteries to solve themselves. Prepare for Battle.

sections.heading: = Part 1: =
sections.text:
Marissa Faireborn: Commander, Magnus has broken free but there's even more disturbing news. Teletraan found a way to hack the Polarized Autobot feed...you need to hear this!

(SG)Optimus Prime: Ah, free of that mist of battle! I have arrived to destroy this new Earth!

(SG)Ironhide: Ain't Earth. Looks like the bridge sent us somewhere a heck of a lot more interestin'.

(SG)Optimus Prime: Ironhide? Is that you? These mirrored form Wheeljack provided are astounding.

(SG)Ironhide: Astounding? I feel ridiculous. Look how much extra metal I'm packing. Flaps on flanges on pistons on parts ... I used to be so streamlined!

(SG)Optimus Prime: Enough of your vanity! What is your report on Project: OMEGA DOOM?

(SG)Ironhide: A few setbacks, thought the change of scenery would help but from what I hear there was a few Bridges sent this way from Paradron.

(SG)Optimus Prime: The prison planet? Fasinating.

sections.heading: = Part 2: =
sections.text:
(SG)Starcream: Grimlock's tech is working as expected! The Space Bridges dumped a buncha' Autojerks here!

Optimus Prime(MV1): Easy on the insults, Starscream. Some of us still wear the Autobot name with pride.

(SG)Optimus Prime: I should rip that emblem from your corpse! Only We have the right to be called by the name AUTOBOT.

(SG)Megatron: So, Prime, just as you copied my technology to shift forms you follow the others to this world.

(SG)Ironhide: Oh I have been waiting to spill some Decepticon lubricant into the dirt and he looks ready to pop.

(SG)Optimus Prime: If it amuses you and sliences this stupidity, strike them down and show them what a real Autobot looks like.

Part 3: 

(SG)Starscream: If they are still sending Bots down here, I have an idea. I may be able to use the K.I.N.G. to get us some backup.

(SG)Megatron: I dislike the concept of further flooding this planet with Bots, but I do not see many alternatives.

(SG)Bumblebee: Oh I have a lot of options ready. Rip your head off, Rip your arms off, Rip your EMBER OUT!

(SG)Starscream: There's not a lot of variety in your choices there Bumble-brat.

Optimus Prime(MV1): Perhaps in place of taunting the crazed copy, you can communicate with our friends?

(SG)Optimus Prime: You have no friends here you hollow shell of a Pretender. Bumblebee, show them your sting!

(SG)Bumblebee: Fine! But only because I wanted to not because you said to!

sections.heading: = Part 1: =
sections.text:
(SG)Soundwave: MEGATRON! STARCSREAM! I got your radical response and rocked down to the Space Bridge avenue!

Optimus Prime(MV1): I require several explanations.

(SG)Soundwave: Apologies abound my most righteous of rulers! I saw that we were color swappin' with our evil other us-ses so I thought I'd look the part!

(SG)Megatron: Very wise Soundwave! It is good to see you friend, are you ready to round up some Autobots?

(SG)Soundwave: You know I am, Boss! Ravage get out here! You can haz Auto-burgers.

sections.heading: = Part 2: =
sections.text:
(SG)Starscream: The bridge is open at the end of the path, if we can push enough of them over it a chain quantum-reaction should start dragging polarized Bots across automatically.

Optimus Prime(MV1): Is there science to back that up?

(SG)Soundwave: He said QUANTUM didn't he? That's like peak science, my dude.

Optimus Prime(MV1): My...dude?

(SG)Ratchet: Ah one last surgical strike on this merry band of misfits.

(SG)Soundwave: We're starting BAND, Bros? I have no mouth...yet I must ROCK!

Part 3:

(SG)Optimus Pirme: You can try and remove us from this world. But what of the mysteries left behind? Do they not claw at you?

Optimus Prime(MV1): They haunt me, yes. We shall tie up the loose ends in time. Your continued presence on this world is a threat to the very fabric of our reality.

(SG)Optimus Pirme: I know one who spoke like you...Nemesis Prime.

Optimus Prime(MV1): There is a polar opposite Nemesis Prime. A dark shadow of your own dark shadow?

(SG)Optimus Pirme: He is a meddling spirit of pure light seeking to unite all timelines. An angelic fool.

(SG)Megatron: OPTIMUS! COMMANDER! This is the final push! No matter how this ends, I have been and always shall be your friend!

(SG)Optimus Pirme: Enough of your popping pleasantries! AUTOBOTS! DESTROY!

Optimus Prime(MV1): We have lost too much to turn back now. AUTOBOTS! ROLL OUT!

Shattered Lenses.lead:
{{Spoiler Warning}}

Shattered Lenses is a Spotlight Mission featuring the Shattered Glass Bots that ran throughout the month of November, following up from the story of Prime Suspect and Shattered Bridges.

sections.heading: Synopsis
sections.text:
Not all is what it first appears on New Quintessa. Usually the sight of Autobot team building would warm your Spark, but not when it's the sinister Autobot forces from a duplicate dimension becoming friends with deadly Decepticons!

No one can be trusted, nothing is what it seems, and a familiar face returning only tosses things into further disarray. You won't believe your optics when you look through the new Spotlight: SHATTERED LENSES.

sections.heading: Changes/Rewards
sections.text:
Still no changes.
{{Rewards}}

sections.heading: = Part 1: =
sections.text:
Optimus Prime (MV1): Megatron, I fear that the spread of your universe over ours is far from over.

Megatron (SG): I completely agree my friend, it seems as though the sense of Decepticon comradery still functions here. The Autobots and Decepticons are teaming up.

Optimus Prime (MV1): I agree with SOME of what you have observed. As such, I have brought someone who has viewed the war from both sides.

Dinobot: I feel uneasy with this, Prime. I want my suspicions noted for when this all turns against us.

Starscream (SG): Our Decepticon might is at your side my well toothed brother. What can ya' tell us?

Dinobot: Decepticons are a cowardly and superstitious lot. But, they are also opportunists. A mindless Maximal would certainly be recruited. 

The stench of the twisted Cheetor is in the air, he'll be our first prey to track.

sections.heading: = Part 2: =
sections.text:
(SG) Cheetor: REND! TEAR! DESTROY! FEAST!

Grindor: You're talking a lot of sense there fuzz-face!

(SG) Cheetor: METAL....BLADES. GOOD FOR CUT. GOOD FOR DESTROY.

Grindor: Normally your chatter overwhelms my com channels. But, I think you and I could make a great partnership.

(SG) Cheetor: YOU BRING FOOD? YOU SLICE?

Grindor: Buddy, you show me how you take down some Bots and we'll have a heck of a meal!

Part 3:

Dinobot: Looks like the Decepticons are harbouring one of your escapees.

(SG) Starscream: Perhaps out of a sense of nobility? Providing safety and support to those in need?

Optimus Prime (MV1): Your instincts are praiseworthy Starscream, sadly I think more sininster motivations are at hand.

(SG) Starscream: I understand, but I shall still hold dear to my belief that true greatness awaits in the Ember of every Bot.

Dinobot: ...Everyone has been deeply unsettled by the hyperbolic sweetness of these Decepticons, yes? I can't be the only one.

Optimus Prime (MV1): It has taken some adjustment. I try not to dwell on it.

Grindor: You won't have to worry about it for long. Because I am looking to feed my new pet and you're about to be chopped chow.

sections.heading: = Part 1: =
sections.text:
Marissa Faireborn: More reports of the...what do we even call them...EVIL Autobots?

(SG) Megatron: Evil is a subjective term, an easy label applied to an uneasy situation.

(SG) Starscream: ...to be fair boss-bot, some of them also just want to hear the sounds of pain. Like, "front-row ticket with a back- stage pass" fans of that noise.

Marissa Faireborn: Right...so there are some subjectively evil Autobots up ahead and Teletraan says they're actually trying to buff up the Decepticon forces.

Optimus Prime(MV1): I can not stand by as those who wish us harm gain assistance from other dimensions. We must hurry.

sections.heading: = Part 2: =
sections.text:
(SG) Ratchet: ...Perhaps I could sharpen your implements so that you can slice AND crush bones.

Bonecrusher: Bonecrusher is just a name. I slice, smash, crush... if there's a way to destroy something, I'll find it.

(SG) Ratchet: Still, I feel that there is more we can do together. Perhaps I can mend the bones of your foes after you crush them, for another round of crushing.

Bonecrusher: I ain't ever gotten to crush the same thing twice. I imagine that'd be quite the thing to see.

(SG) Ratchet: Now all we need is patience and patients. I do so wish to hear a symphony of suffering.

(SG) Starscream: See? EXACTLY like I said. Back-stage pass.

(SG) Megatron: It is difficult to put a positive spin on what we just heard.

(SG) Ratchet: Ah good, my next appointment is here. Time to test your reflexes. Has anyone seen my hammer?

Part 3: 

Bonecrusher: Hey, Doc there was finally talking some sense. What's the big idea attacking your own guys!

(SG) Megatron: He was not of your world, remember yourself Bonecrusher. A proud Decepticon dedicated to clearing mines to keep others safe.

Dinobot: You can not possibly have hope for a Bot named Bonecrusher!

(SG) Starscream: It was an ironic nickname, like when you call a big guy Tiny. Our Bonecrusher is a big ol' softy.

Bonecrusher: I shall choke you in your own exhaust and strip the welds from your joints!

(SG) Megatron: This version does seem less interested in public welfare.

Optimus Prime (MV1): I have bested this beast before, his only language is destruction and I speak it fluently.

sections.heading: = Part 1 =
sections.text:
Bumblebee (DOTM): Guys. I was running over some data with Marissa and Teletraan. It looks like we're going to have a big problem on ourhands.

Dinobot: Oh really? And everything was ALREADY going so well. You thought you'd just come and improve our quest with more bad news?

Bumblebee (DOTM): Sarcasm noted fossil-face. We've been having trouble tracking the doubles. They had a unique signature but it's flipping and disappearing.

Optimus Prime (MV1): So unless they attack us, we may not be able to tell our own Autobots from the dimensionally shifted ones?

Bumblebee (DOTM): Seems that way. There's a spot far ahead where this shifting is happening like someone's throwing a signal rave. Want me to check it out?

Optimus Prime (MV1): Proceed with caution. Who knows what dark plans these Bots have for us.

sections.heading: = Part 2: =
sections.text:
(SG) Jazz: Well look who came to the party! Some tragic fools looking to trip over their own feet.

Optimus Prime (MV1): No use trying to emulate our Jazz. We are wise enough to tell the difference.

(SG) Jazz: Hey, I'm so cool I'm hot. So smooth it's rough. Flipped world or not you can't hide when you look this good.

(SG) Starcsream: Is that how your Jazz acts? Because this is pretty much the Jazz I'm used to as well.

Optimus Prime(MV1): He has been known to be prideful, but that seems excessive.

Barricade: You should see how he has torn apart those that have crossed him. It was a ballet of brutality. Give them your report, Jazz.

(SG) Jazz: Quit your jibber-jabber. Do you think you know me? Of course you do. 'Cuz I'm famous.

Part 3:

Barricade: Feels good punching out a friend, dosen't it?!

Optimus Prime(MV1): Barricade, you take the form of a human peacekeeper but seek only violence.

Barricade: These days I'm just looking for a good time. Too many Megatrons to even take proper orders any more.

(SG) Megatron: Well if it is a chain of command you're looking for, I can certainly tell you what to do.

(SG) Starscream: Yeah, you've never had a friend like Megatron here. I'd follow him into certain doom if he said he had a plan.

Barricade: You heard the flying fool. Lead him to doom, imposter. Because it's coming for you all.

sections.heading: = Part 1: =
sections.text:
Marissa Faireborn: Team. there was just a large explosion over the hill. Energon blasts, chemical burns, seems like a makeshift mobile lab went up.

(SG) Starscream: Something must have broken badly!

(SG) Megatron: We are en route. I take it this is another terrible team-up?

Marissa Faireborn: Seems logical, signals went dead following the blast but hopefully you can find some answers.

Dinobot: We shall forcefully interrogate whatever scrap remains of these worthless wastes of metal. I shall make them wish the blast freed them from this world.

(SG) Starscream: Dinobot, I find you to be violent and unfriendly.

Dinobot: ...I can live with that. Let's head out.

sections.heading: = Part 2: =
sections.text:
(SG) Wheeljack: You bumbling bucket of bolts! You mechanical misfit! Pray that the blast didn't harm my perfect technology.

Mixmaster: I was just mixing the chemicals like you said. This morphing paint is pretty volatile.

(SG) Wheeljack: Hmmm, It seems to still be functioning. Behold...a bit of heat and my emblem should change colours.

There! Do I better resemble my time-hopping doppleganger?

Optimus Prime(MV1): You can not hide the darkness that lurks in your spark, imposter.

(SG) Wheeljack: Mixmaster! Continue to distribute the disguise tech to the others. I'm going to experiment on this pitiful Prime.

Part 3:

Mixmaster: While you were busy feedin' vent-face a knuckle sandwich, I made sure the rest of the newcomers got their paint jobs.

(SG) Megatron: So this is what you've been using? A signal blocking cloak masked as paint?

Mixmaster: We have been brewin' and hidin' and all sorts of subterfuge for a good while now.

Dinobot: I was hoping this interrogation would be met with more...resistance. He seems to be without a firewall for his intel.

Mixmaster: Ah ain't no harm in telling you a thing or two before I melt you down to your base elements.

(SG)Starscream: You think a lot of yourself for a slow moving moron full of literal garbage.

Mixmaster: Good Starsceam, Bad Starscream...any way you're forged I always just wanna' punch you in the face.

sections.heading: = Part 1: =
sections.text:
Optimus Prime(MV1): This is a most troubling development. It was already hard enough to tell our reflections apart, but if they can fully cloak there may be countless evils awaiting us.

(SG)Megatron: When you can't trust your optics you just have to go with your instincts and hope the creator gave you enough wisdom to tell right from wrong.

(SG)Starscream: Your Autobots here seem wise enough, I'm sure they could detect minute changes in personality and tone.

Grimlock: You back again? NO HURT PINK LADY! She friend. Grimlock protect!

(SG)Starcream: Does that kind exact comedic timing occur on this planet a lot?

Optimus Prime(MV1): It can seem that an unseen hand sets us up for confusion on a near monthly basis.

sections.heading: = Part 2: =
sections.text:
Grimlock: Arcee tell Grimlock everything. Cop Bot is bad clone. Boss Bot is bad clone. Trust no one!

(SG)Starscream: Easy there, perhaps you can lead us to Arcee and we could...talk with her calmly. Figure all of this out.

(SG)Arcee: I'm right here. You can't fool this strong friend of mine any longer. Just look who you brought to the fight!

Grimlock: Me have it figured out! You with Decepti-creeps! You bring tiny Dino to fight KING of Dinos!

(SG) Arcee: It's just like I told you big guy, everyone's out to get us.

Dinobot: Primus help us, she's weaponized his stupidity.

Optimus Prime(MV1): That's NOT the Autobot you know, Grimlock! Step aside and let us show you.

Grimlock: ONLY STEP ME DO IS ON YOUR HEAD! ME SHOW YOU WHO IN CHARGE!

Part 3: 

(SG)Arcee: Awww. Looks like large, dumb and stumbling wasn't up to the challenge. Still was nice to have such an easily controlled henchman.

(SG)Megatron: Arcee, what is it you hope to gain from this world tossed into chaos? It is merely a larger cell which has imprisoned us all.

(SG)Arcee: Chaos! CHAOS IS WHAT I CRAVE! To watch the puppets dance. To sit on a high hill and watch the valley fill with the oil and scrap of war.

(SG)Starscream: The universe always finds a way to balance, this world must show you that. For every good and evil, for every evil a good.

(SG)Arcee: So I chip away at the good, plant the seed of paranoia, watch you rip one another apart to find the truth.

That the only true balance is destruction. Leaders or followers, all your Embers shall be extinguished.

sections.heading: = Part 1: =
sections.text:
(SG)Megatron: Plant the seed of paranoia. Arcee said that. A most troubling phrase.

Optimus Prime(MV1): So far it has not suceeded, the reflections can't help but reveal themselves.

Bumblebee(DOTM): OPTIMUS! I...I followed the signal. You have to come quickly.

Optimus Prime(MV1): Bumblebee you look as though you have seen a ghost.

Bumblebee(DOTM): I might have, it's a bot we haven't seen for over a year. We thought he was lost during the arrival of Megatronus...

I found Ultra Magnus! He's over the next ridge with who I THINK is Hot Rod.

Optimus Prime(MV1): Magnus. he has been gone for so long. This may have gotten a lot more complicated.

sections.heading: = Part 2: =
sections.text:
Hot Rod: Prime! Bon! We 'ave found Ultra Magnus but 'e is acting tres bizarre!

Optimus Prime(MV1): Yes...we were concerned so we came as fast as we could. Hot Rod, are you feeling yourself?

Hot Rod: But of course, je suis fantasique! Except for concern over Monsieur Magnus.

Bumblebee(DOTM): Really? Because the Hot Rod that crashed on this planet never spoke with an accent. In other dimensions perhaps...but not this one.

Hot Rod: You think maybe I am in disguise, Bourdon? L'habit ne fait pas le moine!

Ultra Magnus: Hot Rod has been nothing but kind to me since finding me left for scrap in the wastelands. I'll thank you all to step away.

Hot Rod: Oui, lest we seperate and prove that qui court deux lievres a la fois, n'en prend aucun!

Optimus Prime(MV1): We can't be too careful. I think it's time to shut you both down and return to base.

Part 3: 

Ultra Magnus: PRIME! WHAT HAVE YOU DONE?

Optimus Prime(MV1): Ultra Magnus, be calm. It has been over a year since we have gotten any trace of you. Much has occured and must be explained.

Ultra Magnus: A year? No, that can't be. I just woke up. We were chasing someone or something ancient.The other Prime was at my side.

(SG) Megatron: Beings from my universe have recently come over. Twisted Autobots who do not resemble the find friends I see you have here. We seek only to protect ourselves.

Ultra Magnus: I don't know what's going on, but I know that a Decepticon can never be trusted. If there's a struggle you and Starscream are on the wrong side of it.

Dinobot: It sickens me to say this, but these two are noble and trustworthy. We can't even be sure YOU are Magnus or a shadow of him.

Ultra Magnus: You want proof? YOU WANT TO SEE WHO I AM? Tell your Commander to bring his best to this fight, because I'll show you exactly what I'm made of.

Shining Star.lead:
{{StoryArc|Training Montage|Those Fortunate Ones|Sunstreaker}}

Shining Star is a Spotlight Mission featuring Sunstreaker that ran from August 11 - 25, 2022.

sections.heading: Synopsis
sections.text: Sunstreaker has arrived on New Quintessa, much to the delight of his twin brother Sideswipe. But not all is well within the Autobot family as Sunstreaker seems to have it out for the Commander. Will Sideswipe be able to sway his brother into falling in line with their new human friend, or will we be blinded by the rage of this SHINING STAR?

Shock.lead:
Shock is a damaging debuff ability which deals Shock damage over time.

Not to be confused with Instant Shock damage.

sections.heading: Characteristics
sections.text: Shock damage is characterized as a Bot being shocked with some kind of electricity charge.

sections.heading: Strategies
sections.text: Some Brawler Bots work around Bleeds to gain ground, but some don't work around Shocks. Use this to your advantage to take down tough Brawlers.

sections.heading: Bots that inflict Shock damage
sections.text:
* Thundercracker (Special 3)
* Scorponok (3 or more Venom Backfires expire)
* Bumblebee (Shield Break)
*Kickback (Special 1)
*Windblade (Special 1)
*Jetfire (Heavy & Special 3)
*Wheeljack (Special Attacks)
*Blaster (Heavy)
*Shockwave (Heavy, Special 1 & 3)
*Soundwave (Heavy, Special 2 & 3)
*Ratchet (Ranged Attacks)
*Rhinox (From his "Overclock" signature)
*Megatron (Special 3)
*Bumblebee (DOTM) - (Special 2 & 3)

Shocking Revelation.lead:
Shocking Revelation was a Spotlight Mission in September featuring Shockwave, Starscream, and Ramjet.
* Difficulties: 3
* Chapters: 2

sections.heading: Mission 1: Shock Hunter
sections.text:
Part 1:

Marissa Faireborn: Commander, if the new reports are accurate, our stay on this planet just took a turn for the worse.

Sideswipe: What's the deal, Marissa? Did Starscream find new minions to abuse and betray?

Marissa: No, Sideswipe, I'm afraid it's much worse than that. The latest intel reports suggest the Decepticon Shockwave is here.

Sideswipe: So? We dealt with him before. We'll do it again.

Marissa: Do not let your arrogance get the better of you. If Shockwave is nearby, logic dictates that trouble is not far behind. We need to find him before he unleashes whatever trouble he is plotting in that cold, calculating mind of his.

Part 2: 

Shockwave: Motormaster, my sensors indicate an Autobot party is enroute.

Motormaster: I wouldn't doubt it. They're always out on patrols. What of it?

Shockwave: You must delay them. My current research cannot be interrupted.

Motormaster: What's in it for me?

Shockwave: A pivotal role in the impending true Decepticon revolution.

Part 3:

Sideswipe: Well look who we found, old buckethead. Last we saw you, you were toadying up to Megatron.

Motormaster: Stifle it, fool. I toady up to no one, especially that alt-reality backstabber. I choose my allies more logically. 

Sideswipe: Logical? Like Shockwave.

Motormaster: I didn't say that.

Sideswipe: You didn't have to. Where is he?

Motormaster: Don't worry, you won't be alive long enough to find out.

sections.heading: Mission 2: Waves Unite
sections.text:
Part 1: 

Sideswipe: That scrap with old Motormaster didn't reveal much about Shockwave's location. Should have known he'd keep his vocal processor shut.

Mirage: That's why Marissa sent me along. She said my unique scouting skills may be of use.

Sideswipe: I agree. That invisible box trick could come in handy. Lead on, my elusive friend.

Part 2:

Shockwave: I see you've received my summons.

Soundwave: I am a communications officer. It was not hard. What is it you seek?

Shockwave: I seek solidarity with my fellow true Decepticons such as yourself.

Soundwave: I concur that a stronger alliance with those from our reality would benefit us. The alternate reality Megatron has proven to be both diabolical and unstable.

Shockwave: That is a valid observation. I also seek solitude so I can complete my research.

Soundwave: How can I assist?

Shockwave: Prevent the human Commander and the Autobots from breaching my research facility.

Part 3:

Soundwave: Make yourself visible, noisy Autobot. My audio detectors are superior. I have been aware of your party's approach so some time now.

Mirage: Then make yourself useful and tell us where Shockwave is.

Soundwave: Why would I aid you? That is not logical.

Mirage: Your logic is going to get you a beating from the Commander and our squad. 

Soundwave: Implausible. I am superior. Autobots, and especially humans, are inferior. Prepare to cease functioning.

sections.heading: Mission 3: Straight Shooter
sections.text:
Part 1:

Shockwave: Soundwave, you look damaged. Did you engage the Autobots and their human Commander?

Soundwave: I did. The results were unfavorable. Their numbers were superior. I had to retreat.

Shockwave: Were you followed?

Soundwave: Of course not. I am not a fool like Starscream.

Shockwave: Why do you mention that traitor?

Soundwave: I just saw him fly by. He appeared to be in a search pattern.

Shockwave: This is not a desired development. I must return to the lab to secure my research.

Part 2:

Soundwave: I assume your research fares well.

Shockwave: It does, my skills are unmatched.

Soundwave: As a sign of our solidarity, I would like to know what it is I am defending.

Shockwave: Megatron has always trusted you. I will grant your request... to a point. My research is focused on two things that may hold the key to our gaining true Decepticon power.

Soundwave: Soundwave is intrigued. Continue.

Shockwave: The first object is an ancient relic I discovered when I first arrived here. If my theory proves correct, with it I can harness the untold power of Unstable Energon.

Soundwave: The second object...

Shockwave: ... is a device I am working on to give us a decided advantage in battle. The working title is Aim Enhancer.

Soundwave: Considering our history in battles with the Autobots, this device sounds promising. Protect it I shall.

Part 3:

Mirage: Looks like invisibility has its advantages. The tracking device I placed on Soundwave during our last encounter led us right to Shockwave and his research lab.

Shockwave: Soundwave, you brought the Autobot intruders to my doorstep?

Soundwave: I was unaware of this. It was unintentional.

Shockwave: That may be the case, but your actions have once again proved inferior. I must take matters into my own hand. Autobots are all dead... now.

sections.heading: Chapter 2: Seek And You Shall Find
Mission 1: Sharkticon Encounter
sections.text:
Part 1: 

Golden Sharkticon: Halt! Who enters Sharkticon territory? 

Starscream: It is I, Starscream , the possessor of the keys to your freedom.

Golden Sharkticon: Interesting claim, Decepticon. What do you propose?

Starscream: I'm proposing that if you provide me protection, I in turn will give you the power to overthrow your Quintesson masters.

Golden Sharkticon: Others have made such false claims. What makes your promise of freedom any different?

Starscream: Because I have "acquired" certain technology from my traitorous ex-ally Shockwave.

Given time, I will decipher the true extent of its power and use it to remove the shackles the cursed Quintessons have imposed on us all!

Part 2: 

Ultra Magnus: Commander, if what Shockwave revealed in his interrogation is true, Starscream is in possession of some highly dangerous equipment. We must track him down and disarm the Decepticon.

Golden Sharkticon: Not if me and my Sharkticon brothers have anything to say about it. 

Ultra Magnus: Of what concern is Starscream to you?

Golden Sharkticon: Let's just say he's chummed these waters with the allure of freedom... and freedom is a powerful lure.

 Part 3:

Ultra Magnus: Good work, Commander... we've found Starscream.

Starscream: Oh, you found more than just me Ultra Doofus...

Golden Sharkticon: ...you've found a whole lot of teeth amd trouble! Starscream, go procure our freedom. I'll take care of this crew of meddling losers.

sections.heading: Mission 2: Promise Of Power
sections.text:
Part 1:

Marissa Faireborn: Commander, the potential of Shockwave's stolen technology has increased Starscream's duplicitous powers of pursuasion.

Ironhide: In words you can understand, he's got those metal fishbots working for him and now we've heard he's been in negotiations with the Decepticon Barricade.

Marissa: Barricade is from your reality. Intel report?

Ironhide: He's one bad piece of hardware. What would you expect from a Decepticon with the motto "To Punish and Enslave" tattooed on his paint job?

Part 2: 

Barricade: Certain discreet channels have suggested you wanted to see me?

Starscream: Indeed I do. I know you pledge allegiance to your reality's Megatron.

Barricade: And I know you pledge allegiance to nothing but your own lust for power. 

Starscream: I pledge allegiance to those I think can win. And your Megatron is assembling the forces to do just that. But he's missing a piece to the puzzle. 

Barricade: Let me guess... you?

Starscream: No, what I possess. I have two devices, the fruits of the infamous scientist Shockwave's labor. I promise they can tip the balance of power in Megatron's favor.

Barricade: At what cost?

Starscream: Protection now... and a seat by Megatron's side when I deliver the perfected devices. I'm sure your boss would agree, it's a small price to pay for complete power.

Part 3:

Ironhide: Commander, we've got company. You feeling lucky, punks?

Starscream: One doesn't need luck when one has made the proper "arrangements". Barricade?

Barricade: I am your "arrangement"?

Starscream: That was our agreement. 

Barricade: The agreement was that you'd deliver on your promise of power to Megatron. 

Starscream: And I will, once you've properly punished these Autobot cretins!

sections.heading: Mission 3: They Call Me A Seeker
sections.text:
Part 1: 

Marissa: Optimus, we are detecting traces of Seeker exhaust signatures in the area. 

Optimus Prime: That is a good sign. Starscream must be nearby.

Marissa: At least, Starscream.

Optimus Prime: Explain.

Marissa: Teletraan is detecting two distinct Seeker signatures. We believe another Seeker has arrived on New Quintessa.

Optimus Prime: Surely this strengthens Starscream's position and hastens our need to find him. Commander, roll, out!

Part 2:

Starscream: Can it be? Ramjet, you're here. How did you find me?

Ramjet: I'm a Seeker. It's in the name.

Starscream: Well, you're a sight for sore optic orbs. The situation can be hazardous to one's health. It's good to see a trusted comrade.

Ramjet: So I guessed. You've got some pretty heavy hitters looking for you. Since arriving, I've seen squads of Autobots and some strange looking Megatron roaming the area. And, all roads seem to lead to you.

Starscream: They are all depraved and misguided. You know how it is. Everyone is gunning for the one with the power.

Ramjet: That would be you?

Starscream: Yes, I am in possession of some objects of great value and power. Stick with me my friend, and you'll bear witness to the rise of Starscream... oh, and the Seekers, of course!

Part 3: 

Optimus Prime: Commander, Teletraan's supposition is confirmed, multiple Seekers do gather. 

Starscream: Ah, Prime and the Commander. Can we help you?

Optimus Prime: We are here to take back two objects that are not yours.

Starscream: Well, they certainly aren't yours either. What right do you have?

Optimus Prime: The right to prevent such objects falling into the wrong hands... namely yours.

Starscream: Always so quick to pass judgement. Perhaps it's time to put Shockwave's work to the test. Ramjet, take the relic. I'll catch up to you when I've destroyed these fools.

Ramjet: Are you sure about that?

Starscream: I never had faith in Shockwave's aim. But with the improved Aim Enhancer? No problem. See you when I'm done.

sections.heading: Mission 1: Brothers No More
sections.text:
Part 1: 

Ramjet: Starscream, you survived?

Starscream: I am nothing, if not resilient. Do you have the relic?

Ramjet: Of course, I do not fail to do what I say I will. What about that Aim Enhancer gadget you were raving about? Didn't seem to work out for you.

Starscream: It's aim was as reliable as Shockwave's. But, now that I've used it, I know what needs to be fixed. It needs a Sarscream touch. With a little time it'll put The Seekers where we belong... on top!

Ramjet: I've heard that before. Get on with fixing it.

Part 2:

Bludgeon: Ramjet, the shifty one approaches.

Ramjet: So, is the Aim Enhancer repaired? I sense the Commander will arrive soon, and we'll need any advantage we can muster.

Starscream: It is not only repaired, it is perfected. But what is with the samurai reject? Why does he accompany you?

Ramjet: Hey, a bot's got to have back up. Especially when dealing with... the likes of you!

Starscream: What!? Likes of me? I am your leader, your brother, a fellow Seeker!

Ramjet: You are but one of those... a Seeker. Your past says it all. You're too treacherous and self serving to ever be a leader or brother. 

Bludgeon, relieve him of the Aim Enhancer.

Starscream: You'll pay for this!

Part 3:

Ramjet: Who is the geisha painted Autobot?

Bludgeon: They like to bring her along when I'm around. They think her sword gives them an edge. Sadly for them, that edge is pathetically dull.

Windblade: Still full of empty bravado, Bludgeon.

Bludgeon: You're about to be emptied of Energon when my blade spills it upon the battlefield.

Ramjet: That's some serious scrap-talking, Bludgeon. I like the attitude. Take care of business and I'll make you an honorary Seeker.

sections.heading: Mission 2: The Corrupting Cube
sections.text:
Part 1:

Optimus Prime: Commander, the dissension between Ramjet and Starscream has only made our task more difficult. Shockwave's devices now lie with the Seeker known to be clinically unstable.

Arcee: Only a crazed conehead like Ramjet would think mid-air headbutts are a good combat strategy.

Optimus Prime: And now he possesses the Aim Enhancer and a relic of considerable corruptive power. 

Arcee: Primus bless us if he uses the Unstable Energon Cube on one of our own.

Optimus Prime: That, Arcee, is a well founded fear. Commander, you know your mission... find Ramjet.

Part 2:

Ramjet: An Autobot on a joyride, today's my lucky day.

Sideswipe: Ummm, it's not a joyride. It's called a scouting mission and you've just been scouted. 

Ramjet: Want to scout something a little more interesting?

Sideswipe: I've got time to kill. The Commander and his team have been notified. They'll be here soon. 

Ramjet: Good. Take a look at this.

Sideswipe: AYAAAAAAAAAAAAAAH!!!!!!

Ramjet: Looks like Starscream was right for once. Shockwave's Unstable Energon Cube could be the tool I need to rise above the savages of this wasteland.

Part 3:

Sideswipe: What do we have here? The pink sniper and her crew of misfires.

Arcee: Sideswipe, what's gotten into you?

Ramjet: I'm betting he's feeling the effects of my new toy, the Unstable Energon Cube. Sideswipe, why don't you show the Commander and his help what unstable Energon can do?

Sideswipe: No problem... I won't even have to scratch my chrome.

Arcee: We don't want to do this, but it's for your own good. Commander, we've got to get Sideswipe back to HQ... We can't just leave him in Ramjet's control.

Sideswipe: That's not your decision to make. It's time to get it on!

sections.heading: Mission 3: Results May Vary
sections.text:
Part 1: 

Soundwave: We are glad you have accepted our entreaty.

Optimus Prime: I accept that in desperate times, one must consider all options. 

Shockwave: Sounds logic. I will be concise. You want Ramjet and what he possesses. We can help you achieve that. 

Optimus Prime: Do you also not want what he possesses? After all, they were once yours.

Shockwave: Trinkets do not concern me. Ramjet and Starscream pose a threat, one that may rival that of the alternate reality Megatron.

Optimus Prime: So why do you not face the threat yourself? Our causes may be aligned but rarely are our forces. 

Shockwave: We have done the calculations. The Commander and the team you have amassed share a much higher probability of success than the two of us. A limited alliance is the logical choice.

Optimus Prime: What do you offer in return?

Shockwave: Find the Seeker. We hold the means to guarantee your success in battle. That is all.

Part 2: 

Ramjet: The Commander and his Autobot stooges. Wait, Shockwave, Soundwave... Have you caught Starscream's disease and turned traitor?

Soundwave: We do what logic dictates. You must be defeated. They are the means to your destruction.

Shockwave: You must be punished for taking that which is not yours.

Ramjet: In the right hands, these devices contain the power to rule. I have the right hands... Mine!

Optimus Prime: Precisely the reason we are aligned to stop you. Shockwave, now is the time to fulfill your end of the bargain... The guarantee to the Commander's success?

Shockwave: Ramjet does not know that I remote hacked the Aim Enhancer. It will not produce the results he wants. 

Ramjet: I don't need your toys to produce the results I want.

I will produce them myself!

Showcase.lead: Introduced Version 8.3 December 5, 2019, Showcases were small side missions that ran alongside Spotlight Missions so new players could try out featured bots without obtaining them. The featured Bots came in sets of two to five and each bot would be playable for one week. They were always 5-Star at max rank 5, level 50, and signature level 99, and their stats were not affected by Masteries and Relics. The bot's map had three similarly-match opponent bots, the boss sometimes being a class-disadvantageous one, and they did not cost any Energy. They rewarded 10,000 Bot Chips, as well as fulfilling Objectives.

Signature Ability.lead:
A Bot's and Mod's Signature Ability is a unique ability that is awakened and powered up by getting duplicate Bots and Mods of the same star rating (excluding 1-Stars). Each duplicate of a Bot or Mod increases its signature level by 5, up to the max level of 100. See individual articles for each Bot's and Mod's Signature Ability.

Blue stars indicate an unawakened bot or mod, and white stars indicate an awakened bot or mod.

sections.heading: Awakening Programs and Signature Upgrades
sections.text: In version 4.0, Awakening Programs and Signature Upgrades were introduced, providing an alternative to unlock and upgrade Bots' Signature Abilities. Awakening Programs unlock a Bot's Signature Ability at level 1. Signature Upgrades upgrades a Bot's awakened Signature Ability by 1 level each. They come in various rarities and are either class-specific or work on any class. Up to 99 of each star rating of each type Signature Upgrade, and up to 3 of each Awakening Program can be stored.

Size Matters.lead:
Size Matters was a Spotlight Mission in July featuring Megatron (ROTF) and Grimlock.
* Difficulties: 3
* Chapters: 2

sections.heading: 1) Something Bigger
sections.text:
Part 1: 

Optimus Prime (MV1): Windblade, did your aerial survey of the wasteland yield anything of tactical value? 

Windblade: Good news or bad news? 

Optimus Prime (MV1):You know better than to play word games. You're report, soldier. 

Windblade: Well, it's pretty much all bad news. Megatron had established a series of outposts. 

Optimus Prime (MV1): Indeed, he has been staking claim to territory beyond the Quintessons' control. 

Windblade: And it looks like he's leaving some heavy hitters behind to guard his gains. 

Optimus Prime (MV1): Heavy hitters? Explain. 

Windblade: I'm talking heavy as in size and power. He has Mixmaster and Motormaster lying in wait for The Commander's squad. 

 Part 2: 

Mixmaster: Do my optics deceive me or is it a march of the minicons? 

Optimus Prime(MV1): Save the petty jokes, Decepticon. 

Mixmaster: Petty, small...they are apt descriptions of you and your puny human Commander ally. 

Optimus Prime(MV1): Has Megatron deluded you to believe that the size of your metal outweighs the will of your spark? 

Mixmaster: Master Megatron deludes no one. He simply speaks the truth. Those who are weak and betray the ways of Cybertron will be destroyed. As will you, when the time is right. 

Part 3: 

Mixmaster: The time has come for me to end your trespassing through Megatron's realm. 

Optimus Prime(MV1): Mixmaster, your problem is you have never been part of something larger than you. You serve no cause. You only serve an evil master. 

Mixmaster: Are you kidding me? I am part of something larger than you'll ever know. Does the name Devastator not strike fear in your spark? 

Optimus Prime(MV1): I do not see your fellow Constructicons. I see no help to save you. I see only a tormented bot manipulated by Megatron, and bound for defeat at the hands of the Commander. 

Mixmaster: I need no help to crush you and your party. I am bot enough to see the last drops of Energon pour from your dead bodies!

sections.heading: 2) Big Head
sections.text:
Part 1: 

Optimus Prime: Commander, Megatron is reinforcing his troops ahead of us. He is doubling down on his size strategy.

Grimlock: Me Grimlock is best at size strategory! Me go crush little Megatron.

Optimus Prime: Relax big fella. Your size is unquestioned. But, the Commander is in charge. I trust brawn and brains will guide any decisions made.

Grimlock: Me Grimlock has biggest brain too. Me not waste time here. Call Grimlock when you want to win. Me go home and study Kup's war stories.

Me Grimlock learn best strategory!

Part 2:

Megatron (ROTF): Mixmaster, you allowed the human vermin Optimus calls the Commander to defeat you!?How could a creature so small, so insignificant, beat you?

Mixmaster: I admit it was a setback, my master. I underestimated the Commander's leadership skills.

Motormaster: That is because you are not a leader. You are simply part of a weak team. I am the leader, the head no less, of the mighty Stunticons!

Megatron(ROTF): And I lead YOU ALL!

Motormaster, you talk big. Now is the time to prove the size of your actions can match the girth of your stature and words.

Motormaster: Don't worry, Megatron. The bots the Commander places will be flattened into worthless pieces of scrap.

Part 3: 

Motormaster: We meet yet again, Prime. And what is that you bring with you? Another of the lowly human you hold so dearly? 

Optimus Prime: I bring with me the Commander who will defeat you and your master, Megatron. And what do you bring? It appears no Stunticons stand by you. 

Motormaster: They are not here. So what? I need no others to destroy the likes of you! 

Optimus Prime: Mixmaster expressed the same sentiments. How did that work out for him? 

Motormaster: You'd have to ask him. Too bad you won't be able to when I'm done with you. Let's stop with the small talk...FIGHT!

sections.heading: 3) Dissension
sections.text:
Part 1: 

Optimus Prime(MV1): Commander, Teletraan's analysis of drone relays indicate this wasteland mission grows more grave.

Grimlock: Argh! Why Optimus bots always use many words but say nothing? Smart bots talk short and clear.

Ratchet: OK. Let me help, my friend... we aren't dealing with Megatron's henchbots anymore.

Grimlock: More argh! What means henchbots?! Use real words!

Ratchet: We mean it's Megatron. Megatron the true master of the Decepticons is waiting ahead for us.

Grimlock: Me have brain! Me Grimlock remember mission. Megatron thinks he big. Grimlock make him small. LET'S GO!

Optimus Prime(MV1): You must control your anger, soldier. Anger will not beat Megatron, brains will. Ratchet, head back to HQ and see what your brain can come up with to defeat our foe.

Part 2: 

Grimlock: Why we go slow!? Is Commander too weak? ROLL OUT FASTER!

Optimus Prime(MV1): The path of prudence and readiness is one not traveled hastily. We roll at a speed that ensures victory.

Grimlock: BAH! More words... more no meaning. GO! GO!

Optimus Prime(MV1): That is enough Grimlock!

You have shown your temperament is not suited for the mission. I order you to return to the base!

Grimlock: Optimus plan is dumb! Me Grimlock have smart plan. Me go and show who has most brain... and most POWER!

Part 3:

Megatron(ROTF): It took you long enough to get here. I was worried you wouldn't show.

Optimus Prime(MV1): You knew we would show., paths crossing is our fate.

Megatron(ROTF): Your path contained sizable obstacles did it not?

Optimus Prime(MV1): Size doesn't matter. Spark does.

Megatron(ROTF): Spare me your virtuous blather. It won't save your spark from being extinguished!

Optimus Prime(MV1): Commander, I am receiving a concerning transmission from Ratchet. Something about Grimlock... running... amok.

Ratchet just cut out. I must return to HQ. You will have to take care of Megatron without me.

Megatron(ROTF): Ah, dissension in the ranks. The mighty Prime runs and leaves an insect human for me to play with. Perfect! A heart or a spark it makes no difference what I extinguish next.

sections.heading: 1) Forced Retirement
sections.text:
Part 1: 

Optimus Prime (MV1): Ratchet, status report. What happened back at HQ?

Ratchet: A whole lot of Grimlock is what happened. The big fella went on a rampage.

Optimus Prime(MV1): Is the situation under control? Were you able to subdue him?

Ratchet: Ummm, that's the problem. Before he could be apprehended, he fled with Ultra Magnus and Rhinox. But there's more...

Optimus Prime(MV1): More? I do not like the sound of this...

Ratchet: You won't. Before he left, Grimlock broke into my lab. He appears to have downloaded a linguistics program and then stole a mind control device I've been tinkering with... the hypno-chip.

Optimus Prime(MV1): I fear this may all be my fault. I chastised Grimlock abot not being suited for the mission. He said something about a plan. I fear he is trying to prove a point.

Ratchet: A dangerous point. If you bring our wayward warriors back to HQ, I can reverse the effects of the hypno-chip. But they're big bots, and that's a big if. Good luck, Commander.

Part 2:

Grimlock: Ultra Magnus, I have a matter to discuss with you.

Ultra Magnus: I don't mean to be rude, old friend, but your syntax is somewhat "advanced?"

Grimlock: Let's just say that I Grimlock have been doing some "studying," and my studies reveal a nefarious plan being implemented by Optimus Prime and that puny Earth human they call the Commander.

Ultra Magnus: I'm not sure about the Commander, but nefarious does seem out of character for a Prime.

Grimlock: The plan is the Commander's doing. Optimus and the other bots are following due to the effects of The Matrix of Leadership being in the Commander's possession.

Ultra Magnus: So, what is the plan?

Grimlock: The Commander says size and power are an obsolete military strategy. There is a restructuring of the forces with an emphasis on speed and agility. Our days as Autobots are numbered...

Ultra Magnus: We must combat this foolishness!

Grimlock: You will get your opportunity to combat such foolishness soon enough...

Part 3:

Ultra Magnus: Look who approaches, Optimus Prime and his tiny overlord, the Commander.

Optimus Prime(MV1): I do not know what madness Grimlock has put in your circuitry, but we came to help you. 

Ultra Magnus: Ah, "help", that's what you are calling my forced retirement?!

Optimus Prime(MV1): I do not know what you mean by forced retirement. We are simply here to bring you back to HQ so Ratchet can reverse the effects of the hypno-chip.

Ultra Magnus: Return with you so Ratchet can put me in permanent stasis while The Commander carries out an overhaul of our forces to reward the weak and insignificant?

Never! I will not let you and the lowly Commander destroy the Autobots!

sections.heading: 2) Science Deniers
sections.text:
Rhinox: Grimlock, why have you hauled me out into the middle of this wasteland? I could be back at HQ doing research and formulating a method for us to overcome the corrupting effects of this planet's Dark Energon.

Grimlock: You would rather be back among the science deniers and human apologists?

Rhinox: What are you talking about? Ratchet has exhibiting no such behaviour. 

Grimlock: Ratchet is being used to deceive you. They've all fallen under the spell of the human propagandist they call the Commander.

Rhinox: Those are serious claims. What proof do you have?

Grimlock: The proof is on the way. They will send a rescue party... Ratchet in tow... to ostensibly "help" you. 

Know this, you have a brain the ability to reason. You are a threat to them. Their "help" will be your demise.

Part 2: 

Rhinox: Interesting. The Commander, a party of bots, and Ratchet bringing up the rear. It would appear Grimlock was right.

Ratchet: Grimlock...right? That's a novel idea. Right about what?

Rhinox: He said you and your master, the Commander, would come in search of me. He said you would offer help. Help that would lead to my demise.

Ratchet: He's manipulating you. He duped you using a device he stole called the hypno-chip.

Rhinox: In all my cycles of doing my research, I have never come across such a device.

Ratchet: It was science of our time, not yours.

Rhinox: It is not science, it is a ruse... a hoax made up to advance the Commander's purposes. We will settle this "scientific" debate later.

Part 3:

Grimlock: As I predicted, the human charlatan and his Cybertronian minions have come to save their beloved beast Rhinox.

Ratchet: We are here to help those in need, that would include you Grimlock.

Grimlock: I Grimlock need help? Bah, it is to laugh. The biggest, smartest and most powerful need not the help of the smallest, dumbest, and most feeble.

Rhinox: I'm with Grimlock on this one. Anyone that would sell out their own kind to an inferior race of technologically backward humans holds no hope for me.

Our tech, our research, our science is the key to OUR future. The self- destructive humans can fend for themselves.

Ratchet: And it will be our science that will return you to normal.

Grimlock: ENOUGH! Rhinox, show them what a real scientist can do... ATTACK!

sections.heading: 3) Think About It
sections.text:
Part 1: 

Optimus Prime(MV1): I am able to report a positive update, Commander. As promised, Ratchet was able to reverse the ill effects of Grimlock's hypno-chip.

Ultra Magnus: Other than a minor chunk of my memory data banks being deleted, I'm good to go. 

Rhinox: Me too, and I'd be lying if I said I wasn't looking forward to butting heads with our Dinobot buddy should the occasion arise.

Optimus Prime(MV1): We could use the assistance. Grimlock surely will be a true test of our mettle. But remember, he is our friend and ally. His emotions and ego have taken hold of him as they have at times in the past.

Ultra Magnus: That is true, once again we must rally to bring our friend back into the fold.

Rhinox: Yeah, that's fine and good and all... but I'm not opposed to showing him a little tough love. I mean c'mon, he used a hypno-chip on me!

Part 2:

Rhinox: There he is! Optimus, let me go smack some sense into that small armed menace!

Optimus Prime(MV1): Stand down, Rhinox. I am not going to say it again. We are here to help. I am giving Grimlock fair warning and time to think about what he is doing.

Grimlock: You'll GIVE me some time to think about what I'm doing? Bah! I'll TAKE the time to enhance my Battle Tactics Mod.

Optimus Prime(MV1): So be it. You have been warned.

Grimlock: And you've proven your weakness and lack of a strategy to combat the likes of I Grimlock!

Part 3:

Optimus Prime(MV1): Time is up Grimlock. Have you come to your senses?

Grimlock: Always so arrogant, Optimus. I have my senses, and my brain, and my size, and my power. I do not need your approval to know I am the best, the greatest, The King!

Optimus Prime(MV1): The Commander and I have faced great hardship to get here. We are not leaving without you.

Grimlock: The old Grimlock might have said, "Me Grimlock know how to smash brains, maybe yours." But that was the past.

I Grimlock feel it is suffice to say... I will never return to a place where mighty Cybertronian bots allow the tiny little humans to command them. NEVER!

Part 4:

Optimus Prime(MV1): Are you ready to head back to HQ with us soldier?

Grimlock: Yes, and I do concede that the Commander is a skilled strategist. Commander used Commander brain and numbers to beat I... er... me Grimlock. Let's go home.

Maybe the other Dinobots will be there and we can go fishing.

sections.heading: Synergy Bonuses
sections.text:
* Allies - Ramjet, Bludgeon, Kickback - +2~3~8% Armor.
* Enemies - Optimus Prime - 2~3~8% Attack Rating.
* Enemies - Blaster - 2~3~8% Attack Rating.
* Shield Amp - Mirage, Rhinox - 2~4~10% damage reduction when Shielded.
* Brain Gain - Shockwave - Soundwave increases his Attack against Demolition Bots by 10~15~25% at the start of the fight. Shockwave only benefits from this bonus if all Bots on the team have this Synergy.
* Brain Drain - Shockwave - Shockwave's Shocks last 8~10~25% longer.
* Till All is Ours - Megatron - All Decepticons gain 5~10~15% Attack against Autobots.
* Taped Together - Soundblaster - Increase Heavy Attack Damage by 4~10~14%.
* Leadership (5-Star) - +10% Power Rate for all lower tier teammates.

sections.heading: Commander
sections.text:
While Soundwave has above average health than other Bots, his main drawback is that he cannot generate Power by attacking. However, if he manages to hit his opponent with his Heavy Attack or Special 2, he will start gaining Power over time quickly. If he gets hit, he will also gain Power as normal bots. If you can stall for time, do so after the power gain; then he will have a huge power advantage over the opponent.

Soundwave arguably has the most offensive moveset of Tech bots, dealing significant damage with special 2 thus encouraging a repeat charge and discharge tactic, thus the power control abilities of his other specials often end up secondary and situational.

Compared to Jetfire's reflection, Soundwave's deals more damage than Jetfire's. (100% on a max-ranked Jetfire compared to 140% on Soundwave) But they are passively activated and only have a chance to reflect, whereas Jetfire can actively reflect with manual timing.

sections.heading: General
sections.text: Al Soundwave is a powerful greedy bot relying on his heavy attacks and his Special 2 to be effective, dodge them to prevent him from generating max power. Try to use as many normal attacks as possible so his Power will be remain capped at 2 bars. Abilities like Backfire, Nullify, and power draining abilities can hamper him from using his Special.

sections.heading: Rulers of Kaon
sections.text: Rulers of Kaon Soundwave plays like any other Soundwave fight, though with this Soundwave awakened and having a higher block proficiency, it's best not to spam ranged heavies (Like Shockwave's - if you happen to run a Brain Drain Blaster for example it's best to wait until you use a special 1 or 3) Also try not to be tagged by his heavy so he doesn't gain more power.

sections.heading: Strong Match-Ups
sections.text:
*Ironhide (ROTF) - Soundwave’s Sonic Shield is extremely effective against Ironhide’s Special Attacks reflecting his Ranged Attacks back at him. On the contrary, Ironhide would only tear himself apart.
*Hound - Reflecting Hound's ranged attacks can easily bring the bulky bot down.
*Megatron (ROTF) - Shocks ignore Megatron’s tough armor and the sonic shield will ensure that the damage from the impair charges will never be inflicted upon him. Instead Megatron will be using his heavy attacks on himself. Same goes with his G1 Self when his fusion canon reaches full power
*Galvatron - The master of Demolitions will be self-Dark Burned by Sonic Shield.

sections.heading: Mods
sections.text:
* Finesse - Soundwave's Power Gain ignores the zero Power Rate debuff instigated by this Mod.
*Laser Guidance Module - Bots who uses ranged attacks especially those whose heavy attacks are ranged will get their shots reflected back on them with no time to block.

sections.heading: Weak Match-Ups
sections.text:
*Windblade - Windblade can neutralize Soundwave’s Power Gain and inflict extra damage with her Special 1. Soundwave’s Heavy Attack is also very ineffective when Windblade is using her own Heavy Attack because of her ability to make Ranged Attacks miss.
*Kickback - This Insecticon will easily consume Soundwave's shocks, Power Leak and Power Gain with his Heavy Attacks, as well as prevent Soundwave from spamming heavy attacks with T-Clog.
*Grindor - Grindor does more damage as the opponent gains power and since soundwave is a power-hungry bot, Grindor will tear Soundwave apart.
*Hot Rod - Decelerations can weaken Soundwave’s ability to gain power and an awakened Hot Rod will allow to win the power race thanks to his acceleration buffs.
*Grimlock - the king Dino will find Soundwave’s shocks to be a joke as they get instantly purified once inflicted.
*Megatronus - The relic of obedience will prevent the power-hungry Soundwave from gaining power when he spams heavies or even activate his sonic shield despite the class type advantages though a duped Soundwave can reflect his dark burning abilities back at him.

sections.heading: Mods
sections.text:
* Power Conductor - Soundwave will be unable to use his Special 2, as his static Power will immediately drop the moment his Power Gain ends.
*Paralyzer - This mod will drain Soundwave’s power hampering his ability on using his specials.

sections.heading: Recommended Modules
sections.text:
Make Soundwave a Superior Base Defender with these mods!
*Laser Guidance Module - When Soundwave Reflects the opponent’s Ranged Attacks, the Laser Guidance Module will enhance its damage.
*Robot Resource & Superconductor 2000 - The synergy between Soundwave’s Power Gain plus the Power Gain from those modules can stack. This will create a deadly combination in your base.
*Transwarp Cell - with this mod, Soundwave can drain the opponents' Power while charging his own. That would be very unfair!
*Tech Console - This radio drops some serious Shocks and Shields that will be strengthened, making it so Soundwave will be even more superior.
*E. M. I. Module - Optional if Soundwave's Signature is at low level.

*Soundwave's design is based on his Titans Return toy, but with his own concussion blaster.
*Soundwave is the only Bot that does not have an alt-mode in the game. According to the designers, "There were a lot of jokes whether kids today would know what a boombox with tapes is and the obvious scale difference once he transforms into a boombox.  He would look strange being so small next a giant robot that could step on him or kick him off screen and end the match instantly."
*Soundwave and Blaster are the only Bots that deploys other bots, namely his pets Laserbeak and Ravage. Blaster deploys Rewind and Steeljaw.
*Soundwave is the only Bot who "speaks", when activating his Specials.

sections.heading: Obtainment
sections.text:
Spark Essence is primarily earned through the solo Daily Missions. There are two maps for Basic Sparks: An easy map for Tier 1 Basic Spark Essence, and a medium map for Tier 2 Basic Spark Essence. For Class Sparks, there are three maps: an easy map for Tier 1 Class Spark, medium map for around 850 Tier 2 Class Spark Essence, and hard map for around 2100 Tier 2 Class Spark Essence.

Class Spark Essence maps Tiers 1-2 are also rotated throughout the week, with Sunday having all six Tier 1 and Tier 2 Class Spark Essence maps. The order of Class throughout the week is:
*Monday - Crystal Shards
*Tuesday - Brawler
*Wednesday - Warrior
*Thursday - Scout
*Friday - Tech
*Saturday - Demolitions
*Sunday- Tactician

Each day also offers Daily Deals, in-app purchases which are Alpha Spark bundles or Class bundles.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
The difficulty of obtaining a Spark increases in this following order: Basic -> Class -> Alpha -> Mod. More specifically, this list of difficulty is as follows:
*T1 Basic -> T1 Class -> T2 Basic -> T2 Class -> T1 Alpha -> T1 Mod -> T3 Basic -> T2 Alpha -> T3 Class -> T4 Basic -> T2 Mod

*The shapes of Sparks are polyhedrons:
**A T1 Spark's shape is a Platonic (Regular) Tetrahedron
**A T2 Spark's shape is a Platonic (Regular) Octahedron
**A T3 Spark's shape is a Archimedean Cuboctahedron
**A T4 Spark's shape is a Platonic (Regular) Dodecahedron
**A T5 Spark's shape is a Icosahedron

Basic and Class Spark have silver borders, while Alpha and Mod Spark have black borders.

Special Mission.lead:
{{Quotes|Just popping in one last time to say, clearly and distinctly, writing strange stories for you Commanders has been a true highlight of my career.
May you find continued joy and delight in this treasured franchise my friends.
'Till all are one.|- Vin_Cent : silly storyteller human, last Discord message}}

Special Missions are limited-time Solo-player missions to promote new characters and side stories. They are unlocked at player level 12.

The main type of Special Mission are Spotlight Missions, which are story-driven missions with multiple difficulty levels. 

There are also occasional gauntlets such as Challenge Missions, which present you with short maps with six bots that have special Utility Module buffs in three difficulties. Or Fog of War, the most viable way to get all tiers of Class Spark essence especially tier 4, but doesn't appear that often.

Bring the Noise
