sections.heading: Chrono-Vector: Grimlock Saves the Day!
sections.text:
Wheeljack has been experimenting on a device that could harness the many new and strange energies on New Quintessa. His new, and untested, Chrono-Vector Device could POTENTIALLY allow the user to travel along a time-bridge. Unfortunately the first unexpected test-run is manned by Grimlock, a dinobot on a mission. Can Wheeljack and Optimus Prime stop the mighty Grimlock from unravelling the past? Only TIME will tell!

* Date: June 6th-20th
* Notes:

sections.heading: Till All Are Gone
sections.text:
The Reforging Energy triggered by Megatronus trying to awaken the mysterious Titan has thrown the world into disarray. Fearing what may be happening, the Autobots send a scout towards the epicentre of a disturbance, in hopes that they may identify the Titan, or at least find some answers. However, the communications they received were troubling, before stopping all together... Things go from bad to worse when a new foe wearing a familiar face joins the fray. The sinister Nemesis Prime. Created using a subspace impulse cloner, Nemesis Prime is a malicious copy of the heroic Optimus Prime. Although he wears the Decepticon insignia, it’s unclear where his loyalties lie. Now Commander, it’s up to you and Optimus to try and hold things together and fight off the emerging darkness in the suspenseful new Spotlight Mission, Till All Are Gone!

* Date: July 4th~

sections.heading: A Tale Of Two Stingers
sections.text:
Two Stingers, No Clue! - Adding to the troubles of an already war-torn world, the Predacon forces are on the move. Luckily, those forces number just two: Scorponok and Waspinator. The destructive duo are looking for a Space Bridge to bring down more of their kind, but seem to be bumping into Bots in the middle of far more epic and odd missions than they are on. Will their spiteful stingers wound this world, or will they merely be a buzzing annoyance?

* Date: August 1~2

sections.heading: Fog of War: Null-Field
sections.text:
The Decepticons have developed cloaking technology and are using it to ambush us out in the field. They must be stopped.

* Date: August 15 until August 22nd
* Notes: In this first Fog Of War Map, Commanders will be challenged by unknown assailants on what looks like an empty map.
** These cloaked Bots guard the way to your final struggle with the one and only, Megatronus!
** Of course no challenge is without rewards and this will be a way for Commanders to obtain hard to find Class Essence! Getting past these ambushes come with a high energy cost, but will reward you with Class Spark Essence for the Bot that you defeat.
** There are 4 difficulties to choose from. The higher the Difficulty, the rarer the Tier of Class Spark Essence!
** Deception - 10 T1 Class Spark Essence per Fight
** Deceit - 60 Class T2 Spark Essence per Fight
** Disguise - 135 T3 Class Spark Essence per Fight
** Darken - 40 T4 Class Spark Essence per Fight
** You may encounter an occasional tougher Enemy! While they’re more dangerous, defeating them will reward 4x the Class Essence!

sections.heading: Prime Suspect
sections.text: * Date: August 28

sections.heading: Chrono-Vector: Generations
sections.text: * Date: Sept 12th - Sept 25th

sections.heading: Magnus Opus
sections.text:
The devious doubles and clever clones SEEM to have left New Quintessa but they have created havoc in their wake. The Autobots can no longer trust one another, and one Bot's return has started to create a clash between factions. Ultra Magnus is at the center of a conflict he can't hope to overcome in one piece. It will be up to Ratchet and Grimlock to visit their friends and see if sense can be made from a world where nothing is as it seems. Will the Autobots find harmony? Or will this tune split up their merry band? FIND OUT in the first entry of this new TRILOGY of spotlights CIVIL WAR: CHAPTER 1 - MAGNUS OPUS.

Date: January 2nd

sections.heading: Speak No Evil
sections.text:
Around this point onward Spotlight Missions were sub-titled Time-Slides, shorter 2-week missions.

The Time-Slides continue to throw all of New Quintessa across infinite possibilities and realities. Skilled Cityspeaker Windblade discovers that many of the planets had different Titans slumbering within them. Will these massive monsters hold clues that can help her friends? Or is she lost to wander the timelines? Find out more in SPEAK NO EVIL.

* Date: July 30-August 13, 2020
*Notes: Revamps difficulties to the current 4 -level Novice-Captain-Commander-Prime difficulties.

sections.heading: Starscream's Brigade
sections.text:
We join with the Starscream of another Timeline who has gotten what he wanted, he now "leads" the Decepticons. But there is no happily ever after for this treacherous Bot. The Commander is forced to join in to keep up appearances on this twisted world, but how long will the duo last as STARSCREAM'S BRIGADE?

*Date: August 13-27, 2020

sections.heading: Doctor's Orders
sections.text:
Ratchet finds the Commander and recruits them to help with the repair of some Bots. However not everyone is excited to see both sides of the war getting patched by the Autobot Doc. Will Ratchet be able to have the patience to save his patients? We'll have to follow DOCTOR'S ORDERS! An all new adventure inspired by the Netflix series TRANSFORMERS: WAR FOR CYBERTRON

*Date: October 1-15, 2020
*Featured Bots:

sections.heading: Evil Tread - From Rust Till Dawn
Evil Tread - Monster Hunt
sections.text:
Ultra Magnus looks to exorcise spectral corruptions from Autobots and Decepticons alike! Can Ultra Magnus record his findings and survive this harrowing experience? Find out in Evil Tread - Monster Hunt! 

*Date: October 15th~29th, 2020
*Featured Bots: - Bonecrusher, Optimus Primal, Ultra Magnus
*Notes: First to be announced on fully migrated Discord

sections.heading: Shock To The Spark
sections.text:
The minds of Autobots and Decepticons have mysteriously been wiped! Restore their minds and find the culprit in Shock to the Spark.

*Date: October 29th~November 12th, 2020
*Featured Bots: Hot Rod, Galvatron, Optimus Prime (MV1)

sections.heading: Logical Fallacy
sections.text:
This timeline jump once again brings the Commander into the middle of the Cybertronian Civil War. Jetfire encounters an Autobot seeking to gather medical supplies to assist all those who need help. Will this be the spark that lets a seeker see the error of his ways? Or will they draw the wrong conclusions? Find out in LOGICAL FALLACY. 

*Date: November 12th ~ 26th
* Featured Bots: Hot Rod, Galvatron, Optimus Prime (MV1)

sections.heading: Primal Rage
sections.text:
Time-Slides continue to throw our teams across infinite realities and possibilities. In this Time-Slide, Optimus Primal seems to be infected by a Predacon virus causing him to go into a blind rage.
*Date: November 26th~December 10th

sections.heading: Silent Night, Ember Light
sections.text:
In this Holiday Time-Slide, Shattered Glass has returned to wish good tidings and happy holidays to Optimus on Ember Festival Day! However, it turns our the mirror universe doppelganger is not alone...

*Date: December 10th~31st
*Bots of the Month:

sections.heading: Mad Mixmaster
sections.text:
A time-slide into a world where the only way to be ruler is to be ruthless. If you're not smashing you're about to be smashed. Will Marissa be able to steer the Commander through constant attacks, or will they get ground up and remade by MAD MIXMASTER?

* Date: December 31st ~ January 14th
*Featured Bots: Jazz, Starscream, Ratchet

sections.heading: Missing Aspects
sections.text:
A Time-Slide to a world where Megatronus was not seeking the power of a Titan but Aspects of a strange ancient artifact called the Emberstone. A tool made to create life, but capable of providing untold power to those who look to corrupt it. The Commander will have to make some dark alliances to find out more as they look for MISSING ASPECTS. 

*Date: January 14th ~ January 28th
*Featured Bots:

sections.heading: Heavy Metal
sections.text:
Jetfire and Wheeljack are trying to fix a powerful Space Bridge to organize the Autobots back together. Unfortunately, Heavy Munition Bots are programmed to guard or destroy the bridge before it can be switched on. 

*Date: January 28th ~ February 10th
*Bots of the Month: Soundwave, Bludgeon, Ramjet

sections.heading: Time After Time
sections.text:
Encoded notes are streaming from the future and they are all addressed to Starscream. Marissa is forced to track along with the Decepticon as he looks for the source of this secretive author. Will the mystery be solved or will the letters spell out certain doom? Find out in TIME AFTER TIME! 

* Date: February 11th ~ February 25th
*Notes: First Spotlight mission of the 8.5 update

sections.heading: Headmaster and Commander
sections.text:
Wheeljack and Jetfire have begun to piece together some of the scattered Time-Slides, but that doesn’t mean everything is going well. As Scorponok peers into a timeline where he’s a gigantic protector of a Space Bridge! He sees this as a true calling and will protect the timelines no matter the cost. Will the Autobots be able to fight off this multi-minded menace? Or will they finally fall? Find out by playing HEADMASTER AND COMMANDER! 

*Date: February 25th ~ March 11th
*Bots of the Month: Ironhide, Windblade, Blaster, Motormaster
*Notes: introduces Rank 6 5-Star Bots

sections.heading: Prime Conflicts
sections.text:
Optimus Prime finds himself stolen out of time and space, floating in a Dead Universe. He must face off against his darkest reflections and be judged by the universe itself if he ever hopes to return. Will Optimus keep his Spark lit, or is it about to be snuffed in PRIME CONFLICTS!?

* Date: March 11th ~ March 31st
*Bots of the Month:

sections.heading: Shock, Scream, Thunder
sections.text:
The Space Bridge has brought the Commander back to New Quintessa but without the team of Autobots they left with. No worries, there is already a team waiting for them. A team of...SEEKERS? Maybe SOME worries should be had as Thundercracker and Starscream inform you that Shockwave and the Quintessons are hatching some evil plans. Will the world shake apart as you team up with those who seek to destroy? Find out in SHOCK, SCREAM, THUNDER! 

*Date: April 1st~April 15th
*Bots of the Month: Wheeljack, Dinobot, Barricade

sections.heading: Twist of Fates
sections.text:
Quintessons betray Shockwave, nobody is surprised, except Shockwave. Starscream and Thundercracker now work with the freshly arrived Autobots to pick up the pieces. The Quintessons seem to have a frightening control over the time-stream and an army is growing. What can save the Bots? Where will they jump to next? Only TIME will tell with this TWIST OF FATES.

*Date: April 15th~April 29th
*Bots of the Month:

sections.heading: Might as Well Jump
sections.text:
This world needs Cliffjumper to disrupt the timeline! Can Wheeljack and Jetfire figure out the tangled web of time to jump their friend here? Or will they only make more knots in this already complex multiversal mayhem? There’s no time to spare and no other plan so we MIGHT AS WELL JUMP! 

* Date: April 29th~May 13th
* Bots of the Month: Kickback, Shockwave, Hound
*Notes: 4th Anniversary 20% Gold and XP Boost

sections.heading: Jump Around
sections.text:
Bringing over a new Autobot is no easy task, and headstrong Cliffjumper may have been living the tough life on his own for too long as he seems a bit TOO eager for a fight. This is only the start of the Autobots’ troubles. Will they manage to keep on track, or will they lose footing as they JUMP AROUND?

*Date: May 13th~May 27th
*Bots of the Month:

sections.heading: Animal Altercation
sections.text:
Rhinox’s space bridge was wrecked by Cliffjumper coming through, ruining their chances to go back. What’s worse it seems that Wheeljack missed a figure or two in his calculations and his meddling with time and space is having far-reaching consequences across New Quintessa! Will the Maximals be able to rally, or will they fall victim to this ANIMAL ALTERCATION!? 

*Date: May 27th~June 10th
*Bots of the Month: Optimus Prime G1, Mixmaster, Drift, Tantrum

sections.heading: Purple Reign
sections.text:
Scorponok and Waspinator are a great pair, but they know they need a leader. With the timelines and reality of New Quintessa shifting this may be their chance to do something no one ever thought was possible… To give up on getting their REAL Megatron here and paint Dinobot purple!

*Date: June 10th~June 24th
*Bots of the Month:

sections.heading: Fog of War: Gorilla in the Mist
sections.text:
The multiverses are still open and Beast Bots are spilling in from all over. There are reports that a leader of these dangerous animals is deep within the latest Fog Of War and it's up to the Commander to see if they can capture the GORILLA IN THE MIST!
*Date: June 24th~July 1st
*Notes: Crystal Open Alliance Event for the same above mentioned period.

sections.heading: Cliffjump the Shark
sections.text:
Cliffjumper is feeling understandably disconnected in this timeline. His reality has only been fighting and taking care of himself, luckily (or unluckily) it seems some other lost Bots are looking for fresh leadership. The SHARKTICONS look to put Cliffjumper through his paces and see if he's worthy of joining (or maybe even leading) their ranks! Will he take a bite out of the competition, or will he fall short as we CLIFFJUMP THE SHARK.

*Date: July 1st~July 15th
*Bots of the Month: Waspinator, Megatron Gen, Prowl

sections.heading: Free Sharky
sections.text:
Cliffjumper gives the Sharkticon’s and S-1000 freedom from leaders forever, through defeating all their prior leaders. However this new and complicated timeline may not be Cliffjumper’s cup of Energon. Will he want to lead? Will he want to stay? All we know is that he’s going to be in for the fight of his life if he has any hope to FREE SHARKY! 

Date: 10AM EDT July 15th~July 29th

sections.heading: Patch Atoms
sections.text:
Ratchet helps out bots that have been affected by the recent space bridge shattering and other time anomalies. Who will be willing to accept the help of an Autobot? What kind of procedures will need to be done mid-battle? Will Ratchet have the patience for his patients? You'll have to find out as he tries to PATCH ATOMS 

*Date: July 29th~August 12th
*Bots of the Month: Grimlock, Cheetor, Mirage

sections.heading: The Only Sound
sections.text:
Nemesis Prime thought that his task was to align the tangle of time-lines on New Quintessa into one glorious thread. However it seems that the knot has gotten out of hand and he’s starting to lash out at the biggest Bots he can find. Will Nemesis find unity or destruction as he sees if he can hear THE ONLY SOUND. 

*Date: August 12th~August 26th
*Notes: 8.7 update and 8.7.1 patch

sections.heading: Golden Gears
sections.text:
Marissa is tasked with a troubling assignment. With Nemesis Prime no longer monitoring timeline twisting events, some MASSIVE tasks fall upon her shoulders. She recruits the Commander to help with the first of these missions, ensuring that Galvatron sends back a Golden Disc of vital information to his past self. Will the Commander be up for the mission? Will it stumble before it even takes off? We’ll see what winds up in the GOLDEN GEARS!

*Date: August 26th~September 9th
* Bots of the Month: Sideswipe, Arcee, Jetfire, Cyclonus

sections.heading: Double Back Again
sections.text:
Marissa is still convinced that to begin repairing the timeline certain events must occur as originally written in Teletraan’s databanks. Starting with the unpleasant plans to get them out of the way she looks to assist the Decepticons in sending back a Golden Disc to Megatron that is fabled to give him information on future events. However, if she thought the Autobots were unwilling to assist with this goal, just wait until she sees how stubborn a Decepticon can be when offered help! Will she make the past happen on time, or will she need to DOUBLE BACK AGAIN? 

*Date: SEPTEMBER 9th~September 30th
* Notes: Arcee and Barricade Fixes and Updates

sections.heading: Bump in the Night
sections.text:
Something has ripped open a door to the Dead Universe and ghosts from a dark and troubling timeline have begun leaking into New Quintessa. Since this is some new paranormal science, and everyone else is busy, Marissa turns to Wheeljack to go out there and smash some spectres. Will Wheeljack be able to fight back his fears and discover what’s going BUMP IN THE NIGHT?

*Date: September 30th~October 14th
* Bots of the Month: Bonecrusher, Optimus Primal, Ultra Magnus

sections.heading: In the Afterlife
sections.text:
A rip to the Dead Dimension has been spotted and it’s up to Wheeljack and Jetfire to take a walk through the abyss to try and sort things out. What terrors will be revealed? Where will the journey take them? How will they stop bickering for long enough to answer the last two questions? Only way to find out is to find the team IN THE AFTERLIFE! 

*Dates: October 14th~October 28th

sections.heading: Tale as Old as Time
sections.text:
Jetfire and Wheeljack unexpectedly land out of the dead universe in the distance future after the end of the Autobot and Decepticon war and meet the Maximals who are battling over the Golden Disc. Unfortunately the arrival of the Autobots have some very unexpected results on the future forms of their Maximal descendants. 

*Date: 10AM EDT October 28th ~ November 11th
*Bots of the Month: Hot Rod, Galvatron, Cinematic Optimus Prime
* Notes: 8.8 update

sections.heading: A Lesson Learned in Time
sections.text:
All this time-travel, world hopping, and reality bending seems to be getting to the heroic Autobots Wheeljack and Jetfire. As they continue searching for a Golden Disk lost in time, they run into a familiar face from the past also seeking some control. Perhaps there is more to discover than it seems at first, as these Bots find themselves with A LESSON LEARNED IN TIME. 

*Dates: 9AM EST November 11th ~ November 25th

sections.heading: Sound and Fury
sections.text:
MEANWHILE BACK ON NEW QUINTESSA. Things are getting loud and strange as an experiment seems to have gone haywire and Autobots are reporting back blocked broadcasts and terrible tunes! Who could be behind this menacing musical madness? Hopefully Jazz, Bumblebee, and the Commander can find the source of this SOUND AND FURY!

*Date: November 25th ~ December 9th.
*Bots of the Month: Rhinox, Scorponok, Grindor, Megatron (ROTF)

sections.heading: Grimlock Saves Ember Festival
sections.text:
EMBER LIGHT FESTIVAL: It is a time of year where the world is the darkest, but noble Bots still warm themselves with the company of each other’s Sparks and the spirit of giving. There’s no bigger fan of this tradition than GRIMLOCK but he MAY have more SPIRIT than SENSE when it comes to celebration. Will things get scrapped or will we find that GRIMLOCK SAVES EMBER FESTIVAL!? 

*Date: December 9th ~ December 23rd
* Notes: Fixed an issue where sometimes Projectiles are slower when fighting Nemesis Prime, Adjusted the timing on Cliffjumper's SP3 so Glass Gas Debuffs don't run out during the special animation

sections.heading: Fog of War: Spirit of Ember Future
sections.text:
A new seeker has been spotted in the skies. As the Commander approaches the edge of the Fog of War this mysterious and dark specter of a Seeker steps out to warn them of a foreboding future. Who is this Seeker? What waits ahead? And what will light the way in with the SPIRIT OF EMBER FUTURE?

* Date: December 23rd ~ December 30th
The Spotlight Missions with the return of new bots are now sub-titled Bot Incursions.

sections.heading: Gatekeepers
sections.text:
There’s a blank spot on the map and it’s causing distress back in Autobot HQ. A brand new anomaly is making itself known, guarded by Decepticons, and rumored to be cursed. Can Wheeljack and the Commander break through enemy lines to learn more? Or will they find themselves stopped by some sinister GATEKEEPERS? 

*Date: December 30th ~ January 13th.
*Bots of the Month: Ratchet, Jazz, Starscream
*Notes:

sections.heading: Fight or Flight
sections.text:
There seems to be something new and scary happening on New Quintessa. While Wheeljack is off researching it, another Bot is looking for more immediate actions. SHOCKWAVE is taking the Commander for a trip deeper into the anomaly to retrieve some Decepticon Seekers! Will this mission spell doom and gloom? We’ll have to see as we take FIGHT OR FLIGHT!

* Date: January 13th ~ January 27th.
* Bots of the Month:
*Notes:

sections.heading: Fear.exe
sections.text:
Wheeljack is joined by some back-up Bots to see if they can reach the space bridge. Wheeljack thinks he may have found a way to turn down the code of fear that Dirge has put out, but as with many of Wheeljack’s experiments things don’t go as planned. Will the Autobots be able to fight on to find more Bots? Or will their final program be run as they face FEAR.EXE.

*Date: January 27th ~ February 10th
*Bots of the Month: Soundwave, Bludgeon, Ramjet
*Notes:

sections.heading: No Way Back
sections.text:
Having moved past the fear Dirge placed on the natural spacebridge, Optimus and Bumblebee head out to investigate the source of the new Deceptions. What use can this bridge have? What horrors does it hold? There is much debate, even amongst the Autobots, about what to do with this dangerous gate. Will the Autobots find a way home? Or will they discover there is NO WAY BACK?

*Date: February 10th ~ February 24th.
*Notes: 9.0 update and 5th anniversary calendar and boosts

sections.heading: Mean Gears
sections.text:
Space Bridges, Wormholes, and other Time-Space Anomalies have been thrown open all across New Quintessa. Some Bots have been finding their way here who may not have even noticed they crossed over. Such is the case with SKYWARP who finds himself once again on the Seeker Squad as they reintroduce themselves and begin their plots to take control of their destiny. Who will fall to these severe Seekers, and will they be ground up by their MEAN GEARS? 

*Date: February 24th ~ March 10th
*Bots of the Month: Skywarp, Sideswipe, Prowl, Scorponok, Galvatron
* Notes:

sections.heading: Losing Ground
sections.text:
The Seekers have gained a new member in Skywarp, but have they lost touch with the rest of New Quintessa? It may turn out that three seekers isn’t just a crowd, it’s a COUP! Will Starscream and Thundercracker keep control of Skywarp or will they be LOSING GROUND?

*Date: March 10th~March 31st
*Bots of the Month:
*Notes:

sections.heading: Branding Iron
sections.text:
Natural Space Bridges continue to provide new Bots a path to New Quintessa. Autobot backup should be a cause for celebration, but it seems like some big egos (and bigger blasters) are clashing as IRONHIDE joins his compatriots. Will the Commander be able to turn down the heat on this feud or will they find themselves marked by a BRANDING IRON?

*Date: March 31st~April 14th
*Bots of the Month: Ironhide, Blaster, Grindor, Cyclonus, Dinobot
*Notes:

sections.heading: Turned to Steel
sections.text:
The Decepticons are in disarray, disagreement, and on a disastrous path. The Autobots look to use this to their advantage but is their team truly together? New arrivals add fire-power but their lack of preparation may be their downfall! Will Ironhide and Bumblebee have each other’s backs, or will their Sparks be TURNED TO STEEL?

*Date: April 14th~May 5th.
*Bots of the Month:
*Notes: Extended anniversary boost.

sections.heading: Screen Time
sections.text:
Autobots from an alternative universe feel that the Commander has been playing favorites and abandoning them in battle. Will the Commander be able to convince the Autobots that they have their backs no matter the challenge? Or will they become distracted by Decepticon dangers? You’ll need your whole focus as you manage your SCREEN TIME.

*Date: May 5th~May 19th
*Bots of the Month:
*Notes:

sections.heading: A Bad Name
sections.text:
A new Decepticon has entered the fight in New Quintessa! Slipstream has arrived and it looks like Megatron has decided to utilize her particular set of skills. It’s time to clean house in the Decepticon camp and the first on the list are those who dared not to fall in line with Megatron’s rule. Will Slipstream change the course of battle? Or will they just prove they are living up to A BAD NAME? 

*Date: May 19th~June 2nd
*Bots of the Month: Slipstream, Optimus Primal, Cheetor, Kickback, Tantrum
*Notes:

sections.heading: Who Run the World
sections.text:
Seeing the possibilities of a new arrival, Arcee and Windblade seek to see if Slipstream can be reasoned with, and possibly even recruited. However the Bots don’t exactly see optic to optic and Slipstream seems more interested in leading a new team rather than joining any of the old ones. Will Arcee and Windblade convince this Decepticon to fight for the greater good? Or will we really figure out which are the Bots WHO RUN THE WORLD? 

*Date: June 2nd~June 22nd
*Bots of the Month:
*Notes: 9.1.1 patch

sections.heading: Nothing and Everything
sections.text:
After defeating the newly arrived dimension-hopping SLIPSTREAM, the Commander and Autobots gain some valuable intel. A Bot, thought to be lost to the multiverses, has been here on New Quintessa! RODIMUS PRIME has been spotted in a dangerous place between dimensions. Will Arcee, Bumblebee, and Wheeljack be able to find their lost friend? Or will they find NOTHING AND EVERYTHING?

*Date: June 23rd~July 7th
* Bots of the Month: Rodimus Prime, Dirge, Arcee, Wheeljack, Shockwave
* Notes:

sections.heading: Dare to Believe
sections.text:
Rodimus Prime is back amongst the Autobots on New Quintessa, but it’s not a happy reunion. Seeing Optimus only brings back bitter memories for Rodimus, of how he may have failed in the past, and the uncertainty of his future. Will Rodimus Prime arise as a new force amongst the Autobots? Do we DARE TO BELIEVE?

*Date: July 7th~July 28th
* Bots of the Month:
*Notes:

sections.heading: Training Montage
sections.text:
Mirage has made some interesting improvements on his invisibility tech, now he can project perfect copies of his Autobot friends! The tech is still in the testing phase but he wants the Commander to train alongside some Autobot pals as he figures it out. To keep spirits up, Blaster is also on site to ensure that there’s some terrific tunes for this TRAINING MONTAGE.

*Date: July 28th~August 11th
*Showcase Bots: Jetfire, Hound
*Notes:

sections.heading: Shining Star
sections.text:
Sunstreaker has arrived on New Quintessa, much to the delight of his twin brother Sideswipe. But not all is well within the Autobot family reunion as Sunstreaker seems to have it out for the Commander. Will Sideswipe be able to sway his brother into falling in line with their new human friend, or will we be blinded by the rage of this SHINING STAR?

*Date: August 11th~August 25th
*Bots of the Month: Sunstreaker, Mixmaster, Optimus Prime (MV1), Grimlock, Drift
*Notes:

sections.heading: Those Fortunate Ones
sections.text:
Sunstreaker isn’t keen on joining any team the Commander is a part of, so they look to get the party started on their own terms. Can Sunstreaker and his brother Sideswipe find some Bots to join the cause? If they do, who will be THOSE FORTUNATE ONES? 

*Date: August 25th~September 15th
*Bots of the Month:
*Notes:

sections.heading: Play the Hits
sections.text:
A new Bot has appeared on New Quintessa, or have they been here all along? A miscommunication leads the Commander to the secret lair of Soundblaster who is claiming to have some big plans for this little world. Will this new tune sync up with the Autobot and Decepticon playlists? We’ll have to find out as we drop the needle on this track to PLAY THE HITS!

*Date: September 15th~September 29th
*Bots of the Month: Soundblaster, Rhinox, Mirage, Megatron (ROTF), Optimus Prime (Gen)
*Notes:

sections.heading: Make Some Noise
sections.text:
The Commander has managed to join Soundblaster’s team of do-badders as a double-agent as they report back to Autobot HQ. It seems like Soundblaster has some dark plans for New Quintessa, as they are gathering forces and looking to cause trouble. Will the Commander be able to sneak along with them and figure things out? Or after this adventure will they even be able to MAKE SOME NOISE?

*Date: September 29th~October 20th

sections.heading: Release the Beast
sections.text:
Strange times make for strange team-ups. With the shakeup of New Quintessa teams, the Maximals have decided to expand their ranks WITH SHARKTICONS! Will these finned foes become fantastic friends? Hopefully their training will be enough to RELEASE THE BEAST!

* Date: October 20th ~ November 3rd
*Notes: Gorilla in the Mist Fog of War re-launched on 2nd week for the rest of the game.

sections.heading: A Glass Darkly
sections.text:
New Quintessa is ripping apart, universes are collapsing, evil seems to be around every corner, it's time for old friends to come and help! Luckily, Shattered Glass Megatron and Starscream, the delightful Decepticon Duo, are here to lend some firepower to the fight! Will these reflected doubles be enough to buy our heroes some time, or will they only be reflected in A GLASS DARKLY?

* Date: November 3rd ~ November 17th
* Bots of the Month: Motormaster, Windblade, Ultra Magnus, Barricade

sections.heading: Sky's the Limit
sections.text:
More information is being learned about the terrible fate awaiting New Quintessa. Optimus has hope that he can perhaps buy some time to escape, but the skys are darkened by one last attack from the SEEKERS! Will the Commander be able to free their friends and escape, or will they find that the SKY’S THE LIMIT?!

* Date: November 17th ~ December 1st

sections.heading: Exodus Protocol
sections.text:
The time has come to leave this world, its many realities, its countless timelines, and seek adventure in the infinite multiverse. However, dark forces still look to claim what power remains and perhaps corrupt all worlds beyond. One final mission remains, as Optimus and the Commander initiate the EXODUS PROTOCOL.

* Date: December 1st ~ January 13th, 2023

Going into 2023, the Exodus Protocol mission was the only one running until lights out.

The game's second wind found no new Special Missions being run, the only thing in play being a continuous Fog of War cycle.

But it happens that a new movie featuring the Beast Bots is coming out, so pleasantries have been made with a second helping of...

sections.heading: Proving Grounds
sections.text:
...Giving Commanders another go with the Beasties.
* Date: June 9-?
* Notes: Also, the Mirage Gauntlet.

sections.heading: Legends of Cybertron
sections.text:
{{main|Legends of Cybertron}}
Unlocked at level 25, these permanent Special Missions are the uttermost difficult missions in the game.

sections.heading: Rulers of Kaon
sections.text:
Optimus, inspired by his Megatron's arena-fighting past, invites ROTF Megatron to spar with many Bots powered by a special Module made by Mixmaster.
*Completion Rewards: 4-Star Harm Accelerator, Fallen Titan Hand, 3 T3 Basic Spark, 2 T2 Alpha Spark, T3 Class Spark Crystal

sections.heading: Revenge of the King
sections.text:
Grimlock arrives to take his place as King, but the Commander challenges him to it; in response, the King welcomes you to Jurassic Spark! Do you choose to endorse the park, or not?
*Completion Rewards: 10,000 5-Star Bot Crystal Shards, 1 Tier 4 Basic Spark, 1 of each Tier 3 Class Spark, 10 5-Star Signature Upgrades, Stable Nucleon Core Relic

sections.heading: Rise of Kolkular
sections.text:
Thundercracker attempts to bring the Decepticon base to New Quintessa. If you are to stop him, he has imposed a two-bot limit and six Class Gates potentially blocking your path. At least he has a heart spark light enough to node his challenges with potentially very overpowered modules. If you are able to strike him down, you will get a handsome reward...

Also, Titan Fragments! 
*Completion Rewards: 100,000 Titan Fragments, 10,000 5-Star Bot Crystal Shards, 3 Tier 4 Basic Sparks, 2 Tier 4 Class Spark Crystals, 1 Generic 5-Star Signature Awakening Program, 1,000,000 Gold
* Exploration Rewards: 200,000 Titan Fragments, 20,000 5-Star Bot Crystal Shards, 6 Tier 4 Basic Sparks, 2 Tier 4 Class Spark Crystals, 4 Tier 3 Alpha Sparks, 1 Generic 5-Star Signature Awakening Program, 2,000,000 Gold

Status Effect.lead:
Status effects are beneficial or harmful conditions that affect your bots in battle, often caused by a bot’s passive and active abilities and signature abilities. These effects can vary from permanent to temporary buffs or debuffs. For example, linked node buffs in the alliance mission feature provide permanent buffs. Some triggers in battle will spawn specific status effects.

You may view these effects as they appear under your bot’s or your opponent’s health bar, along with a cooldown meter indicating when the effects will wear off, if applicable.

The name of the status effect will also sometimes appear on or around the bots. These are the different kinds of effects that you may come across:

sections.heading: Chapter I: Autobots Turn
sections.text:
On September 26, 2019, the first chapter of the Act, Autobots Turn, launched.

Continuing from where Generations left off, Wheeljack and Jetfire are launched into a potential crisis as they end up in a parallel timeline (perhaps this was where alternate-Arcee originated from) where Megatronus' Titan-related carnage has not started. Emphasis on the has not.

There are no Autobots, no Marissa, no way to get back; all they face are corrupted Bots from a plethora of realities, ready to scrap the two. And with Shockwave in the mix, they are in for some serious trouble! To get back, they will have to put their Sparks on the line, as their journey home begins...

sections.heading: Base Defense
sections.text:
Like the Robot Resource, the Superconductor generates Power over time. However, it generates Power more slowly, and only up to a Bot's second Power bar.

With this Mod, Bots' Special 2's are unblockable, but they can still be evaded. As such, Bots with ranged Special 2's that hit quickly are the best choices. 

Prowl (both hits) and Bludgeon (last hit) are good matches, as their ranged Special 2's hit instantly, making it very hard, if not impossible, to evade. While Ironhide's Special 2, which fires near-instantly, is deadly, especially if Awakened, it can be completely evaded, or be rendered less effective by Tech Bots.

Keep in mind that Bots with this Mod are still likely to use their Special 1's instead of saving up for their Special 2's.

Synergy Bonus.lead:
Pairing certain Bots with the correct bots activates Synergy Bonuses for one or both of them. All Bots have at least one Synergy Bonus except Tier 1 Bots (which they had up to v1.0). If there is the same bot with mutliple tiers on the same team, only the bonus with the highest effect will take effect.

On this wiki,  will represent incoming bonuses that bots receive, and  will represent outgoing bonuses bots give.

Note that most 2-Star Bots start with a level 2 Synergy, and 4-Star and 5-Star bots both cap at level 4, but 2022 Bots start with level 1 Synergies at 2-Stars and have four tiers to 5-Star.

Synergy.lead: A Bot's Synergy is a special ability that activates when paired with another Bot with the same synergy.

sections.heading: Common Synergies
sections.text:
Synergies common to all Bots are:
* {{Syn/Both}} Allies - +2~3~8 Armor
* {{Syn/Out}} Enemies - +2~3~8 Attack Rating
* {{Syn/Out}} Leadership - Acting as a beacon of leadership, all lower tier teammates gain +10% Armor Rating.

The latter is only available to 5-Star bots.

Tactician.lead: {{Class_Template|number_of_champions = 11|non-playable = 0|class_bonus = Brawler|weakness = Demolition|image1 = File:Class Use Tactician.png}}Tactician is one of six Bot Classes. It has a Class Bonus against Brawler, but is weak to Demolitions.

sections.heading: Description

sections.heading: Strategy
sections.text:
Most Tech Bots can benefit from one of the three passive buffs this Mod provides. Ratchet and Sideswipe are good matches, as these bots have powerful healing and power gaining abilities that will be super-charged while under the effects of this module. Those with strong shock abilities, the most obvious being Soundwave, Shockwave and Scorponok will benefit from the Console's enhanced shock abilities. Tech.lead: {{Class Template|number_of_champions = 10|non-playable = 0|class_bonus = Demolitions|weakness = Scout|title1 = |image1 = File:Class Use Tech.png}}Techs are one of six Bot Classes in Transformers: Forged to Fight. It has a Class Bonus against Demolitions bots, but is weak to Scouts.

sections.heading: In-Game Description
sections.text:
Tech Bots generate shields, manipulate Power, and equip some of the most advanced custom weaponry. 
*Tech Bots specialize in Shields, Shock debuffs, and Power control.
*Their shielding abilities are effective against the high-damage attacks of Demolition Bots.

sections.heading: Strategies
sections.text:
Tech Bots in their respective canons are usually smart, like the resident Autobot inventor, Wheeljack. Same goes for their depiction in Forged to Fight, where this intelligence is mapped into unique abilities that they're able to use in a fight to fend off Bots of all kinds and types. Well... especially Demolitions Bots. Most Tech Bots love to utilize shields, repairs, power-related abilities, and... any type of defensive ability to successfully fend off the opponent. With a Tech, you'll be fighting strong with them.

Most Tech bots use Shields to increase defensive resistance, but Life steal, instant energy attacks and damaging debuffs can go through them, so some Demolitions Bots and some Warriors (well any bot who can inflict either) can still show down against a Tech and win. Sometimes, even pure intelligence can be outsmarted.

sections.heading: Brain Drain/Gain
sections.text: This class is unique in particular to have a special synergy exclusive to the class in general. Shockwave has a Brain Drain/Gain Synergy that activates with fellow Tech buddies of his (and only with Tech buds) regardless of faction and rarity.

This is Going to Sting.lead: This is Going to Sting is a Spotlight Mission featuring Scorponok that ran from November 1 to December 6.

sections.heading: Bug Bytes
sections.text:
Part 1
*Marissa Faireborn: Optimus Primal? I have an issue that could a Maximal scan.
*Optimus Primal: Rhinox and I are just on patrol. What needs investigating?
*Marissa Faireborn: Teletraan is showing mysterious readings on a recent arrival from the quadrant you originated from.
*Rhinox: Are they displaying as Maximal or Predacon?
*Marissa Faireborn: I don't know, brainwave scans are bouncing all over.
*Optimus Primal Hopefully we caught some luck and they are an ally...or even a Protoform.
*Marissa Faireborn: Sending last known location. Whoever it is, they're on the move.
Part 2
*Marissa Faireborn: Sorry, but the signal is just static from here.
*Optimus Primal: Not the strongest start, but we will see what we can track from the ground.
*Kickback: Trying to find someone-one?
*Rhinox: We're looking for a Maximal compatriot. You seen anyone hopping by?
*Kickback: Why should I help you-you? What's in it for me-me?
*Optimus Primal: We are all on the same team here Kickback. We are just trying to keep this new Bot safe.
*Kickback: You say team, but not everyone team player-player. The insect Bot that passed wasn't even an Insecticon-con.
*Rhinox: Insect? That usually means Predacon!
Part 3
*Kickback: You got one byte of information as a freebie, bit no more-more!
*Rhinox: Just tell us who you saw and I'll try not to give in to my temptation to swat you.
*Kickback: You catch more flies with honey-honey!
*Rhinox: Who you calling "Honey"?
*Optimus Primal: I believe he is looking for a bribe, Rhinox.
*Rhinox: I'm a bit light on Energon Goodies right now, how about I pay you with a sparring lesson?
*Kickback: Sounds like a poor offer-offer. If I can't have a bribe, I'll just take a bite out of your hide-hide!

sections.heading: Old Friends
sections.text:
Part 1
*Rhinox: Wish we got more intel, insect form doesn't exactly narrow the field. Could be Inferno, Tarantulas, Blackarachnia, Cicadacon, Rampage...
*Optimus Primal: Some of those bots are arachnids, not insects. Also, I believe Rampage is a crab.
*Rhinox: I doubt Kickback was aware of the subtle distinctions. Too many legs an all of them if you ask me.
*Optimus Primal: Well whoever it is, hopefully we can show them some reason.
*Rhinox: Reason wasn't a high function in the Pred's operating system. But we can try.
Part 2
*Waspinator: Apebot and Hornbot! Come to also mock Wazzzpinator?
*Rhinox: What's the big buzz about Hive Head?
*Waspinator: Mocked! No one izzz friend to Wazzzpinator! Even other Predacon pretended to not remember me!
*Optimus Primal: Apologies, I assure you we are here to help. Who did you see?
*Waspinator: He wazzz a very loyal Predacon. Wazzzpinator though Scorponok wazzz gone but...
*Optimus Primal: SCORPONOK? The same Scorponok who stung me with a Cyberbee and made me turn on my most trusted allies when I first arrived here?
*Waspinator: Uhhh...maybe?
Part 3
*Optimus Primal: This is important Waspinator, where did Scorponok go?
*Waspinator: NO! Wazzzpinator will win back old friend by protecting him!
*Rhinox: Why are you sticking out your neck out for Scorponok? He was loyal to Megatron, not to you.
*Waspinator: Wazzzpinator so lonely! Very few Botzzz like me! How are there TWO Bumblebeezzz here and neither one izzz a bug?!
*Rhinox: I could have sworn at least one of them was.
*Optimus Primal: A common misconception.
*Waspinator:ENOUGH MOCKING! WAZZZPINATOR TERRORIZE!

sections.heading: Him King
sections.text:
Part 1
*Scorponok: Do THIS, do THAT, join ME, remember THIS...
*Why is everyone on this planet so creepy, crawly and crazy?
*I just need to get get my bearings. A familiar landmark will remind me where I am...or maybe who In am.
*Also, I should probably stop talking to myself...
*...but I do enjoy the conversation.
Part 2
*Grimlock: What little Snap Claw doing on Grimlock's turf?
*Scorponok: I-I remember you!
*YOU'RE A TRAITOR!
*Grimlock: What? Me most loyal Dinobot that Autobots ever see!
*Scorponok: Exactly! Dinobot! You betrayed our friends and sided with our enemies!
*Grimlock: This happen before. Grimlock not THE Dinbot. Me am KING of Dinobots! Best Dinobot if you ask me! Go on! ASK!
*Scorponok: You make no sense, Dinobot!
*Grimlock:ME MAKE PERFECT SENSE! YOU JUST NOT LISTENING!
Part 3
*Scorponok: We crashed, and you wasted no time in turning on your shipmates!
*Grimlock: Grimlock no turn! Me think you took hit to hard-drive in crash you talk about.
*Scorponok: That was years ago! Then the moon wasn't a moon...and it tried to blow up the planet we were on! I remember that!
*Grimlock: So, now is your turn for not sense making?
*Scorponok: I'm going to rip you apart Dinobot!
*Grimlock: Ah! Fighting! THAT Grimlock understands!

sections.heading: The Traitor
sections.text:
Part 1
*Scorponok: ...Dinobot was a LOT bigger than I remember.
*Waspinator: FRIEND! Wazzzpinator has found you after fighting Maximalzzz for your honor. They let me go when they were done hitting me!
*Scorponok: How do you know they let you go, and aren't just following you?
*Waspinator: Oh...uhh...Wazzzpinator may have mizzzcalculated.
*Scorponok: Is Megatron here? I remember that name. I think he'd know what to do!
*Waspinator: MANY Megatronzzz are here! Wazzzpinator will inform one that you're coming!
*Scorponok: Wait! Where do I go?!
*and...I'm back to talking to myself.
Part 2
*Dinobot: Scorponok, finally slimed your way to a new world?
*Scorponok: Wait, didn't we just do this?
*Dinobot: I was looking for the wretched waste of a spark who was screaming my name across the blasted wasteland. Imagine my surprise to find out it was you!
*Scorponok: Surprises must me contagious! Because, I JUST scrapped you!
*Dinobot: You're living a fantasy! You are an honorless pain in my tail that I shall remove.
*Scorponok: Could you hold off on the removing? I need to clear my head.
Part 3
*Dinobot: That seems like an adequate time for a small head like yours to clear. I wouldn't want you to claim this wasn't a fair fight.
*Scorponok: I'm remembering enough...or maybe too much? I remember lava, ancient worlds,...or was it future worlds. I somehow remember being a giant, but I'm not sure that was even me.
*Dinobot: Enought chatter Scorponok, let us settle this like warriors! Dinobot MAXIMIZE!
*Scorponok: Now that finally sounds familiar! Scorponok TERRORIZE!

sections.heading: Loyalty is Rare
sections.text:
Part 1
*Rhinox: The tracker we put on Waspinator is active. Guess he's useful after all.
*Optimus Primal: Every Bot on this planet has a purpose. Some do not just fulfill their purpose intentionally.
*Rhinox: Downside is he's a buzzing blur, tracker is giving me a wide area not a precise location. Wish we had someone to scout.
*Cheetor: Did someone say a stunningly speedy scout could be of service?
*Rhinox: For Primus sake! Have you just been waiting in the shadows for a proper cue?
*Cheetor: You look a lot faster when you have a split second timing like me, big guy!
*Optimus Primal: Cheetor, run ahead and see if you can make contact with Scorponok then report back.
Part 2
*Megatron: Where are you going in such a hurry, my furred and furrowed friends?
*Rhinox: We ain't friends Megatron. Possibly occasional co-workers till we can get off of New Quintessa.
*Optimus Primal: We are tracking a dangerous new arrival, it would be advisable to assist to allow us to pass.
*Megatron: A little wasp told me this arrival is a true loyalist to the Decepticon cause. Such a precious commodity should be protected.
*Rhinox: Not the team building we're looking to do here Megatron.
*Megatron: You focus every aspect of this world on yourselves. It is time for more brutal leadership.
Part 3
*Optimus Primal: Megatron, there are no sides on this world. Join us and we may hope to restore some sort of order to this constantly expanding war.
*Megatron: Join you? No. Bring forward a new age of Decepticons? Yes!
*Rhinox: Sooner or later, all of you Megatrons start sounding the same.
*Megatron: In the end we both want the same thing: balance. I need loyal soldiers to enforce the balance.
*Optimus Primal: Balance is not the elimination of all who oppose you.
*Megatron: That is your opinion, but I doubt you can present a more appealing argument.
*Optimus Primal: You prefer actions to words? Well, that's just Prime.

sections.heading: Lead or Be Led
sections.text:
Part 1
*Cheetor: Contact has been made Optimus!
*Optimus Primal: Good, were you detected as you observed the target?
*Cheetor: Oh Ok...I may have had a loose understanding of "Contact". I just rushed by and unloaded a laser yolley. Contact made.
*Optimus Primal: That may be contrary to the diplomacy we were hoping to exhibit.
*Rhinox: Is that what we've been doing? A lot of fights for diplomats.
*Cheetor: Scorponok has been forgetful lately, maybe he'll forget this too.
*Scorponok:MAXIMALS!
*Cheetor: He probably remembers.
Part 2
*Scorponok: Would everyone just leave me alone!
*Optimus Primal: Scorponok, I know we have had more than our share of differences, but I can put those aside. Just calm down and listen to us.
*Scorponok: I don't even know who's in charge here any more, how am I supposed to take orders without a chain of command?
*Cheetor: It isn't like that here Scorponok, the war has changed. We can make our own choices now.
*Rhinox: For the first time since your spark first went online, you can be any Bot you want to be.
*Waspinator: WAZZZPINATOR RETURNZZZ! Scorponok look out! Maximalzzz!
*Cheetor: Your timing is astounding Waspinator.
*Waspinator: OH! Thank you!
Part 3
*Scorponok: If I can choose who I want to be, I choose to be in command.
*Rhinox: The default setting of a Predacon, rush to the closest throne.
*Scorponok: It's easy to judge a thirst for power when you're always in charge, Maximal scum!
*Waspinator: Maximalzzz just ruin our lovely planzzz. Never put real work in, just dezzztroy and leave. Bully Botzzz!
*Optimus Primal: We're not in charge. We are just trying to help every Bot here get home, regardless of previous affiliations of struggles.
*Scorponok: Well I'm starting to feel at home right here and I am done changing my mind. So you can either walk away, or leave as scrap metal!

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
* The reasoning behind the ReForged Spotlight Missions is an "interference," according to Teletraan-I.
* The name of the 4-Star chapter, "Thunder Struck," is a reference to the AC/DC song of the same name.
* This event was produced with the cooperation of two Forged to Fight streamers, Luke Connerton and Inqosly (iNightSkies).
* Starscream's quip about Thundercracker being "ugly" and "not looking at a mirror lately" is a reference to the fact he is a reskin.

sections.heading: Official forum info
sections.text:
{{quotes|Commanders!

The Reforging Energy triggered by Megatronus trying to awaken the mysterious Titan has thrown the world into disarray.

Fearing what may be happening, the Autobots send a scout towards the epicentre of a disturbance, in hopes that they may identify the Titan, or at least find some answers.

However, the communications they received were troubling, before stopping all together...

Things go from bad to worse when a new foe wearing a familiar face joins the fray. The sinister Nemesis Prime.

Created using a subspace impulse cloner, Nemesis Prime is a malicious copy of the heroic Optimus Prime. Although he wears the Decepticon insignia, it’s unclear where his loyalties lie.

Now Commander, it’s up to you and Optimus to try and hold things together and fight off the emerging darkness in the suspenseful new Spotlight Mission, Till All Are Gone!

This never before told story will be available July 4th at 10AM! PT}}

{{quotes|Our Writer says "I just talked to Nemesis Prime. He says he can say what he wants and you're not his boss."

Nemesis Prime is not very nice...|Kabam Miike|Forums}}

About Nemesis' position in the universe:

{{quotes|Actually! Kind of a side note, but something I want to point out... Remember that this game takes place in its own little pocket universe, where different Optimus Primes can collide, and Soundwave speaks just as normally as everybody else.

This Nemesis Prime, like all of our other Bots, is based heavily on source Material, but exists on his own in this Universe.|Kabam Miike}}

sections.heading: = Part 1 =
sections.text:
* Marissa Faireborn: Optimus, have you heard from Bumblebee?
* Optimus Prime: After the Decepticons amassed then scattered, I sent him to follow Megatronus and report back.
* Marissa: He sent some scans... but for the past few days he has gone radio silent.
* Optimus Prime: Silence seems like a message itself. If Bumblebee is in trouble I must track him down.
* Marissa: Assumed you'd say that. Uploading some spots he reported from, it's going to be a rough journey.
* Optimus Primal: It always is.

sections.heading: = Part 2 =
sections.text:
* Marissa: First tracker up ahead.
* Tantrum: If I were you I'd head back the way you came.
* Optimus Prime (G1): I have never known you to be the one to relent in a charge, Tantrum.
* Tantrum: Aw heck, suppose you're not wrong. Either way you're about to get turned into a truck stop.
* Optimus Prime (G1): All of this leads to certain demise, you must know that.
* Tantrum: Demise is exactly what I'm promisin', you filthy rust bucket.
* Optimus Prime (G1): I shall have to install a filter on your language processor.

sections.heading: = Part 3 =
sections.text:
* Optimus Prime (G1): Is there no journey on this world that does not result in calamity or conflict?
* Soundwave: Negative. Inferior Autobots always conflict with superior Decepticons.
* Optimus Prime (G1): I look only to retrieve those under my command. What are you protecting?
* Soundwave: Revealing motives would result in a tactical disadvantage.
* Optimus Prime (G1): You are always at a disadvantage when you follow Megatron's orders.
* Soundwave: Incorrect. Advantage belongs to Decepticons, Autobot scum shall be eliminated!

sections.heading: = Part 1 =
sections.text:
* Waspinator: NOOO! CLUMSY CLAWSZZZ! That part goezzz over HERE!
* Scorponok: Who came through a Space Bridge last? I know what I'm doing!
* Optimus Prime (G1): What are the two of you attempting?
* Scorponok: We don't got to tell you ANYTHING Prime!
* Waspinator: We don't need to tell you that we want to bring PREDACON Megatron here!
* Scorponok: YEAH! We don't have to tell you any of that!

sections.heading: = Part 2 =
sections.text:
* Scorponok: There's so many Megatrons! One even says he's a Megatron for US, but he ain't my Megatron!
* Optimus Prime (G1): You refer to Megatronus?
* Waspinator: That izzz the one! He doezzz not even have any Dinosaur partzzz!
* Optimus Prime (G1): You are both misguided and misinformed.
* Waspinator: WAZZZPINATOR IS VERY GUIDED AND INFORMED!
* YOU WANT A MISS? MISS MY MISSILEZZZ!

sections.heading: = Part 3 =
sections.text:
* Optimus Prime (G1): We do not belong here. Why bring down more fo your kind to suffer our fate?
* Scorponok: I'm not programmed to lead! All I know is that Megatron would know what to do.
* Optimus Prime (G1): There are many Megatrons here, none have improved our situation.
* Scorponok: It's like that old saying goes: Two Megatrons is company. Three Megatrons makes you proud.
* Optimus Prime (G1): Taling is not going to be expedient. Simple and blunt methods are advisable Commander.

sections.heading: =Part 1=
sections.text:
*Marissa Faireborn: Something big is here Optimus.
*Optimus Prime (G1): Has the Titan awoken? Can you get a scan on it?
*Marissa Faireborn: No it's different. It's not so much a reading as it is a black hole or signal.
*Jetfire: Prime, we need to discuss vital findings.
*Optimus Prime (G1): Jetfire, it is good to see you. Perhaps you can assist as I track down Bumblebee.
*Jetfire:: No, I do not advise further travel.
*Optimus Prime (G1): Do not advise, or will not allow?
*Jetfire:: Both.

sections.heading: =Part 2=
sections.text:
*Optimus Prime (G1): Bumblebee is missing. It is imperative I locate him.
*Jetfire:: He passed this way with his Prime. However...
*Optimus Prime However?
*Starscream: However, that Prime has gone dark and is on some sort of Cybertronic spree!
*Optimus Prime Tell me you are not placing your trust in Starscream.
*Jetfire:: He lost his army, and I needed a guard as I attempted to identify the Titan. He presents a calculated risk.
*Starscream: I'm a perfect guard. If there's ONE thing I'm good at it's stopping Autobots in their tracks!

sections.heading: =Part 3=
sections.text:
*Optimus Prime You are a more recent arrival here, but there is still a chain of command.
*Jetfire:: A chain with links leading in various directions. It is a net with no origin or end.
*Optimus Prime Then what path would you follow?
*Jetfire:: Among the mysteries of science lies the key to victory. I must monitor our effect on the timestream.
*Optimus Prime: The Commander has been assisting in each Reforged struggle we face. We can study by defending ourselves.
*Jetfire:: ...The Commander is altering time repetitions? I shall have to stop them as well. For the sake of my research.

sections.heading: = Part 1 =
sections.text:
* Optimus Prime: I apologize for the violence Jetfire, but Bumblebee's life may be on the line.
* Jetfire: I understand how you have measured your choices, but disagree with your findings.
* Optimus Prime: I shall take that under advisement. Will you be continuing your research?
* Jetfire: I have to go back to the drawing board, you've introduced a slew of variances.
* Optimus Prime: We will do our best to not alter things further.
* S-1000: OUR LEADER DEMANDS TO SPEAK WITH YOU, PITIFUL PRIME!
* Optimus Prime: Some alterations of course are inevitable.

sections.heading: = Part 2 =
sections.text:
* Optimus Prime: I already fought your leader.
* S-1000: You fought old red leader, new blue leader demands you.
* Optimus Prime: How exactly did Thundercracker steal you away?
* S-1000: Same shapes but different colors and abilities. We Sharkticons see this as a norm.
* Optimus Prime: Of course. My mission is too urgent to humor your leader's megalomania.
* Thundercracker: Oh I wasn't looking for a chat, just a full meal for my hungry troops!
* Optimus Prime: I'm afraid that Prime cuts are off the menu.

sections.heading: = Part 3 =
sections.text:
* Optimus Prime: Something dark is coming, we cease this fighting and band together.
* Thundercracker: Hah! I rule the skies and my army rules the sea. Those on the dirt can solve their own problems.
* Optimus Prime: There is a connection between all things, one can not exist without the others.
* Thundercracker: I'm willing to see where the dust of your world settles.

sections.heading: = Part 1 =
sections.text:
*Optimus Prime: I have spotted Bumblebee and his Optimus.
*Marissa Faireborn: Are you sure? I'm reading one Autobot ahead and that dark signal next to them.
*Optimus Prime: Which is the disruption?
*Marissa Faireborn: Can't tell, the signals are too close. They are headed for a massive energy surge.
*Optimus Prime: One of them will certainly require my assistance, I am heading in.

sections.heading: = Part 2 =
sections.text:
*Bumblebee (DOTM): Optimus! Stay back! I have this under control.
*Optimus Prime: Controlled is not how I define this situation.
*Optimus Prime (MV1): He is serving his purpose! Do not pester us!
*Bumblebee (DOTM): He...he's just not himself right now. It's the interference, or radiation, or something!
*Optimus Prime (MV1): Subordinate, crush this pathetic imposter and allow me to continue my work.
*Optimus Prime: That is no Prime. Bumblebee, you must see this.
*Bumblebee (DOTM): I can't be sure of anything right now. I promise this isn't personal!

sections.heading: = Part 3 =
sections.text:
*Optimus Prime (MV1): There is a light in your spark that calls to me, I look forward to extinguishing it.
*Optimus Prime: What have the two of you been doing?
*Bumblebee (DOTM): He said that he could...fix things. Correct our problems. He sounded different but...
*I shall fix this troubled world by eliminating the abnormalities upon it.
*Optimus Prime: Bumblebee, get to cover. The Commander and I will make this right.
*Optimus Prime (MV1): You shall make nothing but a pile of ash.

sections.heading: = Part 1 =
sections.text:
* Optimus Prime (MV1): Hmmm...your form is simplified, yet has an elegance. I shall claim it.
* Marissa Faireborn: Optimus! What is happening down there? Readings are like nothing I've seen.
* Optimus Prime: Something...troubling.
* Nemesis Prime: Yes, this seems to be a form worthy of inspiration and decimation.
* Shockwave: It is both disturbing and devious, a definite advantage on the battlefield.
* Optimus Prime: Shockwave, waiting in the shadows to decide what side you'd join?
* Shockwave: Those of us in the shadows witness many secrets of this war.

sections.heading: = Part 2 =
sections.text:
* Nemesis Prime: This disturbance is not confined to this world or to your galaxy. You crack the foundation of time itself.
* Optimus Prime: We wish to return to our original timelines, perhaps that is the solution.
* Shockwave: The new arrival has a plan, one to be carried out without hesitation.
* Optimus Prime: What is your purpose here, Shockwave?
* Shockwave: My purpose is survival. I pledge my innumerable talents to those who assist in that goal.
* Optimus Prime: You could have used your skills to heal this world.
* Shockwave: I saw no value in that, but defeating you will demonstrate some degree of my abilities.

sections.heading: = Part 3 =
sections.text:
* Nemesis Prime: I am the end to this tangle of timelines. Step aside and accept oblivion.
* Optimus Prime: You have my form but lack my logic. None have succeeded in claiming this world, why should you be any different?
* Nemesis Prime: I do not bay at the moon, I am the night itself.
* Optimus Prime: You spout poetry but provide mindless chaos.
* Nemesis Prime: Mindless? No. I look not to save, nor lead, nor rule. I am an enemy of life!
* I AM NEMESIS PRIME. YOU SHALL SOON BE NOTHING AT ALL.

Transformers: Forged to Fight (Netflix).lead:
On May 10, 2023,

Transformers: Forged to Fight was made available on the Netflix Games streaming service. There are several key differences between this version of the game and the original at time of closure, and this page will document such changes as they come.

sections.heading: Discord Announcement
sections.text:
Light our Darkest Hour!

Prepare to return to New Quintessa! 

Transformers Fans, prepare to roll out once again! Transformers: Forged to Fight is returning to mobile devices today, exclusively for Netflix members! 

Join Optimus Prime, Bumblebee Marissa Fairborne, and many of your favorite Bots for a new adventure on New Quintessa. 

This new version of Transformers: Forged to Fight revives the award-winning 3D fighting game that our Commanders knew and loved, with a re-imagined story full of new twists and adventures. The game is included with all Netflix memberships without ads or in-app purchases. 

This new version of the game also introduces two brand new bots with completely new animations and abilities, Dead End and Chromia! 

Netflix members can download the game today: https://netflix.com/game/81633034 

To answer some questions that you may have: 
Will my progress carry over? 
This is a completely new version of Transformers: Forged to Fight, and as such, no progress will be carried over, but we hope that you’ll find excitement in starting your adventure from the start once again! 

If there are no Ads or In-App Purchases, how will I obtain Energon? 
You can earn Energon by playing various modes in-game. 

How do I get Bots? 
You can earn bots by completing content, from Crystals, or by using Bot chips, which you also earn by playing! 

Will every Bot be returning?
Unfortunately, not every Bot will be making a comeback in the new game, but keep an eye out for some more old favourites coming back in the future!

sections.heading: Similarities
sections.text:
* The game seems to be based on the last version of the game before it was delisted.
* [https://forums.transformersforgedtofight.com/discussion/6270/requirements-guide This requirements guide should apply here.]

sections.heading: Differences
sections.text:
* You need an existing Netflix account to play.
* No progress is carried over.
* The biggest change yet is the removal of all Cinematic Bots due to licensing; for reference, the last Bayverse bot was released on February 8, 2018 (five years ago). Such content will be marked with the appropiate template on their respective pages. However, the Cinematic backdrops are still present. the bayverse might come back
* However, the announcement on the F2F Discord seems to suggest more "old favorites" popping in.
* As some Story elements revolve around the Bayverse Bots, such will be changed. There have been no confirmation whether Rulers of Kaon and Revenge of the King will return... yet.
* No in-app purchases for anything anymore, nor ads. You earn Energon and Bot Chips (this is now the main currency of the game) by playing the game. Think of this progression scheme as a mixture of Definitive Edition Marvel's Avengers and post-2018 Battlefront II. This means you'll be getting an excess of 500 Energon! after completing Act 1.
* Daily Crystals no longer give bots
* Most Bots are obtainable through Bot Chips.
* So are most Bot upgrade materials. Yes, you can get T3 Class and Alpha Sparks with Energon.
* A few of the Bots' Classes were changed to offset balance issues due to the Cinematic Bots being removed: Windblade is now a Warrior, Skywarp a Scout, Soundblaster a Demolitions, and Chromia a Warrior (from a Tech bot which was unreleased).

Transwarp Cell.lead: The Transwarp Cell is a Utility Mod that can drain an opponent's Power and makes the Bot Defender use Heavy Attacks more often.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: Transform and warp enemy power with the perfect accessory for any space-time traveler. Place this Module on your Base and pair it with a Bot known for their reliable Heavy Attacks for maximum performance.

sections.heading: Abilities
sections.text:
Power Drain
* Passive: Defending Bots paired with this Module are 500% more likely to activate Heavy Attacks.
* Passive: Enemies generate 15~% less Power for each full Power Bar they have. Abilities that generate Power are not affected.
* Heavy Attacks: 100% Chance to drain 15~% total Power.

sections.heading: Strategy
sections.text: It is recommended to use this Mod with Bots whose Heavy Attacks have special abilities.

sections.heading: Base Defense
sections.text:
* Kickback - Ensuring Kickback routinely slams into his opponent with Heavy Attacks will allow him to take great advantage of his Consume and Signature abilities.
* Grimlock will be immune to damage in Dinobot mode, will refresh all his Melee Buffs and his Burn damage will be increased most of the time.
* Megatron - Getting hit by his Fusion Cannon and having Power drained at the same time is the quickest way to the scrap pile.
* Megatron (ROTF) - This will encourage him to use his powerful Heavy Attacks other than his Enraged periods and provide a potent way to lock down the opponent’s Power flow.
* Mirage - It would be a mistake to dash in right after shooting Mirage while he's transforming, because projectiles will miss while he's in F1 mode.
* Nemesis Prime - Nemesis will use his nullifying abilities to the fullest when he uses his heavy attack more often and will be doing constant heat damage with his heavy attacks, this dark clone will make sure to lock down any opponent who faces him.
* Ramjet - This mod will boost the chance Ramjet uses his Unstoppable Heavy Attacks.
* Soundwave - This Mod will allow Soundwave to drain the opponents' Power while charging his own.
* Shockwave - This Mod will allow Shockwave to more intelligently make use of his Energy Charges when he gets them.
* Windblade can avoid all ranged attacks while she flies into opponents.
* Wheeljack will keep making gaining or replacing lost upgrades.
* Thundercracker will keep on Purifying Damaging Debuffs.

sections.heading: Raids
sections.text:
* Kickback's T-Clog can prevent an opponent from using a heavy attack.
*In Dinobot mode, Grimlock is immune to all damage so his heavy attack will prevent all damage that was inflicted by the bot itself and if the mod thinks he can inflict burns on him, the Dino rage signature ability will put a stop to that notion.

source.page: Tutorial/Getting Started With the Game's Unity Files and Assets

Tutorial/Getting Started With the Game's.lead:
The online servers may be gone, but the gigabytes that remain are the source files that the game installer puts onto a device. This basic guide will tell you how to access Unity 3D models and files that make up each Bot, modules and relics, the planet landscape map, and the battle stages.

# Download the .APK from any APK website. (I recommend https://transformers-forged-to-fight.en.uptodown.com/android) Be careful and use common sense and avoid fishy links and sites.
# Right click the .apk and rename the file extension .apk to .zip.
# Extract the .zip file to a folder with an appropriate program.
# Download the Unity Asset Bundle Extractor (UABE) https://github.com/SeriousCache/UABE/releases
# Open "AssetBundleExtractor.exe"
# In the converted apk folder, look for the "assetpack" folder, which is in the "assets" folder. Depending on the version the location may vary. Version 9.2 has it in the "default" folder.
## The directory string string should like: \assets\assetpack\
# On the UABE select "Open" from the File navbar and find an .assetbundle file in one of the several character and prop-named odr folders. It will then prompt you to "select a decompression output directory",
##Be sure to select the odr folders in the "assetpack" folder, The identical-named odr folders outsdie of it have toc.text (Table of Contents)
# Expand the files and components now in the UABE and select File ID #2.
# There are hundreds of elements that make up a playable game character, it may be easier to sort them by type by clicking "Type" on the top bar.
# Certain file types can be exported with the "Plugins" button into readable files, the easiest thing to do and play with if you don't know anything about Unity programming.
## "Mesh" can be exported as an obj. or .dae file, which can be opened in Blender or even Window computers' default 3D Viewer.
## "AudioClip" can be exported as .wav files, to get those cool sound effects of punching and blasting on the battlefield.
## "Texture2D" can be exported as .png or .tga (True Graphics Adaptor). How to wrap flat images around a gray 3D object is another complicated matter...
# If you know or are learning Unity game programming, in theory you could code all those pieces together and recreate a Bot's scripted animation sequences as a video or interactive game, or explore the landscape of Chicago or the Sea of Rust to your leisure. The former players would appreciate an expert bringing back a little bit our our childhood mobile gaming.
# Check out this Unity Modding guide video on YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4sagYiG2ibo
