sections.text:
*Exo-Filter
Category:Abilities

Utility Module.lead:
Utility Mods are only used by opponents in Missions. They have no specific abilities, as they give any kind of Buffs depending on the Mission.

It is possible to see the Mod's effects on your opponent if you select a Bot's portrait (not the actual node) in the Mission. On the "Node Info" screen, you can select "Local Mod" to see the Mod's abilities. You can also tap on the Mod's picture in the "Bot Selection" screen before you start a fight if you want to find out what kind of effects it provides to your opponent.

It is highly recommended that you view the Mod's effects before you start a hard battle or even go on one of the harder paths when exploring Missions, especially in Challenge Missions like The Last Knight Challenge and Expert Commander and Prime difficulties in Spotlight Missions, as these Mods give a formidable effect to opponents that must be strategically overcome.

Mods can be generally categorized as such:
* Special 3 Unlocked - Most mission bots have their Special 3 locked by default unless they have this mod. Reserved for bosses and all Master-level bots.
* Boost - Increase health, attack, both, or add other effects. As these are inherent they cannot be nullified.
* Permanent Buff - Can be nullified and stolen(when using an awakened Megatron) but they will eventually return.
* Timed Buff - Much stronger than permanent buffs, but they're on a cycle for 7.5 seconds of activity, then a 15 second recharge but this speeds up if you’re using an awakened Megatron.
* Conditional - Some mods require very specific debuffs or sequences to temporarily nullify them.
* Player Effect- Some mods affect the Commander's bots instead of the opponent.

sections.heading: List of Effects
sections.text: There are at least four tiers for each effect, maximum 6. "Opponent" refers to your Bots.

sections.heading: Basic Boosts
sections.text:
* Attack Boost - +25~50~100~200~300~500% Attack (?)
*Health Boost - +25~50~100~200~300~500% Health
* Prime Boost - 25~50~100~150% Attack and Health
* Special 3 Unlocked - Special Attack 3 unlocked. Watch out!

sections.heading: Armor/Resistance Control
sections.text:
* Armor - Gain an Armor Buff, reducing damage from attacks by 15~25~50~75~90%.
* Armor Timed - gains an Armor Buff, reducing attack from opponents by 25~50~75~90~% for 7.5 seconds. Recharges in 15 seconds.
* Armor Pierce - Attack bypass 15~25~50~75~90% of the opponent's current Armor.
* Armor Pierce Timed - Attacks bypass 25~50~75~90% of the opponent's current Armor for 7.5 seconds. Recharges in 15 seconds.
* Adaptive - Cycles between +39~46~55~65~90% Physical or Energy Resistance every 7.5 seconds.
* Cycle Resist - Cycles through Melee, Ranged, and Special Damage resistances at 50~75~100~125~150~200% damage resistance.
* Gain Armor - When stuck, there's a 6% to gain a 15~25~40~55~60~85% Armor Buff. Additionally, this Buff automatically activates when a Special Attack is activated by the opponent.
* Energon Shield - When Energon shield is active, absorb (tier 1)~8~18~30% of opponent's Attack as Health. When Energon Shield is down, all resistances are reduced by -(tier 1)~35~50~65%.
* Physical Resistance - Resist 15~25~50~75~90% Physical Damage.
* Energy Resistance - Resist 15~25~50~75~90% Energy Damage.

sections.heading: Attack Control
sections.text:
* Buff Duration - Increase the duration of buffs by 25~50~75~100~150~200%.
* Debuff Duration - Increase the duration of debuffs by 25~50~75~100~150~200%.
* Enhanced Bleed - Bleeds inflicted by this Bot last 25~50~75~100~125% longer.
* Randomizer - At the start of the fight and every 18 seconds, activates a random, Attack, Armor, or Resistance Buff. Each buff increases respective attributes by 10-15~20~30%. Buffs stack up to 10 max.
* Relentless Assault - Each time an opponent Sidesteps or Dashes an attack this bots gains a 3~6~10~13% Attack Buff. When this bot reaches 10 Attack Buffs it becomes Unstoppable for 4 seconds and consumes all Attack Buffs when the Unstoppable ability ends. (Originally, it was every time the opponent dodges.)
* Replicate - When the opponent receives a buff, activate a Buff with a matching effect that lasts 4 seconds. Once activated, Replicate can only trigger again after 5 seconds.

sections.heading: Blocking
sections.text:
* Absorb Attacks - Blocking 5 attacks provides an Unblockable Special Buff, making Special Attacks Unblockable and increasing Special Damage for 10 seconds.
* Block Proficiency - Reduces incoming damage from enemy attacks that are successfully blocked by 7.5~~25~37.5%%
* Heavy Block - Block is no longer broken by opponent's Heavy Attack. Gain 0.25~0.5~1~1.5 bars of Power when Blocking an opponent's Heavy Attack.
* Reflect Ranged - Reflects incoming ranged attacks while Blocking, dealing 85~100~120~140~170% of their original damage.
* Shock Block - Blocked Melee Attacks cause opponents to take 10~25~50~100~150% of opponent's Attack as Shock Damage over 4 seconds.

sections.heading: Critical Control
sections.text:
* Critical Damage - Increase Critical Damage by 25~50~100~150~200%
* Critical Rate - Increases Critical Rate by +15~25~50~75~90%
* Critical Damage Timed - Increase Critical Damage by +50~100~200~400~600% for 7.5 seconds. Recharges in 15 seconds.
* Critical Rate Timed - Increase Critical Rate by +50~(tier 3-4)~90% for 7.5 seconds. Recharges in 15 seconds.
* Target Vitals - Landing 5 Critical Hits grants the next Critical Hit an additional ~110~120~140% of Attack as Bonus Damage and Stuns the opponent for 1.5 seconds.

sections.heading: Evasion
sections.text:
* Evade Melee - 5~10~15~20% chance to Evade Melee Attacks.
* Evade Ranged - 5~10~15~20% chance to Evade Ranged Attacks.
* Evade Melee Timed - 10~15~20~25~30% chance to evade Melee attacks for 7.5 seconds. Recharges in 15 seconds.
* Evade Ranged Timed - 10~15~20~25~30% chance to evade Ranged attacks for 7.5 seconds. Recharges in 15 seconds.
* Evade Power Gain - When Evading a Melee Attack, gain 26~31~36~43~51~60% of a Power Bar.

sections.heading: Heavy Attacks
sections.text:
* Heavy Attack Stun - Heavy Attacks Stun the Opponent for 2~2.5~3~3.5~5 seconds.
* Stagger - Heavy Attacks inflict the opponent with a Stun for 1.5~2~2.5~3~3.5~4 seconds, Power Lock for 4~5~7~9~11~13 seconds, or a 25~35~50~65~85~100% Armor Break for 7 seconds. (Also makes the bot much more likely to use Heavy Attacks)
* Battle Tactics - Increases Ranged Heavy Damage by 300% and reduces Ranged Heavy Speed by 35%. More likely to use Heavy Attacks. (Introduced with Wheeljack on Reforged: Code of a Hero - Chapter 2 Act 2 on Hard onwards)

sections.heading: Melee Damage
sections.text:
* Melee Damage - Increases Melee damage by 25~50~100~150~200%.
* Melee Timed - Increase Melee Damage by 50~100~200~400~600% for 7.5 seconds. Recharges in 15 seconds.
* Melee Bleed - On Melee attacks, inflict a stack of Bleed dealing 5~25~50~100% Attack as Bleed damage over 7.5 seconds per stack of Bleed. (Currently, the leveling is mislabeled at 5~100~25~50%)
* Melee Power Burn - Basic and Heavy Melee Attacks drain a small amount of Power on hit.

sections.heading: Power Control
sections.text:
* Power Flow - Increases the Power generated from all attacks by 25~50~100~150%.
* Power Flow Timed - Increases the Power generated from all attacks by +50~100~200~400~600% for 5 seconds. Recharges in 15 seconds.
* Focus Power Gain - Activates a Power Gain Buff when not struck by a melee attack for 6 seconds, generating 3~3.6~4.2% of Max Power per second.
* Defensive Power Gain - While Blocking, generates 7.5~15~22.5~30% (tier 1)~7.5~11.2~15~18.8% of a Power Bar per second.
* Harness Power - Each bar of Power adds an additional effect to successful melee attacks. 1 bar adds Melee Repair, 2 bars add Power Drain, and 3 bars adds Shock Damage.
* Power Charge - When hit this bot generates a Power Charge. When this bot reaches 8 Power Charges, the next successful hit (on this bot) within 5 seconds consumes all charges, generating a large amount of Power.
* Power Start - Starts with 1~2 Bar(s) of Power.

sections.heading: Ranged Attacks
sections.text:
*Ranged Damage - Increases Ranged Damage by +25~50~100~150~200~300% and Ranged Speed.
*Ranged Timed - Increases Ranged damage and speed by +50~100~200~400~600~1000% for 7.5 seconds. Recharges in 15 seconds.
*Ranged Shock - On ranged attacks, inflict a stack of Shock dealing 10~25~50~100~200% Attack as Shock damage over 7.5 seconds per stack of Shock.
* Aim Enhancer - Basic Ranged Attacks are Unblockable.
* Improved Aim Enhancer - Basic Attacks are Unblockable.
*Hacked Aim Enhancer - Basic Ranged Attacks are Unblockable and ranged speed randomizes throughout the fight.
*Ranged Power Burn - Basic and Ranged Heavy Attacks drain a small amount of Power on hit.

sections.heading: Repair
sections.text:
* Absorb Projectile - When struck by Basic Ranged Attacks, Repair 15~25~50~75~100% of opponent's Attack.
* Repair Timed - Repair ~6~8~10% Health over 7.5 seconds. Recharges in 15 seconds.
* Focus Repair - Activates a repair buff when not struck by a melee attack for 6 seconds, healing 0.3~0.5~0.8~1% of max Health per second.
*Last-Ditch Repair - Once per fight, activates a Repair Buff when below 20% Health, healing 10~15~30 25~40% of max Health over 6 seconds.

sections.heading: Special Attacks
sections.text:
* Special Damage - Increases Special Damage by 25~50~100~150~200~300%.
* Enhanced Special 1 - Special 1 deals +20% more damage and cannot be Blocked.
* Enhanced Special 2 - Special 2 deals +20% more damage and cannot be Blocked.
* Special Attack Stun - On the last hit of Special Attacks, Stun the opponent for 2~2.5~3~3.5~4~4.5 seconds.
* Special Damage Timed - Increases Special Damage by +50~100~200~400~600% for 7.5 seconds. Recharges in 15 seconds.
* Strike Back - When hit by a Special Attack, this enemy gains 1 bar of Power.
* All or Nothing - Stores Power until its Special Attack 3 is ready.

sections.heading: Nullifiable Buffs
sections.text:
The bot starts with exceptionally powerful effects which can be temporarily nullified with certain skills. 
* Focused Frenzy: Focus Frenzy grants Unstoppable for 4~5~8~9 seconds. (1~4) Stacks of Focus Frenzy can be removed by taking hits. If Unstoppable is removed before expiry, the Bot is Stunned for 3 seconds.
* Rampage - Start with a Resistance Buff and all Attack Buffs. Each attack Buff adds 25~50~100~150% and is removed when hit by the corresponding attack. When all Attack Buffs are removed, the Resistance Buff is nullified. Buffs return in 20 seconds. (In other words, the opponent is immune to damage until hit by a melee, ranged, and special attack.)
* Pyrophobia - Start with an Attack Buff that increases Attack damage by 50~100~150~200% and can be removed with Burn Debuffs. Attack Buff will return after 10 seconds.
* Hemophobia - Start with a Power Gain Buff that generates 1~1.5~1.8~2.1% Max Power every second which can be removed with Bleed debuffs. Power Gain Buff will return after 10 seconds.
* Electrophobia - Start with a 40~60~75~85% All Resist Buff which can be removed with Shock debuffs. Resist Buff will return after 10 seconds.
* Unstable Energon - Inflicts 2.5~5~15~20% of Attack as Shock Damage for 10 seconds. Can be removed by (successful) Heavy Attacks. This effect returns 10~9~8~7 seconds after it is removed or expires.

sections.heading: Player Effect
sections.text:
These affect the Commander's Bot rather than the enemy Bot.
* Attack Barrier - Immune to Basic Attack Damage. Opponent's power Rate is increased by t1~t2~100~200%. Opponent's Special 3 Attack is disabled.
* Finesse - Opponent starts with Power Rate reduced to 0. Opponents generate t1~t2~15~t4% of Power Bar when sidestepping or dodging an attack. Opponents generate 60% of a Power Bar when Evading an Attack.
* Energon Storm - Inflicts Shock Damage based on opponent's power bar. The higher the power level, the more Shock damage inflicted. Opponent's Special 2 Attacks repair 10% of their max Health and Special 3 Attacks repair 25% of their max Health.
* Fatigue - Each Dash Back or Sidestep a generates stack of Fatigue that lasts a short duration. Accumulating 5 stacks causes the next Dash Back or Sidestep to inflict Stun for 1.5~2~2.5~3 seconds.
* Power Wipe - Every 30~25~20 seconds, the opponent's Power Meter will be fully depleted.
* Life Transfer - This Bot repairs the opponent for 10~20~30% of damage dealt when hit, but passively drains 0.2~0.5~0.8% of the opponent's health.
* Power Conductor - This Bot grants ~60~80% more Power when hit, but constantly drains opponent's Power.
* Bleed Out - Causes a permanent Bleed on the opponent which deals 0.1~0.2~0.3~0.5% of Max Health.
* Burn Down - Causes a permanent Burn on the opponent which deals 0.1~0.2~0.3~0.5% of Max Health.
*Inflict Bleed - When successfully landing the first Melee attack, inflicts 100% of the opponent's current health as Bleed damage over 180~150~120~90 seconds.
*Inflict Shock - When successfully landing the first Ranged attack, inflicts 100% of the opponent's current health as Shock damage over 180~150~120~90 seconds.

sections.heading: Other
sections.text:
*Combo Shield - The Combo Meter is not reset after being struck by an attack. 
*Bleed Immunity - Immune to Bleed. 
*Debuff Immunity - Immune to all debuffs. 
*Trigger Rate - Increases the Trigger Rate of abilities by +15~25~50~75~90% 
* Trigger Rate Timed - Increase the Trigger Rate of abilities by +15~25~50~75% for 7.5 seconds. Recharges in 15 seconds.

sections.heading: Story
sections.text:
Effects that have appeared exclusively in Story Mode and Challenge Missions.
* Special 3 Power (This is a 1-Star Module) Passive: Passive Power Gain over time until Special 3 is activated. Used by Grimlock in Act 1-Ch1-M3.
* T-Cog Disabler - Prevents opponent from changing into alt-modes during battle.
* Mega-Rager - (Act 2-Ch3-M4) - As the fight goes on, Grimlock becomes increasingly agitated. When struck, there's a 20% chance to gain an Attack Buff, Armor Break Debuff, and becomes more aggressive.
* Shark Frenzy: Used by Sharkticons in Act 3 Chapter 3.
**Shark Frenzy: Attack! - At 50% health or lower, all successful melee attacks grant 2% bonus Attack stacking indefinitely.
** Shark Frenzy: Heavy Boost - At 50% health or lower, taking 3 hits increases damage and speed on the next Heavy Attack.
** Shark Frenzy: Power Rate - At 50% health or lower, Power gained from attacking or being attacked is doubled.
** Shark Frenzy: Rend - At 50% health or lower, all successful melee attacks cause the opponent to Bleed for 0.5% Attack stacking indefinitely.
** Shark Frenzy: Shock Block - At 50% health or lower, blocking Melee attacks causes opponents to take 50% of attack as Shock damage over 4 seconds.
** Shark Frenzy: Unstoppable - At 50% health or lower, taking 7 hits grants Unstoppable.
* Damaged - This Bot has already taken extensive damage and is in a weakened state. (instant health loss to 5% at level 6) (Act 4-Ch2-M6)
* Temporal Anomalizer- Reduces opponent's ranged attack speed. Only appeared in A Question of Loyalty Missions.
* The Equalizer - When the defender takes a Critical Hit, it will be granted a repair, an Armor Up or be inflicted with Shock Damage. These effects can stack. (First appeared in What Could Go Wrong?)
* The Re-Equalizer - When the defender takes a Critical Hit, it will be granted a Fury Buff, an Increased Critical Rate Buff or be inflicted with Burn Damage. These effects can stack. 
* Megatronic Augmenter - (Rulers of Kaon) Megatron ordered Mixmaster to create an Energon infusing mod which enhances bots linked to him. This unlocks their Special 3 Attack and boosts Health and Attack. As evidenced by the name, Megatron retained naming rights. 
*Jurassic Spark - (Revenge of the King) This mods grants a continuously increasing counter that provides buffs at 25, 50, and 75. Each stack of the counter is removed for every 500 damage taken by this bot. At 99 stacks this Bot becomes Enraged. 
**25 Stacks: Melee Fury
**50 Stacks: Projectile Speed and Damage
**75 Stacks: Special 3 is Unlocked
**99 Stacks: Run and duck for cover, because your Opponent is Enraged. They’ll have all the above buffs, plus Power Gain, and they’ll become Unstoppable! You also will not be able to remove any stacks of the counter at this time! So word to the wise… Never let your opponent get to 99!
*Terminus Virus - This Bot has been infected by the Terminus Virus! (Evil Tread: From Rust 'Til Dawn)
** Hunger - This Bot slowly loses health, but gains health whenever it does damage.
** Revive - Bot has a chance to revive, purify all debuffs and heal every time it is defeated. (Reduced chance to revive with less health each time it is defeated.)
** Critical Weakness - Bot suffers -45~50~55~65% Armor Break from Critical Hits, but gains 20~30~40~50% Armor Up against non-Critical hits.
** Burn It - High chance to revive, unless it is on fire.
* Metal Monster - This Bot features monstrous qualities. (Evil Tread: Monster Hunt)
** Ghosted - Bot has phases of intangibility where all regular attacks will miss. (Evade buff)
** Ly-car-thropy - Bot heavily favors alternate mode and can only be killed by Critical Ranged attacks.
** Children of the Night - Melee attacks by this Bot apply a Bleed that drains Health back to the Bot.

sections.heading: Alliance Mission
sections.text:
Effects that are encountered with linked and unlinked Bosses in Alliance Missions.
* Lesser Link Shield - Shielded by a powerful Linked Node, capping damage from each attack by 10% of their max Health, repairing 10% of their max health per second, and granting immunity to all Debuffs. Wait for an ally to remove the link.
* Greater Link Shield - Shielded by a powerful Linked Node, capping damage from each attack by 2% of their max Health, repairing 2% of their max health per second, and granting immunity to all Debuffs. Wait for an ally to remove the link.
* Evolving Power: Phase 1 - Between 100% - 75% Health, Protection from attacks until opponent maintains a Combo of 15 or higher.
* Evolving Power: Phase 2 - Between 75% - 50% Health, every 7.5 seconds, cycle between a Melee, Ranged, and Special Attack Buff. Each Attack Buff adds 300%.
* Evolving Power: Phase 3 - Between 50% - 25% Health, every 10 seconds, cycle through protection from Melee and Ranged Attacks.
* Evolving Power: Phase 4 - Between 25% - 0% Health, activate a Repair Buff when not struck by a melee attack for 6 seconds. healing 1% of max Health per second. Repair stops at 25% max Health.
* Evolving Power: Phase 5 - When dropped to 0% Heath, become Enraged for 6 seconds. While Enraged, Attack is increased by 300%, become Unstoppable, and have protection from Attacks.

Version History.lead: A [http://forums.transformersforgedtofight.com/discussion/16/transformers-forged-to-fight-changelog#latest changelog] of updates throughout the game.

sections.heading: Version 0.3 (March 1)
sections.text:
Official Release Notes

New Modes for Your Alliance!
*Alliance Missions Coming Soon! Use strategy and cooperation as your Alliance breaks into Battlegroups to tackle difficulty Missions for fantastic rewards! More information will be available on those as we get closer to their launch.
*Alliance Events: Take on Alliances from around the world, scoring points in a variety of timed events. Earn Rank and Milestone rewards for your efforts! More information here: http://forums.transformersforgedtofight.com/discussion/85/introducing-alliance-events/p1?new=1

New Features for You:
*Auto Fight: Let your Bots battle for you in Story and Daily Missions!

New Content:
*Story Missions: A new Chapter of Act 2 is available to explore!

Various other Changes and Improvements:
*Fight Introductions: New animations play when Bots enter the battle.
*Raid Rewards: Earn bonus rewards when winning Raids based on your Medal count
*Bug fixes, screen improvements, new tutorials, and optimizations

sections.heading: Version 0.2.0 (January 28, 2017)
sections.text:
Official Release Notes

Introducing Away Team Missions:
*Send your Bots on missions to collect resources
*These missions can be done while you are away and don't require you to play them

Introducing Synergies
*Pair specific Bots to activate bonus attributes and abilities.
*Strategically build your teams to maximize and customize these abilities to your play style and the challenge ahead!

New story missions have been added to help you unravel the mystery of this strange planet where realities collide.

Autobot Ratchet has been hard at work performing standard maintenance and fixing some major gameplay bugs.

sections.heading: Version 1.0 - Global Launch
sections.text: Global Release Date: April 28, 2017

sections.heading: =Official Release Notes=
sections.text:
* New Languages - Support for Japanese, Korean, Thai, Indonesian, French, Italian, Spanish, German, Norwegian, Russian, Dutch, Turkish, and Arabic.
* New Bots - Mixmaster has been added to the Premium Bot Crystal
* New Story Missions - Act 2 Chapter 4 unlocked for you to explore.
* New Event Missions - Celebrate the launch of the game with a set of 6 Boss challenges available for a limited time only! A new challenge will be released every 3 days, but hurry! They disappear on April 24th!
**Rulers of Kaon is a new challenge for the strongest Commanders to test their strength. This Mission is the first story in the new Legends of Cybertron series.
*New Daily Missions
**Introducing new Spark Trials daily Event Missions! Earn T1 Basic Sparks and Essence from Easy difficulty, and T2 Basic Sparks and Essence from Medium difficulty. Progress and rewards reset Daily.
*New Alliance Missions
**Play through cooperative Missions with your Alliance!
**The new Forgotten Ruins map features 10 difficulty levels and is an introductory map acting as a precursor to Shattered Lands.
*General
**Mission crystals have been replaced with direct ORE-13 payouts.
**The third team slot is now unlocked at level 1 (down from 3).
**Daily Missions now unlock at level 8 (up from 4).
**Raids now unlock at level 7 (up from 6).
**Raid store is locked until 7 to prevent buying items you can't use.
**Improved early game tutorialization.
**Reduced the T2 Class Spark Essence awarded for selling T1 Class Sparks
**Reduced the T2 Class Spark Essence obtained from completing the Medium Difficulty of Class Specific Daily Missions

Bug Fixes and Optimizations
*Fixed an issue that would cause Shields to expire prematurely
*Alliance Mission link nodes visibility and sync quality improved
*Fixed an issue where characters recovered from a Light Ranged combo too quickly
*Fixed numerous Crash and Connection issues
*Fixed an issue causing a hang on loading screens
*Fixed an issue causing fights in Alliance Missions to not load
*Fixed an issue where node numbers were not displaying in Alliance Missions
*Fixed an issue where a black bar will appear on top of the screen and remain there on all screens
*Miscellaneous other bug fixes and optimizations.

Game Balance
*Bot Ability Rating
**We’ve updated all Bot Ratings to more accurately reflect the overall strength of that Bot. As a result, the total Rating for all Bots has decreased. Specifically, the Rating assigned to each Bot Ability has been reduced while the Rating from base attributes remains the same. This is a display-only change that affects every Bot and will result in more accurate and reliable Bot Ratings going forward without having any effect on the actual performance of each Bot.
*Light Ranged Attacks
**Decreased damage and Power generated to be on par with Light Melee attacks
*Arcee
**Added a passive chance to automatically Sidestep incoming Ranged Attacks

sections.heading: Official Release Notes
sections.text:
*Complete your Transformers: The Last Knight experience with new limited-time missions. - Rumors that the Autobot Hot Rod has arrived on New Quintessa enrages Drift who vows to hunt him down. - Perplexed by Drift's vow Optimus Prime and Bumblebee fear that the Decepticon turned Autobot has gone rogue and is resorting back to his old Decepticon ways. Play the all new Spotlight - "A Question of Loyalty" - and find out what happens when brothers in arms do battle.
*Megatron has returned to take his place as the new boss of Alliance Missions!
*New Level Cap! Commanders can now reach Level 50!
*New Daily Login Calendar!
**Great prizes await the faithful Commanders who login everyday!
**Collect Rewards from the 7 Day, 28 Day, and Alliance Calendars.
*Fight in a brand new environment inspired by Transformers: The Last Knight.
*A whole new look for your Base!
**Base updates bring a new level of visual polish and navigational ease.
**Show off up to four Relics with two new sockets added.
**Several new Relics with new effects have been added. New Relics can be found by fully Exploring any difficulty level of "A Question of Loyalty" as well as from the special Event Calendar. These Relics also have new in-game benefits.
*Tip the odds in your favor by using Boosts to augment your Bots' performance.
**Boosts can increase your damage output or survivability.
**Activate an XP Boost to accelerate your level ups and claim rewards faster.
**Some Boosts are only applied to a specific game mode.
*Forging a Module now awards bonus Module Crystal Shards based on the Rank, Level, and Signature Ability Level of the Modules that are consumed.
**1-Star Modules do not award Shards.
**2-Star Modules award 3-Shard Module Crystal Shards.
**3-Star Modules award 4-Star Module Crystal Shards.
*A new Synergy Bonus interface now shows you who is providing a bonus and who is receiving a bonus. The benefits and targets for existing Synergy Bonuses have not changed.
*Several new Synergy Bonuses have been added.
*The Alliance-based currency Loyalty has been removed.
**Existing Loyalty balances have been converted to Gold.
**You now earn Gold for answering Alliance Help Requests.
*Alliance Help requests will now immediately award 3 Energy in addition to the Energy received from Alliance mates.
*Bot Changes
**1-Star and 2-Star Bots now start with two Special Attacks at Rank 1 and unlock a third Special Attack after Ranking Up.
**3-Star Bots now start with three Special Attacks at Rank 1.
**New Synergies have been added and tuned for several bots.
*Mixmaster
**Received a re-design, both on his Basic Abilities and his Signature.
**Updated design will be more in line with other Demolition Bots (Very high damage bursts in a short period of time)
**Acid does not have a cost anymore and Neutralizes Resistances Buffs when active, making him really great against Bots like Ultra Magnus.
**Will deal Burn on his Special 3.
**Whenever opponents have an active Debuff, Mixmaster will get a huge Critical Rate Buff.
*Arcee
**Generates power from Non-Critical Hits.
**Power generation from Critical Hits has been reduced to 12%.
**Guardian's Ferocity now has a 20% increased chance to trigger at all Signature levels.
*Mod Changes
**Laser Guidance and EMI Module
***Module buffs and debuffs can no longer be overridden by projectile buffs from bots.
**A new formula adds a global minimum and maximum speed limit for projectiles to account for bots that might stack Projectile Speed buffs.
*Fight Tuning Adjustments:
**Made Adjustments to the AI of enemies to make them less likely to hold their power until they can use their Special 3
**Tuned down aggression of Enemy AI in harder content
**Made a slight adjustment to the speed of Projectile Attacks to make them easier for players to avoid
**Slightly increased the window to chain from a combo into a special attack
*Bug Fixes and Optimizations
**Fixed an issue with the effectiveness of Module Signature Abilities during Raids
**Stash items now default to sort by expiry
**Filter basic ORE-13 and Catalysts in the Stash and Inventory screens
**Some timers that previously just showed hours now show minutes as well.

You’ll also be able to watch an Advertisement upon running out of Energy in a mission to gain 9 more energy. You will be able to do this once every 6 hours.

sections.heading: Bot Rebalances
sections.text:
8.0 rebalanced a whole ton of Bots, including:

HOUND
*Added +3.6% to base Critical Rate.
*The time it takes to switch ammo has been reduced to 60ms, down from 90ms.
*Increased Signature Ability scaling to start at +50% projectile damage. This scales to an unchanged maximum of +200%.
*The bonus from Hound’s Signature Ability remains activate during Special Attacks that activated before the bonus expired.
*Increase Critical Damage against Burning opponents.
*The Critical Resistance Debuff now scales up, gaining +0.5s duration and -1.8% potency each Rank.
*The increased Critical Damage against Burning targets now scales up +5% with each Rank.
*The final (grenade) hit of Special 2 inflicts Burn instead of Bleed.
*Sidestepping while Precision Ammo is equipped Purifies Dazed effects.
*Added +10% Attack to Inferno Ammo heat damage at all Ranks and now all damage is dealt after 10s instead of 15s.

MIXMASTER
*The chance to trigger an Acid Debuff on projectile attacks starts with +5% chance and scales up an additional +5% with each Rank, up to a maximum of 50% at Rank 5.
*The Acid Debuff from projectile attacks lasts +1 second longer at all Ranks.
*Added +10% Attack to Acid Damage from projectile attacks at all Ranks.
*Added +8% base Block Proficiency.
Acid is one of the unique aspects of Mixmaster but wasn’t relevant enough in most fights. These changes make it more worthwhile and reliable to leverage ranged gameplay to generate this unique effect.

JETFIRE
*Added +3% to base Attack.
*Added +5% to base Block Proficiency.
*Increased the duration of his Ranged Bonus from 10s to 20s.
*The Old Friends Synergy with Starscream is now part of Jetfire’s base kit; however, the Stun from well-timed Blocks no longer affects Special Attacks and the Stun duration has been shortened to 1s. The Synergy still exists, but has the new effect of increasing the duration of this Stun from well-timed Blocks by 50%.
It was never intended to let any Bot inflict Stun to an enemy during that enemies’ Special animation. This has led to several issues, and breaks a rule of gameplay in an uncomfortable way. This Synergy with Starscream was so potent that it made Jetfire feel reliant on a specific team. We’ve kept a Synergy between them, but Jetfire is now more viable on non-Starscream teams.

KICKBACK
*Added +3.6% base Critical Rate.
*Added +10% base Critical Damage.
*Special 2 Critical (blade) hits now inflict Bleed.

STARSCREAM
*Special 1 chance for a Projectile Damage Buff increased to 100%.
*Projectile Bonus duration increased by 2 seconds.
*Special 2 Armor Break now has a chance to trigger on both hits and lasts 2 seconds longer.
*Starscream’s Old Friends Synergy with Jetfire no longer plays a Sidestep animation to avoid projectiles when Starscream dashes back. Instead, projectiles miss. He still receives the Critical Damage Buff when a projectile misses during his Dodge.
The extra hit of Armor Break is an additional chance to remove an enemy Armor Up. This Armor Break is now more in line with what to expect from a Special 2, and from a Tactician Bot.

GALVATRON
*Increased the chance to trigger a Dark Burn from Heavy Attacks by 0.7% per charge of Dark Energy.
At 30 charges, the chance to trigger a Dark Burn is 51%, up from the previous 30%.
*Added 10% Attack to Dark Burn damage at all Ranks.

GRIMLOCK
*The Purify from his Signature Ability activates after 1 second, down from 1.5 seconds.

GRINDOR
*Special 3 Critical (missile) Hits inflict Burn like other missile attacks.

SIDESWIPE
*Added +3.6% to base Critical Rate.
*Added +10% to base Critical Damage.
*Special 2 chance to Burn increased to 100%.

DINOBOT
*Increased all Critical Rating Buff durations by 2 seconds.
*Increased all Armor Break durations by 2 seconds.
*Added +10% chance to Special 1 Armor Break at all Ranks.
*Added +5% base Block Proficiency.
*Increased Signature Ability scaling to 15...50% chance of Unblockable.

BUMBLEBEE (DARK OF THE MOON)
*Special 1 now has a 40..60% chance to inflict an Armor Break Debuff on each hit based on Rank.

MEGATRONUS
*Removed 2% base Health.
*Removed 4% base Attack.
We recognize Megatronus as one of the most effective Bots. We don't want to dethrone him, especially after many of you have worked hard to acquire and upgrade him. We've reduced his overall effectiveness a bit by targeting his core stats, which ensure none of his unique functionality is compromised.

SHIELDMASTERS SYNERGY
*The Power Steal from well-timed Blocks increased to 2...8% based on Tier.
*Updated to actually subtract Power from the opponent by an equal amount.

sections.text:
Released September 26, 2019

Commanders!

Version 8.2 is coming your way later this week, and kicks off not just one, but 2 large story arcs in New Quintessa!

Act 4 Chapter 1: Autobot's Turn

Leaping from a Chrono-Vector test, Wheeljack and Jetfire discover they have entered a parallel time-line to the one they left. They are cut off from contact with the rest of the Autobots and have discovered this world has yet to face the destruction of Megatronus and the awakening of the mysterious Titan that dwells below them.

Will they be able to stop the plans of Shockwave, unite their fellow Bots, and fight off the pulsing waves of darkness that threaten to overtake the planet? Find out in Act 4 Chapter 1: Autobots Turn!

The Start of a New 3-Month Story Arc

October's Spotlight mission kicks off a new story that will last until the end of the year, and will have ramifications that reach far and wide!

Bug Fixes and Improvements

*Fixed an issue where Megatron was not getting his Armor Bonus for his Lieutenants synergy

*Fixed an issue where ""Stupify"" mastery was not applying to Prowl's Range Attack

*Fixed an issue where Arcee's signature was triggering less often then it should
*Fixed an issue where Swordmasters would sometimes give the wrong critical damage bonus
*Fixed an issue where Blugeon's Signature Ability was displaying the wrong Critical Hit Damage increase

sections.heading: Version 8.3
sections.text:
Released December 5, 2019

*Showcase Mode allows Commanders to try out a fully maxed-out monthly featured Bot in a Special Mission, without the need to purchase them first.
*Mastered the Daily Missions? Mission Mastery allows you to get the rewards without playing the map. All you need is some energy (or Energon).
*The free-for-all Daily Missions are no more! Replaced by the Crystal Trials that have a chance at T1-3 Class Spark Crystals.
*The official Forged to Fight Discord has arrived! The Options menu now lies a link to join it.
*A brand new splash screen inspired by Chapter 4 has been added, so you look at Megatronus looming over New Quintessa more often.

sections.heading: Version 8.4
sections.text:
Released March 29, 2020
Guess what, Commanders! We're celebrating our Three Year Anniversary with a pretty stellar update! Check out the patch notes below!

New Features
*All those Titan Fragments you've been collecting? It's time to put them to use! With those Fragments you get the chance to purchase 5-Star Level bots that were EXCLUSIVE to previous events.
*The standard Bot Pool for 2 ~ 4-Star Bots is being updated to where Commanders have the chance to gain all non-Sharkticon bots (yes that includes Bumblebee).
*Alliance Missions are being reworked and new rewards will allow Commanders to gain up to x16,000 Titan Fragments each week. These start April 2nd!
*Part of the Alliance Mission changes also include a whole new map (and only the one). 45 minute recharge timers. Difficulty ranging from 1-100. The event name is EXTINGUISHMENT and the map is called Fortress of Corruption.
*A new Daily Mission will be available that will also allow Commanders to gain up to x850 Titan Fragments each week. With this they can receive Repair Packs and Boosts specific to AM.
*Repair and Revive Kits are being reworked to a percentage based repair system! (See below for values)

Bug Fixes
*Fixed numerous Bot related bugs.
*Improved performance on some Android devices.
*Addressed an issue where some iconography was displayed in an unintended manner.
*Addressed an issue where the game would crash during extended play.
*Addressed some translation issues that were causing confusion.
*Populated some descriptions that were missing.
*Addressed an issue where Ads were not appearing properly in certain countries.
*Fixed the display of of text when language is set to Thai.
*Fixed an issue where two unresponsive Game Center Buttons appear in the Settings screen when not signed into Game Center.
*Forge XP bar shows Forge Level above cap (100)

* 2/08/2021
* Introduces the new Rank 6 for 5-Star Bots
*But was also notorious for bugs and the new T5 Sparks not ready yet at time of launch...

* April 2021
* minor bug fixes

* 7/27/2021
* stability update and features some under the hood bug fixes.

* 8/16/21
* fixes for various crashing issues.

* 10/19/21
* back-end changes that should not directly impact gameplay as well as a small animation fix for Cliffjumper.

* 12/14/21
* Major update with Ember Holiday events and Dirge
* Happy Ember Lights Festival, Commanders! To celebrate the season in which we remember that even the darkest days can be brightened by the sparks inside us, we have a surprise for you all! Later today, you’ll find Version 8.9 available to download! Along with various bug fixes and improvements, you’ll find a new Bot to battle and collect! Fear roars through the skies, Dirge has landed! A new anomaly has appeared, and terror has come through it. Collect Dirge and command his fear-inducing engines, punishing your opponents for running away! Add Dirge to your ultimate squad on December 21 at 10 AM Eastern Time!

sections.heading: Version 9.0
sections.text:
February 2022, The biggest roadmap update since forever with the new monthly bots??

* More Bots!
** In the next Timeslide, Commanders will find Dirge was guarding a recently uncovered natural Spacebridge against the clutches of Necrotronus! Once activated, this Spacebridge will open gates to worlds unseen, bringing new friends and foes to New Quintessa!
** Commanders can look forward to more new Bots coming their way this year, starting with 2 new Bots in v9.0 coming later this month! One of these Bots has been hiding in plain sight, while the other is our take on a Generations classic.
** Don’t hold on to those Bot Chips or Titan Fragments though! These new Bots will be available in Crystals and other offers before being added to any other method of acquisition.
** These new Bots will not be released right away, and come with a new content schedule of events and Missions themed around them.
* New Content Schedule
** Each new Bot will have a 5-week event dedicated to them. These events will include:
** 2 Timeslide length Missions called “Bot Incursions”
** Objectives
** Login Rewards
** 4 Featured Bots available for Bot Chips
** Showcases for the featured bots and the new arrival
** Alliance Events
** This new schedule will be replacing our current monthly content schedule. During this time, our goal is to really make the Game feel like it’s dedicated to the New Bot.
* Off-Cycle Events
** There won’t always be back-to-back Bot releases, and during those downtimes, we’ll be running special off-cycle events, focussing on other Bots, factions and teams on New Quintessa, such as Beast Wars or Decepticon events!
* More Content Update Priorities
** Throughout the year, we also want to take some time to focus on updating some other kinds of content and modes. We don’t have details to share on these at the moment, but would like to give you a glimpse at some of the priorities we are working on:
** Sharkticon Week Revamp: We’ve revamped this fan-favourite event, and you can look forward to it coming soon!
** Quest Content Update: We want to work on new Buffs and Map layouts to give players more variety in-game, as well as taking another look at Prime Difficulty as more Commanders have access to Rank 6 Bots.
** Alliance Mission Update: We want to adjust the Alliance Mission Map to be shorter, so that we can regularly mix up the Bots alliances will be facing off against, and reinvigorate the challenge in one of our most popular game modes.
* This all starts soon!
** Get ready Commanders, because all of this kicks off this month! You’ll find out the first new Bots heading your way when v9.0 releases on Feb 8th, and have your chance to snag one of them before the end of the month! These won’t be the last new Bots you see this year either, so look forward to even more additions to the Fight throughout 2022!

* 5/18/22
* Introduces Slipstream and Rodimus Prime.

* 6/02/22
* This update includes a fix to Slipstream's ranged attack.
* (unlisted) fixed a bug where Rodimus would be immune to all debuffs.

* July 26, 2022
* In this update you can collect the arrogant & ruthless Autobot warrior Sunstreaker and the unpredictably dangerous Decepticon, Soundblaster! Additionally, check in frequently for new events and experiences.

sections.heading: Shutdown Announcement
sections.text:
October 14, 2022

It is with a heavy heart that we announce that we will be ending support for Transformers: Forged to Fight and shutting down all servers on January 13, 2023. Working on this game has been nothing less than a labor of love. We created this game for all fans of Transformers to enjoy, and as fans ourselves, we’ve loved every minute of it and have been honored by every fight, Raid, and Mission that you have completed. Although The Fight is coming to a close, we want to thank you for your dedication, support and love that you have shown this game. It has meant the world to us. As of today, we will be disabling all In-App Purchases (purchases that cost real money). But, The Fight is not over! While the adventures on New Quintessa may be coming to an end, new stories will continue to be released into December! Thank you once again for your commitment to Transformers: Forged to Fight. If you have any questions, you can reach out to our support team via the in-game menu.

With all our gratitude, The Transformers: Forged to Fight team.

Warrior.lead: {{Class_Template|number_of_champions = 10|non-playable = 0|class_bonus = Scout|weakness = Brawler|image1 = File:Class Use Warrior.png}}Warriors are one of the six Bot Classes in Transformers: Forged to Fight. It has a Class Bonus against Scouts, but is weak to Brawlers.

sections.heading: In-Game Description
sections.text:
Warrior Bots have deadly accuracy and love bleeding Energon from their opponents.
*The tracking systems of Warrior Bots give them an advantage over the evasive Scout Bots.
*Most Warriors can inflict Bleed debuffs.
*Warriors' Buffs such as Precision can counter Evade abilities.

sections.heading: Strategies
sections.text:
Almost all Warriors specialize in anti-evasion and Bleeds, though some may incorporate one or the other, or both. For example, Hot Rod never Bleeds but specializes in anti-evasion, Bludgeon specializes in Bleeds and Arcee specializes in both.

Warriors, much like the class they're meant to counter, the Scouts, like to score Critical Hits and may have buffs related to those. They are also usually close-range, usually fighting with a melee weapon of some sort. However, this reliance on close-range attacks turns out to also be their downfall, as Brawlers have abilities that counter these kinds of attacks.

sections.heading: Consuming Presence
sections.text:
Part 1
*Megatron: Are you sure your intel is correct?
*Soundwave: Affirmative. Laserbeak is always reliable.
*Megatron: Then they are here?
*Soundwave: I cannot confirm quantity. But, based on our previous encounters, I postulate that there is a presence...
*Megatron: An Insecticon presence. A presence we shall use to our advantage.
Part 2
*Megatron: The swaths of metallic carnage and devoured resources indicate Laserbeak was correct.
*Soundwave: The Insecticons are a destructive nuisance.
*Megatron: A nuisance that can turn the tide of battle in our favor. With their mind control and cloning powers at our disposal, the planet will be ours.
*Soundwave: But we do not possess their powers.
*Megatron: Not yet. We've been down this road before, but remember, they are Decepticons. First things first. You distract the Autobots and their so called Commander. I'll take care of "persuading" our Insecticon friend.
Part 3
*Marissa: Prowl, has your patrol with the Commander confirmed Teletraans's suspicions?
*Prowl: Fields of devoured vegetation? Check. Buildings and supply warehouses gnawed on? Check. Autobot allies acting suspicious and going rogue? Check.
*Marissa: That all adds up to one thing...
*Prowl: An Insecticon presence.
Part 4
*Soundwave: Turn around and return to your base of face annihilation.
*Prowl: Annihilation is pretty severe. Like a horde of locust consuming a planet?
*Soundwave: Grasshopper would be more accurate.
*Prowl: So Kickback is here!
*Soundwave: I did not say that.
*Prowl: You didn't have to.

sections.heading: Buggy Deja-Vu
sections.text:
Part 1
* Marissa Faireborn: Commander, we have a problem. Team members have gone missing.
* Prowl: Who's missing? Any specifics?
* Marissa Faireborn: So far, Mirage, Bumblebee... and... Optimus. Windblade was on sentry duty. She saw...
*Windblade: The three of them walk off. I called to them. They marched ahead vacantly, as though they were programmed to be somewhere else.
* Marissa Faireborn: Prowl, thoughts?
*Prowl: Insecticons arrive and bots start acting strange? That spells trouble. Big Trouble. Cerebro-Shell trouble.
* Marissa Faireborn: Cerebro-Shell?
*Prowl: A mind control device the Insecticons like to use to make bots their minions. Like I said... Big Trouble!
Part 2
*Megatron: Have you made any progress in discerning which Insecticon is here?
*Soundwave: Decepticon affiliated sources have revealed a Autobots behaving erratically. Their behavior suggests they are being controlled.
*Megatron: Bombshell was known to use the Cerebro-Shell device. Ah, but you would know that. After all, he used it on you!
*Soundwave: I do not need reminding. But, Laserbeak has a confirmed an army of grasshopper bots consuming mass quantities or ore and energon in mines nearby.
*Megatron: Then that would be Kickback. Those meddling bugs have shared technology before, it would not surprise me if they did so here. It is time to go cricket hunting.
Part 3
*Mirage: Where do you think you're going?
*Prowl: Whoa, ease up tough guy, it;'s out of character. What's got into you?
*Mirage: You could call it common sense of the insect persuasion.
*Prowl: I knew it, they got you again. Commander, we've been through this before. Mirage has been manipulated by an Insecticon device.
*Mirage: Enlightened by Insecticon technology.
*Prowl: Entomological semantics. Commander, subdue our friend so we can take care of his bug problem.

sections.heading: Bee Be Bugging
sections.text:
Part 1
*Sideswipe: Ratchet just told me he removed something called a Cerebro-Shell from Mirage.
*Prowl: It's a start.
*Sideswipe: A start? What do you mean?
*Prowl: I mean we still have two Autobots AWOL and a crazed grasshopper out there ravaging all that he sees.
*Sideswipe: Then what are we doing sitting here? We don't need Optimus to tell us to roll out. Let's roll!
Part 2
* Megatron: Well, it isn't my favorite Insecticon, Kickback. Welcome to New Quintessa.
* Kickback: Spare me the pleasantries-pleasentries.
* Megatron: Repeating words? I thought that was Shrapnel's thing.
* Kickback: Sometimes things rub off on bots-bots.
* Megatron: Do other things rub off? Like technology?
* Kickback: You've seen my clones-clones?
* Megatron: There have been rumors. There's also been rumors of mind-controlled Autobots.
* Kickback: The Insecticon nation recruits in various ways-ways.
* Megatron: Indeed. Indeed.
Part 3
*Sideswipe: Get the pesticide out, we've got a bug problem.
*Kickback: I hope you fight better than you tell jokes, Automoron-moron.
*Sideswipe: Time for the flyswatter, Commander.
*Kickback: Bah! Are you blind and stupid? I'm a grasshopper you idiot-idiot! Time to turn you to scrap-scrap!
Post-defeat (if ambushed)
*Sideswipe: Had enough, Kickback?
*Kickback: You got lucky-lucky. Next time will be different-rent. And don't be too smug. A bug of a different nature awaits you-you. Have fun... don't get stung-stung.
Part 4
* Bumblebee: Kickback told me to expect company. I just didn't expect it so soon... or so weak.
*Sideswipe: Why you bugging, Bee?
*Bumblebee: I'm a growing bot. And, growing bots need all the energon they can get. My bro-bot Kickback has the hooks ups.That's all you need to know.
*Prowl: That and the fact Bee is being controlled by Kickback's Cerebro-Shell.
*Sideswipe: That old thing? OK, Bee, it's time to get you back to Ratchet for some de-bugging.
*Bumblebee: The only way I'm going with you is if Ratchet has a super-sized helping of Energon and a side order of Ore-13. I doubt he has that, so beat it.
*Sideswipe: Beat it... beat you. Same diff, Let's do this this.

sections.heading: Devouring Freedom
sections.text:
Part 1
*Bumblebee: Whoa, what happened? My programming feels like it got a hard boot, a cold boot, and a swift kick to the tailpipe.
*Ratchet: That's a colorful, but fairly accurate description of what's transpired. The Commander brought you to me, and I brought you to your senses... so to speak.
*Bumblebee: Huh?
*Ratchet: Kickback used the Insecticon's Cerebro-Shell to brainwash you. The Commander's squad brought you to me. I removed the Cerebro-Shell...
*Bumblebee: And we're all good. Sweet!
*Ratchet: Hardly. Kickback is still out there with advanced Insecticon tech and... and...'
*Bumblebee: And what?! Spit it out.
*Ratchet: And, Optimus is out there... under Kickback's control.
Part 2
*Optimus Prime: All these years of seeking freedom for others...
*Kickback: And the path to your own freedom was right before you-you. You just needed to see the truth-truth. Consumption will set you free-free.
*Optimus Prime: Energon will set me free. For too long I have been controlled by the well being of others. It is time for me. It is Prime time! Time to get what I am due.
*Kickback: Spoken like a true Insecti... er... Autobot-Autobot!
Part 3
*Bumblebee: Ratchet said you were out here.
*Optimus Prime: Here I am. What of it?
*Bumblebee: He says you are under Kickback's control. I've been there, I know what you're going through.
*Optimus Prime: I am under no one's control. Ever. That is why I am a Prime. The Prime. But, I will be going through one thing... you... if you get in the way.
*Bumblebee: In the way of what?
*Optimus Prime: My path to optimizing my freedom... one Energon cube at a time. Step aside. It is time to eat!

sections.heading: Quest for Clones
sections.text:
Part 1
*Soundwave: The Insecticon pest is spreading his influence. Yet, the Cerebro-Shell proved less than effective in turning the Autobots.
*Megatron: If the Insecticons had brains they'd be dangerous. But, this one has his uses. The Cerebro-Shell was a longshot. The cloning device is a sure thing.
*Soundwave: Affirmative. A cloning device in your possession would advance the Decepticon position here in New Quintessa.
*Megatron: Exactly. That is why the next step is to earn his trust... and steal his cloning advantage.
Part 2
*Megatron: I'm glad you could take some time from your endless buffets and Autobot failures to see me, Kickback.
*Kickback: The Autobots were a diversion-version. While they were distracting their beloved Commander, my clone army was harvesting vast quantities of Energon for me to consume-sume.
*Megatron: That brings me to why I called you here. A clone army could prove beneficial to the Decepicon cause.
*Kickback: That is your cause. Not mine.
*Megatron: But brother, we share Decepticon code. It is in our core programming.
*Kickback: That might be true, but why should I help you-you? You have decieved me before... "brother"-"other."
*Megatron: Because, without your fellow Decepticons, the Autobots and their accursed Commander will put an end to your wanton path of mass consumption.
*But, a clone army of Megatrons, Decepticons, and of course, Kickbacks could ensure permanent consumption.
*Kickback: Hmmm... something to consider-consider. After I eat-eat.
Part 3
*Megatron: To what I owe the pleasure, Prime? You still hunger for freedom... or is that Energon?
*Optimus Prime: You know what we seek... an end to the Insection and all the destruction he wreaks.
*Megatron: You know I can't help you with that. A Decepticon never turns on a brother.
*Optimus Prime: Really? Does Starscream show your sentiment? Regardless, we know Kickback is nearby. We are here to put him on a diet.
*Megatron: No, you're here to eat dirt, Autobot scum!

sections.heading: Defeat the Feet
sections.text:
Part 1
*Bumblebee: There's been a swarm sighting out by the Energon mines in the western sector.
*Optimus Prime: That spells trouble. Those mines are not just regular old mines. They are Dark Energon mines.
*Bumblebee: We're talking trouble with a capital "T" if Kickback gets his claws on that stuff.
*Optimus Prime: That is why precisely why there is no time to waste. Commander, rally your squad, it is time to roll out!
Part 2
*Megatron: Have you given thought to joining forces with your brethen?
*Kickback: My brethen are Insecticons, not Deceptibots that fall and decieve... like you-you.
*Megatron: But together we can overcome all.
*Kickback: You've plotted against me and my kind too many times before-ore. My clones are all the company I need-need. Now begone, it's time for me to feast-est.
*Megatron: If you live to regret this... I will be waiting. And rest assured, your clones will be mine.
Part 3
*Kickback: If you want to taste defeat at the hands of the feet, you came to the right place-place!
*Bumblebee: Huh? That doesn't even make sense.
*Optimus Prime: I think he is referring to his hind legs. They are formidable and pack a powerful punch.
*Kickback: PUNCH!? Kick-kick! They pack a powerful kick you fool-fool.
*Bumblebee: No one calls Optimus Prime a fool-fool, you tool-tool! You're going to pay for that! Commander, it's time to teach this overgrown grasshopper a lesson.

sections.heading: Furry Incursion
sections.text:
* Boss: Rhinox
Part 1
* Ratchet: Commander, Optimus, the Spacebridge incursions keep happening.
* Optimus Prime: It would seem they are becoming more regular. As though they were on an Earth month cycle.
* Ratchet: Correct. We've scouted the location where incursion occured.
* Optimus Prime: Any clues as to who or what may have come through?
* Ratchet: Perhaps, but I'm not sure the significance. We found a clump of fur... Gray fur.
* Rhinox: *Primal!*
Part 2
* Dinobot: Rhinox, what are you doing out here?
* Rhinox: I've seen this before. They'll try to hunt him down...
* Dinobot: Hunt who down?
* Rhinox: Optimus Primal! He's here and "their" Optimus is sure to follow their standard operating procedure.
* Dinobot: Which is?
* Rhinox: Order the Commander to go on a mission to hunt Optimus Primal down and beat some sense into him so they can debrief him. Primal doesn't deserve that. He needs time. I'm going to buy him some.
* Optimus Prime: Rhinox, you summoned us?
Part 3
* Rhinox: Indeed I did. I have information and a request.
* Optimus Prime: You are a Maximal of honor, proceed.
* Rhinox: I know who you hunt, and I have been in contact. Optimus Primal is here, but he is out of sorts at the present time.
* Optimus Prime: "Out of sorts" can have serious ramifications for us all. We need to bring him back to HQ so Ratchet can help him.
* Rhinox: Which brings me to my request. Let me help him, On my terms... On Maximal terms.
* Optimus Prime: You know I cannot. His current state combined with his Primal power could endanger us all.
* Rhinox: Then it is no longer a request. It is a statement. I will help my friend, and you will not stop me. Do what you must, Commander.

sections.heading: Poisoned Primal
sections.text:
* Boss: Waspinator
Part 1
* Prowl: Optimus, I saw that the bug has returned from patrol. Did he find out anything useful?
* Optimus Prime: Prowl, my old friend. His name is Waspinator, and he is now a trusted member of our alliance.
* Prowl: Ungh... "Trusted"... That'll be the day.
* Optimus Prime: I order you to afford him the respect he is due. And, yes, he did confirm the identity of our latest arrival. He is a Maximal namesake of mine... Optimus Primal.
* Prowl: Another Prime?! Well, that's some news we could use.
* Optimus Prime: Not so fast. There is a catch. Waspinator reports that he is not in a stable mental state. He is out there swinging swords and I guess you could say... Going ape.
* Prowl: I know what comes next. Commander, let's roll out!
Part 2
* Waspinator: I see the big hornbot, but you look damaged. What happened to you, Maximal?
* Rhinox: I got in the way of the Commander and Optimus Prime.
* Waspinator: That wazzz a dumb idea. What makes the hornbot so stupid?
* Rhinox: Because Optimus Primal is here, but somehow his circuits got crossed. I'm going to... We're going to... Help him before Optimus and his Autobot patrol gets heavy handed with him.
* Waspinator: Why would Wazzzpinator help the apebot?
* Rhinox: Because he'e one of us. He's our kind. And, you know he'll treat you right, with respect, when he gets sorted.
* Waspinator: I suppozzzze. Maybe Wazzzpinator can help....
Part 3
* Waspinator: Hornbot, you were right. I found apebot and he is acting crazzzzy.
* Rhinox: Any signs why he's acting deranged?
* Waspinator: Other than Scorponok's cyberbee drone attached to hizzz butt?
* Rhinox: What?!
* Waspinator: Yezzz. Scorponok's drone is attached to him and making the monkey Maximal go bananazzz.
* Rhinox: I know. I'm familiar with the effects. You go distract the Commander. I'm going to find an antidote.
* Waspinator: Waspinator fend off the Commander? How?!
* Rhinox: Oh, I don't know. How about shoot some green lasers or ride a big bomb into them?
Part 4
* Optimus Prime: Ah, Waspinator ...have you any news of Optimus Primal's whereabouts?
* Waspinator: Ummm... Uhhhh... No?
* Prowl: Not very convincing, you insect.
* Optimus Prime: Prowl, desist! I ask you again, Waspinator, do you have any news?
* Waspinator: Hornbot sayzzz Wazzzpinator needzzz to distract you while he helps Optimus Primal.
* Prowl: Distract us how?
* Waspinator: Ummm... Green lasers and big bombs?

sections.heading: Sharkticon Week
sections.text:
* Boss: S-1000
Part 1
* S-1000: My olfactory sensors detect a Maximal, or Predacon, or whatever it is you call yourselves.
* Rhinox: I am a Maximal - part Cybertronian, part beast. From the looks of things, we share something in common.
* S-1000: Such as?
* Rhinox: A link to the Beastie side of life.
* S-1000: That may be true, but what of it? I have seen both the Bots and Quintessons using and abusing my kind. Do you suggest you are different?
* Rhinox: I suggest the one I seek, my leader, the great Optimus Primal is different. He understands our kind. He can be trusted. Will you help me find him?
* S-1000: I'll contemplate it.
Part 2
* Rhinox: Have you reached a decision? Will you help?
* S-1000: Your appearance and apparent sincerity sway me, but honestly, my brethren and I have nothing left to lose.
* Rhinox: Then you'll help?
* S-1000: Yes, but temporarily... For a period of time... Let's say... A week?
* Rhinox: A Sharkticon week? Sounds intriguing. Are you willing to engage in battle?
* S-1000: We were built for it.
Part 3
* S-1000: The Commander approaches with a squad that has taken damage. I smell Energon in the water.
* Optimus Prime: Trust that we mean you no harm, Sharkticon.
* S-1000: I bet you say that to all the victims of your freedom crusade. Well, I'm not buying it anymore. There's a new Primal in town, and I plan to see what he has to offer.
* Optimus Prime: We can work together for the betterment of all... At the very least for the survival of all.
* S-1000: Been there, heard that. When will this fantasy come true?
* Optimus Prime: It takes time.
* S-1000: Yeah? Well, the only time I'm interested in is... FRENZY TIME!

sections.heading: Primal Alert
sections.text:
* Boss: G1 Grimlock
Part 1
* Rhinox: Grimlock, I need to talk to you.
* Grimlock: Why is Rhinobot here? Grimlock hear Optimus is looking for you.
* Rhinox: He may be, but I'm looking for you... For your help.
* Grimlock: Why Grimlock help you? Why Grimlock not help Optimus?
* Rhinox: But has Optimus ever really helped you? Or has he often questioned your intelligence, your abilities, your leadership?
* Grimlock: Ugh... Rhinobot says thing that might be true. Optimus did lock Grimlock up. He did say me too dangerous, Maybe I help you. What you want?
* Rhinox: Just delay the Commander. They will be looking for a friend of mine, a friend that can help Grimlock get Optimus' respect.
* Grimlock: Grimlock not know what delay means. But me do know what smash means.
* Rhinox: That will do, my friend.
Part 2
* Rhinox: It's you! I've finally found you!
* Optimus Primal: Or, did I finally find you in this Primus forsaken land of chaos and enemies?!
* Rhinox: Optimus, we heard you had arrived. We also heard you had some sort of ailment.
* Optimus Primal: My aliment was my Maximals abandoning me back on Earth.
* Rhinox: We didn't abandon you... We were brought here without our consent. Like you.
* Optimus Primal: You, Dinobot, Cheetor... All of you... Deserters! What do you have to say for yourselves?
* Rhinox: *Cheetor!?* Trust me, Optimus, we are here to help you. I have gathered friends that will help you get sorted.
* Optimus Primal: I've seen them. I've crushed them, let others pass. Perhaps, it's time to introduce more to my reality... The reality of the Primal!
Part 3
* Prowl: Commander, we have a code red monkey alert!
* Optimus Primal: Monkey?! Hardly. I am a Maximal! A Prime! You talk scrap, can you back it up?
* Prowl: Commander, teach big, metal, and hairy a lesson.
Part 4
* Prowl: Ah, Grimlock... Good to see you. Were you sent to join us in the search for the one they call Primal?
* Grimlock: Grimlock not know who you look for. The Rhinobot say you want to hurt his friend.
* Prowl: We don't want to hurt him. We want to help him.
* Grimlock: You have many bots and weapons. That not look like help.
* Prowl: Don't be stupid, big guy...
* Grimlock: Arrgghhh! Rhinobot say you call me stupid! He be right! Time for Grimlock to delay you and the Commander!
* Prowl: Delay, distract... Jeez... Why won't anyone just say... "LET'S FIGHT!?"

sections.heading: I Will Not Ask...
sections.text:
* Boss: Dinobot
Part 1
* Optimus Prime: Prowl, seeing as the Commander is the strong silent type, please report the results of the last mission.
* Prowl: Well, Rhinox duped Grimlock into helping him. I can't blame Grimlock, though. His insecurities make him an easy mark.
* Optimus Prime: What about the Maximal? Any sign of him?
* Prowl: Sign? More like a big hairy stop sign. He ambushed us, but the commander and squad made short work of him.
* Optimus Prime: So, he is not the threat Rhinox suggests?
* Prowl: I wouldn't say that. I'd say he was feeling us out... Testing us. Pretty sure next time we meet banana breath... It'll be for real.
Part 2
* Dinobot: Rhinox, I smell you. Show yourself.
* Rhinox: Good to smell you too, friend. What brings you to me?
* Dinobot: A warning, from one warrior of honor to another.
* Rhinox: If I was a betting bot, I'd say it has something to do with Primal.
* Dinobot: Correct. the Commander and their Optimus Prime are becoming increasingly impatient with Primal's dangerous behavior.
* Rhinox: I understand, but I need time to find the antidote to Scorponok's cyberbee drone virus. It's spreading through Primal's circuitry causing spikes in his eradicate actions.
* Dinobot: Time is a luxury I'm not sure we have.
* Rhinox: I will not ask you to do...
* Dinobot: What Optimus Primal would not do... Himself... For a friend. He would help. I will help.
Part 3
* Optimus Prime: Greetings, Dinobot. Is your presence here a mere coincidence? I suspect not.
* Dinobot: You deduce well. I am here to stand for a friend, a comrade, a brother in arms.
* Optimus Prime: Primal? Is he nearby? We must talk with him.
* Dinobot: I've run missions with you. I know how you and the Commander "talk".
* Prowl: Look, lizard face, we only do what's necessary to stabilize the situation and secure the peace.
* Dinobot: I am here to see that you will not "talk" to him until he is ready... And well.
* Prowl: Why put your dinotail on the line? Why take a beating for an out of control ape?
* Dinobot: I owe him my life. I can do no less.

sections.heading: Unless I'd Do It Myself
sections.text:
* Boss: Optimus Primal
Part 1
* Rhinox: Optimus, the Commander and Autobots are closing in on you.
* Optimus Primal: Let them. I'm done running. It's go time.
* Rhinox: With all due respect, they mean well. And... You are not well.
* Optimus Primal: I'm fine! In fact, I'm just prime!
* Rhinox: Sorry, boss, but you're not. Scorponok's virus has infiltrated your circuitry and is making you act out of character.
* Optimus Primal: Enough with the insubordination. Let them come and stay out of the way.
* Rhinox: At least find an antidote. Just a bit more time.
* Optimus Primal: For you, I'll grant your wish... A bit. But then, the power of the Primal will be unleashed!
Part 2
* Optimus Prime: Rhinox, I admire your loyalty and friendship to Optimus Primal, but he trail of destruction he leaves behind cannot be tolerated.
* Rhinox: I'm afraid you're right. Many of us have tried to talk some sense into him, but to no avail. Until we find an antidote to the virus that infects him, there's not much we can do.
* Prowl: But there's plenty I can do. Just wait till I find him.
* Optimus Prime: There's no need for threats, Prowl. Pump your brakes.
Part 3
* Prowl: Look, Commander its the banana breath Maximal. Let's wrap this mission up.
* Optimus Prime: Prowl, enough with the insults. Stand down!
* Optimus Primal: Listen to your Prime, Autobot. Stand down or get beat down.
* Prowl: So, are you done letting others fight your battles?
* Optimus Primal: I only ask them to do what I would do myself.
* Optimus Prime: I understand and respect your honor and predicament. But, we can't let you rampage across the wasteland and endanger innocents. We... Rhinox... Can help you.
* Optimus Primal: When I'm done with you, you'll be the one needing the help!

What Could Go Wrong?.lead: What Could Go Wrong? is a Spotlight Mission featuring Wheeljack that ran from August 9th to September 6th.

sections.heading: Guess Who's Back?
sections.text:
Part 1
*Jazz: Guess who's back, back again... Wheeljack's back, tell a friend.
*Bumblebee: That doesn't make sense, Jazz. Jack's never been here.
*Jazz: I know, bro, but man does it flow. Bottom line, Wheeljack is in the house.
*Prowl: Your gift for gabbing is cool and all, and we're all happy that Wheeljack has arrived, but our situation took a turn for the worse.
*Bumblebee: What're ya talking about?
*Prowl: Let me put it this way. What's worse than a Megatron?
*Bumblebee: Two Megatrons?
*Prowl: That's right, two Megatrons. That other one, from the other reality... well, Mirage's latest scouting probe says... he's back.
Part 2
*Bumblebee: Look who it is, the mad inventor himself.
*Wheeljack: Hey, Bee. That Spacebridge was bit of a shock to the system, but I'm feeling better.
*Prowl: Good, we can use your help.
*Wheeljack: Right to the point, spare the pleasantries as always, typical Prowl.
*Prowl: I don't know if you've figured it our yet, but you've just landed in a heap of scrap. And the scrap heap just got bigger. Megatron, one from another reality, has just resurfaced.
*Wheeljack: From another reality?! I'm guessing that can't be good. How can I help?
*Prowl: Try using that brain of yours, the good part, not the part that backfires on us.
*Bumblebee: Man, Prowl, that's harsh.
*Wheeljack: It's okay, Bee. I'm used to it. Point me to the lab. I have work to do.
Part 3
*Prowl: Trouble ahead.
*Bumblebee: Looks likes one of that other Meg's minions.
*Bonecrusher: Minion? MINION!? Hardly. Protector and ally? That would be correct.
*Prowl: So he's back?
*Bumblebee: Ahhh, great. I hope Wheeljack comes up with something.
*Bonecrusher: Wheeljack? You mean Que?
*Bumblebee: Who?
*Bonecrusher: Nevermind. I assume you're here to get your chassis kicked. Let's get this over with.

sections.heading: The Equalizer
sections.text:
Part 1
*Bonecrusher: Master, they know you're back.
*Megatron (ROTF): And how could that be?
*Bonecrusher: How would I know? But, I am curious. Why did you come back?
*Megatron (ROTF): Why should I tell you? So you can share more intel with the enemy?
*Bonecrusher: That is ridiculous and unfounded! I told you, I don't know how they know... they just do.
*Megatron (ROTF): It matters not. The time is upon us. Realities have collided and we must prepare.
*Bonecrusher: Prepare for what?
*Megatron (ROTF): The return... of a god.
Part 2
*Mirage: It's official. He's back. I saw him with my own optical orbs.
*Optimus Prime (MV1): If that is true, I will organize a squad and set out with the Commander. We know him best.
*Optimus Prime: I suspect that is the beast course of action. But before you embark on your mission, perhaps some training is in order.
*Optimus Prime (MV1): What do you have in mind?
*Optimus Prime: Wheeljack recently arrived. He has cooked up something that he says may help.
*Optimus Prime (MV1): Que?
*Optimus Prime: No, why do people keep calling him that? Anyway, Wheeljack is up ahead. He wants to test his new device. It is called the Equalizer. It may tips the scales in our favor.
Part 3
*Optimus Prime (MV1): Que?
*Wheeljack: Jeez, why do you guys keep calling me that? The name's Wheeljack.
*Optimus Prime (MV1): Sorry, my friend. In my reality you are known by another moniker. I was told you have something you want to test.
*Wheeljack: I do. It's some tech... a mod if you will... that should turn an attacker's aggression against them.
*Optimus Prime (MV1): Sounds intriguing. Will it work?
*Wheeljack: That's why you're here. If you'd be so kind as to be my guinea pigs... Commander, come at me like you mean it.

sections.heading: Preparations
sections.text:
Part 1
*Optimus Prime (MV1): That did not seem to go as planned.
*Wheeljack: Eh, it could have gone better. The Equalizer needs some work.
*Ratchet: What's the problem? Can I help?
*Wheeljack: I think I need to tweak the Quantum Modulator.
*Ratchet: The What Whatulator?
*Wheeljack: The Quantum Modulator. C'mon Ratchet. you know I was messing around with one back on Earth.
*Optimus Prime (MV1): Is that even a thing?
*Ratchet: It could be... but it's fraught with potential danger.
*Wheeljack: Could be? It is a thing. And when I tweak it, The Equalizer will turn the tide against the Decepticons! Trust me, I've got his.
Part 2
*Grindor: Is this what I think it is?
*Barricade: Are you...
*Bonecrusher: Getting the bank back together?
*Megatron (ROTF): That is a bit too vermin colloquial... but yes, we are gathering the proper forces together.
*Grindor: To what end?
*Megatron (ROTF): To end the Autobots, of course. Ready yourselves for what's coming. Destiny awaits those willing to shape and... own it.
Part 3
*Optimus Prime (MV1): Commnander. I surmise our assumptions are correct. Megatron has returned. This two-bit tin pot lackey confirms it.
*Grindor: Words of an Autobot scum do not bother me.
*Optimus Prime (MV1): What about an Energon Hook in your optic? Would that bother you?
*Grindor: I'd like to see you try that.
*Optimus Prime (MV1): I believe this is a... how would you humans say... "been there done that" moment. Commander, it is time to go there and do that... again.

sections.heading: Namesakes
sections.text:
Part 1
*Barricade: I get it. You're my superior officer. I'm following orders...
*Megatron (ROTF): And is there a problem?
*Barricade: You could say that. The Autobots and that Commander keep coming at us. And we keep getting the scrap kicked out of us. I need to know. Is it worth it?
*Megatron (ROTF): Never question me! But this once, I shall answer. When he shows himself, you will see it was worth it.
*Barricade: Who is he?
*Megatron (ROTF): One from before time. The only one that matters.The one that I owe my name to.
Part 2
*Barricade: Optimus and the vermin Commander approach. I shall serve and protect you by punishing and enslaving.
*Megatron (ROTF): Both wise and loyal. You shall be rewarded when the time arrives.
*Barricade: Which is when?
*Megatron (ROTF): When his stasis chamber opens... and he emerges.
*Barricade: This cryptic talk is beyond me.
*Megatron (ROTF): I am aware. That is why you must go forth and do your duty. Interrogate the enemy... by any means necessary!
Part 3
*Barricade: That's all you brought? Sure you don't want to go and get some back up?
*Optimus Prime (MV1): The Commander has the situation well at hand. But, before we continue, I ask you a question. Why did Megatron return? You witnessed his defeat. He is done.
*Barricade: Silence! I ask the questions here, and I have only one. Are you prepared to die?

sections.heading: Rust Removal
sections.text:
Part 1
*Optimus Prime (MV1): Powerful forces are aligning against yet again.
*Hound: You got that right, chief. The only cat missing is Megatron.
*Optimus Prime (MV1): He is here. He just has not shown himself yet.
*Hound: Well, that's just great. But why is he coming back now? Didn't you guys send him running with his tailpipe between his legs?
*Optimus Prime (MV1): I fear he has learned what the other faction of Deceptions has.
*Hound: What's that?
*Optimus Prime (MV1): That we are on the verge of a return of a powerful being... perhaps too powerful to comprehend.
Part 2
*Megatron (ROTF): I see in my absence you did not bother to improve your fighting proficiency.
*Barricade: If you're so great and proficient, why don't you enter the fight?
*Megatron (ROTF): Contained in your insolence is a modicum of sage advice.
*Barricade: Does that mean you're going to take on the Autobots and their vermin leader?
*Megatron (ROTF): Indeed it does. It would be wise for me to remove the rust in preparation for when the true day of reckoning arrives.
Part 3
*Hound: Look, Commander, somebody decided to show up and play with the big boys.
*Optimus Prime (MV1): Do not underestimate our foe, Hound. No matter the reason for his absence, his return should not be taken lightly.
*Megatron (ROTF): For once Prime is right. And, it is not just my return you should fear.
*Optimus Prime (MV1): So it is true you know?
*Megatron (ROTF): About Megatronus? Only a fool would not know. I may be many things, but a fool... I am not.

sections.heading: The Re-Equalizer
sections.text:
Part 1
*Optimus Prime: I know you have heard this before, but time is of the essence. Wheeljack, are you ready to test your modifications?
*Wheeljack: If we are going to test the all new Re-Equalizer, I suggest putting some distance between us and HQ.
*Prowl: Given your track record I'd say that's wise.
*Wheeljack: Ouch, Prowl. That's kind of mean.
*Prowl: And kind of accurate. Remember what happened to Autobot Headquarters when you created the Dinobots? Out of control damage.
*Optimus Prime: And remember what happened next? Wheeljack persisted and now we have valuable new allies and friends...
Part 2
*Prowl: How much do you want to bet Jack's "Re-Equalizer" blows up in his face? "Re-Equalizer", what a dumb name.
*Bumblebee: Lighten up, his spark's in the right place.
*Prowl: It might not be after the test... physically.
*Optimus Prime: Remember this, Prowl... for every time one of his inventions has backfired there are two examples of him saving the day. Respect our comrade.
Part 3
*Prowl: Should we get this over with?
*Wheeljack: You don't seem excited. Have some faith.
*Prowl: Oh, I have faith... faith that your Re-Equalizer will either shock, burn, or disintegrate you.
*Optimus Prime: Show some respect, Prowl. That is an order. Wheeljack, proceed.

sections.heading: Synopsis
sections.text: Seeing the possibilities of a new arrival, Arcee and Windblade seek to see if Slipstream can be reasoned with, and possibly even recruited. However the Bots don’t exactly see optic to optic and Slipstream seems more interested in leading a new team rather than joining any of the old ones. Will Arcee and Windblade convince this Decepticon to fight for the greater good? Or will we really figure out which are the Bots WHO RUN THE WORLD?
